    if not x or not y then return end
    pcall(function() VIM:SendMouseMoveEvent(x, y, game) end)
end

R.ai.attackInputBlocked =                   function()
    local ok,blocked=pcall(function()
        return UIS:GetFocusedTextBox()~=nil or game:GetService("GuiService").MenuIsOpen
    end)
    return not ok or blocked
end 
R.ai.attackPixelClear =                   function(x,y)
    local playerGui=LP and LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    local ok,coreGui=pcall(function()return game:GetService("CoreGui")end)
    if not playerGui or not ok or not coreGui then return false end
    for _,gui in ipairs({playerGui,coreGui})do
        local ok,objects=pcall(function()return gui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(x,y)end)
        if not ok then return false end
        for _,object in ipairs(objects)do
            if object:IsA("GuiButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") or object:IsA("ScrollingFrame") or object.Active
                or object.BackgroundTransparency<.98
                or object:IsA("ImageLabel") and object.Image~="" and object.ImageTransparency<.98
                or object:IsA("TextLabel") and object.Text~="" and object.TextTransparency<.98 then return false end
        end
    end
    return true
end 
R.ai.attackClickPoint =                   function(x,y)
    if R.ai.attackInputBlocked() then return end
    local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera;if not camera then return end
    local size=camera.ViewportSize
    local check; check = function(px,py)
        return px and py and px>=INSET.X+8 and py>=INSET.Y+8 and px<size.X+INSET.X-8 and py<size.Y+INSET.Y-8
            and R.ai.attackPixelClear(px,py)
    end
    if check(x,y) then return x,y end
                                                                             
                                                                               
    for _,point in ipairs({{.5,.5},{.5,.25},{.5,.75},{.25,.5},{.75,.5},{.25,.25},{.75,.25},{.25,.75},{.75,.75}})do
        local px,py=size.X*point[1]+INSET.X,size.Y*point[2]+INSET.Y
        if check(px,py)then return px,py end
    end
end 
local function clickAt(x,y)
    if R.ai.attackClickBusy then return end
    local px,py=R.ai.attackClickPoint(x,y)
    if not px then return end
    R.ai.attackClickBusy=true
    task.spawn(function()
        local down=false
        pcall(function()
            if R.ai.attackInputBlocked() or not R.ai.attackPixelClear(px,py) then return end
            VIM:SendMouseMoveEvent(px,py,game)
            VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(px,py,0,true,game,1);down=true
            task.wait(.04)
        end)
        if down then
                                                                             
            if not R.ai.attackPixelClear(px,py) then px,py=R.ai.attackClickPoint(nil,nil) end
            pcall(function()VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(px or -1000,py or -1000,0,false,game,1)end)
        end
        R.ai.attackClickBusy=false
        if x and y and not R.ai.attackInputBlocked() then moveMouse(x,y) end
    end)
end


                                                                
                                   
                                                                

                                                            
local steerCamera; steerCamera =                   function(pos)
    if not pos then return end
    R.camLook = pos
end 

local releaseCamera; releaseCamera =                   function()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if cam and R.camHooked then
        pcall(function() cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom end)
        R.camHooked = false
    end
end 

local CAM_RAY = RaycastParams.new()
CAM_RAY.IgnoreWater = true
if not pcall(function() CAM_RAY.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude end) then
    pcall(function() CAM_RAY.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist end)
end

                                                                     
                                                                                   
local solveEye; solveEye =                   function(focus, dir, dist, height)
    local now = os.clock()
    if not R.camIgnore or now - R.camIgnoreAt > 0.3 then
        R.camIgnoreAt = now
        local ig = {}
        local c = char()
        if c then ig[#ig + 1] = c end
        for _, e in ipairs(R.enemies) do ig[#ig + 1] = e.model end
        R.camIgnore = ig
    end
    CAM_RAY.FilterDescendantsInstances = R.camIgnore
    local minD = tonumber(S.CamMinDistance) or 5
    for _, h in ipairs({ height, height * 1.7, height * 2.6 }) do
        local toEye = (Vector3.new(0, h, 0) - dir * dist)
        if toEye.Magnitude > 0.1 then
            local hit = workspace:Raycast(focus, toEye, CAM_RAY)
            if not hit then return focus + toEye end
            local free = (hit.Position - focus).Magnitude - 1
            if free >= minD then return focus + toEye.Unit * free end
        end
    end
                                                                          
    return focus + Vector3.new(0, math.max(minD + 2, height * 1.8), 0) - dir * 6
end 

local camStep; camStep =                   function(dt)
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end
    if not R.farming or not S.SteerCamera or S.MoveMode == "VIM Keys" then
        if R.camHooked then releaseCamera() end
        return
    end
    local rp = root()
    local look = R.camLook
    if not rp or not look then return end
    if cam.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
        cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
        R.camHooked = true
    end
    local focus = rp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
    local dir = flat(look - rp.Position)
    if dir.Magnitude < 0.3 then dir = flat(cam.CFrame.LookVector) end
    dir = dir.Magnitude > 0.05 and dir.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
    local eye = solveEye(focus, dir, tonumber(S.CamDistance) or 16, tonumber(S.CamHeight) or 8)
    local aimAt = Vector3.new(look.X, look.Y + 1.5, look.Z)
    if (aimAt - eye).Magnitude < 2 then aimAt = eye + dir * 10 end
    local goal = CFrame.lookAt(eye, aimAt)
    local a = math.clamp(1 - math.exp(-dt * (tonumber(S.CamSmooth) or 12)), 0.02, 1)
    cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame:Lerp(goal, a)
end 

local releaseBodyLock; releaseBodyLock =                   function()
    if R.lockAtt then pcall(function() R.lockAtt:Destroy() end) end
    if R.faceLock then pcall(function() R.faceLock:Destroy() end) end
    local h = hum()
    if h then pcall(function() h.AutoRotate = true end) end
    R.faceLock, R.lockAtt, R.lockPart = nil, nil, nil
end 

                                                                                  
                                                                               
                                                                                
local ensureLock; ensureLock =                   function()
    local rp = root()
    if not rp then releaseBodyLock() return nil end
    if R.lockPart and R.lockPart ~= rp then releaseBodyLock() end
    if not R.faceLock or not R.faceLock.Parent then
        releaseBodyLock()
        local ok = pcall(function()
            local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
            att.Name = "DQBotFaceAtt"
            att.Parent = rp
            local ao = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
            ao.Name = "DQBotFace"
            ao.Attachment0 = att
            ao.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
            ao.RigidityEnabled = false
            ao.MaxTorque = 120000
            ao.MaxAngularVelocity = math.rad(720)
            ao.Responsiveness = 40
            ao.Parent = rp
            R.lockAtt, R.faceLock, R.lockPart = att, ao, rp
        end)
        if not ok then releaseBodyLock() return nil end
    end
    return R.faceLock, rp
end 

local faceStep; faceStep =                   function()
    if R.riseOn then
        if R.faceLock then releaseBodyLock() end
        return
    end
    if not R.farming or not S.BodyLock or not alive() then
        if R.faceLock then releaseBodyLock() end
        return
    end
    local look = R.faceWant
    if not look then
                                                                                   
        local h = hum()
        if h then pcall(function() h.AutoRotate = true end) end
        if R.faceLock then R.faceLock.MaxTorque = 0 end
        return
    end
    local ao, rp = ensureLock()
    if not ao or not rp then return end
    local dir = flat(look - rp.Position)
    if dir.Magnitude < 0.2 then dir = flat(rp.CFrame.LookVector) end
    if dir.Magnitude < 0.05 then return end
    dir = dir.Unit
                                                                              
                                                             
    local h = hum()
    if h then pcall(function() h.AutoRotate = false end) end
    ao.MaxTorque = 120000
    ao.Responsiveness = math.clamp(tonumber(S.LockTurnSpeed) or 40, 5, 200)
    ao.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), dir)
end 

function R.ai.releaseRise()
                                                                                         
    local h = hum()
    if h then pcall(function() h.PlatformStand = false end) end
    if R.riseAtt then pcall(function() R.riseAtt:Destroy() end) end
    if R.risePos then pcall(function() R.risePos:Destroy() end) end
    if R.riseFlip then pcall(function() R.riseFlip:Destroy() end) end
    R.riseAtt, R.risePos, R.riseFlip, R.riseOn = nil, nil, nil, false
    R.riseRoot=nil
    R.ai.gridPath=nil; R.ai.committedPoint=nil; R.ai.lookahead=nil
    R.risePinX, R.risePinZ, R.riseLiftY = nil, nil, nil
    R.riseLanding, R.riseLandStart, R.riseLandFromY, R.riseLandRestY = nil, nil, nil, nil
end

                                                                  
function R.ai.ensureRise(rp)
    if not R.risePos or not R.risePos.Parent then
        R.ai.releaseRise()
        local ok = pcall(function()
            local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
            att.Name = "DQBotRiseAtt"
            R.riseAtt=att; R.riseRoot=rp
            att.Parent = rp
            local ap = Instance.new("AlignPosition")
            ap.Name = "DQBotRise"
            ap.Attachment0 = att
            ap.Mode = Enum.PositionAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
            ap.RigidityEnabled = false
            ap.ApplyAtCenterOfMass = true
            ap.MaxForce = math.clamp(tonumber(S.RiseForce) or 55000, 20000, 150000)
            ap.MaxVelocity = 18
            ap.Responsiveness = 18
            R.risePos=ap
            ap.Parent = rp
                                                                                      
                                                                           
            local ao = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
            ao.Name = "DQBotRiseLook"
            ao.Attachment0 = att
            ao.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
            ao.RigidityEnabled = false
            ao.MaxTorque = 60000
            ao.MaxAngularVelocity = 8
            ao.Responsiveness = 12
            R.riseFlip=ao
            ao.Parent = rp
            R.riseAtt, R.risePos, R.riseFlip = att, ap, ao
        end)
        if not ok then R.ai.releaseRise() return nil end
    end
    return R.risePos
end

                                                                          
function R.ai.closestMob(rp)
    local best, bestD
    for _, e in ipairs(R.enemies) do
        if enemyAlive(e.model) then
            local d = (e.root.Position - rp.Position).Magnitude
            if not bestD or d < bestD then best, bestD = e, d end
        end
    end
    return best, bestD
end

                                                                                     
                                                                                 
function R.ai.riseRestY(rp)
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local ignore = {}
    if rp.Parent then table.insert(ignore, rp.Parent) end
    for _, e in ipairs(R.enemies) do
        if e.model then table.insert(ignore, e.model) end
    end
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
    local hit = workspace:Raycast(rp.Position, Vector3.new(0, -400, 0), params)
    local groundY = (hit and hit.Position.Y) or (R.riseLiftY or (rp.Position.Y - 3))
    local h = hum()
    return groundY + (h and h.HipHeight or 2) + (rp.Size.Y / 2)
end

                                                                                         
                                                                                              
function R.ai.landRise(rp)
    local ap = R.risePos
    if not ap then R.ai.releaseRise() return end
    local now = os.clock()
    if not R.riseLanding then
        R.riseLanding = true
        R.riseLandStart = now
        R.riseLandFromY = ap.Position.Y
        R.riseLandRestY = R.ai.riseRestY(rp)
        ap.MaxVelocity = 26
                                                                    
        if R.riseFlip then
            local lv = rp.CFrame.LookVector
            local fl = Vector3.new(lv.X, 0, lv.Z)
            if fl.Magnitude < 0.05 then fl = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
            R.riseFlip.MaxAngularVelocity = 30
            R.riseFlip.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), fl.Unit)
        end
    end
    local dur = 0.7
    local a = (now - (R.riseLandStart or now)) / dur
    if a >= 1 then
        R.ai.releaseRise()
        local h = hum()
        if h then
            pcall(function() h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed) end)
            pcall(function() h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end)
        end
        return
    end
    local fromY = R.riseLandFromY or ap.Position.Y
    local restY = (R.riseLandRestY or fromY) + 0.5
    ap.Position = Vector3.new(R.risePinX or rp.Position.X, fromY + (restY - fromY) * a, R.risePinZ or rp.Position.Z)
end

                                                         
function R.ai.riseStep()
    local rp = root()
                                                                                  
    if not R.farming or not S.Rise or not alive() or not inDungeon() or not rp then
        if R.riseOn then R.ai.releaseRise() end
        return
    end
    if R.riseRoot and R.riseRoot ~= rp then R.ai.releaseRise() end
    local mob, md = R.ai.closestMob(rp)
    local near = tonumber(S.RiseNear) or 20
                                                                                            
    local trigger = R.riseOn and (near * 1.6) or near
    local wantRise = mob and md and md <= trigger
    if not wantRise then
                                                                                            
        if R.riseOn then R.ai.landRise(rp) end
        return
    end

    local ap = R.ai.ensureRise(rp)
    if not ap then return end
    R.riseOn = true
    R.riseLanding, R.riseLandStart = nil, nil                                                     
                                                                                          
    if not R.risePinX then
        R.ai.generation += 1
        R.ai.gridPath=nil; R.ai.committedPoint=nil; R.ai.lookahead=nil
        R.risePinX, R.risePinZ = rp.Position.X, rp.Position.Z
        R.riseLiftY = rp.Position.Y
    end
    local height = math.clamp(tonumber(S.RiseHeight) or 5, 1, 5)
    ap.MaxForce = math.clamp(tonumber(S.RiseForce) or 55000, 20000, 150000)
    ap.MaxVelocity = 18
    ap.Responsiveness = 18
    ap.Position = Vector3.new(R.risePinX, (R.riseLiftY or rp.Position.Y) + height, R.risePinZ)
                                                                               
    if R.riseFlip then
        R.riseFlip.MaxAngularVelocity = 8
        R.riseFlip.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, Vector3.new(0,-1,0), Vector3.new(0,0,-1))
    end
end


local stopMoving; stopMoving =                   function()
    R.ai.moving = false
    R.ai.emergencyDirection=nil
    R.ai.commandDirection=nil
    if R.ai.preview then R.ai.hideArrows() end
    releaseAll()
    if S.MoveMode == "Humanoid Move" then
        local h = hum()
        if h then h:Move(Vector3.new(), false) end
    end
end 

                                                                                    
local driveKeys; driveKeys =                   function(dir)
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then stopMoving() return end
    local fwd = flat(cam.CFrame.LookVector)
    if fwd.Magnitude <= 0.05 then
        local rp = root()
        fwd = rp and flat(rp.CFrame.LookVector) or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
    end
    fwd = fwd.Magnitude > 0.05 and fwd.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
    local right = fwd:Cross(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
    local ang = math.deg(math.atan2(dir:Dot(right), dir:Dot(fwd)))
    local best, bestDiff
    for _, c in ipairs(COMBOS) do
        local diff = math.abs(((c.ang - ang + 180) % 360) - 180)
        if not bestDiff or diff < bestDiff then best, bestDiff = c, diff end
    end
    local want = {}
    for _, k in ipairs(best.keys) do want[k] = true end
    for k in pairs(MOVE_KEYS) do setKey(k, want[k] == true) end
end 

local pushDir; pushDir =                   function(dir)
    R.ai.emergencyDirection=nil
    if not dir then stopMoving() return end
    local f = flat(dir)
    if f.Magnitude < 0.05 then stopMoving() return end
    f = f.Unit
    f = R.ai.safeDirection(f)
    if not f then stopMoving(); R.ai.forcePathUntil=os.clock()+2; return end
    R.ai.moving = true
    R.ai.commandDirection=f
    if R.ai.render then R.ai.render(f) end
    if S.MoveMode == "Humanoid Move" then
        releaseAll()
        local h = hum()
        if h then h:Move(f, false) end
    else
        driveKeys(f)
    end
end 

                                                                            
                                                                            
                                                                               
R.ai.commandEnd =                   function(from,to)
    local delta=flat(to-from)
    return from+(delta.Magnitude>.01 and delta.Unit*math.min(6,delta.Magnitude) or Vector3.zero)
end 
R.ai.advanceWaypoints =                   function(rp,route,escape)
    local lead=math.clamp((hum() and hum().WalkSpeed or 16)*.2,2,6)
    for _=1,8 do
        if #route<2 or (route[1]-rp.Position).Magnitude>lead then break end
        local nextPoint=route[2]
        if not R.ai.connectedSegment(rp.Position,nextPoint) then break end
        local safe=escape and R.ai.nonWorseningEscape(rp.Position,nextPoint,R.ai.escapeMargin or R.ai.margin)
            or R.ai.routeStepSafe(rp.Position,nextPoint)
        if not safe then break end
        table.remove(route,1)
    end
end 
R.ai.routeStepSafe =                   function(from,to)
                                                                           
                                                                            
    local endpoint=R.ai.commandEnd(from,to)
    if R.ai.coverStepSafe and R.ai.coverStepSafe(from,endpoint) then return true end
    local projectilePoint=R.ai.projectileEscapePoint
    if R.evadeWhy=="PROJECTILE" and projectilePoint
        and flat(R.ai.commandEnd(from,projectilePoint)-endpoint).Magnitude<.1 then
        return R.ai.escapeStepSafe(from,endpoint)
    end
    local plan=R.ai.areaEscapePlan
    if plan and plan.generation==R.ai.generation and plan.point
        and flat(R.ai.commandEnd(from,plan.point)-endpoint).Magnitude<.1
        and R.ai.escapeMargin(plan.point)>=(plan.clearance or 4) then
        return R.ai.escapeStepSafe(from,endpoint)
    end
    return R.ai.safePass(from,endpoint)
end 
R.ai.applyEmergencyMove =                   function()
    if R.booted and R.farming and R.ai.moving and R.ai.emergencyDirection then
        local h=hum();if h then h:Move(R.ai.emergencyDirection,false) end
    end
end 
local pushVerifiedDir; pushVerifiedDir =                   function(dir,mode)
    local rp=root()
    if not rp or not dir then stopMoving();return false end
    local f=flat(dir)
    if f.Magnitude<0.05 then stopMoving();return false end
    f=f.Unit
    local commandEnd=R.ai.commandEnd(rp.Position,rp.Position+dir)
    local clear,reason
    if mode=="shore" then clear,reason=R.ai.segmentUncached(rp.Position,rp.Position+dir,"shore",true)
    else clear,reason=R.ai.segmentUncached(rp.Position,commandEnd) end
    local safe=false
    if clear then
        if mode=="escape" then safe=R.ai.escapeStepSafe(rp.Position,commandEnd)
        else safe=R.ai.routeStepSafe(rp.Position,rp.Position+dir) end
    end
    if not clear or not safe then
        R.ai.lastMovementReject={at=os.clock(),from=rp.Position,to=commandEnd,
            reason=not clear and (reason or "physical obstruction") or "attack/spacing veto"}
        stopMoving();return false
    end
    R.ai.moving=true
    R.ai.commandDirection=f
    if R.ai.render then R.ai.render(f) end
    R.ai.emergencyDirection=mode=="escape" and f or nil
    if mode=="escape" or S.MoveMode=="Humanoid Move" then
        releaseAll();local h=hum();if h then h:Move(f,false) end
    else driveKeys(f) end
    return true
end 

                                                                
          
                                                                

local RAY = RaycastParams.new()
RAY.IgnoreWater = true
if not pcall(function() RAY.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude end) then
    pcall(function() RAY.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist end)
end

local HAS_ALV = pcall(function() return workspace.Terrain.AssemblyLinearVelocity end)

R.ai.rayParams =                   function()
    if R.ai.cachedRay and os.clock() < (R.ai.rayUntil or 0) then return R.ai.cachedRay end
    local p = RaycastParams.new()
    p.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local ignore = {char()}
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then ignore[#ignore+1] = player.Character end
    end
    for _, e in ipairs(R.enemies) do ignore[#ignore+1] = e.model end
    p.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
    p.RespectCanCollide = true
    p.IgnoreWater = false
    R.ai.cachedRay=p; R.ai.rayUntil=os.clock()+0.08
    return p
end 
R.ai.geometryParams =                   function()
    if R.ai.cachedGeometryRay and os.clock() < (R.ai.geometryRayUntil or 0) then return R.ai.cachedGeometryRay end
    local p=RaycastParams.new()
    p.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local ignore={char()}
    for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then ignore[#ignore+1]=player.Character end
    end
    for _,e in ipairs(R.enemies) do ignore[#ignore+1]=e.model end
    p.FilterDescendantsInstances=ignore
                                                                           
                                                                              
    p.RespectCanCollide=true
    p.IgnoreWater=false
    R.ai.cachedGeometryRay=p;R.ai.geometryRayUntil=os.clock()+0.08
    return p
end 
R.ai.bodyOccupied =                   function(floorPosition)
                                                                      
                                                                       
    local footClearance=math.min(2,tonumber(S.MaxStepHeight) or 2)+.1
    local size=Vector3.new(2.2,4.6-footClearance,2.2)
    local cf=CFrame.new(floorPosition+Vector3.new(0,footClearance+size.Y*.5,0))
                                                                           
                                                                            
                                                                          
    local witness=root()
    if witness and (witness.Position-cf.Position).Magnitude>.05 then
        local rays=R.ai.geometryParams()
        local entry=workspace:Raycast(witness.Position,cf.Position-witness.Position,rays)
        if entry and entry.Instance:IsA("Terrain") and entry.Material~=Enum.Material.Water then
            local back=workspace:Raycast(cf.Position,witness.Position-cf.Position,rays)
            if not back then return true,"Terrain interior" end
        end
    end
    local params=OverlapParams.new()
    params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;params.RespectCanCollide=true
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances=R.ai.geometryParams().FilterDescendantsInstances
    if #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cf,size,params)==0 then return false end
                                                                           
                                                                             
    local probe=R.ai.occupancyProbe
    if not probe or not probe.Parent then
        probe=Instance.new("Part");probe.Name="BotNavigationProbe";probe:SetAttribute("BotNavigationVisual",true)
        probe.Anchored=true;probe.CanCollide=false;probe.CanTouch=false;probe.CanQuery=false
        probe.Transparency=1;probe.Size=size;probe.Parent=workspace;R.ai.occupancyProbe=probe
    end
    probe.Size=size;probe.CFrame=cf
    for _,part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartsInPart(probe,params)) do
        if part~=probe and part.CanCollide then return true,part:GetFullName() end
    end
    return false
end 
R.ai.slopeLimit =                   function()
    local h=hum()
    local serverLimit=math.clamp(h and h.MaxSlopeAngle or 45,0,89)
    if S.UseHumanoidSlope then return math.rad(serverLimit) end
    return math.rad(math.min(serverLimit,tonumber(S.MaxWalkSlope) or 45))
end 
                                                                     
                                                                               
                                                                            
local supportFloor; supportFloor =                   function(origin,params)
    local surface=workspace:Raycast(origin,Vector3.new(0,-24,0),params)
    if not surface or surface.Material~=Enum.Material.Water then return surface end
                                                                      
                                                                             
    local dry=RaycastParams.new()
    dry.FilterType=params.FilterType;dry.FilterDescendantsInstances=params.FilterDescendantsInstances
    dry.CollisionGroup=params.CollisionGroup;dry.RespectCanCollide=true;dry.IgnoreWater=true
    local ground=workspace:Raycast(origin,Vector3.new(0,-24,0),dry)
    if ground and surface.Position.Y-ground.Position.Y>=0 and surface.Position.Y-ground.Position.Y<=1.25
        and ground.Normal.Y>=math.cos(R.ai.slopeLimit())then return ground end
    return surface
end 
local waterSupport; waterSupport =                   function(floor)
    return floor and floor.Material==Enum.Material.Water
end 
local waterAtFootprint; waterAtFootprint =                   function(position,params)
    local wet
    for _,off in ipairs({Vector3.zero,Vector3.new(1.25,0,0),Vector3.new(-1.25,0,0),Vector3.new(0,0,1.25),Vector3.new(0,0,-1.25)}) do
        local hit=supportFloor(position+off+Vector3.new(0,4,0),params)
        if waterSupport(hit) and (not wet or hit.Position.Y>wet.Position.Y) then wet=hit end
    end
    return wet
end 
local structuralHit; structuralHit =                   function(hit)
    if not hit or not hit.Instance then return false end
                                                                            
                                                                             
                                                                   
    if hit.Normal and hit.Normal.Y>=math.cos(R.ai.slopeLimit()) then return false end
    local inst=hit.Instance
    return inst:IsA("Terrain") or (inst:IsA("BasePart") and inst.CanCollide)
end 
local walkableSupport; walkableSupport =                   function(floor,params,slope)
    if not floor or waterSupport(floor) then return false end
    if floor.Normal.Y>=math.cos(slope) then return true end
    if not floor.Instance then return false end
                                                                          
                                                                         
                                                                           
                                                                             
                                                                       
    local good=0;local limit=tonumber(S.MaxStepHeight) or 2
    for _,off in ipairs({Vector3.new(1.25,0,0),Vector3.new(-1.25,0,0),Vector3.new(0,0,1.25),Vector3.new(0,0,-1.25)}) do
        local edge=supportFloor(floor.Position+off+Vector3.new(0,2,0),params)
        if not edge or waterSupport(edge) or math.abs(edge.Position.Y-floor.Position.Y)>limit+off.Magnitude*math.tan(slope) then return false end
        if edge.Normal.Y>=math.cos(slope) then good+=1 end
    end
    return good>=2
end 
local supportTransition; supportTransition =                   function(from,to,slope,fromNormal,toNormal)
    local rise=to.Y-from.Y
    local run=flat(to-from).Magnitude
    local ramp=run*math.tan(slope)+0.15
                                                                         
                                                                            
    if fromNormal and toNormal and run>.01 then
        local direction=flat(to-from)/run
        local grade; grade = function(normal)
            return math.abs(normal.X*direction.X+normal.Z*direction.Z)/math.max(.017,normal.Y)
        end
        ramp=math.min(ramp,run*math.max(grade(fromNormal),grade(toNormal))+.15)
    end
    return rise<=math.max(tonumber(S.MaxStepHeight) or 2,ramp)
        and rise>=-math.max(tonumber(S.MaxStepDown) or 4,ramp)
end 
                                                                         
                                                                            
                                                                             
R.ai.supportFooting =                   function(origin,expectedY,params,slope)
    local direct=supportFloor(origin,params)
    if waterSupport(direct) then return direct end
    if direct and direct.Position.Y>=expectedY-(tonumber(S.MaxStepDown) or 4) then return direct end
    local rp=root()
    local radius=rp and rp.Size and math.max(rp.Size.X,rp.Size.Z)*.5 or 1
    local reach=math.clamp(radius-.1,.25,.9)
    local limit=tonumber(S.MaxStepHeight) or 2
    for _,axis in ipairs({Vector3.new(reach,0,0),Vector3.new(0,0,reach)}) do
        local left=supportFloor(origin-axis,params)
        local right=supportFloor(origin+axis,params)
        if not left or not right or waterSupport(left) or waterSupport(right) then continue end
        if left.Normal.Y<math.cos(slope) or right.Normal.Y<math.cos(slope) then continue end
        if math.abs(left.Position.Y-right.Position.Y)>.2 then continue end
        local height=(left.Position.Y+right.Position.Y)*.5
        if math.abs(height-expectedY)>limit then continue end
        return {Position=Vector3.new(origin.X,height,origin.Z),Normal=(left.Normal+right.Normal).Unit,
            Instance=left.Instance,Material=left.Material,footprintSupport=true}
    end
    return direct
end 

local supportProfile; supportProfile =                   function(floor,offset,params,slope,taught)
    local previous=floor.Position
    local previousNormal=floor.Normal
    local count=math.max(1,math.ceil(offset.Magnitude/.5))
    for i=1,count do
        local xz=floor.Position+offset*(i/count)
        local edge=R.ai.supportFooting(Vector3.new(xz.X,previous.Y+math.max(2.25,(tonumber(S.MaxStepHeight) or 2)+.25),xz.Z),previous.Y,params,slope)
        if not edge then return taught==true end
        if waterSupport(edge) or not walkableSupport(edge,params,slope) or not supportTransition(previous,edge.Position,slope,previousNormal,edge.Normal) then return false end
        previous=edge.Position;previousNormal=edge.Normal
    end
    return true
end 
R.ai.segmentUncached =                   function(from, to, ignoreMap, requireArrival)
    local delta=flat(to-from)
    if delta.Magnitude<0.1 then
        if waterAtFootprint(from,R.ai.rayParams()) then return false,"water is not walking support" end
        return not requireArrival or math.abs(to.Y-from.Y)<=1.5,"different floor"
    end
    local p=R.ai.rayParams()
    local geom=R.ai.geometryParams()
    local wetParams,depthLimit,leftWater
    if ignoreMap=="shore" then
                                                                                
                                                                         
        local surface=waterAtFootprint(from,p)
        if not waterSupport(surface) then return false,"shore exit must start in water" end
        wetParams=p
        local dry=RaycastParams.new()
        dry.FilterType=p.FilterType;dry.FilterDescendantsInstances=p.FilterDescendantsInstances
        dry.RespectCanCollide=true;dry.IgnoreWater=true
        local ground=supportFloor(from+Vector3.new(0,1,0),dry)
        if not ground or math.abs(ground.Position.Y+3-from.Y)>1.5 then return false,"no grounded water exit" end
        depthLimit=math.max(0,surface.Position.Y-ground.Position.Y)+.35
        for _,off in ipairs({Vector3.new(1.25,0,0),Vector3.new(-1.25,0,0),Vector3.new(0,0,1.25),Vector3.new(0,0,-1.25)}) do
            local edge=supportFloor(from+off+Vector3.new(0,1,0),dry)
            if edge then depthLimit=math.max(depthLimit,surface.Position.Y-edge.Position.Y+.35) end
        end
        p=dry;geom=dry
    end
                                                                             
                                                                           
    local avatarRoot=root()
    local footprint=avatarRoot and avatarRoot.Size and math.max(avatarRoot.Size.X,avatarRoot.Size.Z)*.5+.1 or 1.1
    local side=Vector3.new(-delta.Z,0,delta.X).Unit*footprint
    local previous,previousNormal
    local slope=R.ai.slopeLimit()
                                                                           
                                                                             
                                                                           
    local sampleStep=.75
    local count=math.max(1,math.ceil(delta.Magnitude/sampleStep))
    for i=0,count do
        local point=from+(to-from)*(math.min(i*sampleStep,delta.Magnitude)/delta.Magnitude)
        local taught=ignoreMap=="taught" or (R.ai.drawnCorridorContains and R.ai.drawnCorridorContains(point))
                                                                             
                                                                             
                                                                           
        local expected=point
        point=Vector3.new(point.X,previous and previous.Y+3 or from.Y,point.Z)
        local floor=R.ai.supportFooting(point+Vector3.new(0,4,0),point.Y-3,p,slope)
        if waterSupport(floor) then return false,"water is not walking support" end
                                                                        
                                                                        
        if not floor and taught then floor={Position=expected-Vector3.new(0,3,0),Normal=Vector3.yAxis} end
        if not walkableSupport(floor,p,slope) then
                                                                           
                                                                   
            if i==0 then previous=nil; continue end
            return false,floor and "steep floor" or "unscanned floor"
        end
        if i==0 and requireArrival and math.abs(floor.Position.Y+3-from.Y)>1.5 then
                                                                            
                                                                          
                                                                             
                                                                       
            local actual=root();local supporting
            if actual and (actual.Position-from).Magnitude<1 then
                for _,off in ipairs({Vector3.new(1,0,0),Vector3.new(-1,0,0),Vector3.new(0,0,1),Vector3.new(0,0,-1)}) do
                    local hit=supportFloor(from+off+Vector3.new(0,1,0),p)
                    if hit and walkableSupport(hit,p,slope) and math.abs(hit.Position.Y+3-from.Y)<=1.5 then
                        if not supporting or math.abs(hit.Position.Y+3-from.Y)<math.abs(supporting.Position.Y+3-from.Y) then supporting=hit end
                    end
                end
            end
            if not supporting then return false,"start floor mismatch" end
            floor={Position=Vector3.new(from.X,supporting.Position.Y,from.Z),Normal=supporting.Normal,Instance=supporting.Instance,Material=supporting.Material}
        end
        if wetParams then
            local wet=false
            for _,off in ipairs({Vector3.zero,side,-side}) do
                local ground=supportFloor(floor.Position+off+Vector3.new(0,2,0),p)
                if not ground then return false,"missing seabed" end
                local surface=supportFloor(ground.Position+Vector3.new(0,depthLimit+2,0),wetParams)
                if waterSupport(surface) then
                    wet=true
                    if leftWater or surface.Position.Y-ground.Position.Y>depthLimit then return false,"deeper water" end
                end
            end
            if not wet then leftWater=true end
            if i==count and (wet or waterAtFootprint(floor.Position+Vector3.new(0,3,0),wetParams)) then
                return false,"exit does not reach dry ground"
            end
        end
        if previous then
            if not supportTransition(previous,floor.Position,slope,previousNormal,floor.Normal) then return false,"step/drop" end
            local move=floor.Position-previous
                                                                           
                                                                            
                                                                           
                                                                           
                                                                             
            local supportY=math.max(previous.Y,floor.Position.Y)
            local stepHeight=tonumber(S.MaxStepHeight) or 2
            local sweepStart=Vector3.new(previous.X,supportY+stepHeight+1.7,previous.Z)
            local horizontal=Vector3.new(move.X,0,move.Z)
            if move.Magnitude>0.01 then
            local body=workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(sweepStart),
                    Vector3.new(2.2,3.2,2.2),horizontal,geom)
            if structuralHit(body) then return false,"wall: "..body.Instance:GetFullName(),body.Instance end
            end
            for _,off in ipairs({Vector3.zero,side,-side}) do
                for _,height in ipairs({1.5,3.5}) do
                    local hit=workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(previous.X,supportY,previous.Z)
                        +off+Vector3.new(0,math.max(height,stepHeight+0.1),0),horizontal,geom)
                    if structuralHit(hit) then return false,"wall: "..hit.Instance:GetFullName(),hit.Instance end
                end
            end
        end
        local ceiling=workspace:Raycast(floor.Position+Vector3.new(0,0.2,0),Vector3.new(0,4.6,0),geom)
        if ceiling then return false,"insufficient headroom" end
                                                                                  
        for _,off in ipairs({side,-side}) do
            if not supportProfile(floor,off,p,slope,taught) and i~=0 then return false,"unsupported edge/height" end
        end
                                                                          
                                                                              
                                                                              
                                                                   
        previous=floor.Position;previousNormal=floor.Normal
    end
    if requireArrival and (not previous or math.abs(previous.Y+3-to.Y)>1.5) then
        return false,"destination is on another floor"
    end
    return true,nil,nil,previous and Vector3.new(to.X,previous.Y+3,to.Z) or to
end 
R.ai.connectedSegment =                   function(from,to,mode)
                                                                              
    return R.ai.segmentUncached(from,to,mode,true)
end 
R.ai.navigationGoal =                   function(position)
    local floor=supportFloor(position+Vector3.new(0,4,0),R.ai.rayParams())
    local point=floor and not waterSupport(floor) and floor.Position+Vector3.new(0,3,0) or position
    return (point-position).Magnitude<.001 and position or point
end 

function R.ai.followShoreExit(rp)
    local surface=waterAtFootprint(rp.Position,R.ai.rayParams())
    if not waterSupport(surface) then R.ai.shoreExit=nil;R.ai.shoreFailure=nil;return false end
    local plan=R.ai.shoreExit
    if plan and (plan.root~=rp or plan.generation~=R.ai.generation) then R.ai.shoreExit=nil;plan=nil end
    if plan and R.ai.safePass(rp.Position,plan.point) and pushVerifiedDir(plan.point-rp.Position,"shore") then
        R.status="following solid slope out of water";return true
    end
    if plan then R.ai.shoreExit=nil;R.ai.shoreFailure=nil end
    local failed=R.ai.shoreFailure
    local unchanged=failed and failed.revision==R.ai.mapTopologyRevision and (failed.position-rp.Position).Magnitude<.5
    if not R.ai.shoreBusy and not unchanged then
        R.ai.shoreBusy=true
        R.ai.planEpoch=(R.ai.planEpoch or 0)+1;R.ai.gridPath=nil;R.ai.committedPoint=nil;R.ai.gridBusy=false
        R.ai.areaEscapePlan=nil;R.ai.coverPlan=nil;R.ai.coverExit=nil
        local generation=R.ai.generation;local from=rp.Position;local revision=R.ai.mapTopologyRevision
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok,point=pcall(function()
                local best,cost
                for i=0,15 do
                    if generation~=R.ai.generation or root()~=rp then return end
                    local angle=i*math.pi/8;local direction=Vector3.new(math.cos(angle),0,math.sin(angle))
                    for distance=3,30,3 do
                        local floor=supportFloor(from+direction*distance+Vector3.new(0,4,0),R.ai.rayParams())
                        if floor and not waterSupport(floor) and walkableSupport(floor,R.ai.rayParams(),R.ai.slopeLimit()) then
                            local finish=floor.Position+Vector3.new(0,3,0)
                            if R.ai.segmentUncached(from,finish,"shore",true) and R.ai.safePass(from,finish) then
                                local value=(finish-from).Magnitude+math.max(0,-R.ai.margin(finish))*4
                                if not cost or value<cost then best,cost=finish,value end
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if i%4==3 then RunService.Heartbeat:Wait() end
                end
                return best
            end)
            if generation==R.ai.generation and root()==rp then
                if ok and point then R.ai.shoreExit={point=point,root=rp,generation=generation}
                else R.ai.shoreFailure={position=from,revision=revision} end
            end
            R.ai.shoreBusy=false
        end)
    end
    stopMoving();R.status=R.ai.shoreFailure and "no checked slope out of water" or "checking solid ground to shore"
    return true
end

                                                                           
                                                                              
                                                                          
                                                                           
                                
function R.ai.rebaseRoute(from,route)
    if type(route)~="table" or #route==0 then return false,"empty route" end
    local candidates={}
    for i,point in ipairs(route) do
        if typeof(point)~="Vector3" then return false,"bad waypoint" end
        candidates[#candidates+1]={index=i,distance=(point-from).Magnitude}
                                                                         
                                                                          
        if i<#route and typeof(route[i+1])=="Vector3" then
            local delta=route[i+1]-point;local length=delta:Dot(delta)
            if length>.01 then
                local t=math.clamp((from-point):Dot(delta)/length,0,1)
                if t>.01 and t<.99 then
                    local projection=point+delta*t
                    candidates[#candidates+1]={index=i+1,point=projection,distance=(projection-from).Magnitude}
                end
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(candidates,function(a,b)
        if a.distance~=b.distance then return a.distance<b.distance end
        return a.index>b.index
    end)
    for _,candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
                                                                            
                                                                  
        if candidate.distance>24 then break end
        local point=candidate.point or route[candidate.index]
        if R.ai.connectedSegment(from,point)
            and (not candidate.point or R.ai.connectedSegment(point,route[candidate.index])) then
            for _=1,candidate.index-1 do table.remove(route,1) end
            if candidate.point and (point-from).Magnitude>.8 then table.insert(route,1,point) end
            R.ai.lastRouteRebase={skipped=candidate.index-1,distance=candidate.distance,at=os.clock()}
            return true
        end
    end
    return false,"no current connection to computed route"
end

function R.ai.simulateRoute(from,route,mode,background)
    if not from or type(route)~="table" or #route==0 then return false,"empty route" end
    if background then
        local joined,why=R.ai.rebaseRoute(from,route)
        if not joined then return false,why end
    end
    local previous=from
    local revision=R.ai.geometryRevision
    for index,point in ipairs(route) do
        if background and R.ai.backgroundCheckpoint then
            R.ai.backgroundCheckpoint("route")
            if revision~=R.ai.geometryRevision then return false,"geometry changed during validation" end
        end
        if typeof(point)~="Vector3" then return false,"bad waypoint" end
        local ok,why=R.ai.connectedSegment(previous,point,mode)
        if not ok then return false,string.format("segment %d: %s",index,why or "blocked") end
        previous=point
    end
    if background then
        local rp=root()
        if rp and (rp.Position-from).Magnitude>.1 then
            local joined,why=R.ai.rebaseRoute(rp.Position,route)
            if not joined then return false,why end
        end
    end
    return true,"ok"
end
R.ai.opennessUncached =                   function(point)
    local total=0
    local params=R.ai.rayParams()
    for i=0,7 do
        local angle=i*math.pi/4
        local dir=Vector3.new(math.cos(angle),0,math.sin(angle))
        local hit=workspace:Raycast(point+Vector3.new(0,1,0),dir*12,params)
        total+=hit and math.min(12,hit.Distance) or 12
    end
    return total/8
end 
R.ai.segment =                   function(from,to)
    local g=R.ai.grid
    if not g then return false end
    local delta=flat(to-from)
    local n=math.max(1,math.ceil(delta.Magnitude/1.5))
    local previous
    for i=0,n do
        local p=from+delta*(i/n)
        local c=R.ai.cell(math.round(p.X/g.size),math.round(p.Z/g.size),previous and previous.pos.Y or from.Y)
        if not R.ai.physicalCell(c) then return false end
        if previous and previous.key~=c.key then
            if not R.ai.mapEdge(previous,c) then return false end
        end
        previous=c
    end
    return true
end 
R.ai.openness =                   function(point)
    local cache=R.ai.openCache or {};R.ai.openCache=cache
    local k=string.format("%d,%d,%d",math.round(point.X/4),math.round(point.Y/4),math.round(point.Z/4))
    if cache[k]==nil then cache[k]=R.ai.opennessUncached(point) end
    return cache[k]
end 
R.ai.keepout =                   function(e)
    local name=string.lower(e.model.Name)
    local base=tonumber(e.reach) or 4
    if e.kind=="Boss" then return math.max(base+10,28) end
    if string.find(name,"brute",1,true) or string.find(name,"golem",1,true) then return math.max(base+8,20) end
    return math.max(base+7,12)
end 
R.ai.impacts={}
R.ai.projectileProfiles={}
R.ai.recentProjectileHits={}
function R.ai.updateProjectile(info,position,velocity,size,cf,now)
                                                                           
                                                                                
    if info.lineCast then info.lineCast.cf=cf or info.lineCast.cf;info.projectile=false;return end
    local dt=info.sampleAt and now-info.sampleAt or 0
    local delta=info.samplePos and position-info.samplePos
    local changed=delta and delta.Magnitude>.05
    local observed=changed and dt>.005 and dt<.5 and delta/dt or nil
                                                                                
                                                                                 
    if not info.samplePos or changed or dt>.5 then info.samplePos=position;info.sampleAt=now end
    local minimumSpeed=info.enemyEffect and .5 or 12
    if observed and observed.Magnitude>minimumSpeed and observed.Magnitude<1500 then
        velocity=observed;info.motionAt=now
        info.motionCadence=(info.motionCadence or dt)*.7+dt*.3
    elseif not changed and velocity.Magnitude<1 and info.lastVel and info.motionAt
        and now-info.motionAt<math.clamp((info.motionCadence or .04)*2.5,.12,.3) then
        velocity=info.lastVel
    end
    if velocity.Magnitude>minimumSpeed and velocity.Magnitude<1500 then info.projectile=true end
    if not info.projectile then return end
    info.lastVel=velocity;info.lastPos=position;info.lastAt=now
    local horizontal=flat(velocity)
    local width=math.min(size.X,size.Z)*.5
    if cf and horizontal.Magnitude>.1 then
        local side=Vector3.new(-horizontal.Z,0,horizontal.X).Unit
        width=(math.abs(cf.RightVector:Dot(side))*size.X
            +math.abs(cf.UpVector:Dot(side))*size.Y+math.abs(cf.LookVector:Dot(side))*size.Z)*.5
    end
    local profile=R.ai.projectileProfiles[info.signature or ""]
    info.radius=math.max(width+(tonumber(S.ProjClearance) or 9),profile and profile.radius or 0)
    info.height=math.max(4,size.Y*.5+3)
end
R.ai.projectileWindow =                   function(info,point,playerVelocity,horizon)
    if not info.lastPos or not info.lastVel then return math.huge,0 end
    local rel=point-info.lastPos
    local velocity=info.lastVel-(playerVelocity or Vector3.zero)
    local horizontal=flat(velocity)
    local first,last=0,horizon
    local height=info.height or 5
    if math.abs(velocity.Y)<.001 then
        if math.abs(rel.Y)>height then return math.huge,0 end
    else
        local a,b=(rel.Y-height)/velocity.Y,(rel.Y+height)/velocity.Y
        first=math.max(first,math.min(a,b));last=math.min(last,math.max(a,b))
        if first>last then return math.huge,first end
    end
                                                                           
                                                                              
    local time=math.clamp(flat(rel):Dot(horizontal)/math.max(horizontal:Dot(horizontal),.001),first,last)
    local closest=rel-velocity*time
    return flat(closest).Magnitude-(info.radius or 9),time
end 
R.ai.projectileMotionMargin =                   function(point,velocity,horizon)
    local margin=math.huge
    local now=os.clock()
    for _,info in pairs(R.watch)do
        if info.projectile and now-(info.lastAt or 0)<.25 then
            local clearance=R.ai.projectileWindow(info,point,velocity,horizon)
            margin=math.min(margin,clearance)
        end
    end
    return margin
end 

                                                                           
                                                                           
                                                    
function R.ai.learnProjectileTiming(signature,delay,speedScale)
    if not signature or delay~=delay or speedScale~=speedScale
        or delay<0 or delay>1.5 or speedScale<.2 or speedScale>1.5 then return false end
    local p=R.ai.projectileProfiles[signature]
    if not p then p={samples=0,radius=0};R.ai.projectileProfiles[signature]=p end
    local n=p.timingN or 0
    local weight=n==0 and 1 or .2
    local oldDelay,oldSpeed=p.delayMean or delay,p.speedMean or speedScale
    p.delayMean=oldDelay+(delay-oldDelay)*weight
    p.speedMean=oldSpeed+(speedScale-oldSpeed)*weight
    p.delayDev=(p.delayDev or .08)*(1-weight)+math.abs(delay-oldDelay)*weight
    p.speedDev=(p.speedDev or .1)*(1-weight)+math.abs(speedScale-oldSpeed)*weight
    p.timingN=math.min(n+1,1000000)
    if R.ai.learning then R.ai.learning.projectiles=R.ai.projectileProfiles end
    return true
end
R.ai.projectileLead =                   function(info,rp)
    local p=R.ai.projectileProfiles[info.signature or ""]
    local h=hum();local speed=math.max(1,h and h.WalkSpeed or 16)
    local line=info.lastVel and flat(info.lastVel)
    local lateral=0
    if line and line.Magnitude>.1 and info.lastPos then
        local side=Vector3.new(-line.Z,0,line.X).Unit
        lateral=math.abs(flat(rp.Position-info.lastPos):Dot(side))
    end
    local distance=math.max(4,(info.radius or 9)+4-lateral)
    local delay=p and (p.delayMean or .18)+2*(p.delayDev or .08) or .34
    local scale=p and (p.speedMean or .75)-2*(p.speedDev or .1) or .55
    local lead=delay+.08+distance/(speed*math.clamp(scale,.25,1.2))
                                                                             
    if not p or (p.timingN or 0)<3 then lead=math.max(1.6,lead) end
    return math.clamp(lead,.25,4),p and p.timingN or 0
end 
function R.ai.beginProjectileTiming(info,rp,direction,now)
    local active=R.ai.projectileTrial
    if active and active.info==info and active.direction:Dot(direction)>.95 then return end
    R.ai.projectileTrial=nil
    if info.timingLearned or R.evadeWhy~="PROJECTILE"
        or flat(rp.AssemblyLinearVelocity):Dot(direction)>1 then return end
    R.ai.projectileTrial={info=info,signature=info.signature or "unknown",direction=direction,
        position=rp.Position,requested=now,walkSpeed=hum() and hum().WalkSpeed or 16,
        hp=hum() and hum().Health}
end
function R.ai.observeProjectileTiming(rp,now)
    local q=R.ai.projectileTrial
    if not q then return end
    local elapsed=now-q.requested
    local displacement=flat(rp.Position-q.position)
    local progress=displacement:Dot(q.direction)
    local h=hum()
    local command=R.ai.commandDirection
    if elapsed>3 or (q.hp and h and h.Health<q.hp)
        or displacement.Magnitude>math.max(4,q.walkSpeed*(elapsed+.3)*1.8)
        or (command and command:Dot(q.direction)<.7) then R.ai.projectileTrial=nil;return end
    if not q.motionAt and progress>.15 and command and command:Dot(q.direction)>.85 then
        q.motionAt=now;q.motionProgress=progress
    end
    local clear=R.ai.projectileWindow(q.info,rp.Position,Vector3.zero,4)>1
    local ended=R.evadeWhy~="PROJECTILE" or not command or clear
        or now-(q.info.lastAt or 0)>.25
    if q.motionAt then
        local duration=now-q.motionAt
        local travel=progress-q.motionProgress
        if duration>=.12 and travel>=1 and (ended or duration>=.35) then
            local learned=R.ai.learnProjectileTiming(q.signature,q.motionAt-q.requested,
                travel/(duration*math.max(1,q.walkSpeed)))
            if learned then q.info.timingLearned=true end
            R.ai.projectileTrial=nil;return
        end
    end
    if ended and elapsed>.2 then R.ai.projectileTrial=nil end
end
R.ai.impactMargin =                   function(point)
    local margin=math.huge
    local now=os.clock()
    for _,hit in ipairs(R.ai.impacts) do
        if hit.untilTime>now and math.abs(point.Y-hit.pos.Y)<10 then
            margin=math.min(margin,flat(point-hit.pos).Magnitude-hit.radius)
        end
    end
    for part,info in pairs(R.watch) do
            if R.ai.characterEffectPart(part) or R.ai.spentBossIceVisual(part)then R.watch[part]=nil;continue end
        if info.projectile and info.lastPos and now-(info.lastAt or 0)<0.25 then
            local clearance=R.ai.projectileWindow(info,point,Vector3.zero,.4)
            margin=math.min(margin,clearance)
        elseif part.Parent then
            local geometry=R.ai.attackGeometry(part,info)
            if geometry then margin=math.min(margin,R.ai.attackMargin(geometry,point)) end
        end
    end
    return margin
end 
R.ai.margin =                   function(point)
    local margin=R.ai.impactMargin(point)
    for _,e in ipairs(R.enemies) do
        if enemyAlive(e.model) and e.root.Parent then
            local velocity=flat(e.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity)
            if velocity.Magnitude>35 then velocity=velocity.Unit*35 end
            local predicted=e.root.Position+velocity*0.35
            margin=math.min(margin,flat(point-predicted).Magnitude-R.ai.keepout(e))
        end
    end
    return margin
end 
R.ai.safePass =                   function(from,to)
    local delta=flat(to-from)
    local initial=R.ai.margin(from)
    for i=1,4 do
        local margin=R.ai.margin(from+delta*(i/4))
                                                                                
        if margin<math.min(0,initial)-0.1 then return false end
    end
    return initial>=0 or R.ai.margin(to)>initial+0.1
end 
R.ai.escapeMargin =                   function(point)
                                                                          
                                                                            
    return R.ai.impactMargin and R.ai.impactMargin(point) or R.ai.margin(point)
end 
R.ai.escapeStepSafe =                   function(from,to)
    return R.ai.nonWorseningEscape(from,to,R.ai.escapeMargin)
end 
R.ai.nonWorseningEscape =                   function(from,to,margin)
    local initial=margin(from)
    for i=1,4 do
        if margin(from+(to-from)*(i/4))<math.min(0,initial)-.1 then return false end
    end
    return true
end 
                                                                       
                                                                        
function R.ai.bossLearningKey(model)
    if not model or type(model.Name)~="string" then return end
    return tostring(game.PlaceId)..":"..tostring(wsVal("dungeonName",S.Dungeon or "unknown")):sub(1,120)
        ..":"..model.Name:sub(1,120)
end
function R.ai.bossKeepsTracking(profile)
    if not profile then return false end
    local n=(profile.targeted or 0)+(profile.other or 0)
    return (profile.targeted or 0)>=3 and n>0 and profile.targeted/n>=.75
        and (profile.recent or 0)>=.6
end
function R.ai.learnBossReturn(key,trial,position,playerPosition,now)
    if not key or not trial or trial.invalid or not R.ai.learning then return end
    local delay=now-trial.at
    if delay~=delay or delay<.1 or delay>15 then return end
    local travel=flat(playerPosition-trial.startPlayer).Magnitude
    local current=flat(position-playerPosition).Magnitude
    local original=flat(position-trial.startPlayer).Magnitude
    if travel~=travel or current~=current or original~=original
        or math.abs(position.Y-playerPosition.Y)>20 then return end
    local memory=R.ai.learning
    memory.bosses=memory.bosses or {}
    local p=memory.bosses[key]
    if not p then
                                                                               
        local count=0;local oldest,oldestAt
        for k,v in pairs(memory.bosses) do
            count+=1;if not oldestAt or (v.at or 0)<oldestAt then oldest,oldestAt=k,v.at or 0 end
        end
        if count>=128 and oldest then memory.bosses[oldest]=nil end
        p={observations=0,targeted=0,other=0,ambiguous=0,recent=0};memory.bosses[key]=p
    end
    p.observations+=1
    p.delayMean=(p.delayMean or delay)+(delay-(p.delayMean or delay))/math.min(p.observations,100)
    p.delayMin=math.min(p.delayMin or delay,delay);p.delayMax=math.max(p.delayMax or delay,delay)
                                                                           
                                                                              
    local result="ambiguous"
    if travel>=8 then
        if current<=10 and original>=current+6 then result="targeted"
        elseif current>18 or (original<=10 and current>=original+6) then result="other" end
        if result~="ambiguous" then p.recent=p.recent*.7+(result=="targeted" and .3 or 0) end
    end
    p[result]+=1;p.at=os.time()
    return result
end
function R.ai.updateBossPhase(model,visible,position,living,playerPosition,now)
    now=now or os.clock()
    local phase=R.ai.bossPhase
    if not living or not model or not position then R.ai.bossPhase=nil;return end
    if not phase or phase.model~=model then
        phase={model=model,key=R.ai.bossLearningKey(model),lastVisible=visible and position or nil,landings={}}
        R.ai.bossPhase=phase
    end
    local origin=phase.lastVisible
    local nearby=flat((origin or position)-playerPosition).Magnitude<150
                                                                          
                                                                           
    local profile=R.ai.learning and R.ai.learning.bosses and R.ai.learning.bosses[phase.key]
    local knownTracking=R.ai.bossRequiresMotion(model,profile)
    local displaced=(origin and math.abs(position.Y-origin.Y)>35)
        or (knownTracking and math.abs(position.Y-playerPosition.Y)>35)
    local hidden=nearby and (not visible or displaced) or false
    local trial=phase.observation
    if trial then
        local dt=now-trial.lastAt
        local moved=(playerPosition-trial.lastPlayer).Magnitude
        local speed=math.max(80,(hum() and hum().WalkSpeed or 16)*3)
        if dt<0 or dt>1 or moved>speed*math.max(dt,0)+2 then trial.invalid=true end
        trial.lastAt=now;trial.lastPlayer=playerPosition
        if phase.hidden and not hidden and visible and not displaced then
            R.ai.learnBossReturn(phase.key,trial,position,playerPosition,now)
            phase.observation=nil
        end
    end
    if hidden and not phase.hidden then
        phase.active=true;phase.direction=R.ai.commandDirection;phase.landings={}
        phase.sawLanding=false;phase.returnObservations=0
        phase.observation={at=now,startPlayer=playerPosition,lastPlayer=playerPosition,lastAt=now}
    end
    phase.hidden=hidden
    if visible and not displaced then phase.lastVisible=position end
    local landing=false
    for part in pairs(phase.landings) do
        if part.Parent then landing=true else phase.landings[part]=nil end
    end
    if landing then phase.sawLanding=true end
    if phase.active and not hidden and not landing then
                                                                             
                                                                             
                                                                            
        phase.returnObservations=(phase.returnObservations or 0)+1
        if phase.sawLanding or phase.returnObservations>=3 then phase.active=false;phase.direction=nil end
    end
    return phase.active and phase or nil
end
function R.ai.sampleBossPhase(rp)
    local model=R.ai.connectedBoss()
    local connectedHum=model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if model and (not connectedHum or connectedHum.Health<=0) then model=nil end
                                                                          
                                                                          
    if not model and R.ai.bossPhase then model=R.ai.bossPhase.model end
    if not model and R.target and R.target.kind=="Boss" then model=R.target.model end
    local h=model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local body=model and enemyRoot(model)
    if not h or h.Health<=0 or not body then
        R.ai.bossPhase=nil;return
    end
    local sample=R.ai.bossVisibility
    if not sample or sample.model~=model or sample.playerRoot~=rp then
        R.ai.bossPhase=nil
        sample={model=model,playerRoot=rp,parts={}}
        for _,part in ipairs(model:QueryDescendants("BasePart")) do
            if part.Name=="Head" or part.Name=="Torso" or part.Name=="UpperTorso" or part.Name=="LowerTorso" then
                sample.parts[#sample.parts+1]=part
            end
        end
        R.ai.bossVisibility=sample
    end
    local visible=false
    for _,part in ipairs(sample.parts) do if part.Parent and part.Transparency<.95 then visible=true;break end end
                                                                          
    if #sample.parts==0 then visible=true end
    if not model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then visible=false end
    return R.ai.updateBossPhase(model,visible,body.Position,true,rp.Position)
end
function R.ai.bossRequiresMotion(model,profile)
                                                                            
                                                                              
    return (model and type(model.Name)=="string" and model.Name:lower():find("pirate captain",1,true)~=nil)
        or R.ai.bossKeepsTracking(profile)
end
function R.ai.learnedBossOrbit(rp,target)
    local phase=R.ai.bossPhase
    if not phase or phase.model~=target.model or phase.active then return end
    local profile=R.ai.learning and R.ai.learning.bosses and R.ai.learning.bosses[phase.key]
    if not R.ai.bossRequiresMotion(target.model,profile) then return end
    local radial=flat(rp.Position-target.root.Position)
    if radial.Magnitude<.1 then return end
    local tangent=Vector3.new(-radial.Z,0,radial.X).Unit
    if not phase.orbitSide then
        local prior=R.ai.commandDirection
        phase.orbitSide=prior and tangent:Dot(prior)<0 and -1 or 1
    end
                                                                           
                                                                        
    phase.direction=tangent*phase.orbitSide
    local direction=R.ai.bossContinuation(rp,phase)
    if direction and math.abs(direction:Dot(tangent))>.2 then
        phase.orbitSide=direction:Dot(tangent)<0 and -1 or 1
    end
    return direction
end
function R.ai.bossContinuation(rp,phase)
    local desired=phase.direction or R.ai.commandDirection or flat(rp.AssemblyLinearVelocity)
    if not desired or desired.Magnitude<.1 then
        local radial=flat(rp.Position-(phase.lastVisible or rp.Position))
        desired=radial.Magnitude>.1 and Vector3.new(-radial.Z,0,radial.X).Unit or Vector3.new(1,0,0)
    end
    desired=flat(desired).Unit
    local function clear(d)
        local point=rp.Position+d*6
        return R.ai.segmentUncached(rp.Position,point) and R.ai.escapeStepSafe(rp.Position,point)
            and R.ai.projectileMotionMargin(rp.Position,d*(hum() and hum().WalkSpeed or 16),.5)>=0
    end
    if clear(desired) then phase.direction=desired;return desired end
                                                                         
                                                                             
    local best,score
    for i=1,15 do
        local angle=i*math.pi/8
        local d=Vector3.new(desired.X*math.cos(angle)-desired.Z*math.sin(angle),0,
            desired.X*math.sin(angle)+desired.Z*math.cos(angle))
        if clear(d) then
            local value=d:Dot(desired)*20-R.ai.risk(rp.Position+d*6,.4)
            if not score or value>score then best,score=d,value end
        end
    end
    phase.direction=best
    return best
end
function R.ai.runBossMotion(rp,phase)
    if R.ai.areaEscapePlan then return false end
    local anticipating=false
    if not phase then
        local observed=R.ai.bossPhase
        local profile=observed and R.ai.learning and R.ai.learning.bosses and R.ai.learning.bosses[observed.key]
        if observed and observed.lastVisible and R.ai.bossRequiresMotion(observed.model,profile)
            and math.abs(observed.lastVisible.Y-rp.Position.Y)<16 then
            local radial=flat(rp.Position-observed.lastVisible)
            if radial.Magnitude>.1 and radial.Magnitude<120 then
                local tangent=Vector3.new(-radial.Z,0,radial.X).Unit
                if not observed.orbitSide then
                    observed.orbitSide=R.ai.commandDirection and tangent:Dot(R.ai.commandDirection)<0 and -1 or 1
                end
                local stand=R.ai.stopDistance and R.ai.stopDistance("enemy") or 35
                observed.direction=(tangent*observed.orbitSide+radial.Unit*math.clamp((stand-radial.Magnitude)/12,-.8,.8)).Unit
                phase=observed;anticipating=true
            end
        end
    end
    if not phase or not S.MoveEnabled or not R.farming or R.riseOn then return false end
    if evading() and R.evadeWhy=="PROJECTILE" then return false end
    local direction=R.ai.bossContinuation(rp,phase)
    if direction and pushVerifiedDir(direction*6,"escape") then
        R.status=anticipating and "moving ahead of boss teleport" or "moving through boss teleport attack"
        return true
    end
    return false
end
R.ai.risk =                   function(point, seconds)
    local cost=math.max(0,-R.ai.impactMargin(point))*25
    for _,e in ipairs(R.enemies) do
        if enemyAlive(e.model) and e.root.Parent then
            local velocity=flat(e.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity)
            if velocity.Magnitude>40 then velocity=velocity.Unit*40 end
            local predicted=e.root.Position+velocity*math.min(seconds,0.8)
            local d=flat(point-predicted).Magnitude
            local reach=R.ai.keepout(e)
            if d<reach then cost+=(reach-d)*12 end
            if d<reach+6 then cost+=(reach+6-d)*2 end
        end
    end
    return cost
end 
                                                                               
R.ai.safeDirection =                   function(dir)
    local rp=root()
    if not rp then return nil end
    local best,score
    local straight=rp.Position+dir*5
    if R.ai.safePass(rp.Position,straight) and R.ai.segmentUncached(rp.Position,straight) and R.ai.risk(straight,0.3)==0 then
        R.ai.lastDirection=dir; return dir
    end
    local speed=hum() and hum().WalkSpeed or 16
    for _,angle in ipairs({0,30,-30,60,-60,90,-90,135,-135,180}) do
        local a=math.rad(angle)
        local d=Vector3.new(dir.X*math.cos(a)-dir.Z*math.sin(a),0,dir.X*math.sin(a)+dir.Z*math.cos(a))
        local finish=rp.Position+d*math.clamp(speed*0.3,3,7)
                                                                           
                                                                               
                                       
        if R.ai.segment(rp.Position,finish) and R.ai.segmentUncached(rp.Position,finish)
            and R.ai.safePass(rp.Position,finish) then
            local value=d:Dot(dir)*12+R.ai.openness(finish)*1.5-R.ai.risk(finish,0.3)
            if R.ai.lastDirection then value+=d:Dot(R.ai.lastDirection)*2 end
            if not score or value>score then best,score=d,value end
        end
    end
    if best and best:Dot(dir)<0.95 then R.ai.activeRoute=nil end
    R.ai.lastDirection=best
    return best
end 
local clearance; clearance =                   function(rp, dir)
    if dir.Magnitude < 0.01 then return 0 end
    for d = 16, 2, -2 do
        if R.ai.segment(rp.Position, rp.Position + dir.Unit*d) then return d end
    end
    return 0
end 

                                                                  
local function sidestep(rp, away)
    local a = flat(away)
    a = a.Magnitude > 0.05 and a.Unit or Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
    local side = Vector3.new(-a.Z, 0, a.X)
    local cands = { side, -side, side + a * 0.6, -side + a * 0.6, a }
    local best, bestScore
    for _, c in ipairs(cands) do
        local d = flat(c)
        if d.Magnitude > 0.05 then
            d = d.Unit
            local sc = clearance(rp, d)
            if R.evadeDir then sc+=math.max(0,d:Dot(R.evadeDir))*3 end
            if not bestScore or sc > bestScore then best, bestScore = d, sc end
        end
    end
    return best or a
end

local function setEvade(dir, why, prio)
    local now = os.clock()
    if R.evadeDir and now < R.evadeUntil and R.evadePrio > (prio or 0) then return end
    if why=="PROJECTILE" then
                                                                            
                                                                        
        R.evadeDir=dir;R.evadeWhy=why;R.evadePrio=prio or 0
        R.evadeUntil=now+.2;return
    end
                                                                                  
                                                                             
    if R.evadeDir and now < (R.ai.evadeLockUntil or 0)
        and R.evadeWhy == why and R.evadePrio == (prio or 0) then
        local rp=root()
        local finish=rp and rp.Position+R.evadeDir*4
        if finish and R.ai.segmentUncached(rp.Position,finish)
            and R.ai.safePass(rp.Position,finish)
            and R.ai.projectileMotionMargin(rp.Position,R.evadeDir*(hum() and hum().WalkSpeed or 16),.7)>0 then
            R.evadeUntil=now+(tonumber(S.EvadeCommit) or .35)
            return
        end
    end
    R.ai.evadeLockUntil=now+0.35
    R.evadeDir = dir
    R.evadeWhy = why
    R.evadePrio = prio or 0
    R.evadeUntil = now + (tonumber(S.EvadeCommit) or 0.45)
end

local evading; evading =                   function()
    if R.evadeDir and os.clock() < R.evadeUntil then return true end
    if R.evadeDir then
        R.evadeDir = nil
        R.evadeWhy = ""
        R.evadePrio = 0
    end
    return false
end 

                                                                              
                                                                            
                                                    
R.ai.casterProfiles={}
R.ai.castWarnings={}
function R.ai.effectCatalog()
    if R.ai.effectCatalogCache then return R.ai.effectCatalogCache end
    local catalog={friendly={},lines={},hostile={}}
    local spells=RS:FindFirstChild("projectiles")
    if spells then for _,asset in ipairs(spells:GetChildren()) do catalog.friendly[asset.Name]=asset end end
    local enemies=RS:FindFirstChild("enemyAssets")
    if enemies then for _,family in ipairs(enemies:GetChildren()) do
        local warning=family:FindFirstChild("preCast")
        local beam=family:FindFirstChild("laserBeam")
        local wp=warning and warning:FindFirstChild("preCast")
        local bp=beam and beam:FindFirstChild("hitBox")
        if wp and bp and wp:IsA("BasePart") and bp:IsA("BasePart") then
            for _,entry in ipairs({{warning,wp,"warning"},{beam,bp,"active"}}) do
                local key=entry[1].Name.."/"..entry[2].Name
                catalog.lines[key]=catalog.lines[key] or {}
                table.insert(catalog.lines[key],{family=family.Name,phase=entry[3],template=entry[2],
                    width=math.min(bp.Size.X,bp.Size.Z),length=math.max(bp.Size.X,bp.Size.Z)})
            end
        end
    end end
    local effects=RS:FindFirstChild("enemyProjectiles")
    if effects then for _,part in ipairs(effects:QueryDescendants("BasePart")) do
                                                                             
                                                                          
        local held=false;local parent=part.Parent
        while parent and parent~=effects do
            if parent:IsA("Accessory") or parent:IsA("Tool") then held=true;break end
            parent=parent.Parent
        end
        if part.Parent and not held then
            catalog.hostile[part.Parent.Name.."/"..part.Name]={hitbox=part.Name:lower()=="hitbox"}
        end
    end end
    R.ai.effectCatalogCache=catalog
    return catalog
end
function R.ai.encounterTrigger(part)
    if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") or not part.Anchored
        or part.CanCollide or part.Transparency<.99 then return false end
    local parent=part.Parent
    if not parent then return false end
    local name=(parent.Name.." "..part.Name):lower()
    local semantic=name:find("entry",1,true) or name:find("trigger",1,true)
        or name:find("checkpoint",1,true) or name:find("activation",1,true)
    if not semantic then return false end
                                                                         
                                                                            
    return math.min(part.Size.X,part.Size.Z)>=20 and part.CanTouch
end

                                                                        
                                                                               
                                                                           
function R.ai.detachedFriendlyEffect(part)
    if not part or not part.Parent then return false end
    local parent=part.Parent
    local circle=parent==workspace and part.Name=="tornadoCircle"
    local trail=parent.Parent==workspace and parent.Name=="trailPart" and parent:IsA("Model")
        and (part.Name=="trailPart" or part.Name=="Union")
    if not circle and not trail then return false end
    local catalog=R.ai.effectCatalog()
    local key=part.Parent.Name.."/"..part.Name
    if (catalog.hostile and catalog.hostile[key]) or (catalog.lines and catalog.lines[key]) then return false end
    local spells=RS:FindFirstChild("projectiles")
    local ability=spells and spells:FindFirstChild("Vortex")
    if trail then
        local model=ability and ability:FindFirstChild("trailPart")
        if not model or model.ClassName~=parent.ClassName then return false end
        for _,name in ipairs({"trailPart","Union"}) do
            local expected=model:FindFirstChild(name);local child=parent:FindFirstChild(name)
            if not expected or not child or expected.ClassName~=child.ClassName
                or (child.Size-expected.Size).Magnitude>.01 then return false end
        end
        local expected=model:FindFirstChild("trailPart");local child=parent:FindFirstChild("trailPart")
        for _,name in ipairs({"smokeTrail","bigSparkles","smallSparkles","mediumSparkles"}) do
            local a=expected:FindFirstChild(name);local b=child:FindFirstChild(name)
            if not a or not b or not a:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or not b:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then return false end
        end
        return true
    end
    local template=ability and ability:FindFirstChild("tornadoCircle")
    if not template or part.ClassName~=template.ClassName or (part.Size-template.Size).Magnitude>.01 then return false end
    for _,spec in ipairs({{"Beam1","Beam"},{"Beam2","Beam"},{"Attachment1","Attachment"},{"Attachment2","Attachment"}}) do
        local expected=template:FindFirstChild(spec[1]);local child=part:FindFirstChild(spec[1])
        if not expected or not expected:IsA(spec[2]) or not child or not child:IsA(spec[2]) then return false end
    end
    return true
end

R.ai.spentBossIceVisual =                   function(part)
    if part.Name~="Ice" or part.Transparency<.98 then return false end
    local parent=part.Parent
    return parent~=nil and (parent.Name=="smallIceSpikes" or parent.Name=="mediumIceSpikes" or parent.Name=="largeIceSpikes")
end 

R.ai.characterEffectPart =                   function(part)
    local ancestor=part
    while ancestor and ancestor~=workspace do
        if ancestor:IsA("Model") and (ancestor:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
