            if generation~=R.ai.generation then return nil end
        end
    end
    if not best then R.ai.drawnStatus="Drawing has no reachable connection toward target";return nil end
    local route={}
    while best do table.insert(route,1,graph.nodes[best]);best=parents[best] end
    if R.ai.connectedSegment(route[#route],goal,true) then route[#route+1]=goal end
    if #route==0 then return nil end
                                                                             
    local corridor={from};for _,p in ipairs(route) do corridor[#corridor+1]=p end
    R.ai.drawnRouteOverride={generation=generation,points=corridor}
    R.ai.lastRouteWasDrawn=true
    R.ai.lastPlannerProof=true;R.ai.lastPlannerRoom=R.ai.roomKey()
    R.ai.drawnStatus="Following connected drawing ("..#route.." waypoints)"
    return route
end


                                                                            
                                                                 
R.ai.corridors={version=1,maps={}}
R.ai.corridorFile="DQR/data/DungeonAI_corridors_v1.json"
R.ai.corridorRejected={}
function R.ai.routeMapKey()
    local d=dungeonFolder()
    return tostring(game.PlaceId)..":"..tostring(S.Dungeon or "")..":"..(d and d.Name or "unknown")
end
function R.ai.packPoint(p) return {p.X,p.Y,p.Z} end
function R.ai.unpackPoint(p) return Vector3.new(p[1],p[2],p[3]) end
function R.ai.validPoint(p)
    if type(p)~="table" then return false end
    for i=1,3 do
        if type(p[i])~="number" or p[i]~=p[i] or math.abs(p[i])>1e7 then return false end
    end
    return true
end
function R.ai.saveCorridors()
    if not R.ai.corridorDirty then return end
    if type(writefile)~="function" then
        R.ai.corridorError="File API unavailable; corridor memory lasts this session only"
        return
    end
    local revision=R.ai.corridorRevision
    local ok,err=pcall(function()
        writefile(R.ai.corridorFile,HTTP:JSONEncode(R.ai.corridors))
    end)
    R.ai.corridorError=not ok and tostring(err) or nil
    if ok and revision==R.ai.corridorRevision then R.ai.corridorDirty=false end
end
function R.ai.loadCorridors()
    if type(readfile)~="function" then return end
    local ok,data=pcall(function() return HTTP:JSONDecode(readfile(R.ai.corridorFile)) end)
    if not ok or type(data)~="table" or data.version~=1 or type(data.maps)~="table" then return end
    for key,records in pairs(data.maps) do
        if type(key)=="string" and type(records)=="table" then
            local clean={}
            for _,record in ipairs(records) do
                local valid=type(record)=="table" and type(record.points)=="table" and #record.points>=2
                if valid then
                    for _,point in ipairs(record.points) do
                        if not R.ai.validPoint(point) then valid=false;break end
                    end
                end
                if valid then
                                                                                   
                    local length=0
                    for i=2,#record.points do
                        length+=(R.ai.unpackPoint(record.points[i])-R.ai.unpackPoint(record.points[i-1])).Magnitude
                    end
                    record.length=length
                    record.damage=type(record.damage)=="number" and record.damage==record.damage
                        and math.clamp(record.damage,0,1e7) or 0
                    clean[#clean+1]=record
                end
            end
            R.ai.corridors.maps[key]=clean
        end
    end
end
function R.ai.checkpointCorridor(trace,outcome)
    if not trace or #trace.points<2 or trace.length<1.5 then return end
    local records=R.ai.corridors.maps[trace.map] or {}
    R.ai.corridors.maps[trace.map]=records
    local record=trace.record
    if not record then
                                                                          
                                                                                
        record={points=trace.points,room=trace.room,at=os.time()}
        records[#records+1]=record;trace.record=record
    end
    outcome=outcome or "in progress"
    if record.length==trace.length and record.damage==trace.damage and record.outcome==outcome then return end
    record.length=trace.length;record.damage=trace.damage
    record.seconds=os.clock()-trace.at;record.outcome=outcome;record.complete=outcome=="reached"
    R.ai.corridorDirty=true
    R.ai.corridorRevision=(R.ai.corridorRevision or 0)+1
end
function R.ai.finishCorridor(outcome)
    local trace=R.ai.corridorTrace
    R.ai.corridorTrace=nil
    R.ai.checkpointCorridor(trace,outcome or "interrupted")
end
function R.ai.beginCorridor(rp,goal)
    local t=R.ai.corridorTrace
    if t and t.root==rp and (t.goal-goal).Magnitude<8 then return end
    R.ai.finishCorridor("target changed")
    local h=hum()
    R.ai.corridorTrace={root=rp,goal=goal,map=R.ai.routeMapKey(),
        room=R.target and R.target.room or "unknown",points={R.ai.packPoint(rp.Position)},
        length=0,damage=0,hp=h and h.Health or 0,at=os.clock(),lastAt=os.clock(),
        lastSeenAt=os.clock(),lastSeen=rp.Position}
end
function R.ai.corridorTick()
    local t=R.ai.corridorTrace
    if not t then return end
    local rp,h=root(),hum()
    if not R.farming or not alive() or R.riseOn or rp~=t.root or R.ai.routeMapKey()~=t.map then
                                                                   
        R.ai.finishCorridor();return
    end
    local now=os.clock();local elapsed=now-t.lastSeenAt
    local observed=(rp.Position-t.lastSeen).Magnitude
    if elapsed>1 or observed>math.max(10,h.WalkSpeed*elapsed*1.8) then
        R.ai.finishCorridor("observation interrupted");return
    end
    t.lastSeenAt=now;t.lastSeen=rp.Position
    t.damage+=math.max(0,t.hp-h.Health);t.hp=h.Health
    local last=R.ai.unpackPoint(t.points[#t.points])
    local dist=(rp.Position-last).Magnitude
    if dist>=1.5 then
        t.points[#t.points+1]=R.ai.packPoint(rp.Position)
        t.length+=dist;t.lastAt=os.clock()
    end
    R.ai.checkpointCorridor(t)
    if (rp.Position-t.goal).Magnitude<4 then R.ai.finishCorridor("reached") end
end
function R.ai.optimizeCorridorRoute(from,route,generation)
    local result={};local anchor=from;local index=1;local probes=0
    while index<=#route do
        if generation~=R.ai.generation then return nil end
        local chosen=index
                                                                          
                                                                            
        for j=math.min(#route,index+11),index+1,-1 do
            if probes>=16 then break end
            local delta=route[j]-anchor;local distance=delta.Magnitude
            if distance>40 then continue end
            probes+=1
            if R.ai.connectedSegment(anchor,route[j]) then
                local safe=true;local previous=anchor;local count=math.max(1,math.ceil(distance/2))
                for k=1,count do
                    local p=anchor+delta*(k/count)
                    if not R.ai.safePass(previous,p) or R.ai.learnedCost(p)>15 then safe=false;break end
                    previous=p
                end
                if safe then chosen=j;break end
            end
        end
        result[#result+1]=route[chosen];anchor=route[chosen];index=chosen+1
    end
    return result
end
function R.ai.recallCorridor(from,goal,generation,incremental)
    local records=R.ai.corridors.maps[R.ai.routeMapKey()] or {}
    local candidates={}
    local initial=(goal-from).Magnitude
    for _,record in ipairs(records) do
        if incremental and R.ai.backgroundCheckpoint then R.ai.backgroundCheckpoint("route") end
        if generation~=R.ai.generation then return nil end
        local points=record.points
                                                                              
                                                                              
        local joins={}
        for i,p in ipairs(points) do
            if incremental and i%64==0 then R.ai.backgroundCheckpoint("route") end
            local distance=(R.ai.unpackPoint(p)-from).Magnitude
            if distance<=16 then joins[#joins+1]={index=i,d=distance} end
        end
        table.sort(joins,function(a,b)return a.d<b.d end)
        for ji=1,math.min(2,#joins) do
            for _,direction in ipairs({1,-1}) do
                local first=joins[ji].index
                local last=first;local remaining=initial
                local travel=joins[ji].d;local bestTravel=travel
                local previous=R.ai.unpackPoint(points[first])
                local finish=direction==1 and #points or 1
                for i=first,finish,direction do
                    if incremental and i%64==0 then R.ai.backgroundCheckpoint("route") end
                    local p=R.ai.unpackPoint(points[i])
                    travel+=(p-previous).Magnitude;previous=p
                    local d=(p-goal).Magnitude
                    if d<remaining then last,remaining,bestTravel=i,d,travel end
                end
                if last~=first and remaining<initial-4 then
                    candidates[#candidates+1]={record=record,first=first,last=last,direction=direction,
                        remaining=remaining,cost=bestTravel}
                end
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(candidates,function(a,b)
        if math.abs(a.remaining-b.remaining)>2 then return a.remaining<b.remaining end
        return a.cost<b.cost
    end)
    for i=1,math.min(12,#candidates) do
        if generation~=R.ai.generation then return nil end
        local c=candidates[i];local route={}
        for j=c.first,c.last,c.direction do
            if incremental and j%64==0 then R.ai.backgroundCheckpoint("route") end
            route[#route+1]=R.ai.unpackPoint(c.record.points[j])
        end
                                                                           
        local valid
        if incremental then valid=R.ai.prepareRoute(from,route,generation)
        else valid=R.ai.simulateRoute(from,route,nil,true) end
        if valid then
            if not incremental then route=R.ai.optimizeCorridorRoute(from,route,generation) end
            if not route then return nil end
            if (route[#route]-goal).Magnitude<=32 and R.ai.connectedSegment(route[#route],goal) then route[#route+1]=goal end
            R.ai.lastRouteWasObserved=true
            R.ai.corridorRecallCount=(R.ai.corridorRecallCount or 0)+1
            return route
        end
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
    end
    return nil
end
R.ai.loadCorridors()

                                                                           
                                                                             
                                                                         
                                                                         
function R.ai.openingProbe(from,goal)
    local delta=flat(goal-from)
    if delta.Magnitude<1 then return nil end
    local forward=delta.Unit
    local best,bestScore
    for _,distance in ipairs({5,8,11,14}) do
        for _,degrees in ipairs({0,10,-10,20,-20,30,-30,45,-45,60,-60,90,-90}) do
            local a=math.rad(degrees)
            local d=Vector3.new(forward.X*math.cos(a)-forward.Z*math.sin(a),0,
                forward.X*math.sin(a)+forward.Z*math.cos(a))
            local point=from+d*distance
            if R.ai.segmentUncached(from,point) and R.ai.safePass(from,point) then
                local score=d:Dot(forward)*100-distance*.05-R.ai.risk(point,0.35)*3-math.abs(degrees)*.12
                if not bestScore or score>bestScore then best,bestScore=point,score end
            end
        end
                                                                              
                                                              
        if best and bestScore and bestScore>95 then break end
    end
    return best
end
function R.ai.openingProbeCached(from,goal)
    local now=os.clock()
    if R.ai.openingCache and now-(R.ai.openingCache.at or 0)<0.35
        and R.ai.openingCache.from and (R.ai.openingCache.from-from).Magnitude<2
        and R.ai.openingCache.goal and (R.ai.openingCache.goal-goal).Magnitude<4 then
        return R.ai.openingCache.point
    end
    local point=R.ai.openingProbe(from,goal)
    R.ai.openingCache={at=now,from=from,goal=goal,point=point}
    return point
end

                                                                      
                                                                        
                                                                            
                                                                            
                                                              
function R.ai.portalRoute(from,goal)
    local key=R.ai.roomKey()
    R.ai.portalCache=R.ai.portalCache or {}
    local remembered=R.ai.portalCache[key]
    if remembered and remembered.point and R.ai.segmentUncached(from,remembered.point)
        and R.ai.safePass(from,remembered.point) then
        R.ai.lastPlannerProof=true;R.ai.lastPlannerRoom=key
        local tail=buildPath(remembered.point,goal)
        local route={remembered.point}
        if tail then
            for i=2,#tail do route[#route+1]=tail[i].Position+Vector3.new(0,3,0) end
        end
        return route
    end
    local delta=flat(goal-from)
    if delta.Magnitude<2 then return nil end
    local goalDir=delta.Unit
    local best,bestScore
    for i=0,23 do
        local a=(i/24)*math.pi*2
        local d=Vector3.new(math.cos(a),0,math.sin(a))
        local alignment=d:Dot(goalDir)
        if alignment>=-0.15 then
            for _,distance in ipairs({5,8,11,14}) do
                local p=from+d*distance
                if R.ai.segmentUncached(from,p) and R.ai.safePass(from,p) then
                    local forwardOpen=R.ai.segmentUncached(p,p+d*5)
                    if forwardOpen then
                        local side=Vector3.new(-d.Z,0,d.X)*2.4
                        local width=(R.ai.segmentUncached(p,p+side) and 1 or 0)
                            +(R.ai.segmentUncached(p,p-side) and 1 or 0)
                        local exits=R.ai.segmentUncached(p,goal)
                                                                             
                                                                         
                                                                           
                        local score=(exits and 300 or 0)+width*10+alignment*80-distance*.45
                        if not bestScore or score>bestScore then best,bestScore=p,score end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if best then
        R.ai.portalCache[key]={point=best,at=os.clock()}
        R.ai.lastPlannerProof=true;R.ai.lastPlannerRoom=key
                                                                           
                                                                             
        local cached=R.ai.sectionRouteCache and R.ai.sectionRouteCache[key]
        if cached and cached.route and cached.route[1]
            and flat(cached.route[1]-best).Magnitude>8 then
            R.ai.sectionRouteCache[key]=nil
        end
        return {best}
    end
    return nil
end

                                                                             
                                                                            
                                                  
function R.ai.updateCourseObjectives(d)
    local course=R.ai.course
    if not course or course.dungeon~=d then course={dungeon=d,rooms={},order={}};R.ai.course=course end
    for _,room in ipairs(d:GetChildren()) do
        local rank=R.ai.roomRank(room)
        if rank and not course.rooms[room] then
            local candidates={}
            for _,p in ipairs(room:QueryDescendants('BasePart[Name="spawn"]')) do candidates[#candidates+1]=p.Position end
            if #candidates==0 then
                for _,e in ipairs(R.enemies) do
                    if R.ai.enemyInRoom(e,room) and e.root and e.root.Parent then candidates[#candidates+1]=e.root.Position end
                end
            end
            if #candidates>0 then
                                                                            
                                                                                
                local center=Vector3.zero
                for _,p in ipairs(candidates) do center+=p end
                center/=#candidates
                table.sort(candidates,function(a,b)return (a-center).Magnitude<(b-center).Magnitude end)
                local entry={room=room,rank=rank,anchor=candidates[1]}
                course.rooms[room]=entry;course.order[#course.order+1]=entry
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(course.order,function(a,b)return a.rank<b.rank end)
    return course
end
R.ai.courseRoomCleared =                   function(entry)
    local state=R.ai.roomScanState
    local record=state and state.rooms[entry.room]
    return record and record.cleared==true
end 
R.ai.proximityApproach =                   function(entry,position,enemies)
    entry.proximityPoint=nil
    if not position or entry.anchor.Y-position.Y<=6 then return end
    for _,enemy in ipairs(enemies or {}) do
        if enemyAlive(enemy.model) and R.ai.enemyInRoom(enemy,entry.room) then
                                                                               
                                                                            
            entry.proximityPoint=nil
            R.ai.proximityObjective=nil
            return
        end
    end
                                                                        
                                                                              
    local floor=supportFloor(Vector3.new(entry.anchor.X,position.Y+4,entry.anchor.Z),R.ai.rayParams())
    if not floor or waterSupport(floor) then return end
    local point=floor.Position+Vector3.new(0,3,0)
    if math.abs(point.Y-position.Y)>4 then return end
                                                                         
                                                                     
    if (point-position).Magnitude>32 then return end
    local now=os.clock();local cached=entry.proximityAccess
    if not cached or now>=cached.untilAt or cached.revision~=R.ai.geometryRevision
        or (cached.from-position).Magnitude>2 or (cached.point-point).Magnitude>1 then
        cached={from=position,point=point,revision=R.ai.geometryRevision,untilAt=now+.5,
            allowed=R.ai.connectedSegment(position,point)==true}
        entry.proximityAccess=cached
    end
    if not cached.allowed then return end
    R.ai.proximityObjective=point
    entry.proximityPoint=point
    return point
end 

R.ai.observedRoomDeaths =                   function(entry)
    local state=R.ai.roomScanState
    local record=state and state.rooms[entry.room]
    if not record or not record.models or not next(record.models) then return false end
    for model,observed in pairs(record.models) do
        local hp=observed.hum and observed.hum.Health or (observed.health and tonumber(observed.health.Value))
        if (not hp or hp>0) and not (R.ai.retiredRoomEnemy and R.ai.retiredRoomEnemy(model,observed,os.clock())) then return false end
    end
    return true
end 
R.ai.progressionDestination =                   function(enemies,position)
    R.ai.proximityObjective=nil
    R.ai.progressionRoom=nil
    R.ai.progressionEnemy=nil
    local course=R.ai.course
    if not course then return end
    local front
    for _,enemy in ipairs(enemies or {}) do
        if enemyAlive(enemy.model) and type(enemy.rank)=="number" then front=math.min(front or math.huge,enemy.rank) end
    end
    if not course.progressRank then
        if not front then return end
        course.progressRank=front
    end
    if front then course.progressRank=math.min(course.progressRank,front) end
    local last
    for _,entry in ipairs(course.order) do
        if entry.room.Parent then last=entry end
        if entry.room.Parent and entry.rank>=(course.progressRank or -math.huge) then
            if position and (position-entry.anchor).Magnitude<8 then entry.arrived=true end
            local approach=entry.proximityPoint
            local alive=false;local closest;local nearest=math.huge;local selected
            for _,enemy in ipairs(enemies or {}) do
                if enemyAlive(enemy.model) and R.ai.enemyInRoom(enemy,entry.room) then
                    alive=true
                    if enemy.root and enemy.root.Parent then
                        local d=position and (enemy.root.Position-position).Magnitude or 0
                        if d<nearest then closest=enemy.root.Position;nearest=d;selected=enemy end
                    end
                end
            end
                                                                          
                                                                         
            if alive and closest then
                entry.proximityPoint=nil;course.progressRank=entry.rank
                R.ai.progressionRoom=entry.room;R.ai.progressionEnemy=selected
                return closest
            end
            if approach and not alive and position and (position-approach).Magnitude<.75 then
                                                                           
                                                                                
                entry.arrived=true
            end
            if not entry.arrived and not R.ai.courseRoomCleared(entry) and not R.ai.observedRoomDeaths(entry) then
                course.progressRank=entry.rank
                R.ai.progressionRoom=entry.room
                for _,enemy in ipairs(enemies or {}) do
                    if enemyAlive(enemy.model) and R.ai.enemyInRoom(enemy,entry.room) and enemy.root and enemy.root.Parent
                        and math.abs(enemy.root.Position.Y-entry.anchor.Y)>6 then
                                                                                 
                                                                                  
                        return enemy.root.Position
                    end
                end
                return (R.ai.proximityApproach and R.ai.proximityApproach(entry,position,enemies)) or entry.anchor
            end
        end
    end
                                                                             
                                                                             
    return last and last.anchor
end 

R.ai.courseDestination =                   function()
    local course=R.ai.course
    if not course or course.dungeon~=dungeonFolder() then return end
    for _,entry in ipairs(course.order) do
        if entry.room.Parent and not R.ai.courseRoomCleared(entry) then return entry.anchor end
    end
end 
function R.ai.courseStep()
    if not R.booted or not R.farming or R.phase=="finished" then return end
    local d=dungeonFolder();local rp=root()
    if not d or not rp then return end
    local course=R.ai.updateCourseObjectives(d)
    if not R.ai.mapReady or R.ai.gridBusy or course.busy then return end
    local pending=0
    for _,entry in ipairs(course.order) do
        if not entry.room.Parent or R.ai.courseRoomCleared(entry) then continue end
        pending+=1;if pending>2 then break end
        local previous=entry.attempt
        local revision=R.ai.geometryRevision or 0
        local topology=R.ai.mapTopologyRevision
        local nearby=false
        if entry.route and entry.geometry==revision then
            for _,p in ipairs(entry.route) do if (p-rp.Position).Magnitude<=24 then nearby=true;break end end
        end
        if nearby then continue end
        if previous and previous.geometry==revision and previous.topology==topology
            and (previous.from-rp.Position).Magnitude<16 then continue end
        local generation=R.ai.generation;local from=rp.Position
        entry.attempt={geometry=revision,topology=topology,from=from}
        course.busy=true
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok,route=pcall(R.ai.mapGraphRoute,{Position=from},entry.anchor,true)
            if ok and not route then ok,route=pcall(R.ai.surfaceGraphRoute,{Position=from},entry.anchor,nil,true) end
            if R.ai.course==course and generation==R.ai.generation and revision==(R.ai.geometryRevision or 0)
                and ok and route then
                entry.route=route;entry.geometry=revision;entry.from=from
            end
            course.busy=false
        end)
        return
    end
end
function R.ai.courseRoute(from,goal)
    local course=R.ai.course
    if not course or course.dungeon~=dungeonFolder() then return end
    local best,bestLength
    for _,entry in ipairs(course.order) do
        local route=entry.route
        if not route or entry.geometry~=(R.ai.geometryRevision or 0) then continue end
        local start,startDistance
        for i,p in ipairs(route) do
            local distance=(p-from).Magnitude
            if distance<=24 and (not startDistance or distance<startDistance)
                and R.ai.connectedSegment(from,p) then start,startDistance=i,distance end
        end
        if not start then continue end
        local length=startDistance
        for i=start,#route do
            local p=route[i];if i>start then length+=(p-route[i-1]).Magnitude end
            local tail=(p-goal).Magnitude
            if tail<=32 and (not bestLength or length+tail<bestLength) and R.ai.connectedSegment(p,goal) then
                best={};for j=start,i do best[#best+1]=route[j] end
                best[#best+1]=goal;bestLength=length+tail
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

function R.ai.rejoinRoute(rp,route)
    if not route then return false end
    local candidates={}
    for i=2,math.min(#route,8) do
        local distance=(route[i]-rp.Position).Magnitude
        if distance<=16 then candidates[#candidates+1]={index=i,distance=distance} end
    end
    table.sort(candidates,function(a,b)return a.distance<b.distance or (a.distance==b.distance and a.index<b.index)end)
    for _,candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
        local point=route[candidate.index]
        if R.ai.connectedSegment(rp.Position,point) and R.ai.routeStepSafe(rp.Position,point) then
            for _=1,candidate.index-1 do table.remove(route,1) end
            R.ai.committedPoint=point;R.ai.activeRoute=route
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

                                                                           
                                                                              
                                                                              
function R.ai.prepareRoute(from,route,generation)
    if not route or #route==0 then return false,"empty route" end
    local dense={};local previous=from
    for _,point in ipairs(route) do
        if typeof(point)~="Vector3" then return false,"bad waypoint" end
        local count=math.max(1,math.ceil((point-previous).Magnitude/8))
        for i=1,count do dense[#dense+1]=previous+(point-previous)*(i/count) end
        previous=point
    end
    local rp=root();local position=rp and rp.Position or from
    local joined,why=R.ai.rebaseRoute(position,dense)
    if not joined then return false,why end
    previous=position;local checked=0
    for i,point in ipairs(dense) do
        if R.ai.backgroundCheckpoint then R.ai.backgroundCheckpoint("route") end
        if generation~=R.ai.generation then return false,"superseded route" end
        local ok,reason=R.ai.connectedSegment(previous,point)
        if not ok then return false,string.format("segment %d: %s",i,reason or "blocked") end
        checked+=(point-previous).Magnitude;previous=point
        if checked>=32 or i>=8 then break end
    end
                                                                        
                                                                               
    rp=root();position=rp and rp.Position or position
    joined,why=R.ai.rebaseRoute(position,dense)
    if not joined then return false,why end
    table.clear(route);for i,point in ipairs(dense) do route[i]=point end
    return true,"verified route prefix"
end

function R.ai.requestRoute(rp,goal,continuationTail)
    if R.ai.gridBusy then return end
    local generation=R.ai.generation
    local epoch=(R.ai.planEpoch or 0)+1;R.ai.planEpoch=epoch
    local from=rp.Position;local navigationRequest=R.ai.navGoal
    R.ai.gridBusy=true;R.ai.planReason="checking saved routes"
    task.spawn(function()
        local reason,source,drawn,observed
        local ok,result=pcall(function()
            local function accept(candidate,label,alreadyPrepared)
                if not candidate then return end
                if continuationTail and (candidate[#candidate]-goal).Magnitude>=(continuationTail-goal).Magnitude-4 then
                    reason="saved prefix has no further connection";return
                end
                local valid,why=true,nil
                if not alreadyPrepared then valid,why=R.ai.prepareRoute(from,candidate,generation) end
                if valid then source=label;return candidate end
                reason=why
            end
            R.ai.lastRouteWasDrawn=false;R.ai.lastRouteWasObserved=false
            local route=accept(R.ai.recallDrawnRoute(from,goal,generation),"following learned drawn route")
            if route then drawn=true;return route end
            route=accept(R.ai.recallCorridor(from,goal,generation,true),"following saved corridor",true)
            if route then observed=true;return route end
            route=accept(R.ai.courseRoute(from,goal),"following planned room corridor")
            if route then return route end
            R.ai.planReason="computing missing route connection"
            route=accept(R.ai.mapGraphRoute({Position=from},goal),"following connected map graph")
            if route then return route end
            route=accept(R.ai.surfaceGraphRoute({Position=from},goal),"following 3D support graph")
            if route then return route end
            local wps=buildPath(from,goal)
            if wps then
                local points={}
                for i=2,#wps do points[#points+1]=wps[i].Position+Vector3.new(0,3,0) end
                return accept(points,"following navigation mesh")
            end
        end)
        if epoch~=R.ai.planEpoch then return end
        R.ai.gridBusy=false
        if generation~=R.ai.generation or not R.booted or not R.farming or R.phase=="finished" or root()~=rp then return end
        if navigationRequest and R.ai.navGoal and (navigationRequest-R.ai.navGoal).Magnitude>8 then
            R.ai.gridRetry=0;R.ai.planReason="destination changed during planning";return
        end
        if ok and result then
            local joined,why=R.ai.rebaseRoute(rp.Position,result)
            if joined and result[1] and R.ai.connectedSegment(rp.Position,result[1]) then
                                                                                     
                R.ai.gridPath=result;R.ai.gridGoal=goal
                R.ai.gridPathDrawn=drawn or false;R.ai.gridPathObserved=observed or false
                R.ai.gridPathRevision=R.ai.mapTopologyRevision
                R.ai.activeRoute=result;R.ai.committedPoint=result[1]
                R.ai.routeValidatedAt=os.clock();R.ai.planReason=source
                R.ai.gridRetry=0;R.ai.continuationRequest=nil
                R.ai.beginCorridor(rp,result[#result])
                return
            end
            reason=why or "current route join blocked"
        end
        R.ai.planReason=not ok and ("planner error: "..tostring(result))
            or reason and ("route rejected: "..reason) or R.ai.mapRouteFailure or "no connected path found"
        R.ai.gridRetry=os.clock()+1
    end)
end

function R.ai.pathTarget(rp,goal,combatRoute)
    goal=R.ai.navigationGoal(goal)
    local now=os.clock();local route=R.ai.gridPath
    local changed=route and R.ai.gridPathRevision~=R.ai.mapTopologyRevision
    if route then
        R.ai.advanceWaypoints(rp,route,false)
        while #route>0 and (route[1]-rp.Position).Magnitude<.8
            and (#route==1 or R.ai.connectedSegment(rp.Position,route[2])) do table.remove(route,1) end
        if #route==0 then R.ai.gridPath=nil;R.ai.committedPoint=nil;route=nil end
    end
    if changed and route and not R.ai.connectedSegment(rp.Position,route[1])
        and not R.ai.rejoinRoute(rp,route) then
        R.ai.gridPath=nil;R.ai.committedPoint=nil;R.ai.activeRoute=nil;route=nil
    end
    local tail=route and route[#route]
    local continuation=tail and (tail-goal).Magnitude>8
        and (tail-rp.Position).Magnitude<math.max(24,(hum() and hum().WalkSpeed or 16)*3)
    local requested=R.ai.continuationRequest
    if continuation and requested and requested.revision==R.ai.mapTopologyRevision
        and (requested.tail-tail).Magnitude<.1 and (requested.goal-goal).Magnitude<=8 then continuation=false end
    local stale=not route or not R.ai.gridGoal or (R.ai.gridGoal-goal).Magnitude>8 or changed or continuation
    if not route and R.ai.connectedSegment(rp.Position,goal) and R.ai.routeStepSafe(rp.Position,goal) then
        R.ai.planReason="verified direct segment";R.ai.beginCorridor(rp,goal);return goal
    end
    if stale and not R.ai.gridBusy and (route or now>=(R.ai.gridRetry or 0)) then
        if continuation then R.ai.continuationRequest={tail=tail,goal=goal,revision=R.ai.mapTopologyRevision} end
        R.ai.requestRoute(rp,goal,continuation and tail or nil)
    end
    route=R.ai.gridPath or route
    if not route then
        local point=R.ai.committedPoint
        if point and (point-rp.Position).Magnitude>2 and R.ai.connectedSegment(rp.Position,point)
            and R.ai.routeStepSafe(rp.Position,point) then return point end
        return nil
    end
    R.ai.advanceWaypoints(rp,route,false)
    local clear,why=R.ai.connectedSegment(rp.Position,route[1])
    if not clear and not R.ai.rejoinRoute(rp,route) then
        R.ai.gridPath=nil;R.ai.committedPoint=nil;R.ai.activeRoute=nil;R.ai.gridRetry=0
        R.ai.planReason="next segment: "..tostring(why);return nil
    end
    if not R.ai.routeStepSafe(rp.Position,route[1]) then
        R.ai.planReason="threat in next movement segment";return nil
    end
    R.ai.activeRoute=route;R.ai.routeAt=now;R.ai.committedPoint=route[1]
    R.ai.lookahead=route[math.min(#route,4)]
    return route[1]
end
local function pathTarget(rp,goal,combatRoute)
    return R.ai.pathTarget(rp,goal,combatRoute)
end

                                                                
                 
                                                                

local KITE_FAN = { 0, 25, -25, 50, -50, 75, -75, 100, -100 }

local function rotY(v, deg)
    local a = math.rad(deg)
    local c, s = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)
    return Vector3.new(v.X * c - v.Z * s, 0, v.X * s + v.Z * c)
end

                                                                                    
local function kiteDir(rp, threat)
    local me = rp.Position
    local away = flat(me - threat.root.Position)
    if away.Magnitude < 0.2 then away = flat(-rp.CFrame.LookVector) end
    away = away.Magnitude > 0.05 and away.Unit or Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
    local prev=R.kiteVec
    local currentDist=flat(rp.Position-threat.root.Position).Magnitude
    local learned=R.ai.learning and R.ai.learning.kite
    local best, bestScore
    for _, deg in ipairs(KITE_FAN) do
        local d = rotY(away, deg)
        local clear = clearance(rp, d)
        if clear > 7 then
            local probe = me + d * 8
            local near = 200
            for _, e in ipairs(R.enemies) do
                if enemyAlive(e.model) then
                    local dd = (e.root.Position - probe).Magnitude
                    if dd < near then near = dd end
                end
            end
            local score = math.min(clear, 16) * 1.2 + math.min(near, 40) - math.abs(deg) * 0.06
            if prev then score += math.max(0,d:Dot(prev))*16 end
            if learned and learned.n>3 then
                local tangent=Vector3.new(-away.Z,0,away.X)
                score+=d:Dot(tangent)*math.clamp(learned.tangent, -1, 1)*8
                score-=math.abs(currentDist-(learned.radius or 0))*.02
            end
            if not bestScore or score > bestScore then best, bestScore = d, score end
        end
    end
    return best
end

                                                                
                                                                                   
local function kiteStep(rp)
    if not S.Kite then return nil end
    if not (S.UseQ or S.UseE) then return nil end
    local now = os.clock()
    local threat, tdist
    for _, e in ipairs(R.enemies) do
        if enemyAlive(e.model) then
            local d = (e.root.Position - rp.Position).Magnitude
            if not tdist or d < tdist then threat, tdist = e, d end
        end
    end
    local trigger=math.min(tonumber(S.KiteNear) or 18, math.max(3,R.ai.range()-3))
    if threat and isRanged(threat.kind) and S.SpaceCasters~=false then
        trigger=math.max(trigger,math.min(tonumber(S.CasterDistance) or 40,R.ai.range()-6)-6)
    end
    local continuing=threat and R.kiteThreat==threat.model
    if not threat or tdist > trigger+(continuing and 5 or 0) then
        R.kiteAt = 0
        R.kiteVec=nil;R.kiteThreat=nil
        return nil
    end
    R.kiteThreat=threat.model
    if R.kiteAt == 0 then
        R.kiteAt = now
        R.kiteBest = tdist
    elseif tdist > R.kiteBest + 1 then
        R.kiteBest = tdist
        R.kiteAt = now
    end
    local keep=R.kiteVec and now-(R.kiteVecAt or 0)<(tonumber(S.EvadeCommit) or 0.5)
        and clearance(rp,R.kiteVec)>5 and R.ai.safePass(rp.Position,rp.Position+R.kiteVec*5)
    local dir = keep and R.kiteVec or kiteDir(rp, threat)
    if not dir then
        R.kiteVec=nil
        R.kiteHold = now + 1
        return nil
    end
    if dir~=R.kiteVec then R.kiteVec=dir;R.kiteVecAt=now end
    return dir, tdist
end

local function nearestEnemy(rp)
    local best, bestD
    for _, e in ipairs(R.enemies) do
        if enemyAlive(e.model) then
            local d = (e.root.Position - rp.Position).Magnitude
            if not bestD or d < bestD then best, bestD = e, d end
        end
    end
    return best, bestD
end

                                                                          
                                                                              
                                                                         
                                                                       
                                                                         
function R.ai.routeWatchdog(rp,goal)
    if not rp or not goal then return nil end
    local now=os.clock()
    if R.ai.watchGoal~=goal then
        R.ai.watchGoal=goal;R.ai.watchPos=rp.Position;R.ai.watchAt=now
        return nil
    end
    local moved=R.ai.watchPos and flat(rp.Position-R.ai.watchPos).Magnitude or math.huge
    if moved>=0.65 then
        R.ai.watchPos=rp.Position;R.ai.watchAt=now
        return nil
    end
    if now-(R.ai.watchAt or now)<1.5 or now<(R.ai.watchCooldown or 0) then return nil end
    R.ai.watchAt=now;R.ai.watchPos=rp.Position;R.ai.watchCooldown=now+1.2
    R.ai.committedPoint=nil;R.ai.gridPath=nil;R.ai.activeRoute=nil;R.ai.wallDir=nil;R.ai.wallUntil=0
    R.ai.gridRetry=0;R.ai.planPoint=nil;R.ai.planAt=0
    local toward=flat(goal-rp.Position)
    if toward.Magnitude<0.1 then return nil end
    toward=toward.Unit
    local best,bestScore
    for i=0,31 do
        local a=i*math.pi/16
        local d=Vector3.new(math.cos(a),0,math.sin(a))
        for _,distance in ipairs({4,7,10}) do
            local point=rp.Position+d*distance
            if R.ai.segmentUncached(rp.Position,point) and R.ai.safePass(rp.Position,point) then
                local score=d:Dot(toward)*14+R.ai.opennessUncached(point)*1.2-R.ai.risk(point,0.35)*2
                if not bestScore or score>bestScore then best,bestScore=d,score end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

function R.ai.stopDistance(kind)
    local stop=6
    if kind=="enemy" then
        local ranged=R.target and isRanged(R.target.kind)
        if S.Kite and (S.UseQ or S.UseE) and (ranged or os.clock()>=(R.closeIn or 0)) then
            stop=math.clamp(tonumber(S.KiteDistance) or 26,6,math.max(8,R.ai.range()-6))
        else stop=math.max(2,tonumber(S.StopDistance) or 8) end
        if ranged and S.SpaceCasters~=false and (S.UseQ or S.UseE) then
            stop=math.max(stop,math.min(tonumber(S.CasterDistance) or 40,math.max(6,R.ai.range()-6)))
        end
        if R.target then stop=math.max(stop,R.ai.keepout(R.target)+3) end
    end
    return stop
end
                                                                                
R.ai.attackHeightKey =                   function(t,rp)
    local names={}
    for key,p in pairs(R.ai.slots or {}) do if S["Use"..key] then names[#names+1]=p.name end end
    table.sort(names)
    local dy=t.root.Position.Y-rp.Position.Y
    return string.sub(table.concat(names,"+")..":"..tostring(t.kind),1,180)..":"..math.floor(dy/4),dy
end 
R.ai.attackHP =                   function(t)
    if t.hum then return t.hum.Health end
    local h=t.model:FindFirstChild("health") or t.model:FindFirstChild("Health")
    return h and tonumber(h.Value)
end 
function R.ai.observeAttackProgress()
    local a=R.ai.attackTrial;if not a then return end
    local rp=root();local hp=R.ai.attackHP(a.target)
    if not rp or not hp then R.ai.attackTrial=nil;return end
    if (rp.Position-a.pos).Magnitude>8 or (a.target.root.Position-a.enemyPos).Magnitude>8 then
        R.ai.attackTrial=nil;return
    end
    local outcome
    if hp<a.hp then outcome="progress"
    elseif hp>a.hp then R.ai.attackTrial=nil;return
    elseif os.clock()-a.at>=3 and a.attempts>=3 then outcome="stalled" end
    if not outcome then return end
    local m=R.ai.learning;m.attackHeights=m.attackHeights or {}
    if not m.attackHeights[a.key] then
        local n=0;for _ in pairs(m.attackHeights) do n+=1 end
        if n>=512 then m.attackHeights[next(m.attackHeights)]=nil end
    end
    local p=m.attackHeights[a.key] or {progress=0,stalled=0};m.attackHeights[a.key]=p
    p[outcome]=math.min((p[outcome] or 0)+1,1000000)
    if outcome=="stalled" and math.abs(a.dy)>3 then
        R.ai.ineffectiveAttack={model=a.target.model,key=a.key,pos=a.pos,enemyPos=a.enemyPos,at=os.clock()}
    elseif outcome=="progress" then R.ai.ineffectiveAttack=nil end
    R.ai.attackTrial=nil
end
function R.ai.recordAttackAttempt(t,rp)
    R.ai.observeAttackProgress()
    local hp=R.ai.attackHP(t);if not hp or hp<=0 then return end
    local key,dy=R.ai.attackHeightKey(t,rp)
    local a=R.ai.attackTrial
    if not a or a.target.model~=t.model or a.key~=key then
        a={target=t,key=key,dy=dy,pos=rp.Position,enemyPos=t.root.Position,hp=hp,at=os.clock(),attempts=0}
        R.ai.attackTrial=a
    end
    a.attempts+=1
end
R.ai.needsAttackElevation =                   function(t,rp)
    local key,dy=R.ai.attackHeightKey(t,rp)
    if math.abs(dy)<=3 then R.ai.ineffectiveAttack=nil;return false end
    local bad=R.ai.ineffectiveAttack
                                                                          
                                                                         
    if not bad or bad.model~=t.model or bad.key~=key or not bad.at or not bad.enemyPos then return false end
    if (rp.Position-bad.pos).Magnitude>4 or (t.root.Position-bad.enemyPos).Magnitude>4 then return false end
    return os.clock()-bad.at<2
end 


R.ai.combatRangeMode =                   function(target,distance,stop)
    local state=R.ai.rangeState
    if not state or state.model~=target.model then state={model=target.model,mode="approach"};R.ai.rangeState=state end
    local inner=math.max(R.ai.keepout(target)+1,stop-6)
    local outer=stop+4
    if distance<inner and (S.Kite or (isRanged(target.kind) and S.SpaceCasters~=false)) then state.mode="retreat"
    elseif state.mode=="retreat" then
        if distance>=stop then state.mode="hold" end
    elseif state.mode=="hold" then
        if distance>outer then state.mode="approach" end
    elseif distance<=stop then state.mode="hold" end
    return state.mode
end 
local walkStep; walkStep =                   function()
    if R.phase=="finished" then stopMoving();return end
    if R.riseOn then stopMoving();R.status=R.riseLanding and "landing" or "floating";return end
    if not R.farming or not S.MoveEnabled or not alive() or not inDungeon() then
        stopMoving()
        return
    end
    local rp = root()
    if not rp then return end
    if R.ai.followShoreExit(rp) then return end
    local bossPhase=S.EvadeEnabled and R.ai.sampleBossPhase(rp)
    if R.ai.areaEscapePlan and not (evading() and R.evadeWhy=="PROJECTILE") and R.ai.followAreaEscape(rp) then return end
    if R.ai.runBossMotion(rp,bossPhase) then return end
    if not (evading() and R.evadeWhy=="PROJECTILE") and R.ai.followCover(rp) then return end
    if not evading() and R.ai.followCoverExit(rp) then return end
    if R.ai.wallDir and not evading() and os.clock() < (R.ai.wallUntil or 0) then
        local d=R.ai.wallDir
        if clearance(rp,d)<5 then d=sidestep(rp,d);R.ai.wallDir=d end
        pushDir(d);R.status="following wall around corner";return
    else R.ai.wallDir=nil end
    R.ai.activeRoute=nil
                                                                              
    if R.ai.lookahead and R.ai.committedPoint and R.ai.risk(R.ai.commandEnd(rp.Position,R.ai.committedPoint),0.35)>8 then
        R.ai.gridPath=nil;R.ai.committedPoint=nil;R.ai.gridRetry=0
        R.status="replanning ahead of danger"
    end

    if os.clock()<(R.ai.projectileBlockedUntil or 0) then
        stopMoving();R.status="projectile blocks approach";return
    end
    if R.ai.areaEscapePlan and (R.evadePrio or 0)<=3 and R.ai.followAreaEscape(rp) then return end
    if not evading() and R.ai.margin(rp.Position)<0 then
        local best,score
        for i=0,15 do
            local a=i*math.pi/8
            local dir=Vector3.new(math.cos(a),0,math.sin(a))
            local p=rp.Position+dir*7
            if R.ai.segment(rp.Position,p) and R.ai.safePass(rp.Position,p) then
                local value=R.ai.margin(p)*4+R.ai.openness(p)
                if not score or value>score then best,score=dir,value end
            end
        end
        if best then pushDir(best); R.status="escaping attack reach"; return end
    end
                                  
    if evading() then
        local t = R.target
        if t and enemyAlive(t.model) then steerCamera(R.faceWant or t.root.Position) end
        local d = R.evadeDir
        if R.evadeWhy=="PROJECTILE" or R.evadeWhy=="CASTER WINDUP"
            or R.evadeWhy=="CASTER LINE" or R.evadeWhy=="ATTACK AREA" then
            local distance=(R.evadeWhy=="CASTER LINE" or R.evadeWhy=="ATTACK AREA")
                and (R.ai.areaStepDistance or 6) or (R.ai.projectileStepDistance or 5)
            if d then pushVerifiedDir(d*distance,"escape") else stopMoving() end
            R.status="evade: "..R.evadeWhy
            return
        end
        if d and clearance(rp, d) < 4 then
            d = sidestep(rp, -d)
            R.evadeDir = d
        end
        pushDir(d)
        R.status = "evade: " .. R.evadeWhy
        return
    end

                                                    
    if S.RetreatEnabled and hpPct() <= (tonumber(S.RetreatHP) or 35) then
        local e, d = nearestEnemy(rp)
        if e and d and d < (tonumber(S.RetreatDistance) or 45) then
            local away = kiteDir(rp, e)
            if not away then
                stopMoving(); return
            end
            steerCamera(R.faceWant or e.root.Position)
            pushDir(away)
            R.status = "retreating"
            return
        end
    end

    local dest, kind = destination()
    if not dest then
        stopMoving()
        R.status = "no destination"
        return
    end
    R.ai.navGoal=dest

    local approachBlocked
    if R.ai.approachGoal and (dest-R.ai.approachGoal).Magnitude<3
        and os.clock()<(R.ai.approachCheckAt or 0) then
        approachBlocked=R.ai.approachBlocked
    else
        approachBlocked=not R.ai.connectedSegment(rp.Position,R.ai.navigationGoal(dest))
        R.ai.approachGoal=dest;R.ai.approachBlocked=approachBlocked
        R.ai.approachCheckAt=os.clock()+0.5
    end
                                                                           
                                                                           
    local rangeMode
    local changeElevation=kind=="enemy" and R.target and R.ai.needsAttackElevation(R.target,rp)
    if kind=="enemy" and not approachBlocked and R.target and not changeElevation then
        rangeMode=R.ai.combatRangeMode(R.target,(dest-rp.Position).Magnitude,R.ai.stopDistance(kind))
    else R.ai.rangeState=nil end
    local inCombatRange=rangeMode~=nil and rangeMode~="approach"

                                                                          
                                                        

                                                                             
                                                                               
                                                                         
    if not inCombatRange and R.ai.gridPath and R.ai.committedPoint then
        local route=R.ai.gridPath
        local tail=route[#route]
        if (tail and (tail-rp.Position).Magnitude<math.max(12,(hum() and hum().WalkSpeed or 16)*1.5))
            or (R.ai.gridGoal and (R.ai.gridGoal-R.ai.navigationGoal(dest)).Magnitude>8)
            or R.ai.gridPathRevision~=R.ai.mapTopologyRevision then
            local nextPoint=pathTarget(rp,dest,kind=="enemy")
            if nextPoint then R.ai.committedPoint=nextPoint end
        end
    end
    if not inCombatRange and R.ai.gridPath and R.ai.committedPoint then
        R.ai.advanceWaypoints(rp,R.ai.gridPath,false)
        R.ai.committedPoint=R.ai.gridPath[1]
    end
    if not inCombatRange and R.ai.committedPoint and flat(R.ai.committedPoint-rp.Position).Magnitude>1.5
        and R.ai.connectedSegment(rp.Position,R.ai.committedPoint)
        and R.ai.routeStepSafe(rp.Position,R.ai.committedPoint) then
        local now=os.clock()
        if not R.ai.commitWatchPos or flat(rp.Position-R.ai.commitWatchPos).Magnitude>=0.5
            or R.ai.commitWatchPoint~=R.ai.committedPoint then
            R.ai.commitWatchPos=rp.Position;R.ai.commitWatchAt=now;R.ai.commitWatchPoint=R.ai.committedPoint
        elseif now-(R.ai.commitWatchAt or now)>1.25 then
                                                                            
                                                                             
            R.ai.committedPoint=nil;R.ai.gridPath=nil;R.ai.activeRoute=nil;R.ai.gridRetry=0
            R.ai.commitWatchPos=nil;R.ai.commitWatchPoint=nil
        end
        if R.ai.committedPoint then
            if pushVerifiedDir(R.ai.committedPoint-rp.Position) then
                R.status=R.ai.gridPathDrawn and "following drawn route" or "following checked route segment"
                return
            end
            R.ai.committedPoint=nil;R.ai.gridPath=nil;R.ai.activeRoute=nil
        end
    end
    if approachBlocked or (not inCombatRange and R.ai.gridPathDrawn and R.ai.gridPath and #R.ai.gridPath>0) then
        local waypoint=pathTarget(rp,dest,false)
        if waypoint then
            R.ai.grouping=false
            steerCamera(R.faceWant or dest)
            if not pushVerifiedDir(waypoint-rp.Position) then
                R.ai.gridPath=nil;R.ai.committedPoint=nil
            end
            R.status=R.ai.gridPathDrawn and "following drawn route" or "following connected map route"
            return
        end
                                                                              
                                                                            
                                                                            
                                                                          
                                                                             
                                                                        
                                                          
        if R.ai.mapReady then
            stopMoving()
            R.status=R.ai.planReason or "route unavailable"
            return
        end
                                                                              
                                                                               
                                          
        local toward=flat(dest-rp.Position)
        if toward.Magnitude>0.1 then
            local ahead=rp.Position+toward.Unit*math.min(5,toward.Magnitude)
            if R.ai.segmentUncached(rp.Position,ahead) and R.ai.safePass(rp.Position,ahead) then
                pushDir(toward.Unit)
                R.status="approaching while route computes"
                return
            end
        end
        stopMoving()
        R.status=R.ai.planReason or "route unavailable"
        return
    end

    R.ai.grouping=false
    if R.ai.rallyTrial and os.clock()-R.ai.rallyTrial.at>12 then R.ai.finishRally() end
                                                                             
    if rangeMode=="retreat" then
        local away=kiteDir(rp,R.target)
        steerCamera(R.faceWant or dest)
        pushDir(away)
        R.status="restoring casting distance"
        return
    end
                                                 
    if kind == "enemy" then
        local kdir, kd = kiteStep(rp)
        if kdir then
            steerCamera(R.faceWant or dest)
            pushDir(kdir)
            R.status = string.format("kiting %.0f", kd or 0)
            return
        end
    end

    local toDest = flat(dest - rp.Position)
    local dist = toDest.Magnitude
    local stop=R.ai.stopDistance(kind)
    if inCombatRange or (kind~="enemy" and dist<=stop and R.ai.segment(rp.Position,dest)) then
        clearPath()
        R.ai.committedPoint=nil;R.ai.lookahead=nil;R.ai.gridGoal=nil
        steerCamera(R.faceWant or dest)
        local t = R.target
        if kind == "enemy" and t and enemyAlive(t.model) then
            local now = os.clock()
            local hp = t.hum and t.hum.Health or 0
            if R.holdModel ~= t.model or math.abs((R.holdHP or hp) - hp) > 1 then
                R.holdModel, R.holdHP, R.holdAt = t.model, hp, now
            elseif not isRanged(t.kind) and now - R.holdAt > 8 then
                R.closeIn = now + 5
                R.holdAt = now
            end
            local face = R.faceWant or t.root.Position
            if S.EvadeEnabled then
                local learned=R.ai.learnedBossOrbit(rp,t)
                if learned and pushVerifiedDir(learned*6) then
                    R.status="keeping moving: learned player-targeted landing";return
                end
            end
            if S.OrbitBoss and t.kind == "Boss" then
                pushDir(orbitDir(rp, t))
                R.status = "orbiting boss"
                return
            end
                                                                                             
                                                                                            
                                                                        
            if S.FaceTarget and not S.BodyLock and not facingTarget(rp, face) then
                local push = flat(face - rp.Position)
                if push.Magnitude > 0.2 then
                    pushDir(push.Unit)
                    R.status = "turning on target"
                    return
                end
            end
        end
        stopMoving()
        R.status = (kind == "enemy") and "in range" or "room clear"
        return
    end

    local goal = pathTarget(rp, dest, kind == "enemy")
    if not goal then
                                                                            
                                                                               
        stopMoving();R.status=R.ai.planReason or "waiting for safe route";return
    end
    steerCamera((kind == "enemy") and (R.faceWant or dest) or goal)
    R.ai.committedPoint=goal
    R.ai.lookahead=R.ai.activeRoute and R.ai.activeRoute[math.min(#R.ai.activeRoute,4)] or goal
    local step = flat(goal - rp.Position)
                                                                            
                                                                       
                                                                            
                                                                              
                                
    local movedAlongRoute=pushVerifiedDir(step)
    if not movedAlongRoute then
        R.ai.gridPath=nil;R.ai.gridGoal=nil;R.ai.activeRoute=nil;R.ai.gridRetry=0
        R.status="verified route segment changed"
    end
    if movedAlongRoute then R.status = string.format("%s %.0f", (kind == "enemy") and "chasing" or "advancing", dist) end
end 

local function stuckStep()
    if R.riseOn then R.ai.progressAt=os.clock();return end
    local rp, h = root(), hum()
    if not rp or not h then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    if not R.farming or not S.MoveEnabled or not R.ai.moving or h.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
        R.ai.progressPos=rp.Position; R.ai.progressAt=now
        return
    end
    if not R.ai.progressPos or flat(rp.Position-R.ai.progressPos).Magnitude >= 2 then
        R.ai.progressPos=rp.Position; R.ai.progressAt=now
        return
    end
    if now-(R.ai.progressAt or now)<2.5 or now<(R.ai.recoverUntil or 0) then return end
    R.ai.progressAt=now
    R.ai.recoverUntil=now+4
    R.ai.forcePathUntil=now+6
                                                                            
                                                                         
    local size=R.ai.grid.size
    local x,z=math.round(rp.Position.X/size),math.round(rp.Position.Z/size)
    R.ai.dirtyMap=R.ai.dirtyMap or {}
    table.insert(R.ai.dirtyMap,{x-2,x+2,z-2,z+2})
    R.ai.lastNavigationFailure={reason="no physical progress",from=rp.Position,to=R.ai.committedPoint,at=now}
    R.ai.committedPoint=nil;R.ai.gridPath=nil;R.ai.activeRoute=nil
    R.ai.planEpoch=(R.ai.planEpoch or 0)+1;R.ai.gridBusy=false;R.ai.gridRetry=0
    stopMoving()
end
                                                                
         
                                                                

local function meleeSwing(x, y)
    if R.ai.damageWaitPending and R.ai.damageWaitPending(os.clock(),R.target) then return end
    R.ai.lastIntentMelee=os.clock()
    if R.ai.observation then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - R.lastClick < (tonumber(S.ClickDelay) or 0.2) then return end
    R.lastClick = now
    if S.AttackMode == "Remote" and fire("weaponUsed") then return end
    clickAt(x, y)
end

                                                                            
                                                                          
                                                                          
R.ai.combatPoint =                   function(enemy,from)
    local root=enemy.root
                                                                                
    if enemy.model.Name=="Crystal Golem" then return root.Position,root,nil,false end
    local now=os.clock();local body=enemy.combatBody
    if not body or now-body.at>2 then
        body={at=now,parts={root},extended=math.max(root.Size.X,root.Size.Y,root.Size.Z)>12}
        for _,part in ipairs(enemy.model:QueryDescendants("BasePart")) do
            local name=part.Name:lower()
            if part~=root and name~="handle" and (name=="head" or name=="chest" or name:find("torso",1,true) or name:find("hand",1,true)
                or name:find("foot",1,true) or name:find("arm",1,true) or name:find("leg",1,true)
                or name:find("hitbox",1,true)) and not part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool") and not part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Accessory") then
                body.parts[#body.parts+1]=part
                if (part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude>8 or math.max(part.Size.X,part.Size.Y,part.Size.Z)>12 then body.extended=true end
                if #body.parts>=24 then break end
            end
        end
        enemy.combatBody=body
    end
    if not body.extended then return root.Position,root,nil,false end
    local choices={}
    for _,part in ipairs(body.parts) do
        if not part.Parent or not part:IsDescendantOf(enemy.model) then continue end
        local localPoint=part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(from);local half=part.Size*.5
        local point=part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(
            math.clamp(localPoint.X,-half.X,half.X),math.clamp(localPoint.Y,-half.Y,half.Y),math.clamp(localPoint.Z,-half.Z,half.Z)))
        local inward=part.Position-point
        if inward.Magnitude>.01 then point+=inward.Unit*math.min(.35,inward.Magnitude) end
        choices[#choices+1]={point=point,part=part,distance=(point-from).Magnitude}
    end
    table.sort(choices,function(a,b)return a.distance<b.distance end)
    local selected=choices[1]
    for i=1,#choices do
        local candidate=choices[i]
        if R.ai.spellLineClear(from,candidate.point) then selected=candidate;selected.clear=true;break end
    end
    if not selected then return root.Position,root,false,true end
    enemy.combatAimPart=selected.part
    return selected.point,selected.part,selected.clear==true,true
end 

R.ai.flameCluster=                  function(target)
    local rp=root()
    if not rp or not target or not target.root then return {},nil end
    local members={target};local included={[target.model]=true}
    local radius=math.clamp(tonumber(S.ClusterRadius) or 18,4,40)
    local now=os.clock();local parent=target.model.Parent
    local spacing=R.ai.groupSpacing
    if not spacing or spacing.parent~=parent or now>=spacing.untilAt then
        local peers={};local nearest={}
        for _,e in ipairs(R.enemies)do
            if e.root and e.model.Parent==parent and e.kind~="Boss" and enemyAlive(e.model)then peers[#peers+1]=e end
        end
        if #peers<=64 then
            for _,e in ipairs(peers)do
                local distance=math.huge
                for _,other in ipairs(peers)do
                    if other~=e and math.abs(e.root.Position.Y-other.root.Position.Y)<=6 then
                        distance=math.min(distance,(e.root.Position-other.root.Position).Magnitude)
                    end
                end
                if distance<40 then nearest[#nearest+1]=distance end
            end
        end
        table.sort(nearest)
        spacing={parent=parent,untilAt=now+.5,radius=#nearest>=3 and math.min(40,nearest[math.ceil(#nearest*.5)]*2)or 0}
        R.ai.groupSpacing=spacing
    end
    radius=math.max(radius,spacing.radius)
    R.ai.groupLinkDistance=radius

    if S.AimCluster~=false and target.kind~="Boss" then
        local cursor=1
        while cursor<=#members do
            local seed=members[cursor];cursor+=1
            for _,enemy in ipairs(R.enemies)do
                if included[enemy.model] or enemy.kind=="Boss" or not enemy.root or not enemyAlive(enemy.model)
                    or enemy.model.Parent~=target.model.Parent then continue end
                local p=enemy.root.Position
                if math.abs(p.Y-target.root.Position.Y)>6 or (p-seed.root.Position).Magnitude>radius or (p-target.root.Position).Magnitude>16 then continue end
                local compact=true
                for _,member in ipairs(members)do
                    if (p-member.root.Position).Magnitude>radius*3 then compact=false;break end
                end
                if compact and R.ai.spellLineClear(seed.root.Position,p)then
                    included[enemy.model]=true;members[#members+1]=enemy
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local low,high=target.root.Position,target.root.Position
    for _,enemy in ipairs(members)do
        local p=enemy.root.Position
        low=Vector3.new(math.min(low.X,p.X),math.min(low.Y,p.Y),math.min(low.Z,p.Z))
        high=Vector3.new(math.max(high.X,p.X),math.max(high.Y,p.Y),math.max(high.Z,p.Z))
    end
    local center=(low+high)*.5
    return members,center
end 

local aimPoint; aimPoint =                   function(t)
    local actor=root()
    if actor then
        local point,_,_,extended=R.ai.combatPoint(t,actor.Position)
        if extended then return point end
    end
    for key,slot in pairs(R.ai.slots or {})do
        if S["Use"..key]and slot.name=="Flame Shuriken"and R.ai.skillStillEquipped(slot)then local _,aim=R.ai.flameCluster(t);return aim or t.root.Position end
    end
    local current=root()
    if current then
        local point,_,_,extended=R.ai.combatPoint(t,current.Position)
        if extended then return point end
    end
    local rp = root()
    if not rp then return t.root.Position end
    local best, score = t.root.Position, -math.huge
    for _, candidate in ipairs(R.enemies) do
        if enemyAlive(candidate.model) then
            local delta = candidate.root.Position-rp.Position
            if delta.Magnitude > 0.1 and delta.Magnitude <= R.ai.range() then
                local direction, hits = delta.Unit, 0
                for _, e in ipairs(R.enemies) do
                    if enemyAlive(e.model) then
                        local v = e.root.Position-rp.Position
                        local along = v:Dot(direction)
                        if along > 0 and along <= R.ai.range() and (v-direction*along).Magnitude <= 3 then hits += 1 end
                    end
                end
                if hits > score then best, score = candidate.root.Position, hits end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end 

local aimedAt; aimedAt =                   function(pos)
    local cam, rp = workspace.CurrentCamera, root()
    if not cam or not rp then return false end
    local want = flat(pos - rp.Position)
    local have = flat(cam.CFrame.LookVector)
    if want.Magnitude < 0.2 or have.Magnitude < 0.05 then return true end
    local tol = math.cos(math.rad(math.clamp(tonumber(S.AimTolerance) or 25, 3, 90)))
    return want.Unit:Dot(have.Unit) >= tol
end

R.ai.combatRangePolicy=(function()
local P={}
local function positive(n)
    n=tonumber(n)
    return n and n==n and n>0 and n<10000 and n or nil
end
P.range =                   function(explicit,override,reference,close,fallback)
    local n=positive(override)
    if n then return n,"manual" end
    n=positive(explicit)
    if n then return n,"tool" end
    n=reference and positive(reference.rangeEstimate)
    if n then return n,reference.rangeSource or "estimate" end
    return close and 18 or positive(fallback) or 55,"fallback"
end 
function P.mobility(reference,known,mode,now)
    if mode=="No" then return false end
    if mode=="Yes" then return true end
    if known and now<(known.retryAfter or 0)then return false end
    return reference and reference.speedBoost==true or known and (known.n or 0)>=2 or false
end
function P.speedResult(known,raised,confirmed,travel,now)
    if not confirmed then return false end
    if raised then known.n=math.min(100,(known.n or 0)+1);known.misses=0;known.retryAfter=nil
    elseif travel then
        known.misses=math.min(100,(known.misses or 0)+1)
        if known.misses>=3 then known.retryAfter=now+30 end
    end
    return true
end
return P

end)()

end

function R.ai.skillValue(tool,name)
    if not tool then return nil end
    local child=tool:FindFirstChild(name)
    if child and child:IsA("ValueBase") then return child.Value end
    return tool:GetAttribute(name)
end

function R.ai.classifySkill(tool,key)
    local a=R.ai
    local instanceName=tostring(tool.Name)
    local generic=instanceName:lower()=="tool" or instanceName:lower()=="ability" or instanceName:lower()=="skill"
    local name=generic and tostring(a.skillValue(tool,"name") or instanceName) or instanceName
    local reference=a.skillCatalog[name:lower()]
    local role=reference and reference.role or "unknown"
    local school=reference and reference.school
                                                                                     
    local liveSchool=tostring(a.skillValue(tool,"damageType") or a.skillValue(tool,"scalesWith") or ""):lower()
    if liveSchool=="physical" or liveSchool=="physical power" then school="physical"
    elseif liveSchool=="magic" or liveSchool=="spell power" then school="magic" end
    local buff=tonumber(a.skillValue(tool,"buffPower"))
    if buff and buff>0 then role="booster"
    elseif role=="unknown" and tonumber(a.skillValue(tool,"damage")) then role="damage" end
    local override=S["SkillRole"..key] or "Auto"
    if override=="Magic damage" then role,school="damage","magic"
    elseif override=="Physical damage" then role,school="damage","physical"
    elseif override=="Magic booster" then role,school="booster","magic"
    elseif override=="Physical booster" then role,school="booster","physical"
    elseif override=="Healing" then role,school="heal","magic"
    elseif override=="Support" then role,school="support",nil end
    return name,role,school,reference and reference.settle or .25,buff,reference
end

                                                                                 
                                                                                 
                                                                      
R.ai.damageIntent =                   function(target,rp,now)
    local a=R.ai
    local state=a.finishEvidence
    local stamp=tostring(a.skillValue(LP,"weaponEquipped"))..":"..tostring(a.skillValue(LP,"spellPower"))..":"..tostring(a.skillValue(LP,"physicalPower"))
        ..":"..tostring(S.SkillRoleQ)..":"..tostring(S.SkillRoleE)..":"..tostring(S.SkillOriginQ)..":"..tostring(S.SkillOriginE)
    local q,e=a.slots.Q,a.slots.E
    local dungeon=a.course and a.course.dungeon
    if not state or state.character~=char() or state.dungeon~=dungeon or state.stamp~=stamp or state.q~=q or state.e~=e then
        state={character=char(),dungeon=dungeon,stamp=stamp,q=q,e=e,records={},count=0};a.finishEvidence=state
    end
    if now>=(state.playerCheck or 0) then
        state.playerCheck=now+1;state.solo=#game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()==1
    end
    local source,ambiguous=0,not state.solo or a.lastIntentMelee and now<a.lastIntentMelee+.6
    local ready,active=false,false
    for key,p in pairs(a.slots) do
        if S["Use"..key] and a.skillStillEquipped(p) then
            if p.role=="booster" then ambiguous=true end
            if p.role=="damage" then
                ready=ready or a.spellSlotReady(p,now)
                local effect=p.activeEffect
                local live=effect and now>=effect.from and now<effect.untilAt
                local fired=p.intentCastAt and now-p.intentCastAt<=math.max(.8,(p.windup or 0)+.4)
                    and ((a.skillCooldown(p) or 0)>0 or p.cooldownSeen)
                if live or fired then
                    source+=key=="Q" and 1 or 2
                    active=active or live and (effect.origin=="follow" or target and a.placedSkillCovers(target)) or false
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local watch=state.watch
    if watch then
        local hp=watch.hum.Health
                                                                                
                                                                    
        if hp<watch.hp and now-watch.at<=.3 and not ambiguous and source>0 and source==watch.source and not watch.ambiguous then
            local amount=hp<=0 and watch.hp or (watch.hp-hp)*.9
            local key=watch.kind.."|"..source
            local record=state.records[key]
            if not record and state.count<64 then record={n=0,amount=amount};state.records[key]=record;state.count+=1 end
            if record then
                if now-(record.at or now)>30 then record.n=0;record.amount=amount end
                record.amount=math.min(record.amount,amount);record.n=math.min(20,record.n+1);record.at=now
            end
        end
    end
    local h=target and target.model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local kind=target and tostring(target.kind).."|"..target.model.Name
    state.watch=h and {hum=h,hp=h.Health,at=now,source=source,ambiguous=ambiguous,kind=kind} or nil
    local intent={mode="approach",ready=ready,active=active,range=math.max(3,a.range()-4),target=target and target.model}
    if not h or h.Health<=0 or S.AttackEnabled==false then a.combatIntent=intent;return intent end
    local estimate=0
    if not ambiguous then
        local availableMask=0
        for key,p in pairs(a.slots) do
            if S["Use"..key] and p.role=="damage" and a.skillStillEquipped(p) then
                local effect=p.activeEffect
                local available=a.spellSlotReady(p,now) or effect and effect.origin=="follow" and now>=effect.from and effect.untilAt-now>.35
                if available then availableMask+=key=="Q" and 1 or 2 end
            end
        end
        for mask=1,3 do
            local record=state.records[kind.."|"..mask]
            if bit32.band(availableMask,mask)==mask and record and record.n>=3 and now-record.at<30 then estimate=math.max(estimate,record.amount) end
        end
    end
    if a.expectedSpellDamage then
        for key,p in pairs(a.slots)do
            if S["Use"..key] and p.role=="damage" and a.skillStillEquipped(p) and a.spellSlotReady(p,now) then
                estimate=math.max(estimate,a.expectedSpellDamage(p,target,now))
            end
        end
    end
    intent.damage=estimate
    if estimate>=h.Health then intent.mode="finish"
    elseif estimate>0 or not ready and not active then intent.mode="kite" end
    a.combatIntent=intent
    return intent
end 

R.ai.spellLineClear =                   function(from,to)
    local base=R.ai.geometryParams()
    local params=RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances=base.FilterDescendantsInstances
    params.RespectCanCollide=base.RespectCanCollide
    params.IgnoreWater=base.IgnoreWater
    params.CollisionGroup=base.CollisionGroup
    return workspace:Raycast(from,to-from,params)==nil
end 

function R.ai.scanSpells()
    local a=R.ai
    local now=os.clock()
    if a.damageWait then a.damageWaitPending(now,R.target) end
    if now<(a.scanAt or 0) then return end
    a.scanAt=now+.5
    if a.skillCooldownCharacter~=char() then a.slots={};a.slotCooldownDeadline("Q") end
    if a.observeSkillSpeed then a.observeSkillSpeed(now) end
    local tools={}
    local function collect(folder)
        if not folder then return end
        for _,tool in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            if tool:IsA("Tool") and tool:FindFirstChild("abilitySlot") then tools[#tools+1]=tool end
        end
    end
    collect(LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack"));collect(char())
    local gui=LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    local abilities=gui and gui:FindFirstChild("abilities")
    local frame=abilities and abilities:FindFirstChild("Frame")
    for _,key in ipairs({"Q","E"}) do
        local panel=frame and frame:FindFirstChild(key=="Q" and "LeftAbility" or "RightAbility")
        local matched,count=nil,0
        for _,tool in ipairs(tools) do
            if tostring(a.skillValue(tool,"abilitySlot")):lower()==key:lower() then
                matched=tool;count+=1
            end
        end
                                                                                     
                                                                                    
        local previous=a.slots[key]
        if previous then a.observeSlotCooldown(previous,now,count~=1 or previous.tool~=matched or previous.name~=select(1,a.classifySkill(matched,key))) end
        if count~=1 then a.slots[key]=nil
        else
            local name,role,school,settle,buff,reference=a.classifySkill(matched,key)
            local p=a.slots[key]
            if not p or p.tool~=matched or p.name~=name then
                p={tool=matched,next=0,inputUntil=0,hits=0,damage=0}
                a.slots[key]=p
            end
            p.name,p.role,p.school,p.settle,p.buffPower=name,role,school,settle,buff
            p.key,p.panel=key,panel
            local known=a.skillMobility and a.skillMobility[name]
            p.speedBoost=a.combatRangePolicy.mobility(reference,known,S["SkillSpeed"..key],now)
            p.speedDuration=reference and reference.speedDuration or 3
            p.origin=reference and reference.origin or "unknown"
            p.shape=reference and reference.shape or "unknown"
            p.throughWalls=reference and reference.throughWalls==true
            p.behaviorSource=reference and reference.behaviorSource or "Unverified behavior"
            local mode=S["SkillOrigin"..key]
            if mode=="Follows character" then p.origin="follow";p.shape="radial"
            elseif mode=="Fixed at cast" then p.origin="snapshot";p.shape="radial"
            elseif mode=="Projectile / forward" then p.origin="projectile" end
            p.duration=reference and reference.duration or 0;p.windup=reference and reference.windup or 0
            p.offset=reference and reference.offset or 0
            p.vertical=reference and reference.verticalEstimate or 6
            local close=p.shape=="radial"
            p.close=close
            local override=tonumber(S["SkillRadius"..key])
            p.range,p.rangeSource=a.combatRangePolicy.range(a.skillValue(matched,"Range"),override,reference,close,S.SpellRange)
            p.engageRange=p.name=="Flame Shuriken" and math.max(1,math.min(p.range,82)-2)or p.range+(p.origin=="snapshot" and p.offset or 0)
            p.cooldown=math.max(.2,tonumber(a.skillValue(matched,"cooldownLength")) or tonumber(a.skillValue(matched,"Cooldown")) or .8)
            p.estimated=p.rangeSource~="tool" and p.rangeSource~="manual"
            local pending=p.effectPending
            if pending then
                local busy=char() and char():FindFirstChild("busyCasting")
                local remaining=tonumber(a.skillValue(matched,"cooldown"))
