                if (remaining and remaining>0) or (a.skillCastConfirmed and a.skillCastConfirmed(p)) or (busy and busy.Value==true) then
                    p.activeEffect={origin=p.origin,point=pending.point,from=pending.at+p.windup,untilAt=pending.at+p.windup+p.duration}
                    p.effectPending=nil
                elseif now-pending.at>1.5 then
                    p.effectPending=nil;p.inputUntil=now;p.next=now
                end
            end
            if p.activeEffect and now>=p.activeEffect.untilAt then p.activeEffect=nil end
            a.observeSlotCooldown(p,now,false)
        end
    end
    if a.refreshCastObserver then a.refreshCastObserver()end
end

R.ai.skillStillEquipped =                   function(p)
    return p and p.tool and p.tool.Parent
        and (p.tool.Parent==LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack") or p.tool.Parent==char())
        and tostring(R.ai.skillValue(p.tool,"abilitySlot")):lower()==p.key:lower()
end 

R.ai.skillCooldown =                   function(p)
    local remaining=tonumber(R.ai.skillValue(p.tool,"cooldown"))
    local label=p.panel and p.panel:FindFirstChild("cooldownNumber",true)
    local displayed=label and label.Visible and tonumber(label.Text)
    if displayed then return math.max(remaining or 0,displayed) end
    return remaining
end 

function R.ai.slotCooldownDeadline(key)
    local a=R.ai;local character=char()
    if a.skillCooldownCharacter~=character then a.skillCooldownCharacter=character;a.skillSlotClocks={} end
    a.skillSlotClocks=a.skillSlotClocks or {}
    return a.skillSlotClocks[key] or 0
end

function R.ai.observeSlotCooldown(p,now,changing)
    local a=R.ai;local deadline=a.slotCooldownDeadline(p.key)
    local remaining=a.skillCooldown(p)
    if remaining and remaining>0 then
        deadline=math.max(deadline,now+remaining,p.intentCastAt and p.next or 0)
        p.cooldownSeen=true
    end
                                                                             
    if changing and p.intentCastAt then deadline=math.max(deadline,p.next or 0,p.inputUntil or 0) end
    a.skillSlotClocks[p.key]=deadline
    return deadline
end

R.ai.spellSlotReady =                   function(p,now)
    if not R.ai.skillStillEquipped(p) or now<(p.inputUntil or 0) or now<(p.retryAt or 0) then return false end
    if now<R.ai.observeSlotCooldown(p,now,false) then return false end
    local remaining=R.ai.skillCooldown(p)
    if remaining and remaining>0 then p.cooldownSeen=true;return false end
                                                                                 
                                                                                     
    if remaining~=nil then return not p.cooldownSeen or now>=(p.next or 0) end
    return now>=(p.next or 0)
end 

R.ai.range =                   function()
    R.ai.scanSpells()
    local range=0
    for key,p in pairs(R.ai.slots) do
        if S["Use"..key] and (p.role=="damage" or p.role=="unknown" or S.BoosterRotation==false) then
            range=math.max(range,p.engageRange or p.range)
        end
    end
    return range>0 and range or (tonumber(S.MeleeRange) or 12)
end 

R.ai.reachRampPolicy=(function()
local P={}
function P.flame(range,x,y,z,vx,vy,vz,windup)
    if type(range)~='number'or range~=range or range<=0 then return false end
    local reach=math.min(range,82)
    local function inside(a,b,c)return c>0 and a*a+b*b+c*c<=(reach-.75)^2 and math.abs(a)<20 end
    local dt=math.clamp(windup or .4,0,.4)
    return inside(x,y,z)and inside(x+vx*dt,y+vy*dt,z+vz*dt)
end
return P

end)()

R.ai.skillCanReach =                   function(p,t,rp)
    if not p or not t or not t.root or not t.root.Parent or not rp then return false end
    local targetPoint=R.ai.combatPoint(t,rp.Position) or t.root.Position
    local approach=R.ai.missedSpellApproach
    if approach and approach.model==t.model and approach.name==p.name and os.clock()<approach.untilAt
        and (targetPoint-rp.Position).Magnitude>approach.range then return false end
    if p.name=="Flame Shuriken" then
        local _,_,_,extended=R.ai.combatPoint(t,rp.Position)
        local members=extended and {t} or R.ai.flameCluster(t)
        for _,enemy in ipairs(members)do
            if not enemy.root or not enemy.root.Parent or not enemyAlive(enemy.model) then continue end
            local point=R.ai.combatPoint(enemy,rp.Position) or enemy.root.Position
            local delta=rp.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
            local enemyVelocity=rp.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(enemy.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity)
            local ownVelocity=rp.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(rp.AssemblyLinearVelocity)
            local windup=math.clamp(p.windup or .4,0,.4)
            local velocity=enemyVelocity-ownVelocity
            if not R.ai.reachRampPolicy.flame(p.range,delta.X,delta.Y,-delta.Z,velocity.X,velocity.Y,-velocity.Z,windup) then return false end
            local arrival=delta+velocity*windup+enemyVelocity*.3
            if not R.ai.reachRampPolicy.flame(p.range,arrival.X,arrival.Y,-arrival.Z,0,0,0,0)then return false end
        end
        return #members>0
    end
    if p.name=="Gale Barrage" then
        local _,_,_,extended=R.ai.combatPoint(t,rp.Position)
        local members=extended and {t} or R.ai.flameCluster(t)
        for _,enemy in ipairs(members)do
            if enemy.root and enemy.root.Parent and enemyAlive(enemy.model)then
                local point=R.ai.combatPoint(enemy,rp.Position) or enemy.root.Position
                local relative=enemy.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity-rp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                local arrival=point+relative*math.clamp(p.windup or .4,0,.4)+enemy.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity*.3
                if (point-rp.Position).Magnitude>p.range-.75 or (arrival-rp.Position).Magnitude>p.range-.75 then return false end
            end
        end
    end
    local point=t.root.Position
    if R.ai.combatPoint then point=R.ai.combatPoint(t,rp.Position) or point end
    if p.close then
        local origin=rp.Position
        if p.origin=="snapshot" and (p.offset or 0)>0 and rp.CFrame then origin+=rp.CFrame.LookVector*p.offset end
        local delta=point-origin
        return math.abs(delta.Y)<=p.vertical and Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z).Magnitude<=p.range
    end
    return (point-rp.Position).Magnitude<=p.range
end 

R.ai.canAttackThroughWall =                   function(t,rp)
    local a=R.ai
    a.scanSpells()
    for key,p in pairs(a.slots) do
        if S["Use"..key] and p.role=="damage" and p.throughWalls and a.skillStillEquipped(p)
            and a.skillCanReach(p,t,rp) then return true end
    end
    return false
end 

R.ai.skillCanCast =                   function(p,t,rp)
    if not R.ai.skillCanReach(p,t,rp) then return false end
    if p.throughWalls or not R.ai.spellLineClear then return true end
    local point=R.ai.combatPoint and R.ai.combatPoint(t,rp.Position) or t.root.Position
    return R.ai.spellLineClear(rp.Position,point)
end 

R.ai.sampleActorMotion=function(previous,position,now)
    if not previous or now<=previous.at or now-previous.at>=.5 then
        return Vector3.zero,{pos=position,at=now,velocity=Vector3.zero,samples={{pos=position,at=now}}}
    end
    local samples=previous.samples or {{pos=previous.pos,at=previous.at}}
    if (position-previous.pos).Magnitude>40 then
        return Vector3.zero,{pos=position,at=now,velocity=Vector3.zero,samples={{pos=position,at=now}}}
    end
    if now-samples[#samples].at<.02 then return previous.velocity or Vector3.zero,previous end
    samples[#samples+1]={pos=position,at=now}
    while #samples>2 and samples[2].at<=now-.25 do table.remove(samples,1)end
    local first=samples[1];local dt=now-first.at
    local delta=position-first.pos
    local measured=dt>=.04 and Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z)/dt or previous.velocity or Vector3.zero
    if measured.Magnitude>=80 then measured=Vector3.zero end
    return measured,{pos=position,at=now,velocity=measured,samples=samples}
end

R.ai.packGatherGoal=function(target,rp)
    if not S.GroupEnemies or not target or target.kind=="Boss" or not target.root or not target.model then return end
    local center,count,farthest=Vector3.zero,0,0
    local members={}
    local range=math.max(8,R.ai.range()-8)
    for _,enemy in ipairs(R.enemies or {})do
        if enemy.kind~="Boss" and enemy.model and enemy.model.Parent==target.model.Parent and enemy.root
            and enemy.hum and enemy.hum.Health>0 and math.abs(enemy.root.Position.Y-rp.Position.Y)<6
            and flat(enemy.root.Position-target.root.Position).Magnitude<=70 then
            center+=enemy.root.Position;count+=1
            members[#members+1]=enemy
            farthest=math.max(farthest,flat(enemy.root.Position-rp.Position).Magnitude)
        end
    end
    R.ai.packGatherEvidence={members=count,farthest=farthest,range=range}
    if count<2 or farthest<=range then return end
    center/=count
    local toward=flat(center-rp.Position)
    if toward.Magnitude<1 then return end
    local step=math.min(toward.Magnitude,math.max(3,farthest-range+2))
                                                                                
    for _,enemy in ipairs(members)do
        local offset=flat(enemy.root.Position-rp.Position)
        local ranged=enemy.kind=="Caster" or enemy.kind=="Archer"
        local radius=ranged and 10 or math.max(10,(enemy.attackDistance or enemy.reach or 4)+8)
        local along=offset:Dot(toward.Unit)
        local perpendicular=offset.Magnitude^2-along^2
        if along>0 and perpendicular<radius^2 then
            step=math.min(step,math.max(0,along-math.sqrt(radius^2-perpendicular)))
        end
    end
    R.ai.packGatherEvidence.step=step
                                                                         
                                                                               
    if step<1 then
        R.ai.packGatherEvidence.blocked=true
        return
    end
    return rp.Position+toward.Unit*step,range
end

R.ai.packCooldownGoal=function(target,rp,now)
    if not S.GroupEnemies or not target or target.kind=="Boss"then return end
    local any=false
    for key,slot in pairs(R.ai.slots or {})do
        if S["Use"..key]and slot.role=="damage"and R.ai.skillStillEquipped(slot)then
            any=true;if R.ai.spellSlotReady(slot,now)then return end
        end
    end
    if not any then return end
    local anchor=target;local lowest=math.huge
    for _,enemy in ipairs(R.enemies or {target})do
        if enemy.kind~="Boss"and enemy.room==target.room and enemy.root and enemy.model and enemy.model.Parent
            and enemy.hum and enemy.hum.Health>0 then
            local d=flat(rp.Position-enemy.root.Position).Magnitude
            local gap=d-(enemy.attackDistance or enemy.reach or 4)
            if d<140 and gap<lowest then anchor=enemy;lowest=gap end
        end
    end
    local delta=flat(rp.Position-anchor.root.Position);local aggro=anchor.aggro or 50
    local spacing=math.max((anchor.attackDistance or anchor.reach or 4)+8,aggro-3)
    if delta.Magnitude<.1 or delta.Magnitude>spacing+32 then return end
    local away=delta.Unit
    local goal=Vector3.new(anchor.root.Position.X,rp.Position.Y,anchor.root.Position.Z)+away*math.max(spacing,delta.Magnitude)
    local c=R.ai.adaptive
    if c and c.io and c.io.probe then
        local cached=R.ai.packOutlet
        if cached and now<cached.untilTime and cached.anchor==anchor.model
            and flat(cached.from-rp.Position).Magnitude<4 then return cached.goal,spacing end
                                                                            
                                                                                   
        local outlet=goal+away*12
        local clear=c.io.probe(rp.Position,outlet)
        if not clear or flat(clear-outlet).Magnitude>1.5 then
            local side=Vector3.new(-away.Z,0,away.X)
            for _,direction in ipairs({(away+side).Unit,(away-side).Unit,side,-side})do
                local candidate=rp.Position+direction*12
                local point=c.io.probe(rp.Position,candidate)
                local escape=point and c.io.probe(point,point+away*12)
                if point and flat(point-candidate).Magnitude<1.5 and escape
                    and flat(escape-(point+away*12)).Magnitude<1.5 then goal=point;break end
            end
        end
        R.ai.packOutlet={anchor=anchor.model,from=rp.Position,goal=goal,untilTime=now+.3}
    end
    return goal,spacing
end

R.ai.damageApproachReady=function(target,rp)
    local a=R.ai;local any,ready=false,false
    for key,slot in pairs(a.slots or {})do
        if S["Use"..key]and slot.role=="damage"and a.skillStillEquipped(slot)then
            local reachable=a.skillCanCast(slot,target,rp)
            any=any or reachable
            if a.spellSlotReady(slot,os.clock())then
                ready=true
                if not reachable then return false end
            end
        end
    end
    return any
end

R.ai.placedSkillCovers =                   function(target)
    local now=os.clock()
    for key,p in pairs(R.ai.slots) do
        local effect=p.activeEffect
        if S["Use"..key] and R.ai.skillStillEquipped(p) and effect and effect.origin=="snapshot"
            and now>=effect.from and now<effect.untilAt then
            local point=R.ai.combatPoint and R.ai.combatPoint(target,effect.point) or target.root.Position
            local delta=point-effect.point
            if math.abs(delta.Y)<=p.vertical and Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z).Magnitude<=p.range then return true end
        end
    end
    return false
end 

R.ai.observeSkillSpeed =                   function(now)
    local a=R.ai;local ch=char();local h=ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not h or S.SpeedOverride then a.speedObservation=nil;return end
    if not a.skillMobility then
        a.skillMobility={}
        local saved=a.learning and a.learning.skillMobility
        if type(saved)=="table" then
            local count=0
            for name,p in pairs(saved) do
                if count>=128 then break end
                if type(name)=="string" and #name<=100 and type(p)=="table" then
                    a.skillMobility[name]={n=math.clamp(tonumber(p.n) or 0,0,100),misses=math.clamp(tonumber(p.misses) or 0,0,100)};count+=1
                end
            end
        end
        if a.learning then a.learning.skillMobility=a.skillMobility end
    end
    local obs=a.speedObservation
    if obs then
        if ch~=obs.character or not a.skillStillEquipped(obs.slot) then a.speedObservation=nil;return end
        local raised=type(h.WalkSpeed)=="number" and h.WalkSpeed>obs.speed+2
        if raised or now>=obs.deadline then
            local confirmed=obs.slot.intentCastAt==obs.at and ((a.skillCastConfirmed and a.skillCastConfirmed(obs.slot)) or obs.slot.cooldownSeen==true)
            if not obs.ambiguous and confirmed then
                local known=a.skillMobility[obs.name]
                local count=0;for _ in pairs(a.skillMobility) do count+=1 end
                if known or count<128 then
                    known=known or {n=0,misses=0};a.skillMobility[obs.name]=known
                    a.combatRangePolicy.speedResult(known,raised,confirmed,obs.travel,now)
                end
                if raised then a.travelBoostUntil=math.max(a.travelBoostUntil or 0,obs.at+obs.slot.speedDuration)
                elseif obs.travel then a.travelBoostUntil=now end
            end
            if obs.travel and not confirmed then a.travelBoostUntil=now end
            a.speedObservation=nil
        end
    elseif now>=(a.travelBoostUntil or 0) then
                                                                              
                                                                             
        if a.travelBaseCharacter~=ch then a.travelBaseCharacter=ch;a.travelBaseSpeed=h.WalkSpeed
        else a.travelBaseSpeed=math.min(a.travelBaseSpeed or h.WalkSpeed,h.WalkSpeed)end
    end
end 

function R.ai.observeDamageGear(raw)
    if type(raw)~="table" then return end
    local rows={}
    for _,bucket in ipairs({"weapons","helmets","chests"})do
        if type(raw[bucket])~="table" then return end
        local count=0
        for id,item in pairs(raw[bucket])do
            count+=1;if count>500 then return end
            if type(item)=="table" and item.equipped==true then
                rows[#rows+1]=table.concat({bucket,tostring(id),tostring(item.name),tostring(item.currentUpgrade),
                    tostring(item.physicalDamage),tostring(item.physicalPower),tostring(item.spellPower)},":")
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(rows);R.ai.damageGearStamp=table.concat(rows,"|")
end

R.ai.spellDamageState =                   function()
    local a=R.ai
    local stamp=tostring(a.skillValue(LP,"weaponEquipped"))..":"..tostring(a.skillValue(LP,"spellPower"))..":"..tostring(a.skillValue(LP,"physicalPower"))
        ..":"..tostring(a.skillValue(LP,"enchantment"))..":"..tostring(a.damageGearStamp)
        ..":"..tostring(a.skillValue(LP:FindFirstChild("leaderstats"),"Level"))
    local dungeon=a.course and a.course.dungeon
    local state=a.spellDamageMemory
    if not state or state.character~=char() or state.dungeon~=dungeon or state.stamp~=stamp then
        state={character=char(),dungeon=dungeon,stamp=stamp,records={},count=0};a.spellDamageMemory=state
    end
    return state
end 

R.ai.spellDamageKey =                   function(p,t,boost)
    return p.name.."|"..tostring(p.school).."|"..tostring(p.origin).."|"..tostring(t.kind).."|"..t.model.Name.."|"..(boost or "base")
end 

R.ai.expectedSpellDamage =                   function(p,t,now,boost)
    if not p or not t or not t.model then return 0 end
    local state=R.ai.spellDamageState()
    local record=state.records[R.ai.spellDamageKey(p,t,boost)]
    if not record or record.n<2 or now-record.at>90 then return 0 end
    return record.amount
end 

R.ai.finishBeforeHit =                   function(target,rp,now)
    local a=R.ai
    if not target or not target.hum or target.hum.Health<=0 or not rp then return end
    local state=a.spellDamageState()
    local point=a.combatPoint(target,rp.Position)
    local range=(point-rp.Position).Magnitude
    local best
    for key,p in pairs(a.slots or {})do
        if not S["Use"..key]or p.role~="damage"or not a.skillStillEquipped(p)then continue end
        local pending=a.damageWait
        local inFlight=pending and pending.slot==p and pending.target==target and pending.lethal and a.skillCastConfirmed(p)
        if not inFlight then continue end
        local record=state.records[inFlight and pending.key or a.spellDamageKey(p,target)]
        if not record or record.n<3 or now-record.at>30 or record.amount<target.hum.Health
            or not record.delay or not record.maxDistance or range>record.maxDistance+1 then continue end
        local finish=(inFlight and pending.at or now)+math.max(record.delay,p.windup or 0)+.2
        if finish>now and finish-now<2 and (not best or finish<best.killAt)then best={owner=target.model,killAt=finish}end
    end
    return best
end 

R.ai.isolatedSpellHit =                   function(t,now)
    local a=R.ai
    if not t or not t.root or not game or a.lastIntentMelee and now-a.lastIntentMelee<.8 then return false end
    for _,player in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers())do
        if player~=LP then
            local c=player.Character;local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root=c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not root or h and h.Health>0 and (root.Position-t.root.Position).Magnitude<160 then return false end
        end
    end
    return true
end 

R.ai.damageWaitPending =                   function(now,target)
    local a=R.ai;local pending=a.damageWait
    if not pending then return false end
    if pending.state~=a.spellDamageState() then a.damageWait=nil;return false end
    if now>=pending.deadline then
        local rp=root()
        local confirmed=a.skillCastConfirmed and a.skillCastConfirmed(pending.slot)
        if confirmed and not pending.hitAt and pending.hum.Parent and pending.hum.Health>=pending.hp
            and pending.slot.origin=="projectile" and pending.origin and pending.targetPosition and rp
            and pending.target.root and pending.target.root.Parent then
            local point=a.combatPoint(pending.target,rp.Position)
            local distance=math.min((pending.targetPosition-pending.origin).Magnitude,(point-rp.Position).Magnitude)
            a.missedSpellApproach={model=pending.target.model,name=pending.name,
                range=math.max(3,distance-math.max(4,distance*.12)),untilAt=now+60}
        end
        local record=pending.state.records[pending.key]
        if pending.lethal and not pending.hitAt and record then record.n=0;record.samples={} end
        a.damageWait=nil;return false
    end
    if pending.learn and not a.isolatedSpellHit(pending.target,now) then pending.learn=false end
    local hp=pending.hum.Health
    if hp<pending.hp then
        if not pending.hitAt then
            pending.hitAt=now
            local state=pending.state;local record=state.records[pending.key]
            local confirmed=(a.skillCooldown(pending.slot) or 0)>0 or pending.slot.cooldownSeen
                or (a.skillCastConfirmed and a.skillCastConfirmed(pending.slot))
            if pending.learn and confirmed and (record or state.count<64) then
                local amount=hp<=0 and pending.hp or (pending.hp-hp)*.95
                if not record then record={n=0,amount=amount,samples={}};state.records[pending.key]=record;state.count+=1 end
                                                                            
                if now-(record.at or now)>90 then record.samples={};record.n=0 end
                table.insert(record.samples,amount);if #record.samples>6 then table.remove(record.samples,1) end
                record.amount=math.huge;for _,sample in ipairs(record.samples)do record.amount=math.min(record.amount,sample)end
                record.n=math.min(20,record.n+1);record.at=now
                record.delay=math.max(record.delay or 0,now-pending.at)
                if pending.origin and pending.targetPosition then record.maxDistance=math.max(record.maxDistance or 0,(pending.targetPosition-pending.origin).Magnitude)end
            elseif pending.lethal and hp>0 and record then
                record.amount=math.min(record.amount,(pending.hp-hp)*.95);record.n=0;record.samples={}
            end
        end
                                                                                
                                                                              
        if hp>0 or now>=pending.hitAt+.15 then a.damageWait=nil;return false end
    elseif not pending.hum.Parent then a.damageWait=nil;return false end
    local same=not target or target.model==pending.target.model
    local hold=pending.hold and (same or pending.hitAt~=nil)
    if hold then a.skillStatus=pending.lethal and "Lethal "..pending.name.." already cast" or "Measuring "..pending.name.." damage" end
    return hold
end 

function R.ai.beginDamageWait(p,t,now)
    local a=R.ai
    local h=t and t.model and t.model.FindFirstChildOfClass and t.model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not h or h.Health<=0 then return end
    local state=a.spellDamageState()
    local boost=a.damageBoostTicket
    if boost and (boost.school~=p.school or now>boost.untilAt) then boost=nil end
    local key=a.spellDamageKey(p,t,boost and boost.name)
    local record=state.records[key]
    local estimate=a.expectedSpellDamage(p,t,now,boost and boost.name)
    local clean=a.isolatedSpellHit(t,now)
    for _,slot in pairs(a.slots)do
        if slot.role=="damage" and slot.intentCastAt and now-slot.intentCastAt<math.max(1,(slot.windup or 0)+(slot.duration or 0)) then clean=false end
    end
    if not boost and now<(a.boostUncertainUntil or 0) then clean=false end
    if a.damageWait and not a.damageWait.hitAt then clean=false end
    local lethal=estimate>=h.Health
    local waitFor=math.clamp(math.max(1,(p.windup or 0)+.5,(record and record.delay or 0)+.25),1,2.5)
    a.damageWait={state=state,target=t,slot=p,hum=h,hp=h.Health,name=p.name,key=key,at=now,deadline=now+waitFor,
        learn=clean,hold=lethal,lethal=lethal,
        origin=root() and root().Position,targetPosition=t.root and t.root.Position}
    a.spellDamageDecision={name=p.name,damage=estimate,hp=h.Health,lethal=lethal,boost=boost and boost.name}
    if boost then a.damageBoostTicket=nil end
end

function R.ai.sendSkill(p,t,rp,now,travel)
    if R.ai.attackClickBusy or R.ai.attackInputBlocked and R.ai.attackInputBlocked() then return false end
    if travel and not R.ai.travelMotionReady(rp,hum(),R.ai.adaptive,now)
        and not (p.speedBoost and p.role=="booster" and R.ai.warningBoostNeeded(rp,hum(),R.ai.adaptive,now)) then return false end
    local damage=not travel and (p.role=="damage" or p.role=="unknown")
    if damage then
        rp=root()
        if not rp or not t or not enemyAlive(t.model)or not R.ai.skillCanCast(p,t,rp)then
            R.ai.skillStatus="Approaching spell range"
            return false
        end
    end
    if damage and R.ai.damageWaitPending(now,t) then return false end
    if R.ai.damageIntent then R.ai.damageIntent(t,rp,now) end
    if not travel and (p.role=="damage" or p.role=="unknown") then R.ai.recordAttackAttempt(t,rp) end
    local a=R.ai;local ch=char();local h=ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if h and type(h.WalkSpeed)=="number" and not S.SpeedOverride then
        if a.speedObservation then a.speedObservation.ambiguous=true
        else a.speedObservation={slot=p,name=p.name,speed=h.WalkSpeed,character=ch,at=now,deadline=now+1.5,travel=travel} end
    end
    local castPoint=rp.Position
    if p.origin=="snapshot" and p.offset>0 and rp.CFrame then castPoint+=rp.CFrame.LookVector*p.offset end
    if damage then a.beginDamageWait(p,t,now) end
    p.intentCastAt=now
    local evidence=a.finishEvidence and a.finishEvidence.watch
    if evidence and t and p.role=="damage" then
        evidence.source=bit32.bor(evidence.source or 0,p.key=="Q" and 1 or 2)
    end
    p.next=now+p.cooldown;p.inputUntil=now+.3;p.cooldownSeen=false
    R.nextSpell=now+.15
    R.spellFlip=not R.spellFlip
    R.ai.skillStatus=(travel and "Travel " or "Cast ")..p.key..": "..p.name.." ("..p.role..")"
    if p.duration>0 then
        p.effectPending={point=castPoint,at=now}
                                                                              
                                                               
        p.inputUntil=now+p.windup+p.duration
    end
    if a.noteSkillIntent then a.noteSkillIntent(p,now)end
    tapKey(Enum.KeyCode[p.key],.06)
    return true
end

function R.ai.dodgeMotionReady(rp,h,c)
    if not R.farming or S.MoveEnabled==false or not rp or not h or h.Health<=0
        or not c or not c.routeEscape or not c.route or not c.route[1] or not c.command then return false end
    local command=Vector3.new(c.command.X,0,c.command.Z)
    local moving=h.MoveDirection
    local velocity=rp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    return command.Magnitude>.1 and moving and moving:Dot(command.Unit)>.1
        and velocity and velocity:Dot(command.Unit)>2
end

function R.ai.travelMotionReady(rp,h,c,now)
    if R.ai.dodgeMotionReady(rp,h,c) then return true end
    local a=R.ai
    local command=c and c.command
    local moving=h and h.MoveDirection
    local velocity=rp and rp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    local speed=h and h.WalkSpeed or 16
    if not R.farming or S.MoveEnabled==false or not rp or not h or h.Health<=0
        or not command or not c.route or not c.route[1] or not moving or not velocity then
        a.travelMotion=nil;return false
    end
    local length=math.sqrt(command.X*command.X+command.Z*command.Z)
    local minimum=math.max(4,speed*.4)
    if length<.1 or moving.X*moving.X+moving.Z*moving.Z<.01
        or velocity.X*moving.X+velocity.Z*moving.Z<minimum
        or velocity.X*command.X+velocity.Z*command.Z<minimum*length then
        a.travelMotion=nil;return false
    end
    local goal=c.goal
    if not goal then a.travelMotion=nil;return false end
    local toward=Vector3.new(goal.X-rp.Position.X,0,goal.Z-rp.Position.Z)
    if toward.Magnitude<1 or command:Dot(toward.Unit)<length*.35 then a.travelMotion=nil;return false end
    local motion=a.travelMotion
    if motion and motion.goal and (motion.goal-goal).Magnitude>4 then motion=nil end
    if not motion or motion.root~=rp or now-motion.at>.35 or now<motion.at then
        a.travelMotion={root=rp,position=rp.Position,at=now,since=now,goal=goal};return false
    end
    local dt=now-motion.at
    if dt>0 then
        local delta=rp.Position-motion.position
        local travelled=math.sqrt(delta.X*delta.X+delta.Z*delta.Z)
        if delta:Dot(toward.Unit)<minimum*dt*.35 or travelled<minimum*dt or travelled>math.max(3,speed*dt*2)
            or delta.X*command.X+delta.Z*command.Z<minimum*dt*length then motion.since=now end
        motion.position=rp.Position;motion.at=now
    end
    if now-motion.since<.6 then return false end
    local endpoint=a.commandEndpoint
    if not endpoint or (endpoint-rp.Position).Magnitude<math.max(6,speed*.4) then return false end
    local runway=0;local previous=rp.Position
    for i=1,math.min(12,#c.route) do
        runway+=(c.route[i]-previous).Magnitude;previous=c.route[i]
        if runway>=math.max(12,speed*.75) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

function R.ai.warningBoostNeeded(rp,h,c,now)
    if not R.farming or S.MoveEnabled==false or S.EvadeEnabled==false or not rp or not h or h.Health<=0
        or not c or c.protected or c.evasionDisabled then return false end
    for _,hazard in pairs(c.hazards or {})do
        if hazard.kind=="projectile" or hazard.bossShape=="moving" then
                                                                                    
            for _,time in ipairs({.15,.3,.5,.75,1})do
                if c:hazardMargin(hazard,rp.Position,time)<.75 then return true end
            end
        end
        local lead=hazard.safeBefore and hazard.safeBefore-now
        if lead and lead>0 and lead<=2.5 and not hazard.contain
            and (hazard.kind=="circle" or hazard.kind=="line" or hazard.kind=="box")
            and (not hazard.bossShape or hazard.bossShape=="circle" or hazard.bossShape=="box") then
            local gap=c:hazardMargin(hazard,rp.Position,lead+.01)
            if gap<.75 and lead<=(-gap+.75)/math.max(1,h.WalkSpeed)+.4 then return true end
        end
    end
    return false
end

function R.ai.reserveArenaSpeed(target,rp)
    if not target or not target.model or not target.root or not rp then return false end
    local name=target.model.Name
    if name~="Midgardian Champion" and name~="Bob The Frost Giant" then return false end
                                                                           
                                                                         
    for key,p in pairs(R.ai.slots or {})do
        local other=R.ai.slots[key=="Q" and "E" or "Q"]
        if S["Use"..key] and p.role=="booster" and p.speedBoost and other
            and S["Use"..other.key] and other.role=="damage" and other.school==p.school
            and R.ai.spellSlotReady(p,os.clock()) and R.ai.spellSlotReady(other,os.clock())
            and R.ai.skillCanCast(other,target,rp) then return false end
    end
    local delta=target.root.Position-rp.Position
    return Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z).Magnitude<110
end

function R.ai.tryTravelSkill()
    local a=R.ai
    if a.attackClickBusy or a.attackInputBlocked and a.attackInputBlocked() then return false end
    if not R.farming or S.AttackEnabled==false or S.TravelSpeedSkills==false or S.MoveEnabled==false then a.travelMotion=nil;return false end
    a.scanSpells()
    local now=os.clock();local c=a.adaptive;local rp=root();local ch=char()
    local h=ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");local busy=ch and ch:FindFirstChild("busyCasting")
    local reserve=a.reserveArenaSpeed(R.target,rp)
    if (not reserve and a.dodgeMotionReady(rp,h,c) or a.warningBoostNeeded(rp,h,c,now)) and now>=R.nextSpell and now>=(a.travelBoostUntil or 0)
        and not a.boosterPending and not (busy and busy.Value==true)
        and not (a.travelBaseSpeed and h.WalkSpeed>a.travelBaseSpeed+2) then
        for _,key in ipairs({"Q","E"}) do
            local p=a.slots[key]
            if S["Use"..key] and p and p.speedBoost and p.role=="booster" and a.spellSlotReady(p,now) then
                a.sendSkill(p,nil,rp,now,true)
                if p.intentCastAt==now then
                    a.travelBoostUntil=now+(p.speedDuration or 0)
                    a.skillStatus="Dodge "..key..": "..p.name
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if game.PlaceId==85776757589518 and not a.northernOpeningDamageSent then return false end
    if reserve or not a.travelMotionReady(rp,h,c,now) then return false end
    if not rp or not h or h.Health<=0 or not c or not c.command or not c.route or not c.route[1]
        or now<R.nextSpell or now<(a.travelBoostUntil or 0) or a.speedObservation or a.boosterPending
        or busy and busy.Value==true then return false end
    local velocity=rp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    local moving=h.MoveDirection
    local command=c.command
    local commandLength=math.sqrt(command.X*command.X+command.Z*command.Z)
    if not velocity or not moving or commandLength<.1
        or moving.X*moving.X+moving.Z*moving.Z<.01
        or velocity.X*moving.X+velocity.Z*moving.Z<2
        or velocity.X*command.X+velocity.Z*command.Z<2*commandLength then return false end
    local speed=h.WalkSpeed or 16
    if a.travelBaseSpeed and speed>a.travelBaseSpeed+2 then return false end
    local goal=a.navGoal or c.goal
    if not goal or (goal-rp.Position).Magnitude<math.max(24,speed*1.5) then return false end
    local target=R.target
    if target and enemyAlive(target.model) then
        local point=a.combatPoint and a.combatPoint(target,rp.Position) or target.root.Position
        if (point-rp.Position).Magnitude<a.range()+speed*.75 then return false end
    end
    for _,key in ipairs({"Q","E"}) do
        local p=a.slots[key]
        if S["Use"..key] and p and p.speedBoost and a.spellSlotReady(p,now)
            and not (a.reserveDamageSlot and a.reserveDamageSlot(key,target,rp,now,true))
            and not ((p.role=="heal" or p.role=="shield") and h.Health<h.MaxHealth*.95) then
            if a.sendSkill(p,nil,rp,now,true) then
                a.travelBoostUntil=now+p.speedDuration
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function castSpell()
    local a=R.ai
    if a.attackClickBusy or a.attackInputBlocked and a.attackInputBlocked() then return end
    a.scanSpells()
    a.observation=nil
    local rp,t=root(),R.target
    a.damageWaitPending(os.clock(),t)
    if not rp or not t or not enemyAlive(t.model) then a.boosterPending=nil;return end
    local now=os.clock()
    local character=char()
    local busy=character and character:FindFirstChild("busyCasting")
    local casting=busy and busy.Value==true
    local smart=S.BoosterRotation~=false
    local pending=a.boosterPending
    if pending then
        local p=a.slots[pending.key]
        if not smart or p~=pending.slot or not S["Use"..pending.key] or not a.skillStillEquipped(p) then
            a.boosterPending=nil
        else
            local cd=a.skillCooldown(p)
            if cd and cd>0 or (a.skillCastConfirmed and a.skillCastConfirmed(p))then pending.confirmed=true;p.cooldownSeen=true end
            if pending.confirmed and not casting and now>=pending.sentAt+p.settle then
                a.damageBoostTicket={name=p.name,school=p.school,untilAt=now+1.5}
                a.boostUncertainUntil=math.max(a.boostUncertainUntil or 0,pending.sentAt+p.cooldown)
                a.boosterPending=nil
                a.skillStatus="Booster accepted; damage next"
            elseif now>=pending.deadline then
                                                                                     
                p.retryAt=now+3
                a.boosterPending=nil
                a.skillStatus="Booster unconfirmed; continuing damage"
            else
                a.skillStatus="Waiting for "..p.name.." activation"
                return
            end
        end
    end
    if casting or now<R.nextSpell then return end
    local order=R.spellFlip and {"Q","E"} or {"E","Q"}
    if smart then
        local hum=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local injured=hum and hum.MaxHealth>0 and hum.Health/hum.MaxHealth*100<=(tonumber(S.SkillHealHP) or 65)
        for _,key in ipairs(order) do
            local p=a.slots[key]
            if S["Use"..key] and p and (p.role=="heal" or p.role=="shield") and injured and a.spellSlotReady(p,now) then
                a.sendSkill(p,t,rp,now);return
            end
        end
        if a.damageWaitPending(now,t) then return end
        local hp=t.model.FindFirstChildOfClass and t.model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local lethal
        for _,key in ipairs(order) do
            local p=a.slots[key]
            if hp and S["Use"..key] and p and p.role=="damage" and a.spellSlotReady(p,now) and a.skillCanCast(p,t,rp)
                and a.expectedSpellDamage(p,t,now)>=hp.Health and (not lethal or p.cooldown<lethal.cooldown) then lethal=p end
        end
        if lethal then a.sendSkill(lethal,t,rp,now);return end
        for _,key in ipairs(order) do
            local p=a.slots[key]
            local other=a.slots[key=="Q" and "E" or "Q"]
            if S["Use"..key] and p and p.role=="booster" and p.school and a.spellSlotReady(p,now)
                and not (p.speedBoost and a.reserveArenaSpeed(t,rp) and not a.warningBoostNeeded(rp,hum,a.adaptive,now))
                and not (a.reserveDamageSlot and a.reserveDamageSlot(key,t,rp,now,false))
                and other and S["Use"..other.key] and other.role=="damage" and other.school==p.school
                and a.spellSlotReady(other,now) and a.skillCanCast(other,t,rp) then
                a.sendSkill(p,t,rp,now)
                a.boosterPending={key=key,slot=p,sentAt=now,deadline=now+2.5,confirmed=false}
                return
            end
        end
    end
    for _,key in ipairs(order) do
        local p=a.slots[key]
        if S["Use"..key] and p and a.spellSlotReady(p,now)
            and (not smart or p.role=="damage" or p.role=="unknown" or p.role=="support")
            and a.skillCanCast(p,t,rp) then
            a.sendSkill(p,t,rp,now);return
        end
    end
end

function R.ai.castEvidenceState()
    local a=R.ai;local character=char()
    if not a.castEvidence or a.castEvidence.character~=character then
        a.castEvidence={character=character,intents={},last={}}
    end
    return a.castEvidence
end

function R.ai.noteSkillIntent(p,now)
    if p.role=="damage"then R.ai.northernOpeningDamageSent=true end
    local state=R.ai.castEvidenceState()
    p.confirmedIntentAt=nil;p.confirmedCharacter=nil
    state.intents[p.key]={slot=p,name=p.name,at=now,duration=p.cooldown}
end

R.ai.skillCastConfirmed =                   function(p)
    return p and p.intentCastAt~=nil and p.confirmedIntentAt==p.intentCastAt
        and p.confirmedCharacter==char()
end 

function R.ai.observeAbilityCast(actor,name)
    local same=actor==LP
    if not same and actor and type(compareinstances)=="function" then
        local ok,result=pcall(compareinstances,actor,LP);same=ok and result==true
    end
    if not same or type(name)~="string" or #name>128 or not char()then return false end
    local a=R.ai;local state=a.castEvidenceState();local now=os.clock()
    local selected,key
    for candidate,intent in pairs(state.intents)do
        if intent.name==name and now>=intent.at and now-intent.at<=3
            and (not intent.confirmed or now<intent.at+intent.duration)then
            if selected then return false end                                      
            selected,key=intent,candidate
        end
    end
    if selected and selected.confirmed then return false end
    if not selected then
        for candidate,p in pairs(a.slots)do
            if p.name==name and a.skillStillEquipped(p)then
                if selected then return false end
                selected={slot=p,name=name,at=now,duration=p.cooldown,manual=true};key=candidate
            end
        end
    end
    if not selected then return false end
    local duration=tonumber(selected.duration)
    if not duration or duration~=duration or duration<=0 or duration==math.huge then return false end
                                                                            
    local previous=state.last[key]
    if previous and previous.name==name and now<previous.untilAt and (selected.manual or previous.intent==selected)then return false end
    local p=selected.slot
    local deadline=math.max(a.slotCooldownDeadline(key),selected.at+duration)
    a.skillSlotClocks[key]=deadline
    state.last[key]={name=name,untilAt=deadline,intent=selected}
    selected.confirmed=true
    p.next=math.max(p.next or 0,deadline);p.cooldownSeen=true
    if selected.manual and a.damageWait then a.damageWait.learn=false end
    if not selected.manual and p.intentCastAt==selected.at then
        p.confirmedIntentAt=selected.at;p.confirmedCharacter=state.character
        local pending=p.effectPending
        if pending then
            p.activeEffect={origin=p.origin,point=pending.point,from=pending.at+p.windup,untilAt=pending.at+p.windup+p.duration}
            p.effectPending=nil
        end
        local booster=a.boosterPending
        if booster and booster.slot==p and booster.sentAt==selected.at then booster.confirmed=true end
    end
    a.scanAt=0
    return true
end

                                                                              
                                                                               
R.ai.applyAttackWindow =                   function(h,info)
    local line=info.lineCast
    if not line or not line.family or line.matched then return end
    local profile=R.ai.casterProfiles[line.family]
    if not profile then return end
    local bounds; bounds = function(field)
        local n,lo,hi=profile[field.."N"],profile[field.."Min"],profile[field.."Max"]
        if type(n)~="number" or n<3 or type(lo)~="number" or type(hi)~="number"
            or lo~=lo or hi~=hi or lo<=0 or hi<lo or hi>8 or hi-lo>math.max(.15,lo*.2)then return end
        return lo,hi,math.max(.15,hi-lo+.08)
    end
    if line.phase=="warning" then
        local lo,hi,guard=bounds("delay")
        if lo and lo>guard then h.safeBefore=line.started+lo-guard end
        local _,active,tail=bounds("active")
        if h.safeBefore and active then h.clearAfter=line.started+hi+active+guard+tail end
    elseif line.phase=="active" and line.paired then
        local _,hi,guard=bounds("active")
        if hi then h.clearAfter=line.started+hi+guard end
    end
end 

local combatStep; combatStep =                   function()
    R.ai.observeAttackProgress()
    if R.ai.observation and os.clock() >= R.ai.observation.untilAt + 1 then R.ai.observation = nil end
    R.aimOk = false
    if not R.farming or not S.AttackEnabled or not alive() or not inDungeon() then
        R.ai.attackStatus=not R.farming and "controller stopped" or not S.AttackEnabled and "attacks disabled" or not alive() and "character not alive" or "waiting for dungeon"
        R.faceWant = nil
        return
    end
    if R.ai.tryTravelSkill() then return end
                                                           
                                                                       
                                                                                
    local rp = root()
    local t = R.target
    if not rp or not t or not enemyAlive(t.model) then
        R.ai.attackStatus="no live target"
        R.faceWant = nil
        return
    end

    local range = R.ai.range()
    local dist = (R.ai.combatPoint(t,rp.Position) - rp.Position).Magnitude


    local aim = aimPoint(t)
    if (aim - rp.Position).Magnitude > range then aim = R.ai.combatPoint(t,rp.Position) end
    R.faceWant = aim
    steerCamera(aim)

    local sx, sy, on = screenPoint(aim)
    if S.AimMode ~= "Camera only" and on then moveMouse(sx, sy) end

                                                                                     
    local steering = S.SteerCamera and S.MoveMode ~= "VIM Keys"
    R.aimOk = (not steering) or aimedAt(aim)
    if R.aimOk then
        R.aimWaitAt = 0
    else
        if R.aimWaitAt == 0 then R.aimWaitAt = os.clock() end
        if os.clock() - R.aimWaitAt > 1.2 then R.aimOk = true end
    end

                                                                                   
                                                                             
    local melee = tonumber(S.MeleeRange) or 12
    local near, nd = nearestEnemy(rp)
    if near and nd and nd <= melee and R.ai.canMeleeAt(near,rp) then
        local mx, my = screenPoint(near.root.Position)
        meleeSwing(mx or sx, my or sy)
    elseif dist <= melee and R.ai.canMeleeAt(t,rp) then
        meleeSwing(sx, sy)
    end
    if not R.aimOk then R.ai.attackStatus="waiting for aim"
    elseif R.ai.canCastAt(t,rp) then castSpell() end
end 

                                                                
                    
                                                                

local function makeLobby()
    if R.ai.dungeonAllowed and not R.ai.dungeonAllowed(S.Dungeon,S.Difficulty) then R.status='Dungeon excluded by config';return false end
    local res = invoke("createLobby", S.Dungeon, S.Difficulty, tonumber(S.LevelReq) or 1,
        S.Hardcore == true, S.Private == true, S.WaveDefence == true)
    log("createLobby -> " .. tostring(res))
    return res == true
end

function R.ai.runEndReason(started,timeLeft,progress,bossFinished,dead,hardcore)
    progress=tostring(progress or ""):lower()
    if started and type(timeLeft)=="number" and timeLeft<=0 then return "timed out" end
    if progress=="failed" or progress=="defeat" then return "failed" end
    if dead and hardcore==true then return "died" end
    if bossFinished then return "completed" end
end
function R.ai.lifecycleOutcome()
    local dungeon=dungeonFolder()
    if not dungeon then return end
    local run=R.ai.lifecycleRun
    if not run or run.dungeon~=dungeon then
        run={dungeon=dungeon};R.ai.lifecycleRun=run
    end
    local started=wsVal("start",false)==true and wsVal("dungeonStarted",false)==true
    local remaining=wsVal("timeLeft",nil)
    if started and type(remaining)=="number" and remaining>0 then run.observedActive=true end
                                                                          
    if not run.observedActive then return end
    if run.outcome then return run.outcome end
    local br=bossRoom()
    local f=br and br:FindFirstChild("dungeonFinished")
    local h=hum()
                                                                            
                                                                               
    run.outcome=R.ai.runEndReason(run.observedActive,remaining,wsVal("dungeonProgress",""),f and f.Value==true,h and h.Health<=0,wsVal("hardcore",false)==true)
    return run.outcome
end

                                                                          
function R.ai.nativeButtonPlan(button)
    if type(getconnections)~="function" then return end
    for _,name in ipairs({"MouseButton1Click","Activated"})do
        local ok,signal=pcall(function()return button[name]end)
        if not ok or not signal then continue end
        local read,connections=pcall(getconnections,signal)
        if not read or type(connections)~="table" then continue end
        local eligible={};local excluded=false
        for _,connection in ipairs(connections)do
            local valid,row=pcall(function()
                if connection.Enabled==false or connection.ForeignState==true or connection.LuaConnection==false then return end
                local fn=connection.Function
                if type(fn)=="function" and type(isexecutorclosure)=="function" then
                    local checked,ours=pcall(isexecutorclosure,fn)
                    if not checked or ours~=false then return end
                end
                return {connection=connection,fire=connection.Fire}
            end)
            if valid and row then eligible[#eligible+1]=row else excluded=true end
        end
        if #eligible==0 then continue end
                                                                                
                                                                            
        if not excluded and type(firesignal)=="function" then
            return function()
                if name=="Activated" then firesignal(signal,nil,1)else firesignal(signal)end
            end,name
        end
        local usable=true
        for _,row in ipairs(eligible)do if type(row.fire)~="function" then usable=false end end
        if usable then
            return function()
                for _,row in ipairs(eligible)do
                    if row.connection.Enabled~=false then
                        if name=="Activated" then row.fire(row.connection,nil,1)else row.fire(row.connection)end
                    end
                end
            end,name
        end
    end
end

function R.ai.runButtonVisible(button,gui)
    if not button or not button:IsA("GuiButton") or not button.Active
        or button.AbsoluteSize.X<=0 or button.AbsoluteSize.Y<=0 then return false end
    local node=button
    while node and node~=gui do
        if node:IsA("GuiObject") and not node.Visible then return false end
        if node:IsA("ScreenGui") and not node.Enabled then return false end
        node=node.Parent
    end
    return node==gui
end
function R.ai.runButtonAt(gui,names)
    local node=gui
    for _,name in ipairs(names) do node=node and node:FindFirstChild(name) end
    return node
end
function R.ai.clickRunButton(button)
    local gui=LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if not gui or R.ai.runButtonBusy or not R.ai.runButtonVisible(button,gui) then return false end
    if R.ai.nativeButtonPlan then
        local planned,dispatch,kind=pcall(R.ai.nativeButtonPlan,button)
        if planned and dispatch then
            R.ai.runButtonBusy=true
            task.spawn(function()
                local fired,why=pcall(function()
                    if R.booted and R.ai.runButtonVisible(button,gui)then dispatch()end
                end)
                R.ai.runButtonBusy=false;R.ai.runButtonError=not fired and tostring(why) or nil
                R.ai.runButtonMethod=kind
            end)
                                                                           
                                                                              
            return true
        end
    elseif type(firesignal)=="function" and type(getconnections)=="function" then
        local ok,connections=pcall(getconnections,button.MouseButton1Click)
        if ok and type(connections)=="table" then
            for _,connection in ipairs(connections)do
                if connection.Enabled~=false then
                    R.ai.runButtonBusy=true
                    task.spawn(function()
                        local fired,why=pcall(function()
                            if R.booted and R.ai.runButtonVisible(button,gui) then firesignal(button.MouseButton1Click)end
                        end)
                        R.ai.runButtonBusy=false;R.ai.runButtonError=not fired and tostring(why) or nil
                    end)
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local center=button.AbsolutePosition+button.AbsoluteSize*.5
    local inset=game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset()
    local x,y=center.X,center.Y+inset.Y
    R.ai.runButtonBusy=true
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok,err=pcall(function()
            if not R.booted or not R.ai.runButtonVisible(button,gui) then return end
            VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(x,y,0,true,game,1)
            task.wait(.08)
            VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(x,y,0,false,game,1)
        end)
                                                                 
        if not ok then pcall(function()VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(x,y,0,false,game,1)end) end
        R.ai.runButtonBusy=false
        R.ai.runButtonError=not ok and tostring(err) or nil
    end)
    return true
end
function R.ai.startRunButton()
    local gui=LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if not gui then return false end
    return R.ai.clickRunButton(R.ai.runButtonAt(gui,{"startButton","Frame","3d","Frame","TextButton"}))
end
function R.ai.replayRunButton()
    local gui=LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if not gui then return false end
    if R.ai.replayButtonPending and os.clock()<R.ai.replayButtonPending then return true end
    local button=R.ai.runButtonAt(gui,{"ReplayDungeonButton","Replay"})
    if not R.ai.runButtonVisible(button,gui) then
        button=R.ai.runButtonAt(gui,{"mainInterface","buttons","optionsButton","ReplayDungeonButton"})
    end
    if not R.ai.runButtonVisible(button,gui) then
        button=R.ai.runButtonAt(gui,{"hostPanel","Frame","Frame","replay","TextButton"})
        local menu=gui:FindFirstChild("hostPanel")
        if button and menu and menu:IsA("ScreenGui") then menu.Enabled=true end
    end
    if R.ai.clickRunButton(button) then
        local deadline=os.clock()+15
        R.ai.replayButtonPending=deadline
                                                                              
        task.spawn(function()
            local confirmedAt
            while R.booted and R.ai.replayButtonPending==deadline and os.clock()<deadline do
                local yes=R.ai.runButtonAt(gui,{"ReplayConfirmation","Frame","Frame","confirm","TextButton"})
                if not confirmedAt and R.ai.runButtonVisible(yes,gui) and R.ai.clickRunButton(yes) then
                    confirmedAt=os.clock()
                end
                if confirmedAt then
                    local tier=R.ai.runButtonAt(gui,{"Menu","Frame","Frame","replayButton","TextButton"})
                    if R.ai.runButtonVisible(tier,gui) and R.ai.clickRunButton(tier) then
                        R.ai.replayButtonPending=nil;return
                    end
                    if not R.ai.runButtonBusy and not R.ai.runButtonVisible(yes,gui) and os.clock()-confirmedAt>=1 then
                        R.ai.replayButtonPending=nil;return
                    end
                end
                task.wait(.1)
            end
            if R.ai.replayButtonPending==deadline then R.ai.replayButtonPending=nil end
        end)
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local function startRun()
    return R.ai.startRunButton()
end

local function readyUp()
    return fire("readyUp")
end

local function toLobby()
    return fire("teleToLobby")
end

local function replayRun()
    if R.ai.dungeonAllowed and not R.ai.dungeonAllowed(wsVal('dungeonName',S.Dungeon),wsVal('difficulty',S.Difficulty)) then
        R.status='Dungeon excluded by config';if not R.ai.sessionCarryActive then return toLobby() end;return false
    end
    return R.ai.replayRunButton()
end

                                                                             
R.ai.runLearningTextFile="DQR/logs/DungeonAI_run_learning.log"
R.ai.runLearningDataFile="DQR/logs/DungeonAI_run_learning.jsonl"
function R.ai.learningSnapshot()
    local m=R.ai.learning
    local snapshot={samples=m.samples or 0,damage=m.damage or 0,stalls=m.stalls or 0,
        locations=0,corridors=0,corridorDistance=0,partialCorridors=0,drawings=0,rallies=0,kite=m.kite and m.kite.n or 0,projectiles={},casters={},bosses={}}
    for _ in pairs(m.cells) do snapshot.locations+=1 end
    for _,list in pairs(m.routes or {}) do snapshot.drawings+=#list end
    for _,value in pairs(m.rallies or {}) do snapshot.rallies+=value.n or 0 end
    for _,list in pairs((R.ai.corridors and R.ai.corridors.maps) or {}) do
        snapshot.corridors+=#list
        for _,record in ipairs(list) do
            snapshot.corridorDistance+=record.length or 0
            if record.complete==false then snapshot.partialCorridors+=1 end
        end
    end
    for key,p in pairs(R.ai.projectileProfiles) do
        snapshot.projectiles[key]={timingN=p.timingN or 0,delay=p.delayMean,speed=p.speedMean,
            radius=p.radius or 0,samples=p.samples or 0}
    end
    for key,p in pairs(R.ai.casterProfiles or {}) do
        snapshot.casters[key]={delayN=p.delayN or 0,delayMean=p.delayMean,activeN=p.activeN or 0,activeMean=p.activeMean,
            pulseN=p.pulseN or 0,pulseMean=p.pulseMean}
    end
    for key,p in pairs(m.bosses or {}) do
        snapshot.bosses[key]={observations=p.observations,targeted=p.targeted,other=p.other,
            ambiguous=p.ambiguous,delayMean=p.delayMean,keepMoving=R.ai.bossKeepsTracking(p)}
    end
    snapshot.attackHeights={}
    for key,p in pairs(m.attackHeights or {}) do
        snapshot.attackHeights[key]={progress=p.progress,stalled=p.stalled}
    end
    return snapshot
end
function R.ai.summarizeRunLearning(run,after,outcome)
    local before=run.before
    local function delta(key)return after[key]-before[key]end
    local report={version=1,id=run.id,startedAt=run.startedAt,endedAt=os.time(),outcome=outcome,
        partial=run.partial,dungeon=run.dungeonName,difficulty=run.difficulty,
        seconds=math.max(0,os.clock()-run.clock),kills=run.counters and run.counters.kills or math.max(0,R.kills-run.kills),
        deaths=run.counters and run.counters.deaths or math.max(0,R.deaths-run.deaths),projectiles={},casters={},bosses={},bossSamples=0,timingSamples=0,
        navigationSamples=delta("samples"),learnedLocationsDelta=delta("locations"),
        recordedDamagePercent=delta("damage"),stallObservations=delta("stalls"),
        corridorsAdded=delta("corridors"),corridorDistanceAdded=delta("corridorDistance"),
        partialCorridors=after.partialCorridors,drawingsDelta=delta("drawings"),
        rallySamples=delta("rallies"),kiteSamples=delta("kite")}
    for key,p in pairs(after.projectiles) do
        local old=before.projectiles[key] or {timingN=0,radius=0,samples=0}
        local added=p.timingN-old.timingN
        if added>0 or p.samples>old.samples or p.radius~=old.radius then
            report.projectiles[#report.projectiles+1]={signature=key,timingSamplesAdded=added,
                timingSamplesTotal=p.timingN,delayBefore=old.delay,delayAfter=p.delay,
                speedBefore=old.speed,speedAfter=p.speed,radiusBefore=old.radius,radiusAfter=p.radius,
                damageSamplesAdded=p.samples-old.samples,stillLearning=p.timingN<3}
            report.timingSamples+=added
        end
    end
    table.sort(report.projectiles,function(a,b)return a.signature<b.signature end)
    local lines={string.format("[%s] Run %s | %s | %s / %s",os.date("!%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC",report.endedAt),
        report.id,outcome,report.dungeon,report.difficulty),
        string.format("Observed %.0fs | %d kills | %d deaths%s",report.seconds,report.kills,report.deaths,
            report.partial and " | partial coverage: tracking began during this run" or ""),
        string.format("Navigation: %+d observations; %+d learned locations; %+d traversed corridors.",
            report.navigationSamples,report.learnedLocationsDelta,report.corridorsAdded),
        string.format("Route memory: %.1f additional observed studs; %d partial routes retained in memory.",
            report.corridorDistanceAdded,report.partialCorridors),
        string.format("Recorded: %.2f%% HP damage; %d stalls. Manual drawings: %+d; kite samples: %+d; rally samples: %+d.",
            report.recordedDamagePercent,report.stallObservations,report.drawingsDelta,report.kiteSamples,report.rallySamples)}
    local function seconds(value)return value and string.format("%.3fs",value) or "untrained" end
    report.attackHeights={}
    for key,p in pairs(after.attackHeights or {}) do
        local old=(before.attackHeights or {})[key] or {progress=0,stalled=0}
        if p.progress>old.progress or p.stalled>old.stalled then
            report.attackHeights[#report.attackHeights+1]={band=key,progress=p.progress-old.progress,stalled=p.stalled-old.stalled}
            lines[#lines+1]=string.format("Attack elevation %s: +%d damage-progress windows; +%d no-progress windows (cause unconfirmed).",
                key:gsub("[%c]"," "),p.progress-old.progress,p.stalled-old.stalled)
        end
    end
    local function speed(value)return value and string.format("%.2fx",value) or "untrained" end
    for _,p in ipairs(report.projectiles) do
        local name=p.signature:gsub("[%c]"," ")
        lines[#lines+1]=string.format("Projectile %s: +%d timing samples (%d total); response %s -> %s; sideways speed %s -> %s; %s.",
            name,p.timingSamplesAdded,p.timingSamplesTotal,seconds(p.delayBefore),seconds(p.delayAfter),
            speed(p.speedBefore),speed(p.speedAfter),p.stillLearning and "conservative prior still active" or "learned timing active")
        if p.damageSamplesAdded>0 or p.radiusBefore~=p.radiusAfter then
            lines[#lines+1]=string.format("  Client-observed clearance: %.2f -> %.2f studs; +%d damage samples.",
                p.radiusBefore,p.radiusAfter,p.damageSamplesAdded)
        end
    end
    if #report.projectiles==0 then lines[#lines+1]="Projectiles: no new accepted learning samples this run." end
    for family,p in pairs(after.casters or {}) do
        local old=(before.casters or {})[family] or {delayN=0,activeN=0}
        if p.delayN>old.delayN or p.activeN>old.activeN or (p.pulseN or 0)>(old.pulseN or 0) then
            report.casters[#report.casters+1]={family=family,delaySamplesAdded=p.delayN-old.delayN,
                activeSamplesAdded=p.activeN-old.activeN,delayMean=p.delayMean,activeMean=p.activeMean,
                pulseSamplesAdded=(p.pulseN or 0)-(old.pulseN or 0),pulseMean=p.pulseMean}
        end
    end
    table.sort(report.casters,function(a,b)return a.family<b.family end)
    for _,p in ipairs(report.casters) do
        if p.pulseSamplesAdded>0 then
            lines[#lines+1]=string.format("Area effect %s: +%d pulse-interval samples, mean %s; quiet-tail detection uses observed cadence.",
                p.family:gsub("[%c]"," "),p.pulseSamplesAdded,seconds(p.pulseMean))
        end
        if p.delaySamplesAdded>0 or p.activeSamplesAdded>0 then
            lines[#lines+1]=string.format("Caster %s: +%d warning-to-beam samples, mean %s; +%d active-beam samples, mean %s.",
                p.family:gsub("[%c]"," "),p.delaySamplesAdded,seconds(p.delayMean),p.activeSamplesAdded,seconds(p.activeMean))
        end
    end
    for key,p in pairs(after.bosses or {}) do
        local old=(before.bosses or {})[key] or {observations=0,targeted=0,other=0,ambiguous=0,keepMoving=false}
        if p.observations>old.observations then
            local added=p.observations-old.observations
            report.bossSamples+=added
            report.bosses[#report.bosses+1]={family=key,observationsAdded=added,
                targetedAdded=p.targeted-old.targeted,otherAdded=p.other-old.other,
                ambiguousAdded=p.ambiguous-old.ambiguous,observationsTotal=p.observations,
                delayMean=p.delayMean,keepMovingBefore=old.keepMoving,keepMovingAfter=p.keepMoving}
        end
    end
    table.sort(report.bosses,function(a,b)return a.family<b.family end)
    for _,p in ipairs(report.bosses) do
        lines[#lines+1]=string.format("Boss %s: +%d disappear/return observations; %d tracking, %d other, %d ambiguous; mean absence %s; %s.",
            p.family:gsub("[%c]"," "),p.observationsAdded,p.targetedAdded,p.otherAdded,p.ambiguousAdded,
            seconds(p.delayMean),p.keepMovingAfter and "learned continuous movement active"
                or (p.keepMovingBefore and "continuous movement withdrawn: conflicting evidence" or "still collecting targeting evidence"))
    end
    report.text=table.concat(lines,"\n")
    return report
end
function R.ai.appendRunLearningFile(path,text)
    if type(isfile)=="function" and type(writefile)=="function" then
        local ok,exists=pcall(isfile,path)
        if ok and not exists then
            local written,err=pcall(writefile,path,text)
            return written,not written and tostring(err) or nil
        end
    end
    if type(appendfile)=="function" then
        local ok,err=pcall(appendfile,path,text)
        return ok,not ok and tostring(err) or nil
    end
                                                                           
                                                               
    if type(writefile)~="function" or type(isfile)~="function" then return false,"append/file API unavailable" end
    local checked,exists=pcall(isfile,path)
    if not checked then return false,"could not check existing log" end
    local previous=""
    if exists then
        if type(readfile)~="function" then return false,"existing log cannot be read" end
        local ok,data=pcall(readfile,path)
        if not ok then return false,tostring(data) end
        previous=data
    end
    local ok,err=pcall(writefile,path,previous..text)
    return ok,not ok and tostring(err) or nil
end
function R.ai.beginRunLearning(dungeon,partial)
    if R.ai.learningRun then return end
    R.ai.learningRun={id=HTTP:GenerateGUID(false),folder=dungeon,
        startedAt=os.time(),clock=os.clock(),before=R.ai.learningSnapshot(),
        dungeonName=tostring(wsVal("dungeonName",S.Dungeon or "unknown")),
        difficulty=tostring(wsVal("difficulty",S.Difficulty or "unknown")),
        kills=R.kills,deaths=R.deaths,partial=partial}
end
function R.ai.finishRunLearning(outcome)
    local run=R.ai.learningRun
    if not run then return end
                                                                           
                                                              
    R.ai.learningRun=nil;R.ai.lastLoggedDungeon=run.folder
    R.ai.finishCorridor();R.ai.finishRally()
    local report=R.ai.summarizeRunLearning(run,R.ai.learningSnapshot(),outcome)
    local savedLearning,saveError=pcall(R.ai.saveLearning)
    report.learningSaved=savedLearning and saveError==true
    local savedCorridors=pcall(R.ai.saveCorridors)
    report.corridorsSaved=savedCorridors and not R.ai.corridorDirty
    if not report.learningSaved then report.text..="\nLearning file not saved: "..tostring(R.ai.saveError or saveError) end
    if not report.corridorsSaved then report.text..="\nCorridor file not saved: "..tostring(R.ai.corridorError) end
    R.ai.lastRunLearning=report
    local jsonOK,json=pcall(function()return HTTP:JSONEncode(report)end)
    local textOK,textError=R.ai.appendRunLearningFile(R.ai.runLearningTextFile,report.text.."\n\n")
    local dataOK,dataError=false,"could not encode summary"
    if jsonOK then dataOK,dataError=R.ai.appendRunLearningFile(R.ai.runLearningDataFile,json.."\n") end
    R.ai.runLearningWriteError=not (textOK and dataOK) and tostring(textError or dataError) or nil
                                          
    if R.ai.runLearningWriteError then                                                               end
    notify("Run learning",string.format("%d timing; %d boss; %d navigation observations. %s",
        report.timingSamples,report.bossSamples,report.navigationSamples,textOK and "Summary saved." or "Summary in console."),5)
    return report
end
function R.ai.runLearningTick()
    local dungeon=dungeonFolder()
    local started=dungeon and wsVal("dungeonStarted",true)~=false
    local run=R.ai.learningRun
    if run then
        if run.folder~=dungeon then R.ai.finishRunLearning("left dungeon")
        elseif R.ai.lifecycleOutcome() then R.ai.finishRunLearning(R.ai.lifecycleOutcome() or "ended (outcome unconfirmed)")
        elseif not started then R.ai.finishRunLearning("ended") end
    end
    if not dungeon then return end
    if not started then
        R.ai.runWaitingDungeon=dungeon;R.ai.lastLoggedDungeon=nil;return
    end
    if R.ai.learningRun or R.ai.lastLoggedDungeon==dungeon or dungeonFinished() or not alive() then return end
    R.ai.beginRunLearning(dungeon,R.ai.runWaitingDungeon~=dungeon)
end


local function brainStep()
    R.ai.runLearningTick()
    if not R.farming then
        R.phase = "idle"
        return
    end
    local now = os.clock()

                                                                    
                                                                  
    if not inDungeon() then
        R.phase="waiting"
        R.status="waiting for dungeon / START button"
        if S.AutoStart and now-R.lastStart>3 then
            R.lastStart=now;startRun()
        end
        return
    end

                                                  
    if R.ai.lifecycleOutcome() then
        if R.finishedAt == 0 then
            R.finishedAt = now
            if R.ai.lifecycleOutcome()=="completed" then R.runs = R.runs + 1 end
            notify("Run "..tostring(R.ai.lifecycleOutcome()), "total completed: " .. R.runs, 3)
            clearPath();R.ai.committedPoint=nil;R.ai.activeRoute=nil
            R.ai.planEpoch=(R.ai.planEpoch or 0)+1;R.ai.gridBusy=false
        end
        R.phase = "finished"
        R.target = nil
        stopMoving()
        if now - R.finishedAt >= (tonumber(S.FinishDelay) or 3) then
            R.finishedAt = now + 5
            if S.AutoReplay then
                R.status = "replaying"
                replayRun()
            elseif S.ReturnLobby then
                R.status = "returning to lobby"
                toLobby()
            else
                R.status = "idle at finish"
            end
        end
        return
    end

    R.finishedAt = 0
    R.phase = "clearing"

                                              
    if wsVal("dungeonStarted", true) == false and S.AutoStart and now - R.lastStart > 3 then
        R.lastStart = now
        
        startRun()
    end

    local rp = root()
    if rp then pickTarget(rp) end
end


local function armPersist() end
local function setFarming(on)
    if on and R.ai.resumeSavedSettings then R.ai.resumeSavedSettings() end
    on = on and true or false
    if on == R.farming then return end
    R.ai.generation += 1
    R.ai.planEpoch=(R.ai.planEpoch or 0)+1;R.ai.gridBusy=false;R.ai.gridRetry=0
    R.ai.gridPath=nil;R.ai.gridGoal=nil;R.ai.committedPoint=nil;R.ai.activeRoute=nil
    R.ai.drawnRouteOverride=nil;R.ai.drawnGraph=nil;R.ai.mapSampleKey=nil;R.ai.mapFollowKey=nil;R.ai.mapSampleStamp=nil
    R.ai.observation=nil; R.ai.grouping=false; R.ai.groupStart=nil; R.ai.planPoint=nil; R.ai.planAt=0
    if not on then R.ai.finishCorridor();R.ai.saveCorridors();R.ai.releaseRise();R.kiteVec=nil end
    R.farming = on
    S.Master = on
    if not on then R.ai.manualDrawing=nil;if R.ai.adaptive then R.ai.adaptive.manualOverride=nil end end
    if on then
        R.status = "starting"
        armPersist()
        R.ai.ensureDungeonMap()
        notify("Armstrong Armory", R.ai.mapReady and "farm enabled; using saved dungeon map" or "farm enabled; mapping dungeon", 2)
    else
        stopMoving()
        releaseCamera()
        releaseBodyLock()
        clearPath()
        R.camLook = nil
        R.faceWant = nil
        R.lastHP = nil
        R.kiteAt, R.kiteBest, R.kiteHold = 0, 0, 0
        R.closeIn, R.holdModel, R.holdAt = 0, nil, 0
        R.phase = "idle"
        R.status = "stopped"
        notify("Armstrong Armory", "farm disabled", 2)
    end
end

                                                                
        
                                                                

local function hookChar()
    local function bind(c)
        R.ai.generation += 1
        releaseAll()
        R.ai.releaseRise();R.kiteVec=nil
        R.held = {}
        R.stuck = 0
        clearPath()
        local h = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or c:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
        if h then
            R.conns[#R.conns + 1] = h.Died:Connect(function()
                R.ai.releaseRise()
                R.ai.notePlayerDeath(h)
                R.status = "died"
                stopMoving()
                clearPath()
                releaseBodyLock()
            end)
        end
    end
    if LP.Character then bind(LP.Character) end
    R.conns[#R.conns + 1] = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
        task.wait(0.5)
        pcall(bind, c)
    end)
end

local function hookEvents()
    R.conns[#R.conns + 1] = LP.OnTeleport:Connect(function(state)
        if state==Enum.TeleportState.InProgress then R.ai.finishRunLearning("teleported") end
    end)
    R.conns[#R.conns + 1] = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst)
        local started=os.clock();local frame=R.ai.frameSerial
        R.ai.observeEnemyInstance(inst)
        R.ai.watchNavigationGeometry(inst)
                                                                                
        if inst:IsA("BasePart") then task.defer(function()
            local started=os.clock();local frame=R.ai.frameSerial
            if R.booted and inst.Parent then pcall(watchPart,inst) end
            if R.ai.recordCallback then R.ai.recordCallback("watchEffect",started,frame)end
        end) end
        if R.ai.recordCallback then R.ai.recordCallback("workspaceAdded",started,frame)end
    end)

    local rem = RS:FindFirstChild("remotes")
    if rem then
        for _, name in ipairs({ "showStartButton", "showReadyGui" }) do
            local ev = rem:FindFirstChild(name)
            if ev and ev:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                R.conns[#R.conns + 1] = ev.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
                    if not R.farming then return end
                    task.wait(0.4)
                    
                    if S.AutoStart then startRun() end
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    R.conns[#R.conns + 1] = LP.Idled:Connect(function()
        if not S.AntiAFK then return end
        pcall(function()
            VU:CaptureController()
            VU:ClickButton2(Vector2.new())
        end)
    end)

    R.conns[#R.conns + 1] = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, busy)
        if busy or input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
        local ok, want = pcall(function()
            return Enum.KeyCode[string.upper(tostring(S.Hotkey or "F"))]
        end)
        if ok and want and input.KeyCode == want then setFarming(not R.farming) end
    end)
end

                                                                
        
                                                                

local safe; safe =                   function(fn,label)
    local started=os.clock();local frame=R.ai.frameSerial
    local ok, err = pcall(fn)
    local elapsed=os.clock()-started
    local name=label or debug.info(fn,"n")
    if name=="" then name="anonymous loop" end
    if frame==R.ai.frameSerial and R.ai.frameWork then
        local work=R.ai.frameWork[name] or {calls=0,seconds=0,max=0}
        work.calls+=1;work.seconds+=elapsed;work.max=math.max(work.max,elapsed)
        R.ai.frameWork[name]=work
    end
    if elapsed>.025 and frame==R.ai.frameSerial then
        R.ai.slowCallbacks=R.ai.slowCallbacks or {}
        R.ai.slowCallbacks[#R.ai.slowCallbacks+1]={name=name,elapsed=elapsed,at=os.clock()}
        if #R.ai.slowCallbacks>24 then table.remove(R.ai.slowCallbacks,1) end
    end
    if not ok then
        local a=R.ai;a.loopErrors=a.loopErrors or {}
        local previous=a.loopErrors[#a.loopErrors]
        if previous and previous.message==tostring(err) and previous.name==name then previous.count+=1;previous.lastAt=os.clock()
        else
            a.loopErrors[#a.loopErrors+1]={name=name,message=tostring(err),at=os.clock(),lastAt=os.clock(),count=1}
            if #a.loopErrors>32 then table.remove(a.loopErrors,1)end
        end
        log("loop error: " .. tostring(err))
    end
end 

local function spin(interval, fn,label)
    task.spawn(function()
        while R.booted do
            safe(fn,label)
            task.wait(interval)
        end
    end)
end


                                                                           
                                                                         
                                                                        
function R.ai.clearDangerCircle(destroy)
    if destroy then
        if R.ai.dangerFolder then R.ai.dangerFolder:Destroy() end
        R.ai.dangerFolder=nil;R.ai.dangerPool=nil;R.ai.dangerGui=nil
        R.ai.dangerPixels=nil;R.ai.dangerPathGui=nil;R.ai.dangerPathDots=nil;R.ai.dangerHeads=nil
        R.ai.dangerSnapshot=nil;R.ai.dangerPaintAt=nil
        R.ai.dangerPathWorld=nil;R.ai.dangerHeadWorld=nil;R.ai.dangerWallCursor=nil
    else
        if R.ai.dangerGui then R.ai.dangerGui.Enabled=false end
        if R.ai.dangerPathGui then R.ai.dangerPathGui.Enabled=false end
    end
end

R.ai.followDangerCircle =                   function()
    local rp=root()
    local p=R.ai.dangerPool and R.ai.dangerPool[1]
    if not rp or not p or not R.ai.dangerGui or not R.ai.dangerGui.Enabled then return end
    local me=rp.Position
    local y=me.Y-2.78
    p.CFrame=CFrame.new(me.X,y,me.Z)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,0)
    if R.ai.dangerPool[2] then R.ai.dangerPool[2].CFrame=p.CFrame end
                                                                          
                                                              
    for _,pixel in ipairs(R.ai.dangerPixels or {}) do
        local point=pixel.wallSample and pixel.wallSample.point or me+pixel.offset
        pixel.frame.Position=R.ai.dangerCanvasPoint(p,point)
    end
    for _,dot in ipairs(R.ai.dangerPathDots or {}) do
        if dot.Visible and R.ai.dangerPathWorld and R.ai.dangerPathWorld[dot] then dot.Position=R.ai.dangerCanvasPoint(p,R.ai.dangerPathWorld[dot]) end
    end
    for _,head in pairs(R.ai.dangerHeads or {}) do
        if head.Visible and R.ai.dangerHeadWorld and R.ai.dangerHeadWorld[head] then head.Position=R.ai.dangerCanvasPoint(p,R.ai.dangerHeadWorld[head]) end
    end
end 

                                                                            
                                                                                
R.ai.projectileVisualSegment =                   function(info,me,radius,horizon)
    if not info.lastPos or not info.lastVel then return end
    local relative=info.lastPos-me
    local velocity=info.lastVel
    local planar=flat(velocity)
    local aa=planar:Dot(planar)
    if aa<144 then return end
    local bb=flat(relative):Dot(planar)
    local cc=flat(relative):Dot(flat(relative))-radius*radius
    local disc=bb*bb-aa*cc
    if disc<0 then return end
    local span=math.sqrt(disc)
    local enter=math.max(0,(-bb-span)/aa)
    local leave=math.min(horizon,(-bb+span)/aa)
    local height=info.height or 5
    if math.abs(velocity.Y)<.001 then
        if math.abs(relative.Y)>height then return end
    else
        local low=(-height-relative.Y)/velocity.Y
        local high=(height-relative.Y)/velocity.Y
        enter=math.max(enter,math.min(low,high))
        leave=math.min(leave,math.max(low,high))
    end
    if leave<enter then return end
