    return info.lastPos+velocity*enter,info.lastPos+velocity*leave,enter
end 

local function dangerDot(gui,name,size,color)
    local dot=Instance.new("Frame")
    dot.Name=name;dot.BorderSizePixel=0;dot.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5)
    dot.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(size,size);dot.BackgroundTransparency=.08
    dot.BackgroundColor3=color;dot.Parent=gui
    local corner=Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(.5,0);corner.Parent=dot
    return dot
end

function R.ai.createDangerSurface(index)
    if not R.ai.dangerFolder then
        local folder=Instance.new("Folder")
        folder.Name="BotDangerCircle";folder:SetAttribute("BotNavigationVisual",true)
        folder.Parent=workspace;R.ai.dangerFolder=folder;R.ai.dangerPool={}
    end
    local part=Instance.new("Part")
    part.Name=index==1 and "DangerGridSurface" or "ProjectilePathsSurface"
    part:SetAttribute("BotNavigationVisual",true)
    part.Anchored=true;part.CanCollide=false;part.CanTouch=false;part.CanQuery=false
    part.CastShadow=false;part.Transparency=1;part.Size=Vector3.new(48,48,.025)
    part.Parent=R.ai.dangerFolder;R.ai.dangerPool[index]=part
    local gui=Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
    gui.Face=Enum.NormalId.Front;gui.CanvasSize=Vector2.new(512,512)
    gui.AlwaysOnTop=true;gui.LightInfluence=0;gui.Parent=part
    return gui
end

R.ai.dangerCanvasPoint =                   function(surface,worldPoint)
    local point=surface.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(worldPoint)
                                                                  
                                                                              
    return UDim2.fromOffset((.5-point.X/surface.Size.X)*512,(.5-point.Y/surface.Size.Y)*512)
end 

R.ai.dangerWallAt =                   function(point)
    if R.ai.bodyOccupied(point-Vector3.new(0,3,0)) then return true end
    local hit=supportFloor(point+Vector3.new(0,4,0),R.ai.geometryParams())
    if not hit then return nil end
    if waterSupport(hit) then return true end
    if hit and hit.Normal.Y<math.cos(R.ai.slopeLimit()) then return true end
                                                                        
                                                                             
    local floor=hit and hit.Position or point-Vector3.new(0,3,0)
    if hit and floor.Y>point.Y+1.25 then floor=point-Vector3.new(0,3,0) end
    if math.abs(floor.Y-(point.Y-3))<.01 then return false end
    return R.ai.bodyOccupied(floor)
end 

R.ai.sampleDangerWalls =                   function(me)
    local pixels=R.ai.dangerPixels
    if not pixels or #pixels==0 then return end
    local now=os.clock();local revision=R.ai.geometryRevision or 0
    local count=0;local cursor=R.ai.dangerWallCursor or 1
                                                                              
                                                                              
                                                                             
    for _=1,#pixels do
        local pixel=pixels[cursor];cursor=cursor%#pixels+1
        local point=me+pixel.offset;local sample=pixel.wallSample
        if not sample or sample.revision~=revision or (sample.point-point).Magnitude>1 then
            pixel.wallSample={point=point,at=os.clock(),revision=revision,blocked=R.ai.dangerWallAt(point)}
            count+=1
            if count>=12 or os.clock()-now>=.00075 then break end
        end
    end
    R.ai.dangerWallCursor=cursor
end 

R.ai.updateDangerDisplay =                   function()
    local rp=root()
    if not rp or not R.ai.dangerGui or not R.ai.dangerGui.Enabled then return end
    R.ai.sampleDangerWalls(rp.Position)
    if os.clock()>=(R.ai.dangerPaintAt or 0) then
        R.ai.dangerPaintAt=os.clock()+.05
        R.ai.paintDangerSnapshot(rp)
    end
end 

R.ai.paintDangerSnapshot =                   function(rp)
    local snapshot=R.ai.dangerSnapshot
    if not snapshot or not R.ai.dangerPixels then return end
    local me=rp.Position;local radius=24
    local enemies,hazards,paths={},{},{}
    for _,entry in ipairs(snapshot.enemies) do
        local body=entry.root
        if body and not body.Parent then continue end
        local pos=body and body.Position or entry.pos
        local vel=body and flat(body.AssemblyLinearVelocity) or entry.vel
        if vel.Magnitude>40 then vel=vel.Unit*40 end
        if math.abs(pos.Y-me.Y)<10 and flat(pos-me).Magnitude<radius+entry.reach+35 then
            enemies[#enemies+1]={pos=pos,vel=vel,reach=entry.reach}
        end
    end
    for _,entry in ipairs(snapshot.hazards) do
        if entry.projectile then
            local info=entry.projectile
            if os.clock()-(info.lastAt or 0)>=.25 then continue end
            local horizon=(flat(info.lastPos-me).Magnitude+radius)/math.max(12,flat(info.lastVel).Magnitude)+.05
            if R.ai.projectileWindow(info,me,Vector3.zero,horizon)>radius then continue end
            hazards[#hazards+1]={projectile=info,horizon=horizon}
            local from,to,eta=R.ai.projectileVisualSegment(info,me,radius,horizon)
            if from then paths[#paths+1]={from=from,to=to,eta=eta,
                margin=R.ai.projectileWindow(info,me,Vector3.zero,horizon),position=info.lastPos,height=info.height or 5} end
        elseif entry.geometry then
            local geometry=entry.geometry
            if entry.part then geometry=entry.part.Parent and R.ai.attackGeometry(entry.part,entry.info) end
            if not geometry or R.ai.attackMargin(geometry,me)>=radius then continue end
            hazards[#hazards+1]={geometry=geometry}
            if geometry.kind=="line" then
                local axis=flat(geometry.axis).Unit
                local from,to=R.ai.projectileVisualSegment({lastPos=geometry.pos-axis*geometry.span*.5,
                    lastVel=axis*geometry.span,height=geometry.height},me,radius,1)
                if from then paths[#paths+1]={from=from,to=to,eta=0,margin=R.ai.attackMargin(geometry,me)} end
            end
        elseif (not entry.untilTime or entry.untilTime>os.clock())
            and math.abs(entry.pos.Y-me.Y)<8 and flat(entry.pos-me).Magnitude<radius+(entry.radius or 0) then
            hazards[#hazards+1]=entry
        end
    end
    for _,pixel in ipairs(R.ai.dangerPixels) do
        local point=pixel.wallSample and pixel.wallSample.point or me+pixel.offset
        pixel.frame.Position=R.ai.dangerCanvasPoint(R.ai.dangerPool[1],point)
        local sample=pixel.wallSample
        local measured=sample and sample.blocked~=nil and sample.revision==(R.ai.geometryRevision or 0)

        local level=measured and 0 or -1
        for _,e in ipairs(enemies) do
            if flat(point-e.pos).Magnitude<e.reach+2 then level=1;break end
            if flat(point-(e.pos+e.vel*.6)).Magnitude<e.reach+4 then level=1 end
        end
        if level<2 then
            for _,h in ipairs(hazards) do
                local inside=false
                if h.geometry then inside=R.ai.attackMargin(h.geometry,point)<0
                elseif h.projectile then
                                                                          
                                                                               
                    inside=R.ai.projectileWindow(h.projectile,point,Vector3.zero,h.horizon)<0
                elseif h.radius then inside=flat(point-h.pos).Magnitude<h.radius+2
                elseif h.span>h.thin*3 then
                    local rel=h.cf:PointToObjectSpace(point)
                    inside=math.abs(rel.X)<h.size.X*.5+2 and math.abs(rel.Z)<h.size.Z*.5+2
                else inside=flat(point-h.pos).Magnitude<h.span*.55+2 end
                if inside then level=2;break end
            end
        end
        if measured and sample.blocked then level=3 end
        if pixel.level~=level then
            pixel.level=level
            pixel.frame.BackgroundColor3=level==3 and Color3.fromRGB(110,120,140)
                or level==2 and Color3.fromRGB(255,35,70)
                or level==1 and Color3.fromRGB(255,210,0)
                or level==-1 and Color3.fromRGB(140,160,180) or Color3.fromRGB(0,255,175)
        end
    end
                                                                              
                                                                                
    table.sort(paths,function(a,b)
        if a.margin~=b.margin then return a.margin<b.margin end
        return a.eta<b.eta
    end)
    local used=0
    if #paths>0 then
        if not R.ai.dangerPathGui then
            R.ai.dangerPathGui=R.ai.createDangerSurface(2);R.ai.dangerPathDots={};R.ai.dangerHeads={}
        end
        R.ai.dangerPool[2].CFrame=R.ai.dangerPool[1].CFrame
        R.ai.dangerPathGui.Enabled=true
        for i=1,math.min(8,#paths) do
            local path=paths[i]
            local head=R.ai.dangerHeads[i]
            local actual=path.position and path.position-me
            local showHead=actual~=nil and flat(actual).Magnitude<radius-.5 and math.abs(actual.Y)<=path.height
            if showHead and not head then
                head=dangerDot(R.ai.dangerPathGui,"TrackedProjectile",12,Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255))
                head.ZIndex=4;R.ai.dangerHeads[i]=head
            end
            if head then
                head.Visible=showHead
                if showHead then
                    R.ai.dangerHeadWorld=R.ai.dangerHeadWorld or {};R.ai.dangerHeadWorld[head]=path.position
                    head.Position=R.ai.dangerCanvasPoint(R.ai.dangerPool[2],path.position)
                end
            end
            local delta=flat(path.to-path.from)
            local steps=math.clamp(math.ceil(delta.Magnitude/3),1,16)
            for step=0,steps do
                used+=1
                local dot=R.ai.dangerPathDots[used]
                if not dot then
                    dot=dangerDot(R.ai.dangerPathGui,"ProjectileDot",9,Color3.fromRGB(255,20,45))
                    dot.ZIndex=3;R.ai.dangerPathDots[used]=dot
                end
                local worldPoint=path.from+delta*(step/steps)
                R.ai.dangerPathWorld=R.ai.dangerPathWorld or {};R.ai.dangerPathWorld[dot]=worldPoint
                dot.Position=R.ai.dangerCanvasPoint(R.ai.dangerPool[2],worldPoint)
                dot.Visible=true
            end
        end
    end
    for i=used+1,#(R.ai.dangerPathDots or {}) do R.ai.dangerPathDots[i].Visible=false end
    for i,head in pairs(R.ai.dangerHeads or {}) do if i>math.min(8,#paths) then head.Visible=false end end
    if R.ai.dangerPathGui then R.ai.dangerPathGui.Enabled=used>0 end
end 

function R.ai.dangerCircleStep()
                                                                           
    local rp=root()
    if not alive() or not rp then R.ai.clearDangerCircle(false);return end
    local me=rp.Position
    local radius=24
    local now=os.clock()
    local hazards,enemies={},{ }
                                                                        
    for part,info in pairs(R.watch) do
            if R.ai.characterEffectPart(part) or R.ai.spentBossIceVisual(part)then R.watch[part]=nil;continue end
        if not part.Parent or part:GetAttribute("BotNavigationVisual") then continue end
        if info.projectile then
            if now-(info.lastAt or 0)<.25 then
                                                                               
                                                                               
                                                                           
                hazards[#hazards+1]={projectile=info}

            end
        elseif not (part.Anchored and part.CanCollide) then
            local h=R.ai.attackGeometry(part,info)
            if h then
                hazards[#hazards+1]={geometry=h,part=part,info=info}

            end
        end
    end
    for _,hit in ipairs(R.ai.impacts) do
        if hit.untilTime>now then
            hazards[#hazards+1]={pos=hit.pos,radius=hit.radius,untilTime=hit.untilTime}
        end
    end
    for _,e in ipairs(R.enemies) do
        if enemyAlive(e.model) and e.root and e.root.Parent then
            local pos=e.root.Position
            local reach=R.ai.keepout(e)
            enemies[#enemies+1]={root=e.root,reach=reach}
        end
    end
    if not R.ai.dangerGui then
        R.ai.dangerGui=R.ai.createDangerSurface(1);R.ai.dangerPixels={}
        for ring=1,3 do
            local count=ring*16
            for sector=1,count do
                local angle=sector*math.pi*2/count
                local offset=Vector3.new(math.cos(angle),0,math.sin(angle))*(ring*7.75)
                local dot=dangerDot(R.ai.dangerGui,"GridDot",7,Color3.fromRGB(0,255,175))
                R.ai.dangerPixels[#R.ai.dangerPixels+1]={frame=dot,offset=offset}
            end
        end
    end
    R.ai.dangerSnapshot={hazards=hazards,enemies=enemies}
    R.ai.dangerGui.Enabled=true;R.ai.dangerPaintAt=0;R.ai.followDangerCircle()
end


                                                                           
                                                                            
do
    local a=R.ai
    local items={}
    pcall(function()
        local stats=game:GetService("Stats")
        for name,path in pairs({cpu={"PerformanceStats","CPU"},gpu={"PerformanceStats","GPU"},
            memory={"PerformanceStats","Memory"},gc={"Luau","AverageGcTime"},
            threads={"Luau","threads"},render={"FrameRateManager","RenderThreadAverage"}}) do
            local group=stats:FindFirstChild(path[1])
            items[name]=group and group:FindFirstChild(path[2])
        end
    end)
    a.frameStalls={}
    a.frameWork={}
    a.recordCallback=                  function(name,started,frame)
        if frame~=a.frameSerial then return end
        local elapsed=os.clock()-started
        local cost=a.frameWork[name] or {calls=0,seconds=0,max=0}
        cost.calls+=1;cost.seconds+=elapsed;cost.max=math.max(cost.max,elapsed)
        a.frameWork[name]=cost
    end 
    a.recordFrameStall=                  function(dt)
        local work=dt>=.08 and {} or nil
        for name,cost in pairs(a.frameWork) do
            if work and cost.calls>0 then work[name]={calls=cost.calls,seconds=cost.seconds,max=cost.max}end
            cost.calls=0;cost.seconds=0;cost.max=0
        end
        if dt<.08 then return end
        local stats={}
        for name,item in pairs(items) do
            local ok,value=pcall(function()return item:GetValue()end)
            if ok then stats[name]=value end
        end
        local c=a.adaptive;local model=getgenv().__UIBotModelDisguise
        local privacy=getgenv().__UIBotPrivacy
        local request=a.nativePathRequest
        local row={at=os.clock(),dt=dt,status=c and c.status,work=work,engineAverages=stats,
            native=request and {started=request.started,finished=request.finished,elapsed=request.elapsed},
            model=model and model.renderPerformance and model.renderPerformance.last,
            privacy=privacy and privacy.renderPerformance and privacy.renderPerformance.last}
        a.frameStalls[#a.frameStalls+1]=row
        if #a.frameStalls>60 then table.remove(a.frameStalls,1)end
    end 
end

local function startLoops()
    R.booted = true
                                                                             
                                                                              
    RunService:BindToRenderStep("UIBotEmergencyMove",Enum.RenderPriority.Input.Value+1,R.ai.applyEmergencyMove)
    R.conns[#R.conns+1]=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(                  function(dt)
        R.ai.frameSerial=(R.ai.frameSerial or 0)+1
        if R.ai.recordFrameStall then R.ai.recordFrameStall(dt)end
    end )
    R.conns[#R.conns + 1] = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(                  function(dt)
        if R.booted then
            safe(function() camStep(dt) end,"camera")
            safe(R.ai.riseStep)
            safe(faceStep)
            safe(R.ai.followDangerCircle)
        end
    end )
    spin(0.30, function()
        if R.farming and inDungeon() then scanEnemies() end
    end,"scanEnemies")
    spin(0.50, brainStep,"brainStep")
    spin(1.0, R.ai.courseStep,"courseStep")
    spin(0.02, R.ai.evasionTick,"evasionTick")
    spin(0.05, walkStep,"walkStep")
    spin(0.05, combatStep,"combatStep")
    spin(0.40, stuckStep,"stuckStep")
    spin(0, R.ai.updateDangerDisplay,"updateDangerDisplay")
    spin(0.20, R.ai.dangerCircleStep,"dangerCircleStep")
    spin(0.30,function() R.ai.scanAheadStep(root(),R.ai.navGoal) end)
    spin(0.50, R.ai.maintainMap,"maintainMap")
    spin(0.25, R.ai.learnTick,"learnTick")
    spin(0.25, R.ai.corridorTick,"corridorTick")
    spin(5,function() if R.ai.canCheckpoint() then R.ai.saveCorridors() end end)
    spin(60,function() if R.ai.canCheckpoint() then R.ai.telemetrySave() end end)
end

local disguisePortraits={}

R.ai.formatNumber=function(value)
    if S.AutoFormat==false then return tostring(value) end
    local n=tonumber(value)
    if not n or n~=n or math.abs(n)==math.huge then return tostring(value) end
    local units={"","k","m","b","t","q","qi","sx"};local i=1
    while math.abs(n)>=1000 and i<#units do n/=1000;i+=1 end
    if i==1 then return tostring(value) end
    n=math.floor(math.abs(n)*100+.5)/100*(n<0 and -1 or 1)
    if math.abs(n)>=1000 and i<#units then n/=1000;i+=1 end
    return (string.format("%.2f",n):gsub("0+$",""):gsub("%.$",""))..units[i]
end

                       
local function createPrivacy(options)
options=options or {}
                                                                      
local Rules={}
function Rules.replacePlain(value,needle,replacement)
    if needle=="" then return value end
    local escaped=needle:gsub("([^%w])","%%%1")
    return (value:gsub(escaped,function()return replacement end))
end
function Rules.field(context,name,path,text)
    name=name:lower();path=path:lower()
    if context=="status" or context=="plate" or context=="row" then
        if name=="name" or name=="playername" or name=="username" or name=="displayname" then return "name" end
        if name=="title" and context~="status" then return "title" end
        if name=="vip" then return "badge" end
        if name=="level" then return "level" end
        if name=="health" or name=="healthamount" or name=="hp" then return "health" end
        if name=="xp" or name=="experience" then return "xp" end
        if path:find("moneymain",1,true) and text~="" then return "money" end
        if context=="row" and text:find("%d") then return "stat" end
    end
    return "names"
end
Rules.render =                   function(field,original,identity,ratio,names)
    if field=="name" then return identity.alias end
    if field=="title" then return "("..identity.title..")" end
    if field=="badge" then return identity.badge end
    if field=="level" then return tostring(identity.level) end
    if field=="health" then
        return R.ai.formatNumber(math.floor(identity.health*math.clamp(ratio or 1,0,1)+.5)).."/"..R.ai.formatNumber(identity.health)
    end
    if field=="xp" then return R.ai.formatNumber(identity.xp).."/"..R.ai.formatNumber(identity.xpMax) end
    if field=="money" or field=="stat" then return R.ai.formatNumber(identity.stat) end
    local rendered=original
    for _,name in ipairs(names) do rendered=Rules.replacePlain(rendered,name,identity.alias) end
    return rendered
end 
function Rules.identity()
    return {alias="ROBLOX",title="Guest",badge="ROBLOX",level=999,
        health=999999,xp="999Sx",xpMax="999Sx",stat="999Sx"}
end
function Rules.maskTitleColor(context,name)
    return (context=="plate" or context=="row") and name:lower()=="title"
end

                
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local CoreGui=game:GetService("CoreGui")
local LP=Players.LocalPlayer
local previous=getgenv().__UIBotPrivacy
local startEnabled=options.enabled==true
local oldModel=getgenv().__UIBotModelDisguise or getgenv().__BatmanDisguise
local choice="ROBLOX Guest"
getgenv().__UIBotDisguiseSelection=choice
if oldModel and oldModel.stop then oldModel.stop() end
if previous and previous.unload then previous.unload() end
local P={enabled=false,loaded=true,records={},connections={},proxies={},masks={},counts={},avatarParts={},avatarEpoch=0}
P.disguise=choice
local names={LP.Name,LP.DisplayName}
table.sort(names,function(a,b)return #a>#b end)
local charConnection,guiConnection,coreConnection
local gui,proxyFolder,controls,statusLabel
local function connect(signal,fn)
    local c=signal:Connect(fn);P.connections[#P.connections+1]=c;return c
end
local function newIdentity()
    return Rules.identity()
end
P.identity=newIdentity()
local function ratio()
    local c=LP.Character;local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return h and h.MaxHealth>0 and h.Health/h.MaxHealth or 1
end
local function own(v)
    return v:GetAttribute("BotPrivacyVisual")==true
        or (gui and v:IsDescendantOf(gui)) or (proxyFolder and v:IsDescendantOf(proxyFolder))
end
local function read(v,property)
    local ok,value=pcall(function()return v[property]end)
    return ok,value
end
local function write(v,property,value)
    pcall(function()if v[property]~=value then v[property]=value end end)
end
local function repaint(v,slot)
    if not P.enabled then return end
    local ok,current=read(v,slot.property);if not ok then return end
    if current~=slot.applied then slot.original=current end
    local replacement=slot.render(slot.original)
    slot.applied=replacement
    if current~=replacement then write(v,slot.property,replacement) end
end
local function bind(v,property,render)
    if not P.enabled or own(v) then return end
    local row=P.records[v]
    if not row then
        row={};P.records[v]=row
        row.destroy=connect(v.Destroying,function()
            for _,slot in pairs(row) do if type(slot)=="table" and slot.connection then slot.connection:Disconnect() end end
            P.records[v]=nil
        end)
    end
    if row[property] then return end
    local ok,value=read(v,property);if not ok then return end
    local slot={property=property,original=value,render=render};row[property]=slot
    slot.connection=connect(v:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property),function()repaint(v,slot)end)
    repaint(v,slot)
end
local function tagged(v)
    v:SetAttribute("BotPrivacyVisual",true);v:SetAttribute("BotNavigationVisual",true)
    return v
end
local function portrait(v)
    if P.masks[v] then return end
    bind(v,"ImageTransparency",function()return 1 end)
    local f=tagged(Instance.new("ImageLabel"));f.Name="PrivatePortrait"
    f.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1);f.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(35,38,43)
    f.Image=disguisePortraits[P.disguise] or "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=1&w=420&h=420"
    f.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit;f.BorderSizePixel=0;f.ZIndex=v.ZIndex+1;f.Parent=v
    P.masks[v]=f
end
local function context(v)
    local c=LP.Character
    if c and v:IsDescendantOf(c) then return "plate" end
    local pg=LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    if not pg or not v:IsDescendantOf(pg) then return "generic" end
    local at=v
    while at and at~=pg do
        if at.Name=="playerStatus" then return "status" end
        if at.Name==LP.Name or at.Name==tostring(LP.UserId) then return "row" end
        at=at.Parent
    end
    return "generic"
end
local bodyNames={Head=true,Torso=true,UpperTorso=true,LowerTorso=true,
    LeftUpperArm=true,LeftLowerArm=true,LeftHand=true,RightUpperArm=true,RightLowerArm=true,RightHand=true,
    LeftUpperLeg=true,LeftLowerLeg=true,LeftFoot=true,RightUpperLeg=true,RightLowerLeg=true,RightFoot=true,
    ["Left Arm"]=true,["Right Arm"]=true,["Left Leg"]=true,["Right Leg"]=true}
local function guestColor(name)
    if name:find("Leg",1,true) or name:find("Foot",1,true) then return Color3.fromRGB(35,73,123) end
    if name:find("Torso",1,true) then return Color3.fromRGB(25,28,32) end
    return Color3.fromRGB(223,224,222)
end
local function clearAvatar()
    P.avatarEpoch+=1
    local model=getgenv().__UIBotModelDisguise
    if model and model.owner==P then model.stop() end
    P.customModel=nil
    if P.avatarModel then P.avatarModel:Destroy();P.avatarModel=nil end
    P.avatarParts={}
    for source,part in pairs(P.proxies)do part:Destroy();P.proxies[source]=nil end
end
local function buildGuest(c)
    local epoch=P.avatarEpoch
    P.avatarState="loading ROBLOX clothing"
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok,model=pcall(function()
                                                                                    
            local description=Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserIdAsync(1)
                                                                                      
            description.Head=0;description.Torso=0
            description.LeftArm=0;description.RightArm=0
            description.LeftLeg=0;description.RightLeg=0
            description.Face=0;description.BodyTypeScale=0;description.ProportionScale=0
            description.HeadColor=guestColor("Head")
            description.LeftArmColor=guestColor("Arm");description.RightArmColor=guestColor("Arm")
            description.TorsoColor=guestColor("Torso")
            description.LeftLegColor=guestColor("Leg");description.RightLegColor=guestColor("Leg")
            return Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescriptionAsync(description,Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
        end)
        if not ok then
            if P.avatarEpoch==epoch then P.avatarState="guest fallback: "..tostring(model) end
            return
        end
        if not P.enabled or not P.loaded or P.avatarEpoch~=epoch or LP.Character~=c then model:Destroy();return end
                                                                           
                                                                                
        local readyUntil=os.clock()+8
        while true do
            if not P.enabled or not P.loaded or P.avatarEpoch~=epoch or LP.Character~=c then model:Destroy();return end
            local missing=false
            for _,part in ipairs(model:GetChildren())do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") and bodyNames[part.Name] and not c:FindFirstChild(part.Name) then missing=true;break end
            end
            if not missing or os.clock()>=readyUntil then break end
            P.avatarState="waiting for character limbs"
            task.wait(.1)
        end
        model.Name="PrivateROBLOXGuest";tagged(model)
                                                                                   
        for _,v in ipairs(model:QueryDescendants("LuaSourceContainer, Animator"))do v:Destroy() end
        for _,v in ipairs(model:QueryDescendants("Light, ParticleEmitter, Trail, Beam, Highlight"))do v:Destroy() end
                                                                            
                                                                               
                                                                          
        local h=model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if h then h:Destroy() end
        local links={}
        for _,part in ipairs(model:QueryDescendants("BasePart"))do
            tagged(part);part.Anchored=true;part.CanCollide=false;part.CanTouch=false;part.CanQuery=false;part.CastShadow=false
            local source=c:FindFirstChild(part.Name)
            if part.Parent==model and bodyNames[part.Name] and source and source:IsA("BasePart") then
                links[#links+1]={source=source,part=part,offset=CFrame.identity}
            elseif part.Parent:IsA("Accessory") then
                local weld=part:FindFirstChildOfClass("Weld")
                local attached=weld and (weld.Part1==part and weld.Part0 or weld.Part1)
                local offset=attached and attached.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                for _,attachment in ipairs(part:GetChildren())do
                    if attachment:IsA("Attachment") then
                        for _,candidate in ipairs(model:GetChildren())do
                            local target=candidate:IsA("BasePart") and candidate:FindFirstChild(attachment.Name)
                            if target and target:IsA("Attachment") then
                                attached=candidate;offset=target.CFrame*attachment.CFrame:Inverse();break
                            end
                        end
                        if attached then break end
                    end
                end
                local anchor=attached and c:FindFirstChild(attached.Name)
                if attached and anchor then
                    links[#links+1]={source=anchor,part=part,offset=offset}
                else part.Transparency=1 end
            else part.Transparency=1 end
        end
                                                                                 
                                                                                  
        for _,v in ipairs(model:QueryDescendants("Constraint, JointInstance"))do v:Destroy() end
        if #links==0 then model:Destroy();P.avatarState="guest fallback: unsupported rig";return end
        for _,item in ipairs(links)do item.part.CFrame=item.source.CFrame*item.offset end
        model.Parent=proxyFolder;P.avatarModel=model;P.avatarParts=links;P.avatarState="ROBLOX guest"
        for source,part in pairs(P.proxies)do part:Destroy();P.proxies[source]=nil end
    end)
end
local function body(v)
    local c=LP.Character;if not c or not v:IsDescendantOf(c) then return end
    if v:IsA("BasePart") then
                                                                           
        bind(v,"LocalTransparencyModifier",function()return 1 end)
        if v.Parent==c and bodyNames[v.Name] and P.disguise=="ROBLOX Guest" and not P.avatarModel and not P.proxies[v] then
            local part=tagged(Instance.new("Part"));part.Name="PrivateBody"
            part.Anchored=true;part.CanCollide=false;part.CanTouch=false;part.CanQuery=false
            part.CastShadow=false;part.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            part.Size=v.Size;part.CFrame=v.CFrame;part.Color=guestColor(v.Name)
            if v.Name=="Head" then part.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball end
            part.Parent=proxyFolder;P.proxies[v]=part
        end
    elseif v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or v:IsA("Trail") or v:IsA("Beam") or v:IsA("Highlight") or v:IsA("Light") then
        bind(v,"Enabled",function()return false end)
    elseif v:IsA("Decal") or v:IsA("Texture") then
        bind(v,"Transparency",function()return 1 end)
    elseif v:IsA("Humanoid") then
        bind(v,"DisplayDistanceType",function()return Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None end)
    end
end
local function inspect(v)
    if not P.enabled or own(v) then return end
    body(v)
    if v:IsA("TextLabel") or v:IsA("TextButton") then
        local ctx=context(v)
        local field=Rules.field(ctx,v.Name,v:GetFullName(),v.Text)
                                                                              
        bind(v,"Text",function(original)return Rules.render(field,original,P.identity,ratio(),names)end)
        if Rules.maskTitleColor(ctx,v.Name) then
            bind(v,"TextColor3",function()return Color3.fromRGB(235,235,235)end)
            bind(v,"TextStrokeColor3",function()return Color3.new(0,0,0)end)
            for _,gradient in ipairs(v:QueryDescendants("UIGradient"))do
                bind(gradient,"Enabled",function()return false end)
            end
        end
    elseif v:IsA("UIGradient") and v.Parent and Rules.maskTitleColor(context(v.Parent),v.Parent.Name) then
        bind(v,"Enabled",function()return false end)
    elseif v:IsA("ImageLabel") or v:IsA("ImageButton") then
        local lower=v.Name:lower();local url=v.Image:lower()
        local thumbnailId=url:match("[?&]userid=(%d+)") or (url:find("rbxthumb",1,true) and url:match("[?&]id=(%d+)"))
        if (context(v)=="status" and (lower=="portrait" or lower=="avatar"))
            or tonumber(thumbnailId)==LP.UserId then portrait(v) end
    end
                                                                              
end
local function scan(root,selector)
    if not root then return end
    for _,v in ipairs(root:QueryDescendants(selector))do inspect(v) end
end
local function watchCharacter(c)
    if charConnection then charConnection:Disconnect();charConnection=nil end
    clearAvatar()
    if not P.enabled then return end
    scan(c,"BasePart, ParticleEmitter, Trail, Beam, Highlight, Light, Decal, Texture, Humanoid, TextLabel, TextButton, UIGradient")
    buildGuest(c)
    charConnection=connect(c.DescendantAdded,function(v)
        task.defer(inspect,v)
    end)
end
local function updateControls()
    if statusLabel then statusLabel.Text=P.enabled and ("Privacy · "..P.identity.alias) or "Privacy off" end
    if controls then controls.Text=P.enabled and "On" or "Off" end
end
function P.setEnabled(on)
    on=on==true;if P.enabled==on or not P.loaded then return end
    P.enabled=on
    if on then
        proxyFolder=tagged(Instance.new("Folder"));proxyFolder.Name="BotPrivacyAvatar";proxyFolder.Parent=workspace
        local lamp=tagged(Instance.new("Part"));lamp.Name="DisguiseWhiteLight"
        lamp.Size=Vector3.one;lamp.Transparency=1;lamp.Anchored=true
        lamp.CanCollide=false;lamp.CanTouch=false;lamp.CanQuery=false;lamp.Parent=proxyFolder
        local light=tagged(Instance.new("PointLight"));light.Color=Color3.new(1,1,1)
        light.Brightness=3;light.Range=20;light.Shadows=false;light.Parent=lamp
        P.lightPart=lamp;P.light=light
        local pg=LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        scan(pg,"TextLabel, TextButton, ImageLabel, ImageButton, ViewportFrame, Frame")
        guiConnection=connect(pg.DescendantAdded,function(v)task.defer(inspect,v)end)
                                                                                   
        pcall(function()
            scan(CoreGui,"TextLabel, TextButton, ImageLabel, ImageButton")
            coreConnection=connect(CoreGui.DescendantAdded,function(v)task.defer(inspect,v)end)
        end)
        if LP.Character then watchCharacter(LP.Character) end
    else
        clearAvatar()
        for _,c in pairs({charConnection,guiConnection,coreConnection})do c:Disconnect() end
        charConnection=nil;guiConnection=nil;coreConnection=nil
        for v,row in pairs(P.records)do
            for _,slot in pairs(row)do
                if type(slot)=="table" then
                    if slot.connection then slot.connection:Disconnect() end
                    local ok,current=read(v,slot.property)
                    if ok and current==slot.applied then write(v,slot.property,slot.original) end
                end
            end
            if row.destroy then row.destroy:Disconnect() end
        end
        P.records={}
        for _,f in pairs(P.masks)do f:Destroy() end;P.masks={}
        if proxyFolder then proxyFolder:Destroy();proxyFolder=nil end;P.proxies={}
    end
    updateControls()
end
function P.setDisguise(name)
    if name=="ROBLOX" then name="ROBLOX Guest" end
    if name~="ROBLOX Guest" then return false end
    if P.disguise==name then return true end
    P.disguise=name;getgenv().__UIBotDisguiseSelection=name
    P.applyIdentity()
    for _,f in pairs(P.masks)do
        if f.Name=="PrivatePortrait" then f.Image=disguisePortraits[name] or "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=1&w=420&h=420" end
    end
    if type(writefile)=="function" then pcall(writefile,"DQR/settings/UIBot-disguise-selection.txt",name) end
    if P.enabled and LP.Character then watchCharacter(LP.Character) end
    updateControls();return true
end
function P.applyIdentity()
    P.identity=newIdentity()
    for v,row in pairs(P.records)do for _,slot in pairs(row)do
        if type(slot)=="table" then repaint(v,slot) end
    end end
    updateControls()
end
P.reroll=P.applyIdentity                                                 
function P.reapply()
    P.applyIdentity()
    if P.enabled and LP.Character then watchCharacter(LP.Character) end
end
function P.audit()
    local n={text=0,appearance=0,portraits=0,panels=0,proxies=0,lights=0,titleColors=0}
    for _,row in pairs(P.records)do
        if row.Text then n.text+=1 end
        if row.LocalTransparencyModifier then n.appearance+=1 end
    end
    for _,f in pairs(P.masks)do if f.Name=="PrivatePortrait" then n.portraits+=1 else n.panels+=1 end end
    for _ in pairs(P.proxies)do n.proxies+=1 end
    for v,row in pairs(P.records)do
        if row.Enabled and v:IsA("Light") then n.lights+=1 end
        if row.TextColor3 then n.titleColors+=1 end
    end
    return {enabled=P.enabled,alias=P.identity.alias,avatar=P.avatarState,disguise=P.disguise,avatarParts=P.customModel and #P.customModel.parts or #P.avatarParts,
        money=P.identity.stat,counts=n,scope="local player only"}
end
function P.unload()
    if not P.loaded then return end
    P.setEnabled(false);P.loaded=false
    RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("UIBotPrivacyVisuals")
    for _,c in ipairs(P.connections)do c:Disconnect() end;P.connections={}
    if gui then gui:Destroy();gui=nil end
    if getgenv().__UIBotPrivacy==P then getgenv().__UIBotPrivacy=nil end
end

connect(LP.CharacterAdded,function(c)if P.enabled then watchCharacter(c)end end)
RunService:BindToRenderStep("UIBotPrivacyVisuals",Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value+1,                  function()
    if not P.enabled then return end

    local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

getgenv().__UIBotPrivacy=P
P.setEnabled(startEnabled)

return P

local function unload()
    if R.ai.stopSettingsAutosave then R.ai.stopSettingsAutosave() end
    if R.ai.stopAutoUpgrade then R.ai.stopAutoUpgrade() end; if R.ai.stopPotentialPredictor then R.ai.stopPotentialPredictor() end; if R.ai.stopItems then R.ai.stopItems() end; if R.ai.stopParty then R.ai.stopParty() end; if R.ai.stopUtilities then R.ai.stopUtilities() end
    if R.ai.stopAutoLevelLobby then R.ai.stopAutoLevelLobby() end
    RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("UIBotEmergencyMove")
    R.ai.finishRunLearning("script unloaded")
    if R.privacy then R.privacy.unload() end
    R.ai.releaseRise()
    R.ai.finishRally(); R.ai.telemetrySave(); R.ai.saveLearning()
    setFarming(false)
    R.booted = false
    R.ai.generation += 1
    if R.ai.preview then R.ai.preview:Destroy() end
    if R.ai.mapPreview then R.ai.mapPreview:Destroy() end
    if R.ai.mapGui then R.ai.mapGui:Destroy() end
    if R.ai.occupancyProbe then R.ai.occupancyProbe:Destroy();R.ai.occupancyProbe=nil end
    R.ai.clearDangerCircle(true)
    for _, c in ipairs(R.conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    R.conns = {}
    R.watch = {}
    stopMoving()
    releaseCamera()
    releaseBodyLock()
    pcall(function() Lib:Unload() end)
end

R.ai.configValues=(function()
local M={}
function M.copy(value)
    local kind=type(value)
    if kind=="boolean" or kind=="string" then return value end
    if kind=="number" then
        if value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge then return value end
        return nil
    end
    if kind~="table" then return nil end
    local copy={};local count=0
    for key,selected in pairs(value)do
        count=count+1
        if count>1000 or type(key)~="string" or type(selected)~="boolean" then return nil end
        copy[key]=selected
    end
    return copy
end
function M.name(value)
    if type(value)~="string" then return nil end
    value=value:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
    if #value==0 or #value>80 or value:find('[%c/\\:*?"<>|]') or value:sub(-1)=="." or value=="." or value==".." then return nil end
    return value
end
return M

end)()
R.ai.configPolicy=(function()
local P={}
local function set(text)local t={};for key in text:gmatch('[^|]+')do t[key]=true end;return t end
P.dungeons=set("Desert Temple|Winter Outpost|Pirate Island|King's Castle|The Underworld|Samurai Palace|The Canals|Ghastly Harbor|Steampunk Sewers|Orbital Outpost|Volcanic Chambers|Aquatic Temple|Enchanted Forest|Northern Lands|Gilded Skies|Oni Dungeon|Egg Island|Krampus|Tutorial Dungeon")
P.difficulties=set("Easy|Medium|Hard|Insane|Nightmare")
local booleans=set("Hardcore|Private|WaveDefence|AutoLobby|AutoStart|AutoReady|AutoReplay|ReturnLobby|AutoLevelLobby|AutoLaunchLobby|LevelLobbyHardcore|UseDungeonRules|AttackEnabled|UseQ|UseE|HoldFire|AimCluster|LeadTargets|FaceTarget|BodyLock|MoveEnabled|SteerCamera|UsePathfinding|JumpOnStuck|UseHumanoidSlope|EvadeEnabled|DodgeProjectiles|DodgeAoE|DodgeWindup|EscapeSurround|HitReact|Kite|Rise|SpaceCasters|SpaceBoss|OrbitBoss|RetreatEnabled|AntiAFK|GroupEnemies|BoosterRotation|TravelSpeedSkills|AutoSwapSets|AutoEquipBest|EquipPotential|AutoSellItems|KeepBestWeapon|KeepUpgraded|KeepRarity|KeepLevel|KeepOnlyBetter|AutoSpendPoints|AutoUpgrade|AutoLobbySell|StallBeforeBoss")
local numbers=set("LevelReq|StartDelay|FinishDelay|MeleeRange|SpellRange|ClickDelay|SpellDelay|PanicHP|AimTolerance|ClusterRadius|LockTurnSpeed|StopDistance|CamDistance|CamHeight|CamSmooth|CamMinDistance|MaxWalkSlope|MaxStepHeight|RiseHeight|RiseNear|RiseForce|KiteNear|KiteDistance|DangerRadius|ProjClearance|EvadeCommit|SurroundCount|SurroundRadius|CasterDistance|BossDistance|RetreatHP|RetreatDistance|GroupRadius|GroupBudget|GroupSpread|SkillRadiusQ|SkillRadiusE|SkillHealHP|EquipBetter|SellBelow|KeepLevelAt|UpgradeReserve|LobbySellAt|StallUntil")
local enums={
    Dungeon=P.dungeons,Difficulty=P.difficulties,AttackMode=set("Input|Remote"),AimMode=set("Camera + Mouse|Camera only|Mouse only"),
    MoveMode=set("VIM Camera|VIM Keys|Humanoid Move"),SwapBuild=set("Auto|Magic|Physical"),
    EquipWeapon=set("Physical Damage|Spell Power"),EquipArmor=set("Physical Damage|Spell Power|Health"),
    UpgradeBuild=set("Physical|Magic|Health"),SpendStat=set("Physical Damage|Spell Power|Stamina"),
    SellBy=set("Rarity|Level|Both|Selected rarities|Below level|Rarity and level"),KeepRarityAt=set("common|uncommon|rare|epic|legendary|ultimate"),
}
for _,slot in ipairs({"Q","E"})do
    enums["SkillSpeed"..slot]=set("Auto|Yes|No")
    enums["SkillRole"..slot]=set("Auto|Magic damage|Physical damage|Magic booster|Physical booster|Healing|Support")
    enums["SkillOrigin"..slot]=set("Auto|Follows character|Fixed at cast|Projectile / forward")
end
local multi={SellRarities=enums.KeepRarityAt,SellCategories=set("weapon|helmet|chest|ability")}
function P.value(key,value)
    if booleans[key] then if type(value)=="boolean" then return value end;return end
    if numbers[key] then
        local n=tonumber(value);if n and n==n and n>=0 and n<1e15 then return n end;return
    end
    if enums[key] then return type(value)=="string" and enums[key][value] and value or nil end
    if multi[key] or key=="DungeonRules" then
        if type(value)~="table" then return end
        local result={};local count=0
        for name,on in pairs(value)do
            count+=1;if count>100 or type(name)~="string" or type(on)~="boolean" then return end
            local valid=multi[key] and multi[key][name]
            if key=="DungeonRules" then
                local dungeon,difficulty=name:match("^(.-)|([^|]+)$")
                valid=P.dungeons[dungeon] and P.difficulties[difficulty]
            end
            if valid then result[name]=on end
        end
        return result
    end
end
function P.clean(data)
    local result={}
    if type(data)~="table" then return result end
    for key,value in pairs(data)do
        if type(key)=="string" then result[key]=P.value(key,value) end
    end
    return result
end
function P.allows(settings,dungeon,difficulty)
    if settings.UseDungeonRules~=true then return true end
    return type(settings.DungeonRules)=="table" and type(dungeon)=="string" and type(difficulty)=="string"
        and P.dungeons[dungeon]==true and P.difficulties[difficulty]==true
        and settings.DungeonRules[dungeon.."|"..difficulty]==true
end
return P

end)()
S.DungeonRules={};S.UseDungeonRules=false
R.ai.dungeonAllowed=function(name,difficulty)return R.ai.configPolicy.allows(S,name,difficulty)end

local function fileApi()
    return type(writefile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function"
end

local function cfgFolders()
    pcall(function()
        if type(isfolder) ~= "function" or type(makefolder) ~= "function" then return end
        if not isfolder("DQR") then makefolder("DQR") end
        if not isfolder(CFG_ROOT) then makefolder(CFG_ROOT) end
        if not isfolder(CFG_DIR) then makefolder(CFG_DIR) end
    end)
end

local function uiTable(name)
    local ok, t = pcall(function() return Lib[name] end)
    if ok and type(t) == "table" then return t end
    ok, t = pcall(function()
        local env = getgenv and getgenv()
        return env and env[name]
    end)
    if ok and type(t) == "table" then return t end
    return nil
end

local function uiEach(fn)
    for _, name in ipairs({ "Toggles", "Options" }) do
        local tbl = uiTable(name)
        if tbl then
            for id, obj in pairs(tbl) do
                if type(obj) == "table" and not CFG_SKIP[id] then
                    pcall(fn, id, UI_KEY[id] or id, obj)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local function fixTypes()
    S.DebugMap=false;S.DangerCircle=true;S.LearningMode=false;S.LearnKiting=false
    if type(S.Hotkey) ~= "string" or S.Hotkey == "" then S.Hotkey = "F" end
    S.LevelReq = tonumber(S.LevelReq) or 1
end

                                                                                        
                                                                                          
                                                                                
function R.ai.applyRangedDefaults()
    S.SpaceCasters=true;S.CasterDistance=40;S.ProjClearance=9
    local toggles,options=uiTable("Toggles"),uiTable("Options")
    if toggles and toggles.SpaceCasters then toggles.SpaceCasters:SetValue(true) end
    if options and options.CasterDistance then options.CasterDistance:SetValue(40) end
    if options and options.ProjClearance then options.ProjClearance:SetValue(9) end
    R.ai.rangedPresetUpgraded=true
end
local function syncFromUI()
    uiEach(function(id, key, obj)
        local cur, val = S[key], obj.Value
        if cur == nil or val == nil then return end
        if type(cur) == "number" then
            val = tonumber(val)
            if val then S[key] = val end
        elseif type(cur) == type(val) then
            S[key] = val
        end
    end)
    fixTypes()
                                                                             
                                                                           
    if not R.ai.rangedPresetUpgraded and S.SpaceCasters==false
        and S.CasterDistance==20 and S.ProjClearance==7 then R.ai.applyRangedDefaults() end
    if R.privacy and R.privacy.enabled~=S.PrivacyEnabled then
        R.privacy.setEnabled(S.PrivacyEnabled)
    end
end

                                                                           
local function pushToUI()
    uiEach(function(id, key, obj)
        local val = S[key]
        if val ~= nil and obj.Value ~= val and type(obj.SetValue) == "function" then obj:SetValue(val) end
    end)
end

local function cfgNames()
    local out,seen = {},{}
    pcall(function()
        if type(listfiles) ~= "function" then return end
        for _,dir in ipairs({CFG_DIR,CFG_LEGACY}) do
            local ok,files=pcall(listfiles,dir)
            if ok then for _,path in ipairs(files) do
                local n=tostring(path):match("([^/\\]+)%.json$")
                if n and not seen[n] then seen[n]=true;out[#out+1]=n end
            end end
        end
    end)
    table.sort(out)
    return out
end

local function cfgRefresh()
    local dd = U.cfgList
    if type(dd) ~= "table" or type(dd.SetValues) ~= "function" then
        local O = uiTable("Options")
        dd = O and O.CfgList or nil
        if type(dd) == "table" then U.cfgList = dd end
    end
    if type(dd) == "table" then pcall(function() dd:SetValues(cfgNames()) end) end
end

local function cfgSave(name)
    name=R.ai.configValues.name(name)
    if not name then return false, "enter a valid config name" end
    if not fileApi() then return false, "no file api in this executor" end
    syncFromUI()
    cfgFolders()
    local data = {}
    for k, v in pairs(S) do
        if not CFG_SKIP[k] then data[k]=R.ai.configValues.copy(v) end
    end
    uiEach(function(id,key,obj)
        if not CFG_SKIP[key] then data[key]=R.ai.configValues.copy(obj.Value) end
    end)
    data=R.ai.configPolicy.clean(data)
    local ok, enc = pcall(function() return HTTP:JSONEncode(data) end)
    if not ok or type(enc) ~= "string" then return false, "encode failed" end
    if not pcall(function() writefile(CFG_DIR .. "/" .. name .. ".json", enc) end) then
        return false, "write failed"
    end
    return true, name
end

local function cfgApply(raw,paused,localSettings)
    local ok,dec=pcall(function() return HTTP:JSONDecode(raw) end)
    if not ok or type(dec) ~= "table" then return false, "bad file" end
                                                                            
                                                                               
    if type(dec.objects)=="table" then
        local values={}
        for _,entry in ipairs(dec.objects) do
            if type(entry)=="table" and type(entry.idx)=="string" and not CFG_SKIP[entry.idx] then
                local key=UI_KEY[entry.idx] or entry.idx
                if entry.type=="Input" then values[key]=entry.text
                elseif entry.type=="Toggle" or entry.type=="Slider" or entry.type=="Dropdown" then
                    values[key]=entry.value
                end
            end
        end
        dec=values
    end
    if not localSettings then dec=R.ai.configPolicy.clean(dec) end
    if dec.SellBy then dec.SellBy=({Rarity="Selected rarities",Level="Below level",Both="Rarity and level"})[dec.SellBy] or dec.SellBy end
    local defaults={}
    uiEach(function(id,key,obj)defaults[key]=obj.Value end)
    for k, v in pairs(dec) do
        local cur=S[k]
        if cur==nil then cur=defaults[k] end
        if cur~=nil and not CFG_SKIP[k] then
            if paused and R.ai.configPaused[k] then S[k]=false
            else
                if type(cur)=="number" then v=tonumber(v) end
                local copy=R.ai.configValues.copy(v)
                if copy~=nil and type(copy)==type(cur) then S[k]=copy end
            end
        end
    end
    fixTypes()
    pushToUI()
    if R.ai.refreshConfigRules then R.ai.refreshConfigRules()end
    if not localSettings then
        if paused then R.ai.startupPreset=dec
        elseif R.ai.onPresetLoaded then R.ai.onPresetLoaded(dec)end
    end
    return true
end

local function cfgLoad(name,paused)
    name=R.ai.configValues.name(name)
    if not name then return false, "pick a valid config" end
    if not fileApi() then return false, "no file api in this executor" end
    local ok,raw=pcall(readfile,CFG_DIR.."/"..name..".json")
    if not ok then ok,raw=pcall(readfile,CFG_LEGACY.."/"..name..".json") end
    if not ok or type(raw)~="string" then return false,"not found" end
    local loaded,why=cfgApply(raw,paused)
    if not loaded then return false,why end
    return true, name
end

local function cfgDelete(name)
    name=R.ai.configValues.name(name)
    if not name then return false, "pick a valid config" end
    if type(delfile) ~= "function" then return false, "no delfile" end
    local ok=pcall(function() readfile(CFG_DIR.."/"..name..".json") end)
    local dir=ok and CFG_DIR or CFG_LEGACY
    if not pcall(function() delfile(dir .. "/" .. name .. ".json") end) then
        return false, "delete failed"
    end
    return true, name
end

local function cfgAutoName()
    if not fileApi() then return nil end
    local ok, raw = pcall(function() return readfile(CFG_AUTO) end)
    if not ok then ok,raw=pcall(readfile,CFG_LEGACY.."/autoload.txt") end
    if ok and type(raw) == "string" then
        raw = raw:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        return R.ai.configValues.name(raw)
    end
    return nil
end

local function cfgAutoSet(name)
    if not fileApi() then return false end
    if name~=nil then
        name=R.ai.configValues.name(name)
        if not name then return false end
        cfgFolders()
        return pcall(function() writefile(CFG_AUTO, name) end)
    end
    if not pcall(writefile,CFG_AUTO,"") then return false end
    if type(delfile) == "function" then pcall(delfile,CFG_LEGACY.."/autoload.txt") end
    return true
end

                                                                
     
                                                                

R.ai.sessionControls={settings={},actions={},counts={}}
function R.ai.wrapSessionWindow(window)
    local registry=R.ai.sessionControls
    local function announce(command)
                                                                                                        
        if command.command=="setting" and command.key:match("^Webhook") then return end
        if R.ai.sessionBroadcast and not registry.applying then R.ai.sessionBroadcast(command) end
    end
    local function button(object,path)
        if not object or not object.Func then return object end
        local name=path.." / "..tostring(object.Text)
        registry.counts[name]=(registry.counts[name] or 0)+1
        local key=name.." #"..registry.counts[name]
        registry.actions[key]=object
        local callback=object.Func
        object.Func=function(...)
            announce({command="action",key=key,build=R.ai.buildId,excludeMaster=true})
            return callback(...)
        end
        if object.AddButton then
            local add=object.AddButton
            object.AddButton=function(self,...)return button(add(self,...),path)end
        end
        return object
    end
    local function group(box,path)
        if not box then return box end
        for _,method in ipairs({"AddToggle","AddSlider","AddDropdown","AddInput"}) do
            local original=box[method]
            if original then box[method]=function(self,id,info,...)
                local object=original(self,id,info,...)
                if object and type(id)=="string" then
                    registry.settings[id]=object
                    local callback=object.Callback
                    object.Callback=function(...)
                        if callback then callback(...) end
                        announce({command="setting",key=id,value=object.Value,excludeMaster=true})
                    end
                end
                return object
            end end
        end
        local add=box.AddButton
        if add then box.AddButton=function(self,...)return button(add(self,...),path)end end
        return box
    end
    local addTab=window.AddTab
    window.AddTab=function(self,info,...)
        local tab=addTab(self,info,...)
        local name=type(info)=="table" and info.Name or info
        if name=="Auto Carry" then return tab end
        for _,method in ipairs({"AddLeftGroupbox","AddRightGroupbox"}) do
            local original=tab[method]
            if original then tab[method]=function(t,title,...)
                return group(original(t,title,...),tostring(name).." / "..tostring(title))
            end end
        end
        for _,method in ipairs({"AddLeftTabbox","AddRightTabbox"}) do
            local original=tab[method]
            if original then tab[method]=function(t,...)
                local tabs=original(t,...);local add=tabs.AddTab
                tabs.AddTab=function(owner,title,...)return group(add(owner,title,...),tostring(name).." / "..tostring(title))end
                return tabs
            end end
        end
        return tab
    end
end
function R.ai.applySessionCommand(command)
    local registry=R.ai.sessionControls
    local function setting(key,value)
        local object=registry.settings[key]
        assert(object and not object.Destroyed and object.SetValue,"Setting unavailable: "..tostring(key))
        local copy=R.ai.configValues.copy(value)
        assert(copy~=nil and type(copy)==type(object.Value),"Setting type changed")
        if object.Type=="Dropdown" and object.Values then
            if type(copy)=="string" then assert(table.find(object.Values,copy),"Dropdown option unavailable")
            elseif type(copy)=="table" then for key,on in pairs(copy) do assert(not on or table.find(object.Values,key),"Dropdown option unavailable")end end
        end
        if type(copy)=="number" then
            if object.Min then copy=math.max(object.Min,copy) end
            if object.Max then copy=math.min(object.Max,copy) end
        end
        object:SetValue(copy)
    end
    registry.applying=true
    local ok,why=pcall(function()
        if command.command=="bot" then setting("Master",command.enabled)
        elseif command.command=="setting" then setting(command.key,command.value)
        elseif command.command=="settings" then
            local failures={}
            for key,value in pairs(command.values)do
                local applied,reason=pcall(setting,key,value)
                if not applied then failures[#failures+1]=tostring(reason)end
            end
            assert(#failures==0,table.concat(failures,"; "))
        elseif command.command=="host" then
            setting("JoinHost",command.value);setting("AutoRequestHost",true)
        elseif command.command=="action" then
            assert(command.build==R.ai.buildId,"Update linked scripts before sending actions")
            local action=registry.actions[command.key]
            assert(action and not action.Destroyed and not action.Disabled and action.Visible~=false,"Action unavailable")
            action.Func()
        end
    end)
    registry.applying=false
    return ok,why
end

local Window = Lib:CreateWindow({
    Title = "Armstrong Armory",
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(880,640),
    Footer = "Dungeon Quest Reborn | V1",
    Icon = "swords",
})

R.ai.wrapSessionWindow(Window)
local MainTab = Window:AddTab("Main", "home")
local DungeonTab = Window:AddTab("Dungeon", "castle")
local CombatTab = Window:AddTab("Combat", "swords")
local MoveTab = Window:AddTab("Movement", "footprints")
local EvadeTab = Window:AddTab("Evasion", "shield")
local MiscTab = Window:AddTab("Misc", "wrench")
local SettingsTab = Window:AddTab({Name="Settings",Icon="settings",Order=10000})
                                                                               
do
    local player=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local replicated=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local group=DungeonTab:AddRightGroupbox("Lobby for your level")
    local label=group:AddLabel("Off. Enable Pick best for level to create a lobby.",true)
    S.AutoLevelLobby=false;S.AutoLaunchLobby=false
    S.LevelLobbyHardcore=false
    local state={stopped=false,preview=false,pending=nil,created=nil,failed=false,cache={},at=0}
    local difficulties={Easy=1,Medium=2,Hard=3,Insane=4,Nightmare=5}
    local excluded={['Egg Island']=true,Krampus=true,['Tutorial Dungeon']=true,Tutorial=true,['Boss Raid']=true,['Wave Defence']=true}
    local function say(text)label:SetText(tostring(text))end
    local function flag(name)
        local v=player:FindFirstChild(name)
        return v and v:IsA("BoolValue") and v.Value
    end
    local function available()
        return not state.stopped and not Lib.Unloaded and game.PlaceId==77649408247578
            and not (R.ai.inventoryTripBlocks and R.ai.inventoryTripBlocks())
            and (not R.ai.sessionCarryActive or R.ai.sessionCarryCanHost and R.ai.sessionCarryCanHost())
            and not S.AutoJoinLobby and not S.AutoRequestHost
            and flag("dataLoaded")==true and flag("teleporting")==false
            and flag("busyTrading")==false and flag("inBlacksmith")==false and flag("inEnchant")==false
    end
    local function allowed()return available() and flag("inGame")==false end
    local function request(name,class)
        local r=replicated:FindFirstChild("remotes")
        r=r and r:FindFirstChild(name)
        assert(r and r:IsA(class),"Lobby remote missing: "..name)
        return r
    end
    local function currentLobby()
        local games=workspace:FindFirstChild("games")
        assert(games and games:FindFirstChild("inLobby") and games:FindFirstChild("inGame"),"Lobby list not loaded")
        for _,name in ipairs({"inLobby","inGame"}) do
            local entries=games[name]:GetChildren()
            assert(#entries<=500,"Lobby list exceeds scan limit")
            for _,entry in ipairs(entries) do
                if entry.Name==player.Name or entry:FindFirstChild(player.Name) then return entry,name end
                local roster=entry:GetAttribute("Roster")
                if type(roster)=="string" and #roster<32768 then
                    local ok,people=pcall(function()return HTTP:JSONDecode(roster)end)
                    if ok and type(people)=="table" then
                        for _,person in ipairs(people) do
                            if type(person)=="table" and person.n==player.Name then return entry,name end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function selection()
        local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
        local level=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Level")
        assert(level,"Player level unavailable")
        local gui=player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        local queue=gui and gui:FindFirstChild("queueGui")
        local choose=queue and queue:FindFirstChild("chooseDungeon")
        local left=choose and choose:FindFirstChild("backgroundFillLeft")
        local list=left and left:FindFirstChild("ScrollingFrame")
        assert(list,"Dungeon menu not loaded")
        local utility=replicated:FindFirstChild("Utility")
        local module=utility and utility:FindFirstChild("MapPlaces")
        assert(module,"Dungeon availability module missing")
        local maps=require(module)
        local names={}
        for _,entry in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
            if entry:IsA("ImageLabel") and entry.Visible and not excluded[entry.Name]
                and maps.IsAvailable(entry.Name) then names[#names+1]=entry.Name end
        end
        assert(#names>0 and #names<=40,"No normal dungeons available")
        table.sort(names)
        local best,nextUnlock
        if os.clock()-state.at>300 then state.cache={};state.at=os.clock() end
        for _,name in ipairs(names) do
            if not available() or not (state.preview or S.AutoLevelLobby) then return nil end
            local data=state.cache[name]
            if not data then
                data=request("getDungeonStats","RemoteFunction"):InvokeServer(name)
                assert(type(data)=="table","Dungeon stats unavailable: "..name)
                state.cache[name]=data
                task.wait(.2)
            end
            for difficulty,rank in pairs(difficulties) do
                if R.ai.dungeonAllowed and not R.ai.dungeonAllowed(name,difficulty) then continue end
                local d=data[difficulty]
                local minimum=type(d)=="table" and tonumber(d.levelReq)
                local cap=R.ai.sessionCarryActive and R.ai.sessionCarryPlan and R.ai.sessionCarryPlan.minLevel or level.Value
                if minimum and minimum>=0 and minimum%1==0 and minimum<=cap then
                    if not best or minimum>best.level or (minimum==best.level and rank>best.rank)
                        or (minimum==best.level and rank==best.rank and name<best.name) then
                        best={name=name,difficulty=difficulty,level=minimum,rank=rank}
                    end
                elseif minimum and minimum>cap and minimum%1==0 then
                    if not nextUnlock or minimum<nextUnlock.level or minimum==nextUnlock.level and rank>nextUnlock.rank
                        or minimum==nextUnlock.level and rank==nextUnlock.rank and name<nextUnlock.name then
                        nextUnlock={name=name,difficulty=difficulty,level=minimum,rank=rank}
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if best and R.ai.sessionCarryActive then R.ai.sessionCarryRoute={current=best,next=nextUnlock or false}end
        return best
    end
    local function apply(pick)
        S.Dungeon=pick.name;S.Difficulty=pick.difficulty;S.LevelReq=pick.level
        S.Hardcore=S.LevelLobbyHardcore==true;S.WaveDefence=false
        local options,toggles=uiTable("Options"),uiTable("Toggles")
        for name,value in pairs({DungeonPick=pick.name,DifficultyPick=pick.difficulty,LevelReq=tostring(pick.level)}) do
            if options and options[name] then pcall(function()options[name]:SetValue(value)end) end
        end
        if toggles and toggles.Hardcore then toggles.Hardcore:SetValue(S.Hardcore)end
        if toggles and toggles.WaveDefence then toggles.WaveDefence:SetValue(false)end
    end
    local function step()
        if state.pending and state.pending.action=="start" and flag("teleporting")==true then
            state.pending=nil;return
        end
        if not available() then return end
        local existing,location=currentLobby()
        if state.pending then
            if state.pending.action=="leave" and not existing then
                state.pending=nil;state.created=nil
            elseif state.pending.action=="create" and existing and existing.Name==player.Name then
                state.created=existing;state.pending=nil
            elseif state.pending.action=="start" and (location=="inGame" or flag("teleporting")) then
                state.pending=nil;return
            elseif os.clock()>state.pending.deadline then
                state.pending=nil;error("Server did not confirm lobby action; paused without retry spam")
            else say("Waiting for lobby action confirmation");return end
        end
        if existing then
            say(existing.Name==player.Name and "Your lobby is ready" or "Already in another lobby; leaving it alone")
            if (R.ai.sessionCarryActive or S.UseDungeonRules) and existing.Name==player.Name and location=="inLobby" then
                local pick=selection()
                if not pick then say("No eligible selected dungeon");return end
                local map=existing:FindFirstChild("mapName");local difficulty=map and map:FindFirstChild("difficulty")
                local minimum=map and map:FindFirstChild("minLevelReq")
                local hardcore=map and map:FindFirstChild("hardcore")
                if map and difficulty and minimum and (map.Value~=pick.name or difficulty.Value~=pick.difficulty or R.ai.sessionCarryActive and minimum.Value>R.ai.sessionCarryPlan.minLevel
                    or hardcore and hardcore.Value~=(S.LevelLobbyHardcore==true))then
                    request("leaveGame","RemoteEvent"):FireServer()
                    state.pending={action="leave",deadline=os.clock()+15};say("Updating selected dungeon");return
                end
            end
            if S.AutoLaunchLobby and existing.Name==player.Name and location=="inLobby" then
                if R.ai.partyReady and not R.ai.partyReady() then say("Waiting for configured party members");return end
                assert(available(),"Lobby state changed")
                request("startDungeon","RemoteEvent"):FireServer()
                state.pending={action="start",deadline=os.clock()+20}
                state.created=nil
            end
            state.preview=false;return
        end
        if not allowed() then say("Waiting for lobby replication");return end
        if not state.preview and not S.AutoLevelLobby then return end
        local pick=selection()
        if not pick then
            if R.ai.sessionCarryActive then R.ai.sessionCarryRoute=nil end
            say(S.UseDungeonRules and "No eligible selected dungeon" or "No eligible normal dungeon for your level");state.preview=false;return
        end
        apply(pick)
        say(pick.name.." / "..pick.difficulty.." (level "..pick.level..")\nHardcore: "..tostring(S.LevelLobbyHardcore))
        if state.preview then state.preview=false;return end
        if not S.AutoLevelLobby or not allowed() then return end
        if currentLobby() then return end
        local ok=request("createLobby","RemoteFunction"):InvokeServer(pick.name,pick.difficulty,pick.level,
            S.LevelLobbyHardcore==true,S.Private==true,false)
        assert(ok==true,"Lobby creation rejected; check requirements, then resume")
        state.pending={action="create",deadline=os.clock()+15}
    end
    group:AddToggle("AutoLevelLobby",{Text="Pick best for level",Default=false,
        Callback=function(v)S.AutoLevelLobby=v end})
    group:AddToggle("Private",{Text="Private",Default=S.Private==true,
        Callback=function(v)S.Private=v end})
    group:AddToggle("LevelLobbyHardcore",{Text="Hardcore",Default=false,
        Callback=function(v)S.LevelLobbyHardcore=v end})
    group:AddToggle("AutoLaunchLobby",{Text="Start the lobby after creating it",Default=false,
        Callback=function(v)S.AutoLaunchLobby=v end})
    group:AddButton({Text="Resume after checking lobby",Func=function()state.failed=false end})
    group:AddLabel("Creates the highest eligible dungeon. Starting it is a separate option.",true)
    R.ai.stopAutoLevelLobby=function()state.stopped=true;S.AutoLevelLobby=false;S.AutoLaunchLobby=false end
    R.ai.resumeCarryLobby=function()if not state.pending then state.failed=false end end
    task.spawn(function()
        while not state.stopped and not Lib.Unloaded do
            task.wait(3)
            if state.stopped or Lib.Unloaded then break end
            if not state.failed and (state.preview or state.pending or S.AutoLevelLobby or S.AutoLaunchLobby) then
                local ok,err=pcall(step)
                if not ok then state.failed=true;say("Paused: "..tostring(err))end
            end
        end
    end)
end

R.ai.upgradeMath=(function()
                                                                           
local M={}
local function number(n)return type(n)=="number" and n==n and n>=0 and n<9e15 end
function M.counts(current,maximum)
    return number(current) and number(maximum) and current%1==0 and maximum%1==0
        and current<=maximum
end
function M.parse(text)
    if type(text)~="string" then return nil end
    text=text:gsub("<[^>]*>",""):gsub("[%s,]","")
    if not text:match("^%d+$") then return nil end
    local n=tonumber(text);return number(n) and n or nil
end
function M.parseUpgrades(text)
    if type(text)~="string" then return nil end
    local a,b=text:gsub("<[^>]*>",""):match("^%s*([%d,%s]+)/([%d,%s]+)%s*$")
    a,b=M.parse(a),M.parse(b)
    if M.counts(a,b) then return a,b end
end
local prefix={[0]=0};local running=100
for n=0,466 do
    prefix[n+1]=prefix[n]+math.floor(math.min(running,100000))
    running=math.min(running*1.06+50,running+220)
end
local function through(n)return n<=467 and prefix[n] or prefix[467]+(n-467)*100000 end
function M.cost(current,count)
    if not number(current) or not number(count) or not M.counts(current,current+count) then return nil end
    return through(current+count)-through(current)
end
function M.potential(power,current,maximum)
    if not number(power) or power<200 or not M.counts(current,maximum) then return nil end
    return power+(maximum-current)*10
end
function M.format(n)
    if not number(n) then return "Unavailable" end
    local result=string.format("%.0f",n):reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)","%1,"):reverse()
    return result:gsub("^,","")
end
function M.preview(raw)
    local current,maximum=M.parseUpgrades(raw.upgrades)
    if not current then return nil end
    local rows={}
    for _,field in ipairs({{"physicalDamage","Physical"},{"spellPower","Spell"},{"health","Health"}}) do
        if raw[field[1]]~=nil then
            local value=M.parse(raw[field[1]])
            if not value then return nil end
            local potential=current==maximum and value or M.potential(value,current,maximum)
            rows[#rows+1]={name=field[2],current=value,potential=potential}
        end
    end
    if #rows<2 then return nil end
    return {current=current,maximum=maximum,cost=M.cost(current,maximum-current),rows=rows}
end
function M.place(x,y,tooltipWidth,tooltipHeight,width,height,screenWidth,screenHeight)
    local right=x+tooltipWidth+8
    local left=x-width-8
    if right+width<=screenWidth-4 then x=right
    elseif left>=4 then x=left
    else x=math.clamp(x,4,math.max(4,screenWidth-width-4));y=y+tooltipHeight+8 end
    return math.clamp(x,4,math.max(4,screenWidth-width-4)),math.clamp(y,4,math.max(4,screenHeight-height-4))
end
return M

end)()
                                                                                 
function R.ai.installPotentialPredictor(box)
    local mathModel=R.ai.upgradeMath
    local player=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local run=game:GetService("RunService")
    local stopped=false;local screen,layer,panel,title,upgrade,gold,foot
    local rows={};local fingerprint;local previewValid=false;local connection
    if S.PotentialPredictor==nil then S.PotentialPredictor=true end
    local function destroy()
        if layer then layer:Destroy() end
        screen=nil;layer=nil;panel=nil;rows={};fingerprint=nil;previewValid=false
    end
    local function text(parent,name,x,y,w,h,size,color)
        local label=Instance.new("TextLabel")
        label.Name=name;label.BackgroundTransparency=1;label.BorderSizePixel=0
        label.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y);label.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h)
        label.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham;label.TextSize=size;label.TextColor3=color
        label.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;label.TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
        label.RichText=false;label.Active=false;label.ZIndex=1002;label.Parent=parent
        return label
    end
    local function create(gui)
        destroy();screen=gui
        layer=Instance.new("Frame");layer.Name="DQRPotentialLayer"
        layer.BackgroundTransparency=1;layer.BorderSizePixel=0;layer.Active=false
        layer.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1);layer.ZIndex=1000;layer.Parent=gui
        panel=Instance.new("Frame");panel.Name="PotentialPredictor";panel.Visible=false
        panel.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(18,19,21);panel.BackgroundTransparency=.12
        panel.BorderSizePixel=0;panel.Active=false;panel.ZIndex=1001;panel.Parent=layer
        local corner=Instance.new("UICorner");corner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,7);corner.Parent=panel
        title=text(panel,"Title",12,5,232,22,13,Color3.fromRGB(255,174,0));title.Text="Potential Predictor"
        upgrade=text(panel,"Upgrades",12,31,232,18,12,Color3.fromRGB(211,211,214))
        for i=1,3 do rows[i]=text(panel,"Stat"..i,12,31+i*21,232,18,12,Color3.fromRGB(235,235,239)) end
        gold=text(panel,"Gold",12,117,232,19,12,Color3.fromRGB(255,201,48))
        foot=text(panel,"Note",12,140,232,18,10,Color3.fromRGB(162,164,170))
        foot.Text="Full upgrades per stat · estimate"
    end
    local visible; visible =                   function(item,gui)
        local depth=0
        while item and item~=gui do
            if item:IsA("GuiObject") and not item.Visible then return false end
            depth+=1;if depth>12 then return false end
            item=item.Parent
        end
        return item==gui and gui.Enabled
    end 
    local readLabel; readLabel =                   function(frame,name)
        local label=frame:FindFirstChild(name)
        return label and label:IsA("TextLabel") and label.Text or nil
    end 
    local update; update =                   function()
        if not S.PotentialPredictor then if panel then panel.Visible=false end;return end
        local pg=player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        local gui=pg and pg:FindFirstChild("inventory")
        if not gui or not gui:IsA("ScreenGui") then if layer then destroy() end;return end
        if screen~=gui or not layer or not layer.Parent then create(gui) end
        local tooltip=gui:FindFirstChild("itemStatFrame")
        if not tooltip or not visible(tooltip,gui) then panel.Visible=false;return end
        local selected
        for _,name in ipairs({"weaponMain","armorMain"}) do
            local candidate=tooltip:FindFirstChild(name)
            if candidate and candidate:IsA("GuiObject") and candidate.Visible then
                if selected then panel.Visible=false;return end
                selected=candidate
            end
        end
        if not selected then panel.Visible=false;return end
        local raw={upgrades=readLabel(selected,"upgrades"),physicalDamage=readLabel(selected,"physicalDamage"),
            spellPower=readLabel(selected,"spellPower"),health=selected.Name=="armorMain" and readLabel(selected,"health") or nil}
        local key=selected.Name.."|"..tostring(readLabel(selected,"name")).."|"..tostring(raw.upgrades).."|"
            ..tostring(raw.physicalDamage).."|"..tostring(raw.spellPower).."|"..tostring(raw.health)
        if fingerprint~=key then
            fingerprint=key;previewValid=false
            local preview=mathModel.preview(raw)
            if not preview then panel.Visible=false;return end
            previewValid=true
            upgrade.Text="Upgrades     "..mathModel.format(preview.current).." → "..mathModel.format(preview.maximum)
            for i=1,3 do
                local value=preview.rows[i];rows[i].Visible=value~=nil
                if value then rows[i].Text=value.name.."     "..mathModel.format(value.current).." → "..mathModel.format(value.potential) end
            end
            local base=52+#preview.rows*21
            gold.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,base);gold.Text="Upgrade cost     "..mathModel.format(preview.cost)
            foot.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,base+24)
            panel.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(256,base+46)
        end
        if not previewValid then panel.Visible=false;return end
        local p=selected.AbsolutePosition-layer.AbsolutePosition
        local x,y=mathModel.place(p.X,p.Y,selected.AbsoluteSize.X,selected.AbsoluteSize.Y,
            panel.Size.X.Offset,panel.Size.Y.Offset,layer.AbsoluteSize.X,layer.AbsoluteSize.Y)
        panel.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y);panel.Visible=true
    end 
    box:AddToggle("PotentialPredictor",{Text="Inventory potential predictor",Default=S.PotentialPredictor,
        Callback=function(value)S.PotentialPredictor=value;if not value and panel then panel.Visible=false end end})
    R.ai.stopPotentialPredictor=function()
        stopped=true;if connection then connection:Disconnect();connection=nil end;destroy()
    end
    connection=run.RenderStepped:Connect(                  function()
        if stopped then return end
        if Lib.Unloaded then R.ai.stopPotentialPredictor();return end
        local ok,err=pcall(update)
        R.ai.potentialPredictorError=not ok and tostring(err) or nil
        if not ok and panel then panel.Visible=false;fingerprint=nil end
    end )
end

do
    local a=R.ai
    local playerDeaths=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
    local function disconnect(record)
        for _,connection in ipairs(record.connections or {}) do connection:Disconnect() end
        record.connections={}
    end
    function a.trackRunEnemy(entry)
        local run=a.learningRun
