        if not run or not run.counters or run.closed or run.folder~=dungeonFolder() then return end
        local model=entry.model
        if run.enemyRecords[model] then return end
        if run.enemyCount>=2000 then run.partial=true;return end
        run.enemyCount+=1
        local h=enemyHum(model)
        local value=not h and (model:FindFirstChild("health") or model:FindFirstChild("Health"))
        local record={connections={},alive=false,counted=false};run.enemyRecords[model]=record
        local function read()
            return h and h.Health or value and value:IsA("ValueBase") and tonumber(value.Value)
        end
        local function retire()
            if run.closed or record.counted or not record.alive then return end
            record.counted=true;run.counters.kills+=1;R.kills+=1
            if a.adaptive then a.adaptive:retireOwner(model)end
            if R.target and R.target.model==model then R.target=nil end
            disconnect(record)
        end
        local function observe()
            if run.closed then return end
            local health=read()
            if health and health>0 then record.alive=true end
            if health and health<=0 then retire()end
        end
        record.connections[#record.connections+1]=model.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
            if model:IsDescendantOf(workspace)or workspace.StreamingEnabled then return end
            task.delay(.35,function()
                if not R.booted or run.closed or a.learningRun~=run or run.folder~=dungeonFolder()
                    or not run.folder or not run.folder:IsDescendantOf(workspace)then return end
                if not model:IsDescendantOf(workspace)then retire()end
            end)
        end)
        record.observe=observe
        observe()
        if h then
            record.connections[#record.connections+1]=h.HealthChanged:Connect(observe)
            record.connections[#record.connections+1]=h.Died:Connect(retire)
        elseif value and value:IsA("ValueBase") then
            record.connections[#record.connections+1]=value.Changed:Connect(observe)
        end
    end
    function a.notePlayerDeath(h)
        if not h or playerDeaths[h] then return end
        playerDeaths[h]=true;R.deaths+=1
        local run=a.learningRun
        if run and not run.closed and run.counters and run.playerHumanoid==h then run.counters.deaths+=1 end
    end
    local begin=a.beginRunLearning
    a.beginRunLearning=function(dungeon,partial)
        local previous=a.learningRun;begin(dungeon,partial)
        local run=a.learningRun
        if not run or run==previous then return end
        run.counters={kills=0,deaths=0};run.enemyRecords={};run.enemyCount=0;run.playerHumanoid=hum()
                                                                             
        a.lifecycleRun={dungeon=dungeon}
        a.lifecycleOutcome()
        for _,entry in ipairs(R.enemies) do a.trackRunEnemy(entry) end
    end
    local finish=a.finishRunLearning
    a.finishRunLearning=function(reason)
        local run=a.learningRun
        if not run or run.closed then return end
        local outcome=run.folder==dungeonFolder() and a.lifecycleOutcome()
            or a.lifecycleRun and a.lifecycleRun.dungeon==run.folder and a.lifecycleRun.outcome
        if not outcome then
            outcome=reason=="finished" and "ended (outcome unconfirmed)" or reason
        end
        if run.playerHumanoid and run.playerHumanoid.Health<=0 then a.notePlayerDeath(run.playerHumanoid) end
        for _,record in pairs(run.enemyRecords or {}) do record.observe() end
        run.closed=true
        for _,record in pairs(run.enemyRecords or {}) do disconnect(record) end
        run.enemyRecords={}
        return finish(outcome)
    end
end

R.ai.itemModel=(function()
local M={}
local definitions={weapon={"weapons",8},chest={"chests",7},helmet={"helmets",8},ability={"abilities",9}}
local finite; finite =                   function(n)return type(n)=="number" and n==n and n>=0 and n<9e15 end 
function M.normalize(inventory)
    assert(type(inventory)=="table","Inventory unavailable")
    local rows,byKey={},{}
    for kind,d in pairs(definitions) do
        local bucket=inventory[d[1]]
        assert(type(bucket)=="table","Unknown inventory category: "..d[1])
        local count=0
        for key,raw in pairs(bucket) do
            count+=1;assert(count<=500,"Inventory category exceeds limit")
            local id=type(key)=="string" and key:sub(d[2])
            assert(id and id:match("^%d+$") and type(raw)=="table","Unknown item identity")
            id=tonumber(id);assert(finite(id) and id%1==0,"Invalid item ID")
            local equipped
            if kind=="ability" then
                assert(type(raw.equipped)=="table","Unknown ability slots")
                equipped=false
                for _,v in pairs(raw.equipped) do if v~=false then equipped=true end end
            else
                assert(type(raw.equipped)=="boolean","Unknown equipped state")
                equipped=raw.equipped
                assert(finite(raw.currentUpgrade) and finite(raw.maxUpgrades) and raw.currentUpgrade%1==0
                    and raw.maxUpgrades%1==0 and raw.currentUpgrade<=raw.maxUpgrades,"Unknown upgrades")
            end
            assert(finite(raw.levelReq),"Unknown required level")
            local row={kind=kind,id=id,key=kind..":"..id,name=tostring(raw.name or key),raw=raw,equipped=equipped,
                level=raw.levelReq,current=raw.currentUpgrade or 0,max=raw.maxUpgrades or 0,
                rarity=type(raw.rarity)=="string" and raw.rarity:lower() or "unknown"}
            assert(not byKey[row.key],"Duplicate item ID");rows[#rows+1]=row;byKey[row.key]=row
        end
    end
    table.sort(rows,function(a,b)return a.key<b.key end)
    return rows,byKey
end
function M.stat(row,build)
    if build=="Spell Power" then return "spellPower" end
    if build=="Health" and row.kind~="weapon" then return "health" end
    return row.kind=="weapon" and "physicalDamage" or "physicalPower"
end
function M.score(row,build,potential,mathModel)
    if row.kind=="ability" then return nil end
    local value=row.raw[M.stat(row,build)]
    if not finite(value) then return nil end
    if potential and row.current<row.max then return mathModel.potential(value,row.current,row.max) end
    return value
end
function M.equipment(rows,settings,level,mathModel)
    local equipped,best={},{}
    for _,row in ipairs(rows) do
        if row.kind=="ability" then continue end
        if row.equipped then assert(not equipped[row.kind],"Multiple equipped items in slot");equipped[row.kind]=row end
        if row.level<=level then
            local build=row.kind=="weapon" and settings.weapon or settings.armor
            local score=M.score(row,build,settings.potential,mathModel)
            local old=best[row.kind]
            if score and (not old or score>old.score or score==old.score and row.equipped) then best[row.kind]={row=row,score=score} end
        end
    end
    local changes={}
    for _,kind in ipairs({"weapon","helmet","chest"}) do
        local candidate=best[kind];local current=equipped[kind]
        local build=kind=="weapon" and settings.weapon or settings.armor
        local baseline=current and M.score(current,build,settings.potential,mathModel) or 0
        if candidate and not candidate.row.equipped and baseline
            and candidate.score>baseline*(1+(settings.better or 0)/100) then
            changes[#changes+1]={row=candidate.row,score=candidate.score,baseline=baseline}
        end
    end
    return changes,equipped
end
function M.held(row,hold)
    for _,field in ipairs({"locked","isLocked","favorite","favourite","isFavorite","protected"}) do
        if row.raw[field] and row.raw[field]~=0 and row.raw[field]~="" then return true end
    end
    for text in tostring(hold or ""):gmatch("[^,\n]+") do
        text=text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):lower()
        if text==row.key:lower() or text==row.name:lower() then return true end
    end
    return false
end
M.rarities={"common","uncommon","rare","epic","legendary","ultimate"}
local ranks={};for i,name in ipairs(M.rarities) do ranks[name]=i end
function M.decisions(rows,s,mathModel)
    local keep={}
    if s.keepBest then
        for _,build in ipairs({"Physical Damage","Spell Power"}) do
            for _,potential in ipairs({false,true}) do
                local best=-1
                for _,r in ipairs(rows) do if r.kind=="weapon" then best=math.max(best,M.score(r,build,potential,mathModel) or -1) end end
                for _,r in ipairs(rows) do if r.kind=="weapon" and M.score(r,build,potential,mathModel)==best then keep[r.key]=true end end
            end
        end
    end
    local decisions={};local equipped={}
    for _,r in ipairs(rows) do if r.equipped and r.kind~="ability" then
        if equipped[r.kind]~=nil then equipped[r.kind]=false else equipped[r.kind]=r end
    end end
    local anyCategory=next(s.categories or {})~=nil
    for _,r in ipairs(rows) do
        local reason
        if r.equipped then reason="equipped"
        elseif M.held(r,s.hold) then reason="hold / locked / favorite"
        elseif keep[r.key] then reason="best weapon protection"
        elseif s.keepUpgraded and r.current>0 then reason="upgraded protection"
        elseif s.keepRarity and (not ranks[r.rarity] or not ranks[s.keepRarityAt] or ranks[r.rarity]>=ranks[s.keepRarityAt]) then reason="rarity protection"
        elseif s.keepLevel and r.level>=(s.keepLevelAt or 1) then reason="level protection"
        elseif anyCategory and not s.categories[r.kind] then reason="category excluded" end
        local rarity=s.rarities and s.rarities[r.rarity]==true
        local level=r.level<(s.below or 0)
        local match=(s.mode=="Rarity" or s.mode=="Selected rarities") and rarity
            or (s.mode=="Level" or s.mode=="Below level") and level
            or (s.mode=="Both" or s.mode=="Rarity and level") and rarity and level
                                                                                
                                                                              
        if not reason and s.onlyBetter then
            local eq=s.compare or {};local current=equipped[r.kind]
            local build=r.kind=="weapon" and eq.weapon or eq.armor
            local score=build and M.score(r,build,eq.potential,mathModel)
            local baseline=current and build and M.score(current,build,eq.potential,mathModel)
            if not score or not baseline then reason="comparison unavailable"
            elseif score>baseline then reason="better than equipped" end
        end
        if not reason and s.bankRare and (r.rarity=="legendary" or r.rarity=="ultimate") then reason="bank protection" end
        decisions[r.key]={sell=not reason and match==true,reason=reason or (match and "matches sell filters" or "outside sell filters")}
    end
    return decisions
end
function M.sales(rows,s,mathModel)
    local selected={};local decisions=M.decisions(rows,s,mathModel)
    for _,r in ipairs(rows) do if decisions[r.key].sell then selected[#selected+1]=r end end
    return selected
end
function M.fingerprint(row)
    local r=row.raw
    return table.concat({row.key,row.name,row.rarity,tostring(row.level),tostring(row.equipped),tostring(row.current),
        tostring(row.max),tostring(r.physicalDamage),tostring(r.physicalPower),tostring(r.spellPower),tostring(r.health)},"|")
end
function M.ruleOptions(s)
    local held={s.ItemHold or ""}
    for label,on in pairs(s.ItemHoldSelection or {}) do
        local key=on and tostring(label):match("^(%a+:%d+)")
        if key then held[#held+1]=key end
    end
    local equip={weapon=s.EquipWeapon or "Spell Power",armor=s.EquipArmor or "Spell Power",potential=s.EquipPotential~=false,better=s.EquipBetter or 0}
    return equip,{mode=s.SellBy or "Selected rarities",below=s.SellBelow or 1,rarities=s.SellRarities or {},categories=s.SellCategories or {},
        hold=table.concat(held,"\n"),keepBest=s.KeepBestWeapon~=false,keepUpgraded=s.KeepUpgraded~=false,
        keepRarity=s.KeepRarity,keepRarityAt=s.KeepRarityAt or "legendary",keepLevel=s.KeepLevel,keepLevelAt=s.KeepLevelAt or 100,
        onlyBetter=s.KeepOnlyBetter,compare=equip,bankRare=s.AutoLobbySell==true}
end
return M

end)()
do (function()
local model=R.ai.itemModel;local mathModel=R.ai.upgradeMath
    local player=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local remotes=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("remotes")
    local tab=Window:AddTab("Items","backpack")
    R.ai.itemsTab=tab
    local sell=tab:AddLeftGroupbox("Auto sell")
    local equip=tab:AddRightGroupbox("Equip best")
    local skills=tab:AddRightGroupbox("Skill points")
    local saleLabel=sell:AddLabel("No sale preview.",true)
    local equipLabel=equip:AddLabel("Inventory not loaded.",true)
    local pointLabel=skills:AddLabel("Reading skill points…",true)
    local state={stopped=false,failed=false,request=nil,preview=nil,pending=nil,rows={},revision=0}
    S.AutoEquipBest=false;S.AutoSellItems=false;S.AutoSpendPoints=false
    S.EquipWeapon=S.EquipWeapon or "Spell Power";S.EquipArmor=S.EquipArmor or "Spell Power"
    if S.EquipPotential==nil then S.EquipPotential=true end
    S.EquipBetter=tonumber(S.EquipBetter) or 0;S.ItemHold=S.ItemHold or ""
    S.ItemHoldSelection=S.ItemHoldSelection or {}
    S.SellBy=({Rarity="Selected rarities",Level="Below level",Both="Rarity and level"})[S.SellBy] or S.SellBy or "Selected rarities";S.SellBelow=tonumber(S.SellBelow) or 1
    S.SellRarities=S.SellRarities or {};S.SellCategories=S.SellCategories or {}
    if S.KeepBestWeapon==nil then S.KeepBestWeapon=true end
    if S.KeepUpgraded==nil then S.KeepUpgraded=true end
    S.KeepRarityAt=S.KeepRarityAt or "legendary";S.KeepLevelAt=tonumber(S.KeepLevelAt) or 100
    S.SpendStat=S.SpendStat or "Spell Power"
    local function val(name)
        local v=player:FindFirstChild(name);return v and v:IsA("ValueBase") and v.Value
    end
    local function allowed()
        return not state.stopped and not Lib.Unloaded and game.PlaceId==77649408247578 and val("dataLoaded")==true
            and val("inGame")==false and val("busyTrading")==false and val("teleporting")==false
            and val("inEnchant")==false and val("inBlacksmith")~=true
    end
    local function remote(name,class)
        local v=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild(name);assert(v and v:IsA(class),"Missing remote: "..name);return v
    end
    local function valueNumber(name)
        local n=val(name);assert(type(n)=="number" and n>=0 and n<1e9,"Unavailable "..name);return n
    end
    local function level()
        local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats");local n=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Level")
        assert(n and type(n.Value)=="number","Level unavailable");return n.Value
    end
    local function options()
        local equip,sell=model.ruleOptions(S)
        sell.bankRare=sell.bankRare or R.ai.inventoryTripBusy==true
        return equip,sell
    end
    R.ai.itemRuleOptions=options
    R.ai.rewardInventory=function()
        assert(not state.stopped and not Lib.Unloaded and val("dataLoaded")==true,"Inventory unavailable")
        local raw=remote("reloadInvy","RemoteFunction"):InvokeServer()
        if R.ai.observeDamageGear then R.ai.observeDamageGear(raw)end
        return model.normalize(raw)
    end
    local function refresh()
        assert(allowed(),"Waiting for idle lobby")
        local raw=remote("reloadInvy","RemoteFunction"):InvokeServer()
        if R.ai.observeDamageGear then R.ai.observeDamageGear(raw)end
        assert(allowed(),"Lobby changed during inventory read")
        local rows,byKey=model.normalize(raw);state.rows=rows
        local labels,seen={},{}
        for _,row in ipairs(rows) do local label=row.key.." | "..row.name;labels[#labels+1]=label;seen[label]=true end
        for label,on in pairs(S.ItemHoldSelection) do if on and not seen[label] then labels[#labels+1]=label end end
        local uiOptions=uiTable("Options")
        if uiOptions and uiOptions.ItemHoldSelection then uiOptions.ItemHoldSelection:SetValues(labels) end
        local eq,sa=options();local changes,current=model.equipment(rows,eq,level(),mathModel)
        local sales=model.sales(rows,sa,mathModel)
        if S.AutoLobbySell or R.ai.inventoryTripBusy then
            local filtered={};for _,row in ipairs(sales)do if row.rarity~="legendary" and row.rarity~="ultimate" then filtered[#filtered+1]=row end end
            sales=filtered
        end
        local lines={}
        for _,kind in ipairs({"weapon","helmet","chest"}) do lines[#lines+1]=kind..": "..(current[kind] and current[kind].name or "none") end
        for _,v in ipairs(changes) do lines[#lines+1]="Next: "..v.row.name.." ("..mathModel.format(v.baseline).." → "..mathModel.format(v.score)..")" end
        equipLabel:SetText(table.concat(lines,"\n"))
        return rows,byKey,changes,sales
    end
    local function invalidate()state.revision+=1;state.preview=nil end
    local function queue(action)
        if state.stopped or state.pending or state.request then return end
        state.request=action;state.failed=false
    end
    local function auto(name,text,group)
        group:AddToggle(name,{Text=text,Default=false,Callback=function(v)S[name]=v end})
    end
    local function choose(group,name,text,values,default,multi)
        group:AddDropdown(name,{Text=text,Values=values,Default=default,Multi=multi or false,
            Callback=function(v)
                local changed=S[name]~=v
                if type(v)=="table" and type(S[name])=="table" then
                    changed=false
                    for key,on in pairs(v) do if (S[name][key]==true)~=(on==true) then changed=true end end
                    for key,on in pairs(S[name]) do if (v[key]==true)~=(on==true) then changed=true end end
                end
                S[name]=v;if changed then invalidate()end
            end})
    end
    choose(equip,"EquipWeapon","Weapon by",{"Physical Damage","Spell Power"},S.EquipWeapon)
    choose(equip,"EquipArmor","Armor by",{"Physical Damage","Spell Power","Health"},S.EquipArmor)
    equip:AddToggle("EquipPotential",{Text="Judge by max upgrades",Default=S.EquipPotential,Callback=function(v)S.EquipPotential=v;invalidate()end})
    equip:AddSlider("EquipBetter",{Text="Only if better by",Default=S.EquipBetter,Min=0,Max=100,Rounding=1,Suffix="%",Callback=function(v)S.EquipBetter=v;invalidate()end})
    auto("AutoEquipBest","Auto equip best",equip)
    equip:AddButton({Text="Equip best now",Func=function()queue("equip")end})
    equip:AddButton({Text="Refresh inventory",Func=function()queue("refresh")end})
    equip:AddButton({Text="Swap ability set",Func=function()queue("swap")end})
    equip:AddLabel("Potential mode may equip gear that needs upgrading first.",true)
    choose(sell,"SellBy","Sell items matching",{"Selected rarities","Below level","Rarity and level"},S.SellBy)
    choose(sell,"SellRarities","Sell rarities",{"common","uncommon","rare","epic","legendary","ultimate"},S.SellRarities,true)
    choose(sell,"SellCategories","Item types (empty = all)",{"weapon","helmet","chest","ability"},S.SellCategories,true)
    sell:AddSlider("SellBelow",{Text="Sell below required level",Default=S.SellBelow,Min=1,Max=500,Rounding=0,Callback=function(v)S.SellBelow=v;invalidate()end})
    local function setSell(key,value)
        local controls=type(value)=="boolean" and uiTable("Toggles") or uiTable("Options")
        if controls and controls[key] then controls[key]:SetValue(value)end
    end
    sell:AddButton({Text="Preset: sell common through epic",Func=function()
        setSell("SellBy","Selected rarities")
        setSell("SellRarities",{common=true,uncommon=true,rare=true,epic=true})
        setSell("KeepRarityAt","legendary");setSell("KeepRarity",true)
    end})
    sell:AddButton({Text="Preset: sell below my level",Func=function()
        setSell("SellBy","Below level");setSell("SellBelow",level())
        setSell("KeepRarityAt","legendary");setSell("KeepRarity",true)
    end})
    sell:AddInput("ItemHold",{Text="Never sell (names or type:id)",Default=S.ItemHold,Finished=true,Callback=function(v)S.ItemHold=tostring(v);invalidate()end})
    choose(sell,"ItemHoldSelection","Hold list",{},S.ItemHoldSelection,true)
    for _,entry in ipairs({{"KeepBestWeapon","Keep best physical / spell weapons"},{"KeepUpgraded","Keep upgraded items"}}) do
        local name=entry[1];sell:AddToggle(name,{Text=entry[2],Default=S[name],Callback=function(v)S[name]=v;invalidate()end})
    end
    for _,entry in ipairs({{"KeepRarity","Keep at or above rarity"},{"KeepLevel","Keep at or above required level"},{"KeepOnlyBetter","Keep gear better than equipped"}}) do
        local name=entry[1];sell:AddToggle(name,{Text=entry[2],Default=S[name]==true,Callback=function(v)S[name]=v;invalidate()end})
    end
    choose(sell,"KeepRarityAt","Minimum rarity to keep",model.rarities,S.KeepRarityAt)
    sell:AddSlider("KeepLevelAt",{Text="Minimum required level to keep",Default=S.KeepLevelAt,Min=1,Max=500,Rounding=0,Callback=function(v)S.KeepLevelAt=v;invalidate()end})
    sell:AddLabel("Keep rules always win. Gear comparison uses your Equip best settings.",true)
    sell:AddButton({Text="Preview sales",Func=function()queue("preview")end})
    sell:AddButton({Text="Sell previewed items",Func=function()queue("sell")end})
    sell:AddButton({Text="Open sell menu",Func=function()
        local pg=player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui");local gui=pg and pg:FindFirstChild("sellShop")
        if gui and gui:IsA("ScreenGui") then gui.Enabled=true end
    end})
    auto("AutoSellItems","Auto sell matching items",sell)
    sell:AddLabel("Sales happen in the lobby. Rarity and level requires both.",true)
    choose(skills,"SpendStat","Spend into",{"Physical Damage","Spell Power","Stamina"},S.SpendStat)
    auto("AutoSpendPoints","Auto spend skill points",skills)
    skills:AddButton({Text="Spend all available points",Func=function()queue("spend")end})
    skills:AddButton({Text="Preview skill reset cost",Func=function()queue("resetPreview")end})
    skills:AddButton({Text="Confirm reset",Func=function()queue("reset")end})
    skills:AddButton({Text="Resume",Func=function()state.failed=false;state.request=nil;state.preview=nil end})
    local function fail(message)
        state.failed=true;state.request=nil;R.ai.itemsPending=state.pending~=nil
        saleLabel:SetText("Paused: "..tostring(message));equipLabel:SetText("Paused: "..tostring(message))
    end
    local function step()
        if not allowed() then
            state.request=nil;state.preview=nil
            if S.AutoSellItems then saleLabel:SetText("Auto sell: waiting for the lobby.")end
            return
        end
        local request=state.request;state.request=nil
        if state.pending then
            local p=state.pending;local confirmed=false
            if p.kind=="spend" then confirmed=valueNumber("skillPoints")==p.points-p.count and valueNumber(p.stat)==p.before+p.count
            elseif p.kind=="reset" then confirmed=valueNumber("physicalPower")+valueNumber("spellPower")+valueNumber("stamina")==0
            else
                local _,byKey=refresh()
                if p.kind=="equip" then confirmed=byKey[p.key] and byKey[p.key].equipped
                else confirmed=true;for key in pairs(p.keys) do if byKey[key] then confirmed=false;break end end end
            end
            if confirmed then state.pending=nil;R.ai.itemsPending=false;saleLabel:SetText("Last action confirmed.")
            elseif os.clock()>p.deadline then error("Action was not confirmed; it will not be repeated automatically") end
            return
        end
        if request=="swap" then remote("swapAbilitySet","RemoteEvent"):FireServer();return end
        if request=="resetPreview" or request=="reset" then
            local spent=valueNumber("physicalPower")+valueNumber("spellPower")+valueNumber("stamina")
            local cost=(val("freeStatResets")==true or val("goldGamepass")==true) and 0 or math.floor(spent^1.75*60)
            if request=="resetPreview" then
                state.reset={spent=spent,cost=cost,untilAt=os.clock()+30}
                pointLabel:SetText("Reset "..spent.." points for "..mathModel.format(cost).." gold. Confirm within 30 seconds.");return
            end
            local p=state.reset;state.reset=nil
            assert(p and os.clock()<p.untilAt and p.spent==spent and p.cost==cost and spent>0,"Refresh reset preview first")
            local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats");local gold=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Gold")
            assert(gold and gold.Value>=cost,"Not enough gold for reset")
            S.AutoSpendPoints=false
            local toggles=uiTable("Toggles");if toggles and toggles.AutoSpendPoints then toggles.AutoSpendPoints:SetValue(false)end
            state.pending={kind="reset",deadline=os.clock()+12};R.ai.itemsPending=true
            remote(val("freeStatResets")==true and "resetPointsWithGamepass" or "resetSkillPoints","RemoteEvent"):FireServer();return
        end
        local points=valueNumber("skillPoints")
        if request=="spend" or not request and S.AutoSpendPoints and points>0 then
            if points<=0 then return end
            local stat=({["Physical Damage"]="physicalPower",["Spell Power"]="spellPower",Stamina="stamina"})[S.SpendStat]
            assert(stat,"Choose a skill stat")
            state.pending={kind="spend",stat=stat,before=valueNumber(stat),points=points,count=points,deadline=os.clock()+12};R.ai.itemsPending=true
            remote("spendSkillPoint","RemoteEvent"):FireServer(stat,points);return
        end
        if not request and not S.AutoEquipBest and not S.AutoSellItems then return end
        local rows,byKey,changes,sales=refresh()
        if request=="preview" then
            local selected={};local lines={"Sell preview: "..#sales.." matching items"}
            for _,row in ipairs(sales) do selected[row.key]=model.fingerprint(row);if #lines<14 then lines[#lines+1]=row.name.." ["..row.key.."]" end end
            if #sales>13 then lines[#lines+1]="…and "..(#sales-13).." more" end
            state.preview={selected=selected,revision=state.revision,untilAt=os.clock()+60}
            saleLabel:SetText(table.concat(lines,"\n"));return
        end
        if request=="equip" or not request and S.AutoEquipBest and #changes>0 then
            local candidate=changes[1];if not candidate then return end
            assert(allowed(),"Equip interrupted")
            state.pending={kind="equip",key=candidate.row.key,deadline=os.clock()+12};R.ai.itemsPending=true
            remote("equipItem","RemoteFunction"):InvokeServer(candidate.row.kind,candidate.row.id);return
        end
        if request=="sell" or not request and S.AutoSellItems then
            local approved
            if request=="sell" then
                local preview=state.preview;state.preview=nil
                assert(preview and preview.revision==state.revision and os.clock()<preview.untilAt,"Refresh sales preview first")
                approved=preview.selected
            end
            local payload={weapon={},chest={},helmet={},ability={}};local keys={};local count=0
            for _,row in ipairs(sales) do
                if not approved or approved[row.key]==model.fingerprint(row) then
                    table.insert(payload[row.kind],row.id);keys[row.key]=true;count+=1
                    if count>=50 then break end
                end
            end
            if count==0 then
                local _,rules=options();local selected=false
                for _,on in pairs(rules.rarities)do if on then selected=true;break end end
                if rules.mode~="Below level" and rules.mode~="Level" and not selected then
                    saleLabel:SetText("Nothing selected. Choose sell rarities or use a preset above.")
                else saleLabel:SetText("No items to sell. Matching items may be protected.")end
                return
            end
            assert(allowed(),"Sale interrupted")
            state.pending={kind="sell",keys=keys,deadline=os.clock()+12};R.ai.itemsPending=true
            remote("sellItemEvent","RemoteEvent"):FireServer(payload)
            saleLabel:SetText("Waiting for confirmation of "..count.." sales.")
        end
    end
    sell:AddButton({Text="Resume auto sell",Func=function()
        if state.pending then saleLabel:SetText("An item action is still waiting for confirmation.");return end
        state.failed=false;state.request=nil;state.preview=nil
    end})
    R.ai.stopItems=function()state.stopped=true;state.request=nil;S.AutoEquipBest=false;S.AutoSellItems=false;S.AutoSpendPoints=false end
    task.spawn(function()
        while not state.stopped and not Lib.Unloaded do
            task.wait(3)
            if state.stopped or Lib.Unloaded then break end
            if not state.reset or os.clock()>state.reset.untilAt then
                pointLabel:SetText("Points: "..tostring(val("skillPoints") or "?").." | physical "..tostring(val("physicalPower") or "?")
                    .." | spell "..tostring(val("spellPower") or "?").." | stamina "..tostring(val("stamina") or "?"))
            end
            if not state.failed and not R.ai.itemActionBusy and not R.ai.upgradePending
                and (state.pending or not R.ai.inventoryTripBusy)
                and (state.pending or state.request or S.AutoEquipBest or S.AutoSellItems or S.AutoSpendPoints) then
                local token={};R.ai.itemActionBusy=token
                local ok,err=pcall(step)
                if R.ai.itemActionBusy==token then R.ai.itemActionBusy=nil end
                if not ok then fail(err) end
            end
        end
    end)
end)() end

R.ai.rewardModel=(function()
local M={}
function M.clean(value)
    return tostring(value or "unknown"):gsub("[%c]"," "):gsub("@","＠"):gsub("[<>`*_~|]",""):sub(1,180)
end
function M.lines(items,rows,decisions,autoSell,all,alerts,rarities)
    local lines,details={},{};local ping=false
    local filtered=false
    for _,on in pairs(rarities or {})do if on==true then filtered=true;break end end
    for _,item in ipairs(items) do
        local matchesRarity=not filtered or rarities[item.rarity]==true
        local selected=alerts and matchesRarity
        if selected then ping=true end
        if matchesRarity and (all or alerts or filtered) then
            local matches={}
            for _,r in ipairs(rows or {}) do
                if r.name==item.name and r.rarity==item.rarity then matches[#matches+1]=r end
            end
            local d=#matches==1 and decisions and decisions[matches[1].key]
                                                                                                
            if not d and #matches>1 and decisions then
                local first=decisions[matches[1].key];local same=first~=nil
                for _,row in ipairs(matches)do
                    local candidate=decisions[row.key]
                    if not candidate or not first or candidate.sell~=first.sell or candidate.reason~=first.reason then same=false;break end
                end
                if same then d=first end
            end
            local status="sale status unavailable (inventory match not unique or not read)"
            if d then
                status=d.sell and (autoSell and "SELL eligible (next idle-lobby pass)" or "SELL eligible; auto-sell OFF") or "KEEP: "..d.reason
            end
            lines[#lines+1]=M.clean(item.name).." ["..M.clean(item.rarity).."] — "..status
            details[#details+1]={item=item,row=#matches==1 and matches[1] or nil,status=status,ping=selected}
        end
    end
    return lines,ping,details
end
function M.preferences(settings)
    local out={}
    for _,key in ipairs({"WebhookEnabled","WebhookEveryone","WebhookRunSummary","WebhookListItems","WebhookSeparateDrops","WebhookRarityAlerts"})do out[key]=settings[key]==true end
    local url=type(settings.WebhookURL)=="string" and settings.WebhookURL:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
    if #url>300 or not url:match("^https://discord%.com/api/webhooks/%d+/[%w_%-]+$") then url="";out.WebhookEnabled=false end
    out.WebhookURL=url
    local user=type(settings.WebhookUser)=="string" and settings.WebhookUser or ""
    out.WebhookUser=#user>=15 and #user<=22 and user:match("^%d+$") and user or ""
    out.WebhookRarities={}
    for _,name in ipairs({"common","uncommon","rare","epic","legendary","ultimate"})do
        if settings.WebhookRarities and settings.WebhookRarities[name]==true then out.WebhookRarities[name]=true end
    end
    return out
end
function M.pages(title,lines)
    local pages={};local page="DQR — "..M.clean(title)
    for _,line in ipairs(lines) do
        if #page+#line+1>1750 then pages[#pages+1]=page;page="DQR — continued" end
        page..="\n"..line
    end
    pages[#pages+1]=page;return pages
end
                                                     
M.colors={common=0x989898,uncommon=0x5BC250,rare=0x4B4DC3,epic=0x92469F,legendary=0xF49A09,ultimate=0xFF0000,dev=0}
function M.embeds(title,lines)
    local result={};local description=""
    for _,line in ipairs(lines) do
        if #description+#line+1>3500 then
            result[#result+1]={title=M.clean(title),description=description,color=0x9296EC,footer={text="Armstrong Armory"}}
            description=""
        end
        description..=(description=="" and "" or "\n")..line
    end
    if description~="" or #result==0 then
        result[#result+1]={title=M.clean(title),description=description,color=0x9296EC,footer={text="Armstrong Armory"}}
    end
    return result
end
function M.runEmbed(report)
    local outcome=tostring(report.outcome or "unknown")
    local won=outcome=="won" or outcome=="completed" or outcome=="victory"
    local seconds=math.max(0,math.floor(tonumber(report.seconds) or 0))
    return {title=won and "Completed" or M.clean(outcome):gsub("^%l",string.upper),
        description=M.clean(report.dungeon).." · "..M.clean(report.difficulty or ""),
        color=won and 0x5BC250 or (outcome=="timed out" and 0xF49A09 or 0xD75B63),
        fields={{name="Run",value=string.format("Duration: %d:%02d\nEnemies defeated: %d\nYour deaths: %d",seconds//60,seconds%60,report.kills or 0,report.deaths or 0)}},
        footer={text=report.partial and "Armstrong Armory · Partial run coverage" or "Armstrong Armory"}}
end
function M.itemEmbed(detail,context,image)
    local item,row=detail.item,detail.row
    local embed={title=M.clean(item.name),description=M.clean(item.rarity)..(row and " · Level "..tostring(row.level) or ""),
        color=M.colors[item.rarity] or 0x989898,fields={},footer={text="Armstrong Armory · "..M.clean(context)}}
    if row then
        local stats={}
        for _,pair in ipairs({{"physicalDamage","Physical"},{"physicalPower","Physical"},{"spellPower","Spell"},{"health","Health"}}) do
            local v=row.raw[pair[1]]
            if type(v)=="number" and v==v and v>=0 and v<9e15 then stats[#stats+1]=pair[2]..": "..tostring(v) end
        end
        if #stats>0 then embed.fields[#embed.fields+1]={name="Stats",value=table.concat(stats," · ")} end
        if row.kind~="ability" then embed.fields[#embed.fields+1]={name="Upgrades",value=tostring(row.current).." / "..tostring(row.max),inline=true} end
    end
    embed.fields[#embed.fields+1]={name="Keep / sell",value=M.clean(detail.status)}
    if image then embed.thumbnail={url=image} end
    return embed
end
function M.assetId(value)
    local text=tostring(value or "")
    local id=text:match("^rbxassetid://(%d+)$") or text:match("^%d+$")
        or text:match("^https?://www%.roblox%.com/asset/%?id=(%d+)$")
        or text:match("^https?://www%.roblox%.com/asset%?id=(%d+)$")
    if id and #id<=20 and tonumber(id)>0 then return id end
end
return M

end)()
do
    local players=game:GetService("Players");local player=players.LocalPlayer
    local tab=Window:AddTab("Joiner","users")
    local search=tab:AddLeftGroupbox("Join another lobby")
    local hoster=tab:AddLeftGroupbox("Party host")
    local joiner=tab:AddRightGroupbox("Follow a host")
    local status=search:AddLabel("Lobby list not loaded.",true)
    local partyStatus=hoster:AddLabel("No party selected.",true)
    local requestStatus=joiner:AddLabel("Idle",true)
    S.AutoJoinLobby=false;S.AutoRequestHost=false;S.WaitForParty=false;S.LeaveWithoutHost=false
    S.JoinMaps=S.JoinMaps or "";S.JoinDifficulties=S.JoinDifficulties or "";S.PartyNames=S.PartyNames or ""
    S.JoinHost=S.JoinHost or "";S.LeaveHostAfter=tonumber(S.LeaveHostAfter) or 30
    local state={stopped=false,action=nil,at=0,whitelisted={},missing=nil}
    local function val(parent,name)
        local v=parent and parent:FindFirstChild(name);return v and v:IsA("ValueBase") and v.Value
    end
    local function allowed()
        return not state.stopped and not Lib.Unloaded and game.PlaceId==77649408247578 and val(player,"dataLoaded")==true
            and not (R.ai.inventoryTripBlocks and R.ai.inventoryTripBlocks())
            and val(player,"busyTrading")==false and val(player,"teleporting")==false
    end
    local function rpc(name,invokeCall,...)
        assert(allowed(),"Waiting for idle lobby")
        assert(val(player,"inGame")==false or name=="sendJoinRequest" or name=="addPlayerToWhitelist" or name=="leaveGame","Already in a lobby")
        local r=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("remotes");r=r and r:FindFirstChild(name)
        assert(r and r:IsA(invokeCall and "RemoteFunction" or "RemoteEvent"),"Missing lobby remote: "..name)
        if invokeCall then return r:InvokeServer(...) end
        r:FireServer(...)
    end
    local function names(text)
        local result={}
        for name in tostring(text):gmatch("[^,\n]+") do
            name=name:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
            if name~="" then result[#result+1]=name end
            if #result>=20 then break end
        end
        return result
    end
    local function includes(text,value)
        local list=names(text);if #list==0 then return true end
        for _,name in ipairs(list) do if name:lower()==tostring(value):lower() then return true end end
        return false
    end
    local function lobbies()
        local games=workspace:FindFirstChild("games");local folder=games and games:FindFirstChild("inLobby")
        return folder and folder:GetChildren() or {}
    end
    local function roster(lobby)
        local people={[lobby.Name]=true}
        for _,v in ipairs(lobby:GetChildren()) do if v:IsA("StringValue") and v.Name~="mapName" then people[v.Name]=true end end
        local encoded=lobby:GetAttribute("Roster")
        if type(encoded)=="string" and #encoded<32768 then
            local ok,rows=pcall(function()return HTTP:JSONDecode(encoded)end)
            if ok and type(rows)=="table" then for _,p in ipairs(rows) do if type(p)=="table" and type(p.n)=="string" then people[p.n]=true end end end
        end
        return people
    end
    local function current()
        for i,lobby in ipairs(lobbies()) do if i>500 then break end;if roster(lobby)[player.Name] then return lobby end end
    end
    R.ai.partyReady=function()
        if not S.WaitForParty then return true end
        local wanted=names(S.PartyNames);local lobby=current()
        if #wanted==0 or not lobby or lobby.Name~=player.Name then partyStatus:SetText("Waiting: configure names and create your lobby.");return false end
        local people=roster(lobby);local missing={}
        for _,name in ipairs(wanted) do if not people[name] then missing[#missing+1]=name end end
        partyStatus:SetText(#missing==0 and "Party ready." or "Waiting for: "..table.concat(missing,", "))
        return #missing==0
    end
    local originalStart=startRun
    startRun=function()if not R.ai.partyReady() then return false end;return originalStart()end
    local originalMake=makeLobby
    makeLobby=function()if S.AutoJoinLobby or S.AutoRequestHost then return false end;return originalMake()end
    local function disable(name)
        S[name]=false;local t=uiTable("Toggles");if t and t[name] then t[name]:SetValue(false)end
    end
    local function joining(v)
        if v then disable("AutoLobby");disable("AutoLevelLobby");disable("AutoLaunchLobby") end
    end
    search:AddInput("JoinMaps",{Text="Dungeons (comma separated; empty = any)",Default=S.JoinMaps,Finished=true,Callback=function(v)S.JoinMaps=v end})
    search:AddInput("JoinDifficulties",{Text="Difficulties (empty = any)",Default=S.JoinDifficulties,Finished=true,Callback=function(v)S.JoinDifficulties=v end})
    search:AddToggle("JoinHardcoreOnly",{Text="Hardcore only",Default=false,Callback=function(v)S.JoinHardcoreOnly=v end})
    search:AddToggle("AutoJoinLobby",{Text="Auto join best eligible lobby",Default=false,Callback=function(v)S.AutoJoinLobby=v;joining(v)end})
    search:AddButton({Text="Join best now",Func=function()state.action="join"end})
    search:AddButton({Text="Refresh lobby list",Func=function()state.action="refresh"end})
    search:AddButton({Text="Leave current lobby",Func=function()state.action="leave"end})
    hoster:AddInput("PartyNames",{Text="Party usernames (comma separated)",Default=S.PartyNames,Finished=true,Callback=function(v)S.PartyNames=v end})
    hoster:AddToggle("WaitForParty",{Text="Allow listed players and wait for them",Default=false,Callback=function(v)S.WaitForParty=v end})
    hoster:AddLabel("Waits for all listed players before starting.",true)
    joiner:AddInput("JoinHost",{Text="Host username",Default=S.JoinHost,Finished=true,Callback=function(v)S.JoinHost=tostring(v):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$");state.missing=nil end})
    joiner:AddButton({Text="Send join request",Func=function()state.action="request"end})
    joiner:AddToggle("AutoRequestHost",{Text="Auto request / join this host",Default=false,Callback=function(v)S.AutoRequestHost=v;joining(v)end})
    joiner:AddToggle("LeaveWithoutHost",{Text="Return to lobby if host leaves",Default=false,Callback=function(v)S.LeaveWithoutHost=v;state.missing=nil end})
    joiner:AddSlider("LeaveHostAfter",{Text="Host absence delay",Default=S.LeaveHostAfter,Min=10,Max=120,Rounding=0,Suffix="s",Callback=function(v)S.LeaveHostAfter=v end})
    local rank={Easy=1,Medium=2,Hard=3,Insane=4,Nightmare=5}
    local function candidates()
        local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats");local level=val(stats,"Level") or 0
        local result={}
        for i,lobby in ipairs(lobbies()) do
            if i>500 then break end
            local map=lobby:FindFirstChild("mapName");local minimum=val(map,"minLevelReq")
            local name=val(lobby,"mapName");local difficulty=val(map,"difficulty");local private=map and map:FindFirstChild("private")
            if R.ai.dungeonAllowed and not R.ai.dungeonAllowed(name,difficulty) then continue end
            if type(minimum)~="number" or minimum>level or not players:FindFirstChild(lobby.Name) or lobby.Name==player.Name then continue end
            if not private or private.Value~=false and not private:FindFirstChild(player.Name) then continue end
            if not includes(S.JoinMaps,name) or not includes(S.JoinDifficulties,difficulty) or S.JoinHardcoreOnly and val(map,"hardcore")~=true then continue end
            result[#result+1]={lobby=lobby,name=name,difficulty=difficulty,minimum=minimum}
        end
        table.sort(result,function(a,b)
            if a.minimum~=b.minimum then return a.minimum>b.minimum end
            if rank[a.difficulty]~=rank[b.difficulty] then return (rank[a.difficulty] or 0)>(rank[b.difficulty] or 0) end
            return a.lobby.Name<b.lobby.Name
        end)
        return result
    end
    local function step()
        if not allowed() then state.action=nil;return end
        local action=state.action;state.action=nil
        local own=current()
        local requestHost=action=="request" or not action and S.AutoRequestHost
        if action=="leave" then rpc("leaveGame",false);state.at=os.clock()+15;return end
        if own and not (requestHost and own.Name~=S.JoinHost) then
            if S.WaitForParty and own.Name==player.Name then
                local map=own:FindFirstChild("mapName");local whitelist=map and map:FindFirstChild("private")
                if state.whitelistLobby~=own then state.whitelistLobby=own;state.whitelisted={}end
                for _,name in ipairs(names(S.PartyNames)) do
                    if name~=player.Name and players:FindFirstChild(name) and whitelist and not whitelist:FindFirstChild(name)
                        and os.clock()>=(state.whitelisted[name] or 0) then
                        state.whitelisted[name]=os.clock()+10;rpc("addPlayerToWhitelist",false,name)
                    end
                end
                R.ai.partyReady()
            end
            status:SetText("In "..own.Name.."'s lobby.");return
        end
        if val(player,"inGame")~=false and not requestHost then status:SetText("Waiting for lobby membership");return end
        if action=="request" or not action and S.AutoRequestHost and os.clock()>=state.at then
            local host=S.JoinHost;assert(host:match("^[%w_]+$") and #host>=3 and #host<=20,"Enter the host's username")
            state.at=os.clock()+(R.ai.sessionCarryActive and 3 or 30)
            for _,candidate in ipairs(candidates()) do if val(player,"inGame")==false and candidate.lobby.Name==host then
                local ok,why=rpc("joinDungeon",true,host);requestStatus:SetText(ok==false and tostring(why or "Join rejected") or "Waiting to join "..host);return
            end end
            local force=R.ai.sessionCarryActive and state.forceHost==host and os.clock()<(state.forceUntil or 0)
            local ok,message,canForce=rpc("sendJoinRequest",true,host,force==true)
            if R.ai.sessionCarryActive and ok and canForce==true and not force then state.forceHost=host;state.forceUntil=os.clock()+8
            else state.forceHost=nil;state.forceUntil=nil end
            requestStatus:SetText(ok and "Request sent to "..host or tostring(message or "Request rejected"));return
        end
        local list=candidates();local lines={#list.." eligible open lobbies"}
        for i=1,math.min(5,#list) do local c=list[i];lines[#lines+1]=c.lobby.Name..": "..tostring(c.name).." / "..tostring(c.difficulty) end
        status:SetText(table.concat(lines,"\n"))
        if #list>0 and (action=="join" or S.AutoJoinLobby and os.clock()>=state.at) then
            state.at=os.clock()+15;rpc("joinDungeon",true,list[1].lobby.Name)
        end
    end
    R.ai.stopParty=function()state.stopped=true;S.AutoJoinLobby=false;S.AutoRequestHost=false;S.WaitForParty=false;S.LeaveWithoutHost=false end
    task.spawn(function()
        while not state.stopped and not Lib.Unloaded do
            task.wait(3);if state.stopped or Lib.Unloaded then break end
            if S.LeaveWithoutHost and inDungeon() and S.JoinHost~="" then
                if players:FindFirstChild(S.JoinHost) then state.missing=nil
                else
                    state.missing=state.missing or os.clock()
                    if os.clock()-state.missing>=S.LeaveHostAfter then S.LeaveWithoutHost=false;toLobby() end
                end
            else state.missing=nil end
            if state.action or S.AutoJoinLobby or S.AutoRequestHost or S.WaitForParty then
                local ok,err=pcall(step);if not ok then status:SetText(tostring(err));state.at=os.clock()+30 end
            end
        end
    end)
end

do
    local player=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local runService=game:GetService("RunService");local lighting=game:GetService("Lighting")
    local character=Window:AddTab("Character","user")
    local motion=character:AddLeftGroupbox("Movement")
    local stats=MiscTab:AddLeftGroupbox("Stats")
    local info=stats:AddLabel("Loading stats…",true)
    local performance=MiscTab:AddRightGroupbox("Performance")

    local priority=Window:AddTab("Priority","list-ordered"):AddLeftGroupbox("Activity order")
    priority:AddLabel("1. Dodge\n2. Combat\n3. Lobby / party\n4. Items",true)
    local state={stopped=false,humanoid=nil,originalSpeed=nil,lastSet=nil,shadow=lighting.GlobalShadows,at=0,reporting=false,reportAt=0}
    S.SpeedOverride=false;S.RenderDisabled=false;S.PerformanceMode=false;S.WebhookEnabled=false;S.StallBeforeBoss=false
    S.SpeedValue=math.clamp(tonumber(S.SpeedValue) or 20,1,20);S.StallUntil=tonumber(S.StallUntil) or 120
    S.WebhookURL=S.WebhookURL or "";S.WebhookUser=S.WebhookUser or ""
    local function restoreSpeed()
        if state.humanoid and state.humanoid.Parent and state.originalSpeed and state.humanoid.WalkSpeed==state.lastSet then
            state.humanoid.WalkSpeed=state.originalSpeed
        end
        state.humanoid=nil;state.originalSpeed=nil;state.lastSet=nil
    end
    local function restoreName()
        if state.nameHum and state.nameHum.Parent and state.nameDisplay and state.nameHum.DisplayDistanceType==Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None then
            state.nameHum.DisplayDistanceType=state.nameDisplay
        end
        state.nameHum=nil;state.nameDisplay=nil
    end
    S.HideNameplate=false
    stats:AddToggle("HideNameplate",{Text="Hide own nameplate",Default=false,Callback=function(v)S.HideNameplate=v;if not v then restoreName()end end})
    motion:AddToggle("SpeedOverride",{Text="Hold walk speed",Default=false,Callback=function(v)S.SpeedOverride=v;if not v then restoreSpeed() end end})
    motion:AddSlider("SpeedValue",{Text="Walk speed",Default=S.SpeedValue,Min=1,Max=20,Rounding=0,Callback=function(v)S.SpeedValue=v end})
    local stall=DungeonTab:AddRightGroupbox("Boss delay")
    stall:AddToggle("StallBeforeBoss",{Text="Delay boss fight",Default=false,Callback=function(v)S.StallBeforeBoss=v end})
    stall:AddSlider("StallUntil",{Text="Engage after run time",Default=S.StallUntil,Min=0,Max=600,Rounding=0,Suffix="s",Callback=function(v)S.StallUntil=v end})
    stall:AddLabel("Timer starts with the run. Unavailable when joining mid-run.",true)
    R.ai.stallBossActive=function()
        local current=R.ai.learningRun
        return S.StallBeforeBoss and current and not current.partial and os.clock()-current.clock<S.StallUntil
    end
    performance:AddToggle("PerformanceMode",{Text="Reduce lighting cost",Default=false,Callback=function(v)
        S.PerformanceMode=v;if v then lighting.GlobalShadows=false else lighting.GlobalShadows=state.shadow end
    end})
    performance:AddToggle("RenderDisabled",{Text="Disable 3D rendering",Default=false,Callback=function(v)
        if S.RenderDisabled~=v then S.RenderDisabled=v;runService:Set3dRenderingEnabled(not v) end
    end})

    local function value(parent,name)
        local v=parent and parent:FindFirstChild(name);return v and v:IsA("ValueBase") and v.Value or "?"
    end
    local heartbeat
    R.ai.stopUtilities=function()
        if R.ai.stopRewardReports then R.ai.stopRewardReports() end
        state.stopped=true;restoreSpeed();restoreName();if S.PerformanceMode then lighting.GlobalShadows=state.shadow end
        if S.RenderDisabled then runService:Set3dRenderingEnabled(true) end
        S.RenderDisabled=false;S.SpeedOverride=false;S.WebhookEnabled=false
        if heartbeat then heartbeat:Disconnect();heartbeat=nil end
    end
    heartbeat=runService.Heartbeat:Connect(                  function()
        if state.stopped then return end
        if Lib.Unloaded then R.ai.stopUtilities();return end
        if S.HideNameplate then
            local h=hum()
            if h~=state.nameHum then restoreName();state.nameHum=h;state.nameDisplay=h and h.DisplayDistanceType end
            if h and h.DisplayDistanceType~=Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None then h.DisplayDistanceType=Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None end
        end
        if S.SpeedOverride then
            local h=hum()
            if h~=state.humanoid then restoreSpeed();state.humanoid=h;state.originalSpeed=h and h.WalkSpeed end
            if h and h.Health>0 then state.lastSet=S.SpeedValue;if h.WalkSpeed~=S.SpeedValue then h.WalkSpeed=S.SpeedValue end end
        end
        if os.clock()<state.at then return end;state.at=os.clock()+1
        local ls=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats");local current=R.ai.learningRun
        info:SetText("Level "..tostring(value(ls,"Level")).." | gold "..tostring(value(ls,"Gold")).." | gems "..tostring(value(ls,"Gems"))
            .."\nPoints "..tostring(value(player,"skillPoints")).." | physical "..tostring(value(player,"physicalPower"))
            .." | spell "..tostring(value(player,"spellPower")).." | stamina "..tostring(value(player,"stamina"))
            .."\n"..tostring(wsVal("dungeonName","Lobby")).." | "..tostring(wsVal("dungeonProgress",""))
            .."\n"..(current and string.format("Observed run: %.0fs | ",os.clock()-current.clock) or "")..tostring(R.status or "Idle"))
    end )
end

do
    local player=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local replicated=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local tab=Window:AddTab("Upgrades","hammer")
    local box=tab:AddLeftGroupbox("Upgrade better replacements")
    local label=tab:AddRightGroupbox("Comparison"):AddLabel("Visit the blacksmith to compare gear.",true)
    S.AutoUpgrade=false
    S.UpgradeBuild=S.UpgradeBuild or "Physical"
    S.UpgradeReserve=tonumber(S.UpgradeReserve) or 100000
    S.UpgradeKeep=S.UpgradeKeep or ""
    local state={pending=nil,failed=false,stopped=false,preview=false,verified={},target=nil}
    local buckets={weapon="weapons",chest="chests",helmet="helmets"}
    local function say(text) label:SetText(tostring(text)) end
    local function flag(name)
        local item=player:FindFirstChild(name)
        return item and item:IsA("BoolValue") and item.Value
    end
    local function lobby()
        return game.PlaceId==77649408247578 and flag("dataLoaded")==true and flag("inGame")==false
            and flag("busyTrading")==false and flag("teleporting")==false and flag("inEnchant")==false
    end
    local function remote(name,class)
        local folder=replicated:FindFirstChild("remotes")
        local value=folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
        assert(value and value:IsA(class),"Missing inventory remote: "..name)
        return value
    end
    local finite; finite =                   function(n) return type(n)=="number" and n==n and n>=0 and n<math.huge end 
    local function statName(kind)
        if S.UpgradeBuild=="Magic" then return "spellPower","spell" end
        if S.UpgradeBuild=="Health" and kind~="weapon" then return "health","health" end
        return kind=="weapon" and "physicalDamage" or "physicalPower","physical"
    end
    local function snapshot()
        assert(lobby(),"Waiting for idle lobby")
        local inventory=remote("reloadInvy","RemoteFunction"):InvokeServer()
        if R.ai.observeDamageGear then R.ai.observeDamageGear(inventory)end
        assert(lobby() and type(inventory)=="table","Inventory unavailable or lobby changed")
        local rows,byId={},{}
        for kind,bucket in pairs(buckets) do
            assert(type(inventory[bucket])=="table","Unknown inventory category")
            local count=0
            for key,item in pairs(inventory[bucket]) do
                count+=1
                assert(count<=500,"Inventory exceeds scan limit")
                if count%50==0 then task.wait() end
                                                                                        
                local id=type(key)=="string" and tonumber(key:sub(kind=="chest" and 7 or 8))
                local stat,attribute=statName(kind)
                assert(id and id>=0 and id%1==0 and type(item)=="table" and type(item.equipped)=="boolean"
                    and finite(item[stat]) and finite(item.levelReq) and finite(item.currentUpgrade) and finite(item.maxUpgrades)
                    and item.currentUpgrade%1==0 and item.maxUpgrades%1==0
                    and item.currentUpgrade<=item.maxUpgrades,"Unknown item schema; upgrades paused")
                local row={kind=kind,id=id,key=kind..":"..id,name=tostring(item.name or key),raw=item,
                    equipped=item.equipped,current=item.currentUpgrade,max=item.maxUpgrades,
                    level=item.levelReq,power=item[stat],stat=stat,attribute=attribute}
                assert(not byId[row.key],"Duplicate item ID")
                rows[#rows+1]=row;byId[row.key]=row
            end
        end
        return rows,byId
    end
    local function balances()
        local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
        local gold=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Gold")
        local level=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Level")
        assert(gold and level and finite(gold.Value) and finite(level.Value),"Gold/level unavailable")
        return gold.Value,level.Value
    end
    local cost=R.ai.upgradeMath.cost
    local function potential(item)
        return R.ai.upgradeMath.potential(item.power,item.current,item.max)
    end
    local function protected(item)
        for _,field in ipairs({"locked","isLocked","favorite","favourite","isFavorite","protected"}) do
            if item.raw[field] and item.raw[field]~=0 and item.raw[field]~="" then return true end
        end
        for entry in tostring(S.UpgradeKeep):gmatch("[^,\n]+") do
            entry=entry:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):lower()
            if entry==item.key:lower() or entry==item.name:lower() then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function compare(item,equipped,budget,level,readyPower)
        if item.equipped or protected(item) or item.level>level or item.current>=item.max or not equipped then return nil end
        local projected,baseline=potential(item),potential(equipped)
        if baseline then baseline=math.max(baseline,readyPower or 0) end
        if not projected or not baseline or projected<=baseline then return nil end
        local needed=math.max(0,math.floor((baseline-item.power)/10)+1)
        if needed>item.max-item.current then return nil end
        local requiredCost=cost(item.current,math.max(1,needed))
        if requiredCost>=budget then return nil end
        return {item=item,baseline=baseline,projected=projected,needed=needed,
            requiredCost=requiredCost,fullCost=cost(item.current,item.max-item.current)}
    end
    local function step()
        if not lobby() then say("Waiting for idle lobby; no combat or trading actions");return end
        if not state.pending and not flag("inBlacksmith") and not state.preview then
            say("Open the blacksmith to upgrade stronger replacement gear");return
        end
        local rows,byId=snapshot()
        local gold,level=balances()
        if state.pending then
            local p=state.pending
            local item=byId[p.key]
            assert(item,"Upgrade item missing; check inventory")
            if item.current>p.before then
                state.pending=nil
                local delta=item.current-p.before
                assert(delta==p.count and item.raw[p.stat]==p.power+delta*10,
                    "Observed stat growth differs from the calculator. Paused; no further gold spent")
                assert(gold==p.gold-p.cost,
                    "Gold changed by an unexpected amount. Check costs or other purchases before resuming")
                state.verified[p.key..":"..p.stat]=true
            elseif os.clock()>p.deadline then
                state.pending=nil
                error("Server did not confirm upgrade; paused instead of repeating the request")
            else say("Waiting for upgrade confirmation");return end
        end
        if state.failed or state.stopped then return end
        local equipped,readyPower={},{}
        for _,item in ipairs(rows) do
            if item.level<=level then readyPower[item.kind]=math.max(readyPower[item.kind] or 0,item.power) end
            if item.equipped then
                assert(not equipped[item.kind],"Multiple equipped items in one slot; check inventory")
                equipped[item.kind]=item
            end
        end
        local reserve=math.max(0,tonumber(S.UpgradeReserve) or 100000)
        local budget=gold-reserve
        local candidates={}
        for _,item in ipairs(rows) do
            local candidate=compare(item,equipped[item.kind],budget,level,readyPower[item.kind])
            if candidate then candidates[#candidates+1]=candidate end
        end
        table.sort(candidates,function(a,b)
            local ar=(a.projected-a.baseline)/math.max(1,a.baseline)
            local br=(b.projected-b.baseline)/math.max(1,b.baseline)
            if ar~=br then return ar>br end
            if a.requiredCost~=b.requiredCost then return a.requiredCost<b.requiredCost end
            return a.item.key<b.item.key
        end)
        local selected=candidates[1]
        if state.target then
            for _,candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
                if candidate.item.key==state.target then selected=candidate;break end
            end
        end
        if not selected then
            state.target=nil
            say("No affordable replacement beats your equipped gear's full potential. Low-stat items under 200 are skipped.")
            state.preview=false;return
        end
        local item=selected.item
        say(item.name.." ["..item.key.."]\nCurrent: "..item.power.." | potential: "..selected.projected
            .."\nEquipped potential: "..selected.baseline.." | gain: "..(selected.projected-selected.baseline)
            .."\nGold to beat it: "..selected.requiredCost.." | gold to max: "..selected.fullCost)
        if state.preview then state.preview=false;return end
        if not S.AutoUpgrade or state.stopped or not flag("inBlacksmith") then return end
        local count=1
        if state.verified[item.key..":"..item.stat] and item.max-item.current>=10 and cost(item.current,10)<budget then count=10 end
        assert(lobby() and flag("inBlacksmith") and S.AutoUpgrade,"Upgrade interrupted")
        remote("upgradeItem","RemoteEvent"):FireServer(item.kind,item.id,item.attribute,count,count==10 and "10x" or nil)
        state.target=item.key
        state.pending={key=item.key,before=item.current,power=item.power,stat=item.stat,count=count,
            gold=gold,cost=cost(item.current,count),deadline=os.clock()+12}
    end
    box:AddDropdown("UpgradeBuild",{Text="Build",Values={"Physical","Magic","Health"},Default=S.UpgradeBuild,
        Callback=function(value)S.UpgradeBuild=value;state.target=nil end})
    box:AddInput("UpgradeReserve",{Text="Gold to keep",Default=tostring(S.UpgradeReserve),Numeric=true,Finished=true,
        Callback=function(value)S.UpgradeReserve=math.max(0,tonumber(value) or 100000) end})
    box:AddInput("UpgradeKeep",{Text="Do not upgrade (names or type:id, comma separated)",Default=S.UpgradeKeep,Finished=true,
        Callback=function(value)S.UpgradeKeep=tostring(value) end})
    box:AddToggle("AutoUpgrade",{Text="Auto upgrade better replacements",Default=false,
        Callback=function(value)S.AutoUpgrade=value end})
    box:AddButton({Text="Analyze candidates (no upgrades)",Func=function()state.preview=true end})
    box:AddButton({Text="Resume",Func=function()state.failed=false;state.verified={} end})
    R.ai.installPotentialPredictor(box)
    box:AddLabel("Upgrades usable, unequipped gear only when it can beat your current gear within budget.",true)
    box:AddLabel("Stats below 200 are skipped. Health builds use physical weapons.",true)
    R.ai.stopAutoUpgrade=function()state.stopped=true;S.AutoUpgrade=false end
    task.spawn(function()
        while not state.stopped and not Lib.Unloaded do
            task.wait(3)
            if state.stopped or Lib.Unloaded then break end
            if not state.failed and not R.ai.itemActionBusy and not R.ai.itemsPending and (state.pending or not R.ai.inventoryTripBusy) and (state.preview or state.pending or S.AutoUpgrade) then
                local token={};R.ai.itemActionBusy=token
                local ok,err=pcall(step)
                R.ai.upgradePending=state.pending~=nil
                if R.ai.itemActionBusy==token then R.ai.itemActionBusy=nil end
                if not ok then state.failed=true;say("Paused: "..tostring(err)) end
            end
        end
    end)
end

    Callback=function(v)S.AutoSwapSets=v;if R.ai.skillSwapReset then R.ai.skillSwapReset()end end})
box:AddDropdown("SwapBuild",{Text="Spell build",Values={"Auto","Magic","Physical"},Default=S.SwapBuild,
    Callback=function(v)S.SwapBuild=v;if R.ai.skillSwapReset then R.ai.skillSwapReset()end end})
box:AddLabel("Unknown skill types can be set below.",true)
for _,slotKey in ipairs({"Q","E"}) do
    local key=slotKey
    box:AddDropdown("SkillSpeed"..key,{Text=key.." gives a speed boost",Values={"Auto","Yes","No"},Default="Auto",
        Callback=function(v)S["SkillSpeed"..key]=v;R.ai.scanAt=0 end})
    box:AddDropdown("SkillRole"..key,{
        Text=key.." skill role",
        Values={"Auto","Magic damage","Physical damage","Magic booster","Physical booster","Healing","Support"},
        Default="Auto",
        Callback=function(v) S["SkillRole"..key]=v;R.ai.scanAt=0;R.ai.boosterPending=nil end,
    })
    box:AddDropdown("SkillOrigin"..key,{Text=key.." damage origin",Values={"Auto","Follows character","Fixed at cast","Projectile / forward"},Default="Auto",
        Callback=function(v)S["SkillOrigin"..key]=v;R.ai.scanAt=0;local p=R.ai.slots[key];if p then p.activeEffect=nil;p.effectPending=nil end end})
    box:AddSlider("SkillRadius"..key,{Text=key.." effective range (0 = database estimate)",Default=0,Min=0,Max=150,Rounding=0,
        Callback=function(v)S["SkillRadius"..key]=v;R.ai.scanAt=0 end})
end
box:AddSlider("SkillHealHP",{
    Text="Use healing below",Default=65,Min=1,Max=100,Rounding=0,Suffix="%",
    Callback=function(v) S.SkillHealHP=v end,
})
do
    local status=box:AddLabel("No skill details loaded.",true)
    box:AddButton({Text="Inspect equipped skills",Func=function()
        R.ai.scanAt=0;R.ai.scanSpells()
        local lines={}
        local coverage=R.ai.skillCatalogCoverage
        if coverage then lines[#lines+1]=coverage.available.." available skills catalogued; "..coverage.origins.." effect origins classified" end
        for _,key in ipairs({"Q","E"}) do
            local p=R.ai.slots[key]
            lines[#lines+1]=p and (key..": "..p.name.." / "..p.role.." / "..(p.school or "unverified type").." / "..p.origin.." / "..p.shape.." / range "..p.range..(p.estimated and " (estimate/override)" or "").." / cooldown "..tostring(R.ai.skillCooldown(p) or "unavailable"))
                or (key..": no unique equipped slot")
        end
        lines[#lines+1]=R.ai.skillStatus or "No automated casts yet"
        lines[#lines+1]=R.ai.skillSwapStatus or "Spell sets: not checked yet"
        lines[#lines+1]="Estimated enemy recovery: "..string.format("%.1fs",R.ai.enemyRecoveryRemaining or 0)
        lines[#lines+1]="Travel speed use: "..tostring(S.TravelSpeedSkills~=false)
        status:SetText(table.concat(lines,"\n"))
    end})
end

    Callback = function(v)
        if type(v) == "string" and v ~= "" then R.cfgName = v end
    end,

    Text = "Save",
    Func = function()

        if ok then cfgRefresh() end
    end,
})

    Text = "Load",

    end,
})

    Text = "Delete",
    DoubleClick = true,
    Func = function()
        local ok, why = cfgDelete(R.cfgName)
        notify("Configs", ok and ("deleted " .. tostring(why)) or ("delete failed: " .. tostring(why)), 3)
        cfgRefresh()
    end,
})

do
    local group=R.ai.configTab:AddRightGroupbox("Dungeon choices","map")
    local status=group:AddLabel("No dungeon choices saved.",true)
    local selected=DUNGEONS[1];local changing=false;local choices
    local function refresh()
        local values={};local lines={}
        for _,difficulty in ipairs(DIFFICULTIES)do values[difficulty]=S.DungeonRules[selected.."|"..difficulty]==true end
        changing=true;if choices then choices:SetValue(values)end;changing=false
        for _,name in ipairs(DUNGEONS)do
            local enabled={}
            for _,difficulty in ipairs(DIFFICULTIES)do
                if S.DungeonRules[name.."|"..difficulty] then enabled[#enabled+1]=difficulty end
            end
            if #enabled>0 then lines[#lines+1]=name..": "..table.concat(enabled,", ")end
        end
        status:SetText(#lines>0 and table.concat(lines,"\n") or "No dungeon choices saved.")
    end
    R.ai.refreshConfigRules=refresh
    group:AddToggle("UseDungeonRules",{Text="Only use selected dungeons / difficulties",Default=false,
        Callback=function(v)S.UseDungeonRules=v;if R.ai.resumeCarryLobby then R.ai.resumeCarryLobby()end end})
    group:AddDropdown("CfgDungeon",{Text="Dungeon",Values=DUNGEONS,Default=selected,
        Callback=function(v)if type(v)=="string" then selected=v;refresh()end end})
    choices=group:AddDropdown("CfgDifficulties",{Text="Allowed difficulties",Values=DIFFICULTIES,Multi=true,Default={},
        Callback=function(v)
            if changing or type(v)~="table" then return end
            for _,difficulty in ipairs(DIFFICULTIES)do
                S.DungeonRules[selected.."|"..difficulty]=v[difficulty]==true or nil
            end
            if R.ai.settingsChanged then R.ai.settingsChanged()end
            if R.ai.resumeCarryLobby then R.ai.resumeCarryLobby()end
            refresh()
        end})
    group:AddButton({Text="Clear dungeon choices",DoubleClick=true,Func=function()
        S.DungeonRules={};refresh();if R.ai.settingsChanged then R.ai.settingsChanged()end
        if R.ai.resumeCarryLobby then R.ai.resumeCarryLobby()end
    end})
    group:AddButton({Text="Enable automatic dungeon selection",Func=function()
        local toggles=uiTable("Toggles")
        if toggles and toggles.AutoLevelLobby then toggles.AutoLevelLobby:SetValue(true)end
    end})
    group:AddLabel("Auto selection picks the highest eligible choice. An empty enabled list pauses selection.",true)
    refresh()
end

local function setLabel(lbl, txt)
    if not lbl then return end
    pcall(function() lbl:SetText(txt) end)
end

local function statusStep()
    setLabel(U.phase, "Phase: " .. tostring(R.phase))
    setLabel(U.status, "Status: " .. tostring(R.status))

    local t = R.target
    if t and enemyAlive(t.model) then
        local rp = root()
        local d = rp and (R.ai.combatPoint(t,rp.Position) - rp.Position).Magnitude or 0
        local h = t.hum
        setLabel(U.target, string.format("Target: %s [%s] %s hp %.0f away",
            t.model.Name, t.kind, R.ai.formatNumber(h and math.floor(h.Health) or 0), d))
    else
        setLabel(U.target, "Target: none")
    end

    setLabel(U.evade, "Evade: " .. (evading() and R.evadeWhy or "clear"))
    local timing=R.ai.projectileTimingStatus
    if timing then
        local profile=R.ai.projectileProfiles[timing.signature or ""]
        local samples=profile and profile.timingN or timing.samples or 0
        setLabel(U.projectileTiming,string.format("Auto dodge: %.2fs | %d samples%s",
            timing.lead,samples,samples<3 and " (learning)" or ""))
    end
    setLabel(U.aim, "Aim: " .. (R.target and (R.aimOk and "on target" or "turning") or "-"))
    setLabel(U.place, "Place: " .. placeName())
    setLabel(U.mobs, "Enemies: " .. #R.enemies)
    setLabel(U.hp, string.format("HP: %d%%", math.floor(hpPct())))
    setLabel(U.runs, "Wins: " .. R.runs)
    setLabel(U.kills, "Enemies defeated: " .. R.kills)
    setLabel(U.deaths, "Deaths: " .. R.deaths)

    local el = math.floor(os.clock() - R.startedAt)
    setLabel(U.time, string.format("Elapsed: %dm %ds", math.floor(el / 60), el % 60))
end

R.ai.retiredRoomEnemy =                   function(model,record,now)
    local hp=record.hum and record.hum.Health or (record.health and tonumber(record.health.Value))
    if hp and hp<=0 then return true end
    if workspace.StreamingEnabled or not model or model.Parent or not record.hum
        or record.hum.Parent or model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
        record.removedAt=nil
        return false
    end
    record.removedAt=record.removedAt or now
    return now-record.removedAt>=.35
end

    a.classifyEffect=                  function(part)
        local kind,entry,owner=original(part)
        if kind then return kind,entry,owner end
        local name=part.Name:lower()
        if name:find("safe",1,true) or name:find("spawn",1,true) then return end
        local ancestor=part
        for _=1,4 do
            if not ancestor or ancestor==workspace then break end
            local family=ancestor.Name:lower()
            if a.knownAttackFamilies[family] then
                if ancestor~=part and name~="hitbox" and name~="hitpart" and name~="damagepart"
                    and name~="precast" and name~="warning" and name~="indicator"
                    and name~=family then return end
                return "enemy",{hitbox=name=="hitbox" or name=="hitpart" or name=="damagepart",family=family}
            end
            ancestor=ancestor.Parent
        end
    end 
    for part,info in pairs(R.watch)do
            if R.ai.characterEffectPart(part) or R.ai.spentBossIceVisual(part)then R.watch[part]=nil;continue end
        if part.Parent and not info.enemyEffect and not info.lineCast then
            local kind,entry=a.classifyEffect(part)
            if kind=="enemy" then info.enemyEffect=true;info.enemyHitbox=entry and entry.hitbox==true end
        end
    end
end

                         
do
local Adaptive=(function()
                                                                          
                                                                              
local Adaptive = {}
local flat; flat =                   function(v) return Vector3.new(v.X,0,v.Z) end 
local distance; distance =                   function(a,b) return (a-b).Magnitude end 
local key; key =                   function(p) return math.round(p.X*4)..":"..math.round(p.Y*4)..":"..math.round(p.Z*4) end 
local finite; finite =                   function(n) return type(n)=="number" and n==n and math.abs(n)<1e9 end 
local function packNode(n)
    local edges={}
    for to,e in pairs(n.edges) do
        if e.success>0 then edges[to]={success=e.success,failures=e.failures,time=e.time,damage=e.damage,cost=e.cost,needsValidation=e.needsValidation} end
    end
    return {p={n.p.X,n.p.Y,n.p.Z},edges=edges}
end
local push; push =                   function(heap,item)
    local i=#heap+1
    while i>1 do local p=math.floor(i/2);if heap[p].score<=item.score then break end;heap[i]=heap[p];i=p end
    heap[i]=item
end 
local pop; pop =                   function(heap)
    local first=heap[1];local last=table.remove(heap)
    if #heap>0 then
        local i=1
        while i*2<=#heap do
            local c=i*2;if c<#heap and heap[c+1].score<heap[c].score then c+=1 end
            if heap[c].score>=last.score then break end;heap[i]=heap[c];i=c
        end
        heap[i]=last
    end
    return first
end 
function Adaptive.new(io,saved)
    local self={io=io,nodes={},archive={},slots={},slotCursor=1,nodeLimit=12000,count=0,cues={},patterns={},hazards={},tails={},visits={},epoch=0,
        stats={travel=0,damage=0,stalls=0,learnedEdges=0,searches=0,expansions=0,cueMatches=0},
        status="ready",budget=8,step=2,searchLimit=6000,route={},lastSave=0,probeCache={},hazardEpoch=0,
        ownerIds=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"}),nextOwner=0,engagements={},engagementStates=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"}),engagementEvents={},
        attackEpisodes={},continuityProfiles={},attackStreams={},attackTransitions={},attackCadence={},behaviorProfiles={}}
    setmetatable(self,{__index=Adaptive})
    self:restore(saved)
    return self
end
Adaptive.node =                   function(self,p)
    local k=key(p);local n=self.nodes[k]
    if not n then
        local slot
        if self.count>=self.nodeLimit then
            local protected={}
            if self.observation and self.observation.key then protected[self.observation.key]=true end
            for _,point in ipairs(self.route) do protected[key(point)]=true end
            for _=1,#self.slots do
                local i=self.slotCursor;self.slotCursor=i%#self.slots+1
                local oldKey=self.slots[i]
                if not protected[oldKey] and not (self.search and self.search.cost[oldKey]) then
                    local old=self.nodes[oldKey]
                    if old then self.archive[oldKey]=packNode(old);self.nodes[oldKey]=nil;self.count-=1 end
                    slot=i;break
                end
            end
            if not slot then return nil end
        end
        local saved=self.archive[k]
        n={key=k,p=saved and Vector3.new(table.unpack(saved.p)) or p,edges=saved and saved.edges or {},seen=0}
        self.archive[k]=nil;self.nodes[k]=n;self.count+=1
        self.slots[slot or (#self.slots+1)]=k
    end
    return n
end 
Adaptive.indexRecorded =                   function(self,p)
    self.recordedBuckets=self.recordedBuckets or {}
    local bucketKey=math.floor(p.X/4)..":"..math.floor(p.Y/4)..":"..math.floor(p.Z/4)
    local bucket=self.recordedBuckets[bucketKey]
    if not bucket then bucket={count=0,points={}};self.recordedBuckets[bucketKey]=bucket end
    local k=key(p)
    if bucket.points[k] or bucket.count>=24 then return end
    bucket.points[k]=p;bucket.count+=1
end 
Adaptive.nearbyRecorded =                   function(self,p)
    local result={};local bx,by,bz=math.floor(p.X/4),math.floor(p.Y/4),math.floor(p.Z/4)
    for x=-1,1 do for y=-1,1 do for z=-1,1 do
        local bucket=self.recordedBuckets and self.recordedBuckets[(bx+x)..":"..(by+y)..":"..(bz+z)]
        if bucket then for _,point in pairs(bucket.points) do
            local d=distance(p,point)
            if d>.1 and d<=3 then result[#result+1]={p=point,d=d} end
        end end
    end end end
    table.sort(result,                  function(a,b)return a.d<b.d end )
    local points={};for i=1,math.min(6,#result) do points[i]=result[i].p end
    return points
end 
function Adaptive:remember(p,q)
    self:indexRecorded(p);self:indexRecorded(q)
                                                                             
    local function record(point)
        local k=key(point);local active=self.nodes[k]
        if active then return active,k end
        local n=self.archive[k]
        if not n then n={p={point.X,point.Y,point.Z},edges={}};self.archive[k]=n end
        return n,k
    end
    local a,ak=record(p);local _,bk=record(q)
    if ak~=bk and not a.edges[bk] then a.edges[bk]={success=1,failures=0,time=0,damage=0,cost=distance(p,q),needsValidation=true} end
end
Adaptive.edge =                   function(self,a,b,observed,elapsed,damage)
    if not a or not b or a==b then return end
    local e=a.edges[b.key] or {success=0,failures=0,time=0,damage=0}
    e.cost=distance(a.p,b.p);e.at=self.io.now()
    if observed then
        e.blocked=nil
        e.needsValidation=false
        e.validatedRevision=self.revision;e.validatedAt=self.io.now()
        if e.success==0 then self.stats.learnedEdges+=1 end
        e.success+=1;e.time+=elapsed or 0;e.damage+=damage or 0
    end
    a.edges[b.key]=e
    return e
end 
Adaptive.recordTraversal =                   function(self,position)
    self:indexRecorded(position)
