    self.traversed=self.traversed or {};self.traversedKeys=self.traversedKeys or {}
    local k=math.round(position.X/2)..":"..math.round(position.Y/2)..":"..math.round(position.Z/2)
    if self.traversedKeys[k] then return end
    if #self.traversed>=12000 then return end
    self.traversedKeys[k]=true
    self.traversed[#self.traversed+1]={position.X,position.Y,position.Z}
end 
                                                                         
                                                                    
Adaptive.breadcrumb =                   function(self,position)
    if self.backtrack then return end
    local trail=self.breadcrumbs or {};self.breadcrumbs=trail
    local last=trail[#trail]
    if last and distance(last,position)<1 then return end
    for i=#trail-1,math.max(1,#trail-64),-1 do
        if distance(trail[i],position)<1.5 then
            for j=#trail,i+1,-1 do trail[j]=nil end
            return
        end
    end
    trail[#trail+1]=position
    if #trail>512 then table.remove(trail,1) end
end 
Adaptive.recoveryBlocked =                   function(self,finish,goal)
    local r=self.recoveryAvoid
    return r and self.io.now()<r.untilAt and distance(goal,r.goal)<8
        and distance(finish,r.position)<12 and distance(finish,goal)>8
end 
Adaptive.recoverProgress =                   function(self,sample,now,danger)
    local goal=sample.goal;local position=sample.position
    if not sample.enabled or sample.hp<=0 or not goal then
        self.backtrack=nil;self.progressWatch=nil;self.breadcrumbs={};self.recoveryAvoid=nil;return false
    end
    if self.backtrack and (danger or distance(goal,self.backtrack.goal)>8) then
        self.backtrack=nil;self.route={};self.command=nil;self.search=nil;self.progressWatch=nil
    end
    if danger or sample.canAttack then
        if sample.canAttack and self.backtrack then self.backtrack=nil;self.route={};self.command=nil end
        self.progressWatch=nil;return false
    end
    if self.backtrack then
        if self.route[1] then return true end
        self.backtrack=nil;self.progressWatch=nil
                                                                          
                                                             
        self.breadcrumbs={position};return false
    end
    local d=distance(position,goal);local w=self.progressWatch
    if not w or distance(w.goal,goal)>8 then
        self.progressWatch={goal=goal,best=d,bestVertical=math.abs(position.Y-goal.Y),at=now};return false
    end
    if d<w.best-3 then w.best=d;w.at=now;return false end
    if not self.routeEscape and not self.backtrack and self.route[1] and sample.grounded
        and now>=(w.routeCheckAt or 0) then
        w.routeCheckAt=now+.5
        local remaining=self:routeLength(self.route,position)
        if w.route==self.route and w.routeRemaining and remaining<w.routeRemaining-3
            and w.routePosition and distance(position,w.routePosition)>1 then
            w.routeRemaining=remaining;w.routePosition=position;w.at=now;return false
        end
        if w.route~=self.route then
            w.route=self.route;w.routeRemaining=remaining;w.routePosition=position
        end
    end
    local vertical=math.abs(position.Y-goal.Y)
    if not self.routeEscape and not self.backtrack and self.route[1] and sample.grounded
        and vertical<(w.bestVertical or vertical)-2 then
                                                                           
                                                                           
        w.bestVertical=vertical;w.at=now;return false
    end
    if now-w.at<12 or sample.grounded~=true then return false end
    w.at=now
    local trail=self.breadcrumbs or {};local route={};local length=0;local previous=position
                                                                           
                                                                          
    for i=#trail,math.max(1,#trail-127),-1 do
        local point=trail[i];local step=distance(previous,point)
        if step>8 then break end                                   
        if step>.65 then
            length+=step;route[#route+1]=point;previous=point
            if distance(point,position)>=32 or length>=80 then break end
        end
    end
    if #route<2 or distance(previous,position)<8 then return false end
    self.backtrack={goal=goal,origin=position}
    self.recoveryAvoid={goal=goal,position=position,untilAt=now+60}
    self.route=route;self.routeMacro=true;self.routeDirect=false;self.routeStreamed=false;self.routeEscape=false
    self.routeSource="checked dead-end recovery";self.search=nil;self.offeredRoute=nil;self.command=nil
    self.failedSearch=nil;self.retryAt=0
    return true
end 
Adaptive.observe =                   function(self,position,hp,now,grounded)
    local last=self.observation
    local n=self:node(position)
    if last then
        local dt=now-last.at;local travelled=distance(position,last.p)
        local damage=math.max(0,last.hp-hp);self.stats.damage+=damage
        if dt>0 and dt<.5 and travelled<math.max(3,(self.speed or 16)*dt*2.5) then
            if grounded==true and last.grounded==true and travelled>.1 then
                self:recordTraversal(last.p);self:recordTraversal(position)
                self:breadcrumb(last.p);self:breadcrumb(position)
            end
            self.stats.travel+=travelled
            if n and n.key~=last.key then
                self:edge(self.nodes[last.key],n,true,dt,damage)
                self.visits[n.key]=(self.visits[n.key] or 0)+1
            end
            if self.command and travelled<.03 then self.stalled=(self.stalled or 0)+dt else self.stalled=0 end
            if (self.stalled or 0)>.55 then
                self.stats.stalls+=1;self.stalled=0
                if self.commandEdge then
                    local e=self.commandEdge;e.failures+=1;e.blocked=now+2;e.needsValidation=true
                end
                self.motionFailures=self.motionFailures or {}
                self.motionFailures[#self.motionFailures+1]={position=position,direction=self.command,untilAt=now+4,revision=self.revision}
                if #self.motionFailures>12 then table.remove(self.motionFailures,1) end
                self.route={};self.search=nil;self.command=nil
            end
        else self.route={};self.search=nil;self.command=nil;self.stalled=0;self.breadcrumbs={};self.backtrack=nil;self.progressWatch=nil end
        if grounded~=true or last.grounded~=true then self.breadcrumbs={} end
        if damage>0 then
                                                                           
                                                                            
            local xyz; xyz =                   function(v)return v and {v.X,v.Y,v.Z} end 
            local evidence={at=now,damage=damage,dt=dt,status=self.status,
                position=xyz(position),previous=xyz(last.p),command=xyz(self.command),
                actualSpeed=dt>0 and travelled/dt or 0,escape=self.routeEscape==true,
                threats={},threatCount=0}
            for id,h in pairs(self.hazards) do
                evidence.threatCount+=1
                if h.pos and distance(h.pos,position)<100 and #evidence.threats<8 then
                    evidence.threats[#evidence.threats+1]={id=tostring(id):sub(1,160),kind=h.kind,
                        position=xyz(h.pos),velocity=xyz(h.velocity),radius=h.radius,
                        thin=h.thin,span=h.span,started=h.started,axis=xyz(h.axis),size=xyz(h.size),
                        right=h.cf and xyz(h.cf.RightVector),look=h.cf and xyz(h.cf.LookVector),clearance=h.clearance}
                end
            end
            self.recentDamage=self.recentDamage or {}
            self.recentDamage[#self.recentDamage+1]=evidence
            if #self.recentDamage>8 then table.remove(self.recentDamage,1) end
                                                                          
            for _,p in pairs(self.patterns) do
                if p.predictedUntil and now<p.predictedUntil+1 then
                    p.errors=(p.errors or 0)+1;p.safeN=0;p.extra=math.min(2,(p.extra or .15)+.15)
                end
            end
        end
        for id,tail in pairs(self.tails) do
            local pattern=self.patterns[tail.h.pattern]
            if pattern and self:hazardMargin(tail.h,position,0)<0 then
                if damage>0 then
                    pattern.safeTailN=0;pattern.safeN=0;pattern.extra=math.min(2,(pattern.extra or .15)+.15)
                    self.tails[id]=nil
                else
                    tail.exposure=(tail.exposure or 0)+math.min(.1,math.max(0,dt))
                    if tail.exposure>=.2 then
                        pattern.safeTailN=(pattern.safeTailN or 0)+1;self.tails[id]=nil
                    end
                end
            end
            if now-tail.at>.75 then self.tails[id]=nil end
        end
    end
    self.observation={p=position,hp=hp,at=now,key=n and n.key,grounded=grounded}
end 
                                                                             
                                                                            
local function sequenceKey(source,history,length)
    local parts={tostring(#source)..":"..source}
    for i=#history-length+1,#history do local k=history[i];parts[#parts+1]=tostring(#k)..":"..k end
    return table.concat(parts,"|")
end
Adaptive.attackOrder =                   function(self,source,sourceKey,events,now,exposed)
    local s=self.attackStreams[source]
    if not s or s.key~=sourceKey or now-s.at>12 then
        local count=0;for _ in pairs(self.attackStreams) do count+=1 end
        if count>=32 and not s then return end
        s={key=sourceKey,history={},at=now};self.attackStreams[source]=s
    end
    if exposed then s.exposedAt=now end
    local event,eventCount=nil,0
    for k in pairs(events) do event=k;eventCount+=1 end
    if eventCount==0 then return end
                                                                 
    if eventCount>1 then s.history={};s.lastEvent=nil;s.runCount=0;s.prediction=nil;s.at=now;return end
    local gap=now-s.at
    if s.lastEvent and gap>=.15 and gap<=12 then
        local p=self.attackCadence[sourceKey]
        local count=0;for _ in pairs(self.attackCadence) do count+=1 end
        if p or count<128 then
            p=p or {n=0,minGap=gap,maxGap=gap}
            p.n=math.min(10000,p.n+1);p.minGap=math.min(p.minGap,gap);p.maxGap=math.max(p.maxGap,gap)
            self.attackCadence[sourceKey]=p
        end
    end
    if #s.history>0 and gap<.08 then s.history={};s.lastEvent=nil;s.runCount=0;s.prediction=nil;s.at=now;return end
    local runCount=s.lastEvent==event and (s.runCount or 0)+1 or 1
    s.lastEvent=event;s.runCount=math.min(33,runCount)
    if runCount>32 then s.history={};s.prediction=nil;s.at=now;return end
    for length=1,math.min(4,#s.history) do
        local key=sequenceKey(sourceKey,s.history,length)
        local p=self.attackTransitions[key]
        if not p then
            local count=0;for _ in pairs(self.attackTransitions) do count+=1 end
            if count>=256 then break end
            p={n=0,streak=0,next=event,hits=0,minGap=gap,maxGap=gap};self.attackTransitions[key]=p
        end
        p.n=math.min(10000,p.n+1)
        if p.next==event then
            p.hits=math.min(10000,p.hits+1);p.streak=math.min(10000,p.streak+1)
            p.minGap=math.min(p.minGap,gap);p.maxGap=math.max(p.maxGap,gap)
        else
                                                                         
            p.next=event;p.hits=1;p.streak=1;p.n=1;p.minGap=gap;p.maxGap=gap
        end
    end
                                                                             
                                                                    
    s.history[#s.history+1]=tostring(#event)..":"..event.."#"..tostring(runCount)
    if #s.history>4 then table.remove(s.history,1) end
    s.at=now;s.prediction=nil
    for length=math.min(4,#s.history),1,-1 do
        local key=sequenceKey(sourceKey,s.history,length);local p=self.attackTransitions[key]
        local lifetime=p and self.continuityProfiles[p.next]
        if p and p.streak>=3 and p.hits/p.n>=.85 and lifetime and lifetime.n>=3 and lifetime.exposed>=2 then
            local deadline=now+math.min(12,p.maxGap+(p.maxGap-p.minGap)+.2)
            s.prediction={context=key,next=p.next,deadline=deadline,
                notBefore=now+math.max(0,p.minGap-math.max(.6,p.maxGap-p.minGap+.35))}
            break
        end
    end
end 
Adaptive.recoveryWindow =                   function(self,owner,now)
    local s=self.attackStreams[owner]
    local p=s and self.attackCadence[s.key]
    if not p or p.n<3 or self.deadOwners and self.deadOwners[owner] then return 0 end
    local lead=math.max(.6,p.maxGap-p.minGap+.35)
    return math.max(0,s.at+p.minGap-lead-now)
end 
Adaptive.anticipatingAttack =                   function(self,now)
    local active=false
    for owner,s in pairs(self.attackStreams) do
        if self.deadOwners and self.deadOwners[owner] or now-s.at>12 then self.attackStreams[owner]=nil
        elseif s.prediction then
            if now>s.prediction.deadline then
                for length=1,math.min(4,#s.history) do
                    local p=self.attackTransitions[sequenceKey(s.key,s.history,length)]
                    if p and p.next==s.prediction.next then p.streak=0 end
                end
                s.prediction=nil
            elseif now>=(s.prediction.notBefore or s.at) and s.exposedAt and now-s.exposedAt<=12 then active=true end
        elseif s.exposedAt and now-s.exposedAt<=12 then
            local p=self.attackCadence[s.key]
            if p and p.n>=3 and p.minGap>math.max(.6,p.maxGap-p.minGap+.35)+.25
                and self:recoveryWindow(owner,now)==0 and now<=s.at+p.maxGap+.35 then active=true end
        end
    end
    return active
end 
Adaptive.finishAttackEpisode =                   function(self,e)
    if e.invalid or e.samples<2 or e.lastSeen-e.at<=.05 or e.lastSeen-e.at>8 then return end
    local p=self.continuityProfiles[e.key]
    if not p then
        local count=0;for _ in pairs(self.continuityProfiles) do count+=1 end
        if count>=256 then return end
        p={n=0,exposed=0,minDuration=8,maxDuration=0,pauses=0,moving=0,outages=0}
        self.continuityProfiles[e.key]=p
    end
    local duration=e.lastSeen-e.at
    p.n=math.min(10000,p.n+1)
    p.minDuration=math.min(p.minDuration,duration);p.maxDuration=math.max(p.maxDuration,duration)
    if e.exposed then p.exposed=math.min(10000,p.exposed+1) end
    p.pauses=math.min(1e6,p.pauses+e.pauses);p.moving=math.min(1e6,p.moving+e.moving)
end 
Adaptive.attackContinuity =                   function(self,effects,position,now,enabled)
    if not enabled then self.attackEpisodes={};self.attackStreams={};self.continuityObservation=nil;return false end
    local previous=self.continuityObservation
    local dt=previous and now-previous.at or 0
    local moved=previous and flat(position-previous.p).Magnitude or 0
    local teleported=previous and moved>math.max(3,self.speed*math.max(0,dt)*2.5)
    if teleported then self.attackEpisodes={} end
    local outage=previous and (dt<=0 or dt>.3 or teleported)
    if outage then self.attackStreams={} end
                                                                                  
    for _,e in pairs(self.attackEpisodes) do e.present=false;e.near=false;if outage then e.invalid=true end end
    local count=0;for _ in pairs(self.attackEpisodes) do count+=1 end
    local onsets={}
    for _,h in ipairs(effects) do
        local id,k=h.attackId,h.attackKey
        if not id or type(k)~="string" or #k>240 or h.predicted or self.deadOwners and self.deadOwners[h.owner] then continue end
        local e=self.attackEpisodes[id]
        if not e and count<80 then
            e={key=k,at=now,lastSeen=now,samples=0,exposed=false,pauses=0,moving=0,owner=h.owner}
            self.attackEpisodes[id]=e;count+=1
            if h.attackSource and type(h.attackSourceKey)=="string" and #h.attackSourceKey<=240 and not outage then
                local batch=onsets[h.attackSource] or {key=h.attackSourceKey,events={}}
                batch.events[k]=true;onsets[h.attackSource]=batch
            end
        end
        if not e or e.key~=k then continue end
        e.present=true;e.lastSeen=now
        if e.sampleAt~=now then e.samples+=1;e.sampleAt=now end
        if self:hazardMargin(h,position,0)<.75 then e.near=true;e.exposed=true end
        if h.attackSource and e.near then
            local s=self.attackStreams[h.attackSource];if s then s.exposedAt=now end
            local batch=onsets[h.attackSource];if batch then batch.exposed=true end
        end
    end
    for source,batch in pairs(onsets) do self:attackOrder(source,batch.key,batch.events,now,batch.exposed) end
    local active=false
    for id,e in pairs(self.attackEpisodes) do
        local p=self.continuityProfiles[e.key]
        local learned=p and p.n>=3 and p.exposed>=2
        local horizon=learned and math.min(8,p.maxDuration+(p.maxDuration-p.minDuration)+.1) or 0
                                                                                 
                                                                           
        local held=not e.cleared and e.exposed and now-e.at<8 and (e.present or learned and now-e.at<horizon)
        if self.deadOwners and self.deadOwners[e.owner] then held=false;self.attackEpisodes[id]=nil
        else
            if not outage and dt>0 and e.near then
                if moved/dt<math.max(1,self.speed*.15) then e.pauses+=dt else e.moving+=dt end
            elseif outage and p then p.outages=math.min(1e6,p.outages+1) end
            if not e.present and (e.cleared or now-e.lastSeen>.35) and not held then
                self:finishAttackEpisode(e);self.attackEpisodes[id]=nil
            end
        end
        if held then active=true end
    end
    self.continuityObservation={p=position,at=now}
    return self:anticipatingAttack(now) or active
end 
Adaptive.cue =                   function(self,owner,signature,transform,now)
    if self.deadOwners and self.deadOwners[owner] then return end
    local total=0;for _ in pairs(self.cues) do total+=1 end
    if total>=128 then return end
    if not self.ownerIds[owner] then self.nextOwner+=1;self.ownerIds[owner]=self.nextOwner end
    local k=tostring(self.ownerIds[owner])..":"..tostring(signature)
    self.cues[k]={owner=owner,signature=signature,transform=transform,at=now,matched=false}
    local p=self.patterns[signature]
    if p and p.n>=3 and p.safeN>=2 and p.shape and p.duration then
        local h=self.io.predict(p.shape,transform)
        if h then
            h.id="prediction:"..k;h.predicted=true;h.pattern=signature;h.owner=owner
            h.launchTime=now+p.delay
            h.untilTime=now+p.delay+p.duration+(p.extra or .15)
            p.predictedUntil=h.untilTime;self.hazards[h.id]=h;self.hazardEpoch+=1
        end
    end
end 
Adaptive.retireOwner =                   function(self,owner)
    if not owner then return end
    self.deadOwners=self.deadOwners or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
    self.deadOwners[owner]=true
    self.ownerRetired=true
    self.attackStreams[owner]=nil
    for id,e in pairs(self.attackEpisodes) do if e.owner==owner then self.attackEpisodes[id]=nil end end
    self.retiredHazards=self.retiredHazards or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
    for id,h in pairs(self.hazards) do
        if h.owner==owner then
            self:finishHazardMotion(h)
            self.retiredHazards[id]=true
            self.hazards[id]=nil;self.hazardEpoch+=1
        end
    end
    for id,tail in pairs(self.tails) do if tail.h.owner==owner then self.tails[id]=nil end end
    for id,cue in pairs(self.cues) do if cue.owner==owner then self.cues[id]=nil end end
    self.escapeCandidates=nil;self.coverOffer=nil
    if self.search and self.search.escape then self.search=nil end
end 
Adaptive.observeHazardMotion =                   function(self,h,old,now)
    old=old and (old.motionSnapshot or old)
    if old and old.kind==h.kind and now-(old.observedAt or now)<.015 then
        h.motionSnapshot=old
        for _,field in ipairs({"motionEvidence","motionUncertainty","motionPoint","motionAt","measuredVelocity","motionVelocity","pathTurnRate","turnSamples","curveRate","turnRate","growthRate","motionClass"})do
            h[field]=old[field]
        end
        if h.kind=="projectile" then h.velocity=old.measuredVelocity or old.velocity or h.velocity end
        return
    end
    h.motionSnapshot=nil
    local dt=old and now-(old.observedAt or now) or 0
    local k=h.behaviorKey
    local profile=type(k)=="string" and self.behaviorProfiles[k] or nil
    if not old or old.kind~=h.kind or dt<.015 or dt>.3 then
        h.motionEvidence={samples=0,turns=0,growth=0,following=0,travel=0,started=now}
        h.motionUncertainty=profile and profile.episodes>=3 and profile.turning>=2 and 2 or 0
        return
    end
    local displacement=h.pos-(old.motionPoint or old.pos)
    local elapsed=now-(old.motionAt or old.observedAt or now)
    local measured=displacement/math.max(.015,elapsed)
    if displacement.Magnitude>.025 then
        h.motionPoint=h.pos;h.motionAt=now
    else
        h.motionPoint=old.motionPoint or old.pos;h.motionAt=old.motionAt or old.observedAt
        measured=elapsed<.12 and old.measuredVelocity or Vector3.zero
        measured=measured or Vector3.zero
    end
    if measured.Magnitude>240 then
        h.motionEvidence={samples=0,turns=0,growth=0,following=0,travel=0,started=now}
        h.motionUncertainty=4;return
    end
    local evidence=old.motionEvidence or {samples=0,turns=0,growth=0,following=0,travel=0,started=now-dt}
    h.motionEvidence=evidence;evidence.samples+=1;evidence.travel+=measured.Magnitude*dt
    h.measuredVelocity=measured
    if h.kind=="projectile" then h.velocity=measured else h.motionVelocity=measured end
    local previous=old.measuredVelocity
    local uncertainty=(old.motionUncertainty or 0)*.75
    if previous then
        local error=(measured-previous).Magnitude
        uncertainty=math.max(uncertainty,math.min(24,error*.25))
        local v,p=flat(measured),flat(previous)
        if v.Magnitude>2 and p.Magnitude>2 then
            local angle=math.atan2(p.X*v.Z-p.Z*v.X,p:Dot(v))
            if math.abs(angle)>.12 then evidence.turns+=1 end
                                                                            
                                                                        
            if math.abs(angle)<.6 then
                local turn=angle/dt
                if old.pathTurnRate and math.abs(turn-old.pathTurnRate)<.8 then h.turnSamples=(old.turnSamples or 0)+1 else h.turnSamples=1 end
                h.pathTurnRate=turn
                if h.kind=="projectile" and h.turnSamples>=3 and math.abs(turn)<=4 then
                    h.curveRate=turn
                    if math.abs(turn)>.25 then evidence.turns+=1 end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local orientation=h.axis or h.kind=="box" and h.cf and h.cf.RightVector
    local previousOrientation=old.axis or old.kind=="box" and old.cf and old.cf.RightVector
    if orientation and previousOrientation then
        local axis,prior=flat(orientation),flat(previousOrientation)
        if axis.Magnitude>.1 and prior.Magnitude>.1 then
            axis=axis.Unit;prior=prior.Unit;if axis:Dot(prior)<0 then axis=-axis end
            local turn=math.atan2(prior.X*axis.Z-prior.Z*axis.X,prior:Dot(axis))/dt
            if math.abs(turn)<=6 then h.turnRate=turn end
        end
    end
    local growth=0
    for _,field in ipairs({"radius","thin","span"}) do
        if finite(h[field]) and finite(old[field]) then growth=math.max(growth,(h[field]-old[field])/dt*(field=="radius" and 1 or .5)) end
    end
    if h.size and old.size then
        local d=(h.size-old.size)/dt;growth=math.max(growth,d.X*.5,d.Y*.5,d.Z*.5)
    end
    h.growthRate=math.clamp(growth,0,120)
    if growth>.1 then evidence.growth+=1 end
    local player=self.observation and self.observation.p
    if player and measured.Magnitude>2 then
        local delta=flat(player-h.pos);local v=flat(measured)
        if delta.Magnitude>1 and v.Magnitude>1 and delta.Unit:Dot(v.Unit)>.95 then evidence.following+=1 end
    end
    h.motionUncertainty=uncertainty
    h.motionClass=evidence.turns>=2 and "changing direction" or measured.Magnitude>1 and "moving" or "stationary"
    if h.growthRate>.1 then h.motionClass="expanding" end
                                                                              
end 
Adaptive.finishHazardMotion =                   function(self,h)
    local k,e=h.behaviorKey,h.motionEvidence
    if type(k)~="string" or #k>300 or not e or e.samples<3 then return end
    local p=self.behaviorProfiles[k]
    if not p then
        local count=0;for _ in pairs(self.behaviorProfiles) do count+=1 end
        if count>=256 then return end
        p={episodes=0,turning=0,growing=0,following=0,maxSpeed=0,maxObservedLife=0};self.behaviorProfiles[k]=p
    end
    p.episodes=math.min(10000,p.episodes+1)
    if e.turns>=2 then p.turning=math.min(10000,p.turning+1) end
    if e.growth>=2 then p.growing=math.min(10000,p.growing+1) end
    if e.following>=3 and e.turns>=2 then p.following=math.min(10000,p.following+1) end
    p.maxSpeed=math.max(p.maxSpeed,math.min(240,e.travel/math.max(.01,(h.observedAt or e.started)-e.started)))
    p.maxObservedLife=math.max(p.maxObservedLife,math.min(120,(h.observedAt or e.started)-e.started))
end 
Adaptive.projectilePosition =                   function(self,h,time)
    local t=math.max(0,time-(h.launchTime and h.launchTime-self.io.now() or 0))
    local v=h.velocity or Vector3.zero;local w=h.curveRate or 0
    if math.abs(w)<.01 then return h.pos+v*t end
    local angle=w*t;local s,c=math.sin(angle),math.cos(angle)
    return h.pos+Vector3.new((v.X*s+v.Z*(c-1))/w,v.Y*t,(v.X*(1-c)+v.Z*s)/w)
end 
Adaptive.motionPadding =                   function(self,h,time)
    return ((h.motionUncertainty or 0)+(h.growthRate or 0))*math.clamp(time or 0,0,3)
end 
Adaptive.scriptedHazardChanged =                   function(h,old)
    local regions,previous=h.regions or {},old.regions or {}
    if h.safeBefore~=old.safeBefore or h.untilTime~=old.untilTime or #regions~=#previous
        or h.cf~=old.cf or h.spinRate~=old.spinRate then return true end
    for i,z in ipairs(regions)do
        local prev=previous[i]
        if not prev or z.cf~=prev.cf or z.size~=prev.size or z.pos~=prev.pos or z.radius~=prev.radius then return true end
    end
    return false
end 
Adaptive.effects =                   function(self,effects,now)
    local present={}
    for _,h in ipairs(effects) do
        if self.io.hazardActive and self.io.hazardActive(h)==false then continue end
        if self.retiredHazards and self.retiredHazards[h.id] then continue end
        local old=self.hazards[h.id]
        h.protectedExposure=self.protected==true or old and old.protectedExposure==true
        h.owner=old and old.owner or h.owner
        if self.deadOwners and self.deadOwners[h.owner] then continue end
        if not h.scripted then self:observeHazardMotion(h,old,now)end
        present[h.id]=true
        if old then
            h.started=old.started;h.pattern=old.pattern;h.matchDelay=old.matchDelay;h.damageAtStart=old.damageAtStart
            if distance(h.pos,old.pos)>.25 or h.axis and old.axis and h.axis:Dot(old.axis)<.995 then self.hazardEpoch+=1 end
            if math.abs(h.turnRate or 0)>.01 then self.hazardEpoch+=1 end
            if h.inner~=old.inner or h.radius~=old.radius or h.thin~=old.thin or h.span~=old.span or h.size and old.size and distance(h.size,old.size)>.1 then self.hazardEpoch+=1 end
            if h.scripted and Adaptive.scriptedHazardChanged(h,old) then self.hazardEpoch+=1 end
        else
            self.hazardEpoch+=1
            h.started=now;h.damageAtStart=self.stats.damage
            local chosen,count=nil,0
            for _,cue in pairs(self.cues) do
                if not cue.matched and (cue.owner==h.owner or h.owner==nil) and now-cue.at>=0 and now-cue.at<=4 then chosen=cue;count+=1 end
            end
            local patternCount=0;for _ in pairs(self.patterns) do patternCount+=1 end
            if not h.scripted and not h.strategic and count==1 and (self.patterns[chosen.signature] or patternCount<256) then
                chosen.matched=true;h.owner=h.owner or chosen.owner;h.pattern=chosen.signature;h.matchDelay=now-chosen.at
                local p=self.patterns[h.pattern] or {n=0,safeN=0,errors=0,extra=.15}
                p.n+=1;p.delay=p.delay and p.delay+(h.matchDelay-p.delay)/math.min(p.n,30) or h.matchDelay
                p.shape=self.io.relative(h,chosen.transform);self.patterns[h.pattern]=p
                self.stats.cueMatches+=1
                                                                          
                                                                            
                for id,prediction in pairs(self.hazards) do
                    if prediction.predicted and prediction.owner==chosen.owner and prediction.pattern==h.pattern then self.hazards[id]=nil end
                end
            end
        end
        h.observedAt=now;self.hazards[h.id]=h
    end
    for id,h in pairs(self.hazards) do
        if h.predicted then
            if now>=h.untilTime then self.hazards[id]=nil;self.hazardEpoch+=1 end
        elseif not present[id] or self.io.hazardActive and self.io.hazardActive(h)==false then
            self:finishHazardMotion(h)
            if h.attackId and self.io.hazardActive and self.io.hazardActive(h)==false then
                local remaining=false
                for otherId,other in pairs(self.hazards) do
                    if otherId~=id and present[otherId] and other.attackId==h.attackId then remaining=true;break end
                end
                local episode=self.attackEpisodes[h.attackId]
                if episode and not remaining then episode.cleared=true end
            end
            if h.pattern then
                local p=self.patterns[h.pattern];local duration=now-h.started
                if p and duration>.05 and duration<30 then
                    p.duration=math.max(p.duration or 0,duration)
                                                                              
                                                                             
                    if not h.protectedExposure then
                        if self.stats.damage==(h.damageAtStart or 0) then p.safeN+=1 else p.safeN=0 end
                    end
                    if not h.protectedExposure then self.tails[id]={h=h,at=now,exposure=0} end
                end
            end
            self.hazards[id]=nil;self.hazardEpoch+=1
        end
    end
    for k,cue in pairs(self.cues) do if now-cue.at>5 then self.cues[k]=nil end end
end 
Adaptive.engagementProfile =                   function(self,signature)
    if type(signature)~="string" or #signature>200 then return end
    local p=self.engagements[signature]
    if not p then
        local n=0;for _ in pairs(self.engagements) do n+=1 end
        if n>=128 then return end
        p={bins={},starts=0,provokedStarts=0,stops=0,hitCount=0,missCount=0};self.engagements[signature]=p
    end
    return p
end 
Adaptive.engagementEvent =                   function(self,event)
    self.engagementSequence=(self.engagementSequence or 0)+1;event.sequence=self.engagementSequence
    self.engagementEvents[#self.engagementEvents+1]=event
    if #self.engagementEvents>64 then table.remove(self.engagementEvents,1) end
end 
Adaptive.attackAttempt =                   function(self,id,signature,d,hp)
    local state=self.engagementStates[id] or {};self.engagementStates[id]=state
    if state.attempt then return end                                                
    state.attempt={at=self.io.now(),distance=d,hp=hp,signature=signature}
end 
Adaptive.learnEngagement =                   function(self,sample,now)
    if now<(self.nextEngagementObservation or 0) then return end
    self.nextEngagementObservation=now+.2
    for _,actor in ipairs(sample.actors or {}) do
        local profile=actor.signature and self:engagementProfile(actor.signature)
        if not profile or not actor.id then continue end
        local state=self.engagementStates[actor.id] or {};self.engagementStates[actor.id]=state
        local dt=state.at and math.clamp(now-state.at,0,.5) or 0
        local d=flat(actor.pos-sample.position).Magnitude
        local delta=flat(sample.position-actor.pos)
        local speed=actor.velocity.Magnitude
        local toward=delta.Magnitude>.1 and actor.velocity:Dot(delta.Unit) or 0
        local attack=false
        for _,effect in ipairs(sample.effects or {}) do if effect.owner==actor.id then attack=true;break end end
        local hpDrop=finite(actor.hp) and finite(state.hp) and actor.hp<state.hp-.5
        if hpDrop then state.provokedUntil=now+5 end
        local visible=actor.clear==true and math.abs(actor.pos.Y-sample.position.Y)<6
        local chasing=visible and speed>2 and toward>speed*.65
        local quiet=visible and speed<.6 and not attack
        if chasing then state.chaseTime=(state.chaseTime or 0)+dt else state.chaseTime=0 end
        if quiet then state.quietTime=(state.quietTime or 0)+dt else state.quietTime=0 end
        if not visible then state.mode=nil;state.quietDistance=nil end
        if state.quietTime>=1 and state.mode~="quiet" then
            if state.mode=="chasing" then
                profile.stops+=1
                self:engagementEvent({kind="pursuit stopped",signature=actor.signature,distance=d,at=now})
            end
            state.mode="quiet"
        end
        if state.mode=="quiet" and quiet then state.quietDistance=d end
        if state.chaseTime>=.3 and state.mode~="chasing" then
            if state.mode=="quiet" and state.quietDistance and actor.solo==true then
                local provoked=now<(state.provokedUntil or 0)
                if provoked then profile.provokedStarts+=1
                else
                    profile.starts+=1
                    local lo,hi=math.min(d,state.quietDistance),math.max(d,state.quietDistance)
                    profile.startLow=profile.startLow and math.min(profile.startLow,lo) or lo
                    profile.startHigh=profile.startHigh and math.max(profile.startHigh,hi) or hi
                end
                self:engagementEvent({kind=provoked and "provoked pursuit" or "proximity pursuit",signature=actor.signature,distance=d,at=now})
            end
            state.mode="chasing"
        end
        local binKey=tostring(math.floor(d/4));local bin=profile.bins[binKey]
        if visible then
            if not bin then bin={idle=0,chase=0,hits=0,misses=0};profile.bins[binKey]=bin end
            if quiet then bin.idle+=dt end
            if chasing then bin.chase+=dt end
        end
        local attempt=state.attempt
        if attempt then
            local age=now-attempt.at
            local hit=actor.solo==true and finite(actor.hp) and finite(attempt.hp) and actor.hp<attempt.hp-.5
            local window=math.max(4,(profile.hitDelayMax or 0)+1)
            if hit or age>=window then
                local k=tostring(math.floor(attempt.distance/4))
                local b=profile.bins[k] or {idle=0,chase=0,hits=0,misses=0};profile.bins[k]=b
                if hit then
                    b.hits+=1;profile.hitCount+=1;profile.hitDelayMax=math.min(10,math.max(profile.hitDelayMax or 0,age))
                elseif visible and actor.solo==true then b.misses+=1;profile.missCount+=1 end
                self:engagementEvent({kind=hit and "damage after attack" or "unconfirmed attack",signature=actor.signature,distance=attempt.distance,delay=age,at=now})
                state.attempt=nil
            end
        end
        state.at=now;state.hp=actor.hp
    end
end 
Adaptive.engagementDistance =                   function(self,signature,fallback)
    local p=signature and self.engagements[signature]
    if not p then return fallback end
    local proven
    for k,b in pairs(p.bins) do
        if b.hits>=3 and b.hits>b.misses then proven=math.max(proven or 0,tonumber(k)*4) end
    end
    if not proven then return fallback end
                                                                           
                                                                                  
    local reach=math.min(fallback,math.max(3,proven))
    if p.starts>=3 and p.startHigh and p.startHigh+2<=reach then return p.startHigh+2 end
    return reach
end 
Adaptive.selectCombatTarget =                   function(self,position,current,candidates,range)
    local nearest,nd,held,hd
    for _,x in ipairs(candidates) do
        local d=distance(x.pos,position)
        if x.id==current then held=x;hd=d end
        if x.clear~=false and (not nd or d<nd) then nearest=x;nd=d end
    end
    if nearest and nd<=range and (not held or held.clear==false or hd>range or nd<math.min(10,range*.3) and hd>nd+4) then return nearest.id end
    if held then return held.id end
    return nearest and nearest.id or candidates[1] and candidates[1].id
end 
Adaptive.attackFeasible =                   function(self,d,range,height,clear,failedElevation)
                                                                       
                                                                           
                                                                        
    if clear~=true then return false,"blocked line of fire" end
    if d>range then return false,"outside attack range" end
    if failedElevation then return false,"requires a new firing position" end
    return true,"attackable"
end 
                                                                                
                                                                                  
Adaptive.timedSegmentClear =                   function(self,from,to,offset,duration,forecast)
    local now=self.io.now();offset=math.max(0,offset or 0);duration=math.max(0,duration or 0)
    local speed=duration>0 and distance(from,to)/duration or 0
    local at; at =                   function(t)return duration>0 and from+(to-from)*math.clamp((t-offset)/duration,0,1)or from end 
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
        if self.io.now()>=self.deadline then return false end
        local first=math.max(offset,finite(h.safeBefore)and h.safeBefore-now or 0)
        local last=offset+duration
        if finite(h.untilTime)then last=math.min(last,h.untilTime-now)end
        if forecast and finite(h.clearAfter)and h.clearAfter>now then last=math.min(last,h.clearAfter-now)end
        if first>last then continue end
        local reach=h.span and h.span*.5 or h.size and h.size.Magnitude*.5 or h.radius or 0
        local velocity=h.motionVelocity or h.velocity or Vector3.zero
        local boundary=velocity.Magnitude+math.abs(h.turnRate or h.curveRate or 0)*reach
            +(h.growthRate or 0)+(h.motionUncertainty or 0)
        local steps=math.max(1,math.ceil((last-first)*(speed+boundary)/.5),
            speed+boundary>0 and math.ceil((last-first)/.04)or 1)
        if steps>160 then return false end
        local dt=(last-first)/steps;local padding=(speed+boundary)*dt*.5
        for i=0,steps do
            if i%8==0 and self.io.now()>=self.deadline then return false end
            local t=first+dt*i
            if self:hazardMargin(h,at(t),t)-padding<.75 then return false end
        end
    end
    for _,actor in ipairs(self.actors or {})do
        if self.io.now()>=self.deadline then return false end
        local steps=math.max(1,math.ceil(duration/.04));if steps>160 then return false end
        local dt=duration/steps;local padding=(speed+actor.velocity.Magnitude)*dt*.5
        for i=0,steps do
            local t=offset+i*dt;local point=at(t)
            local enemy=actor.pos+actor.velocity*math.clamp(t,0,.7)
            if math.abs(point.Y-enemy.Y)<6 and flat(point-enemy).Magnitude-actor.radius-padding<.75 then return false end
        end
    end
    return true
end 
Adaptive.timedTravelClear =                   function(self,from,to,offset,forecast)
    if self:travelSeconds(distance(from,to),offset)>distance(from,to)/math.max(1,self.speed)+.001 then return false end
    if self.io.mechanicPathSafe and not self.io.mechanicPathSafe(from,to,self.speed,offset,self.deadline)then return false end
    local duration=distance(from,to)/math.max(1,self.speed)
                                                                         
    return self:timedSegmentClear(from,to,offset,duration,forecast)
        and self:timedSegmentClear(from,to,offset,duration/ .8,forecast)
end 
Adaptive.releaseTimedDodge =                   function(self)
    if self.timedDodge then
        self.timedDodge=nil;self.route={};self.routeEscape=false;self.command=nil;self.search=nil
        self.io.stop()
    end
end 
Adaptive.driveTimedPoint =                   function(self,position,point)
    if not self:timedTravelClear(position,point,0,false)then return false end
    local checked,why=self:probe(position,point,false,true)
    if not checked or why=="budget" or distance(checked,point)>1 then return false end
    if not self:timedTravelClear(position,checked,0,false)then return false end
    local delta=flat(checked-position)
    if delta.Magnitude<.1 then return false end
    self.route={checked};self.routeEscape=true;self.routeMacro=false;self.routeDirect=false;self.routeStreamed=false
    self.routeSource="timed dodge";self.search=nil;self.progressWatch=nil;self.driveObservation=nil
    self.command=delta.Unit
    self.io.move(self.command,.1,checked)
    return true
end 
Adaptive.followTimedDodge =                   function(self,sample,now)
    local plan=self.timedDodge;if not plan then return false end
    if plan.revision~=self.revision or plan.context~=sample.routeContext or plan.target~=sample.targetId
        or now>=plan.deadline or self:pocketMotionRequired(now)then self:releaseTimedDodge();return false end
    local position=sample.position
                                                                       
    local exitArrival=distance(position,plan.exit)/(self.speed*.8)
    if self:timedTravelClear(position,plan.exit,0,false)
        and self:timedSegmentClear(plan.exit,plan.exit,exitArrival,math.max(.35,plan.deadline-now-exitArrival+.25),false)then
        if distance(position,plan.exit)<=.65 then
            self:releaseTimedDodge();self.status="timed dodge complete";return false
        end
        if self:driveTimedPoint(position,plan.exit)then plan.exiting=true;self.status="moving into cleared attack lane";return true end
        self:releaseTimedDodge();return false
    end
    if plan.exiting then self:releaseTimedDodge();return false end
    local travel=distance(position,plan.stage)/(self.speed*.8)
    local depart=math.max(now+travel,plan.depart)
    local exitTravel=distance(plan.stage,plan.exit)/(self.speed*.8)
    if depart+exitTravel+.15>=plan.deadline
        or not self:timedTravelClear(position,plan.stage,0,false)
        or not self:timedSegmentClear(plan.stage,plan.stage,travel,math.max(0,depart-now-travel)+.1,false)
        or not self:timedTravelClear(plan.stage,plan.exit,depart-now,true)then
        self:releaseTimedDodge();return false
    end
    if distance(position,plan.stage)>.65 then
        if self:driveTimedPoint(position,plan.stage)then self.status="moving into delayed warning";return true end
        self:releaseTimedDodge();return false
    end
    self.route={};self.command=nil;self.progressWatch=nil;self.driveObservation=nil
    self.io.stop();self.status="waiting for older attack to clear";return true
end 
Adaptive.updateTimedDodge =                   function(self,sample,now)
    if not sample.enabled or sample.evadeEnabled==false or sample.hp<=0 or not next(self.hazards)then
        self:releaseTimedDodge();return false
    end
    if self.timedDodge and self:followTimedDodge(sample,now)then return true end
    if now<(self.nextTimedSearch or 0)or self:pocketMotionRequired(now)then return false end
    local horizon=now;local clears={};local exits={}
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
        if self.io.now()>=self.deadline then return false end
        if finite(h.safeBefore)then horizon=math.max(horizon,h.safeBefore)end
    end
    local reach=math.max(0,horizon-now)*self.speed*.8
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
        if self.io.now()>=self.deadline then return false end
        if finite(h.clearAfter)and h.clearAfter>now and h.clearAfter<horizon then
            clears[#clears+1]=h.clearAfter+.04
            local point=h.pos
            if h.kind=="line" and h.axis then
                point=h.pos+h.axis*math.clamp((sample.position-h.pos):Dot(h.axis),-h.span*.45,h.span*.45)
            end
            if distance(sample.position,point)<=reach then exits[#exits+1]=point end
        end
    end
    if horizon<=now or self:threat(sample.position)>=.75
        or not self:timedSegmentClear(sample.position,sample.position,0,0,false)then return false end
    self.nextTimedSearch=now+.15
    table.sort(clears)
    local stages={sample.position};local heading=sample.goal and flat(sample.goal-sample.position)or Vector3.new(1,0,0)
    local base=math.atan2(heading.Z,heading.X)
    for i=0,7 do
        local direction=Vector3.new(math.cos(base+i*math.pi/4),0,math.sin(base+i*math.pi/4))
        stages[#stages+1]=sample.position+direction*math.min(8,reach*.3)
        exits[#exits+1]=sample.position+direction*math.min(18,reach*.65)
    end
    local checkedSegments={}
    local checkSegment; checkSegment =                   function(from,to)
        if distance(from,to)<.05 then return from end
        local id=string.format("%.3f:%.3f:%.3f>%.3f:%.3f:%.3f",from.X,from.Y,from.Z,to.X,to.Y,to.Z)
        local cached=checkedSegments[id]
        if cached~=nil then return cached or nil end
        local point=self:probe(from,to,false,true)
        checkedSegments[id]=point or false
        return point
    end 
    for _,stage in ipairs(stages)do
        local arrival=distance(sample.position,stage)/(self.speed*.8)
        local deadline
        for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
            if finite(h.safeBefore)and self:hazardMargin(h,stage,arrival)<.75 then
                deadline=math.min(deadline or math.huge,h.safeBefore)
            end
        end
        if not deadline or now+arrival+.2>=deadline or not self:timedTravelClear(sample.position,stage,0,false)then continue end
        local departures={now+arrival}
        for _,clear in ipairs(clears)do
            if clear>=deadline then break end
            if clear>now+arrival then departures[#departures+1]=clear end
        end
                                                                             
                                                                           
                                                                          
        for _,clear in ipairs(departures)do
            local depart=math.max(now+arrival,clear)
            if not self:timedSegmentClear(stage,stage,arrival,depart-now-arrival+.1,false)then continue end
            for _,exit in ipairs(exits)do
                if self.io.now()>=self.deadline or self.queries>=self.budget-2 then return false end
                local travel=distance(stage,exit)/(self.speed*.8)
                if travel<.05 or depart+travel+.15>=deadline
                    or not self:timedTravelClear(stage,exit,depart-now,true)
                    or not self:timedSegmentClear(exit,exit,depart-now+travel,math.max(.4,deadline-depart-travel+.25),true)then continue end
                local first=checkSegment(sample.position,stage)
                local second=first and checkSegment(first,exit)
                if not first or not second or distance(first,stage)>1 or distance(second,exit)>1 then continue end
                                                                               
                if not self:timedTravelClear(sample.position,first,0,false)
                    or not self:timedSegmentClear(first,first,arrival,depart-now-arrival+.1,false)
                    or not self:timedTravelClear(first,second,depart-now,true)then continue end
                self:releasePocket()
                self.timedDodge={stage=first,exit=second,depart=depart,deadline=deadline,
                    revision=self.revision,context=sample.routeContext,target=sample.targetId}
                return self:followTimedDodge(sample,now)
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end 
Adaptive.hazardMargin =                   function(self,h,p,time)
    time=time or 0
    if h.safeBefore and self.io.now()+time<h.safeBefore then return math.huge end
    if h.untilTime and self.io.now()+time>=h.untilTime then return math.huge end
    if h.scriptedMargin then return h.scriptedMargin(h,p,time,self.io.now())end
    if h.kind~="projectile" then
        local velocity=h.motionVelocity or h.velocity
        local q=p-(velocity or Vector3.zero)*time
        if h.turnRate and h.turnRate~=0 then
            local delta=q-h.pos;local angle=h.turnRate*time
            local c,s=math.cos(angle),math.sin(angle)
            q=h.pos+Vector3.new(delta.X*c+delta.Z*s,delta.Y,-delta.X*s+delta.Z*c)
        end
        return self.io.margin(h,q,time)-self:motionPadding(h,time)
    end
    local position=self:projectilePosition(h,time)
    if math.abs(p.Y-position.Y)>(h.height or 5) then return math.huge end
    return flat(p-position).Magnitude-(h.radius or 0)-self:motionPadding(h,time)
end 
Adaptive.margin =                   function(self,p,time)
    if self.evasionDisabled then return math.huge end
    local m=math.huge
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards) do m=math.min(m,self:hazardMargin(h,p,time or 0)) end
                                                                           
                                                                            
    for _,actor in ipairs(self.actors or {}) do
        if math.abs(p.Y-actor.pos.Y)<6 then
            local predicted=actor.pos+actor.velocity*math.clamp(time or 0,0,.7)
            m=math.min(m,flat(p-predicted).Magnitude-actor.radius)
        end
    end
    return m
end 
Adaptive.projectileSweep =                   function(self,from,to,duration,offset)
    if self.evasionDisabled then return math.huge end
    offset=offset or 0
    local worst=math.huge
    local playerVelocity=duration>0 and (to-from)/duration or Vector3.zero
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards) do
        if h.kind~="projectile" or not h.velocity then continue end
        local delay=h.launchTime and h.launchTime-self.io.now() or 0
        local first,last=math.max(0,delay-offset),duration
        if h.untilTime then last=math.min(last,h.untilTime-self.io.now()-offset) end
        if first>last then continue end
        if h.curveRate or (h.motionUncertainty or 0)>0 or (h.growthRate or 0)>0 then
            local steps=math.clamp(math.ceil((last-first)/.08),1,48)
            local dt=(last-first)/steps
            local start=from+playerVelocity*first-self:projectilePosition(h,offset+first)
            for i=1,steps do
                local t=first+dt*i
                local finish=from+playerVelocity*t-self:projectilePosition(h,offset+t)
                local delta=finish-start
                local lo,hi=0,1;local height=h.height or 5
                if math.abs(delta.Y)<.00001 then
                    if math.abs(start.Y)>height then start=finish;continue end
                else
                    local a,b=(-height-start.Y)/delta.Y,(height-start.Y)/delta.Y
                    lo=math.max(0,math.min(a,b));hi=math.min(1,math.max(a,b))
                end
                if lo<=hi then
                    local r,v=flat(start),flat(delta);local vv=v:Dot(v)
                    local u=vv>.00001 and math.clamp(-r:Dot(v)/vv,lo,hi) or lo
                    local curveError=h.velocity.Magnitude*math.abs(h.curveRate or 0)*dt*dt/8
                    worst=math.min(worst,(r+v*u).Magnitude-(h.radius or 0)-self:motionPadding(h,offset+t)-curveError)
                end
                start=finish
            end
            continue
        end
        local relative=from-(h.pos+h.velocity*(offset-delay))
        local velocity=playerVelocity-h.velocity
        local height=h.height or 5
        if math.abs(velocity.Y)<.0001 then
            if math.abs(relative.Y)>height then continue end
        else
            local a,b=(-height-relative.Y)/velocity.Y,(height-relative.Y)/velocity.Y
            first=math.max(first,math.min(a,b));last=math.min(last,math.max(a,b))
        end
        if first>last then continue end
        local r,v=flat(relative),flat(velocity);local vv=v:Dot(v)
        local t=vv>.0001 and math.clamp(-r:Dot(v)/vv,first,last) or first
        worst=math.min(worst,(r+v*t).Magnitude-(h.radius or 0))
    end
    return worst
end 
                                                                                
                                                                                 
Adaptive.surfaceSweep =                   function(self,from,to,duration,offset,threshold)
    if self.evasionDisabled then return math.huge end
    offset=offset or 0;threshold=threshold or .75
    local speed=duration>0 and distance(from,to)/duration or 0
    local worst=math.huge
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
        if h.kind=="projectile"then continue end
        local reach=h.span and math.sqrt(h.span*h.span+(h.thin or 0)^2)*.5+(h.clearance or 0)
            or h.size and h.size.Magnitude*.5 or h.radius or 0
        local boundary=(h.motionVelocity or h.velocity or Vector3.zero).Magnitude
            +math.abs(h.turnRate or 0)*reach+(h.growthRate or 0)+(h.motionUncertainty or 0)
        boundary=math.max(boundary,h.motionBoundarySpeed or 0)
        if boundary<.01 and not h.safeBefore and not h.scripted then continue end
        local first,last=offset,offset+duration
        if h.safeBefore then first=math.max(first,h.safeBefore-self.io.now())end
        if h.untilTime then last=math.min(last,h.untilTime-self.io.now()-.00001)end
        if last<first then continue end
                                                                                               
        if h.bossShape=="moving" and h.speed and h.speed>0 then
            local now=self.io.now();local stop=h.launch+h.length/h.speed-now
            local cuts={first};if stop>first and stop<last then cuts[#cuts+1]=stop end;cuts[#cuts+1]=last
            local playerVelocity=duration>0 and (to-from)/duration or Vector3.zero
            for i=1,#cuts-1 do
                local t0,t1=cuts[i],cuts[i+1]
                local player=from+playerVelocity*(t0-offset)
                local centre=h.origin+h.axis*math.clamp((now+t0-h.launch)*h.speed,0,h.length)
                local projectileVelocity=t0<stop and h.axis*h.speed or Vector3.zero
                local relative=player-centre;local velocity=playerVelocity-projectileVelocity
                local lo,hi=0,t1-t0;local height=h.height or 16
                if math.abs(velocity.Y)<.00001 then
                    if math.abs(relative.Y)>height then continue end
                else
                    local a,b=(-height-relative.Y)/velocity.Y,(height-relative.Y)/velocity.Y
                    lo=math.max(lo,math.min(a,b));hi=math.min(hi,math.max(a,b))
                end
                if lo<=hi then
                    local r,v=flat(relative),flat(velocity);local vv=v:Dot(v)
                    if h.halfLength then
                                                                                    
                                                                                     
                        local side=Vector3.new(-h.axis.Z,0,h.axis.X)
                        local pad=(h.clearance or 0)+threshold
                        for _,slab in ipairs({{h.axis,h.halfLength+pad},{side,(h.radius or 0)+pad}})do
                            local x,dx=r:Dot(slab[1]),v:Dot(slab[1])
                            if math.abs(dx)<.00001 then
                                if math.abs(x)>=slab[2]then lo=hi+1;break end
                            else
                                local a,b=(-slab[2]-x)/dx,(slab[2]-x)/dx
                                lo=math.max(lo,math.min(a,b));hi=math.min(hi,math.max(a,b))
                            end
                        end
                        if lo<hi then
                            local q=r+v*((lo+hi)*.5)
                            local gap=math.max(math.abs(q:Dot(h.axis))-h.halfLength-(h.clearance or 0),
                                math.abs(q:Dot(side))-(h.radius or 0)-(h.clearance or 0))
                            if gap<threshold then return gap end
                        end
                        continue
                    end
                    local t=vv>.00001 and math.clamp(-r:Dot(v)/vv,lo,hi) or lo
                    local gap=(r+v*t).Magnitude-(h.radius or 0)-(h.clearance or 0)
                    if gap<threshold then return gap end
                    worst=math.min(worst,gap)
                end
            end
            continue
        end
        local point; point =                   function(t)return duration>0 and from+(to-from)*math.clamp((t-offset)/duration,0,1)or from end 
        local left=self:hazardMargin(h,point(first),first)
        local right=self:hazardMargin(h,point(last),last)
        local stack={{first,last,left,right,0}};local visits=0
        while #stack>0 do
            visits+=1
            if visits>96 or visits%8==0 and self.io.now()>=self.deadline then return -math.huge end
            local row=table.remove(stack);local t0,t1,m0,m1,depth=table.unpack(row)
            local low=math.min(m0,m1)-(speed+boundary)*(t1-t0)*.5
            if low>=threshold then worst=math.min(worst,low)
            elseif math.min(m0,m1)<threshold then return math.min(m0,m1)
            elseif depth>=8 then return low
            else
                local mid=(t0+t1)*.5;local m=self:hazardMargin(h,point(mid),mid)
                stack[#stack+1]={t0,mid,m0,m,depth+1};stack[#stack+1]={mid,t1,m,m1,depth+1}
            end
        end
    end
    return worst
end 
Adaptive.rotatingLaserThreat =                   function(self,point,offset)
    local worst=math.huge;offset=offset or 0
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
        local laser=h.forestLaser
        if not laser then continue end
        local omega=math.abs(laser.angle)/math.max(.01,laser.finish-laser.spin)
        local sweep=omega*flat(point-laser.pos).Magnitude
        local width=math.min(h.size.X,h.size.Z)+2*(h.clearance or 0)+2
        local crossing=width/math.max(1,self.speed)
        local horizon=math.clamp(crossing*(1+sweep/math.max(1,self.speed)),.7,3)
        local steps=math.max(1,math.ceil(horizon/.05));local dt=horizon/steps
        local previous=self:hazardMargin(h,point,offset)
        for i=1,steps do
            local margin=self:hazardMargin(h,point,offset+i*dt)
            worst=math.min(worst,math.min(previous,margin)-sweep*dt*.5)
            previous=margin
        end
    end
    return worst
end 
Adaptive.wavefrontThreat =                   function(self,position)
    local worst=math.huge
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
        if h.kind=="circle" and not h.contain and not h.scripted and (h.growthRate or 0)>.1 then
            local speed=math.max(1,self.baseSpeed or self.speed)
            local lead=math.clamp(((h.radius or 0)+(h.clearance or 0)+2)/speed+.25,.75,3)
                                                                               
                                                                        
            for i=1,12 do
                worst=math.min(worst,self:hazardMargin(h,position,lead*i/12))
            end
        end
    end
    return worst
end 

Adaptive.threat =                   function(self,p)
    local m=math.min(self:margin(p,0),self:wavefrontThreat(p))
                                                                          
                                                                               
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
        if h.bossShape=="moving" then
            local horizon=math.clamp(((h.radius or 0)+(h.clearance or 0)+2)/math.max(1,self.speed)+.6,.7,2)
            for t=.8,horizon,.1 do m=math.min(m,self:hazardMargin(h,p,t))end
        end
    end
                                                                          
    local now=self.io.now()
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
        if h.safeBefore and h.safeBefore>now and h.kind=="circle" and not h.contain
            and (not h.bossShape or h.bossShape=="circle") and (not h.velocity or h.velocity.Magnitude<.1) and (not h.motionVelocity or h.motionVelocity.Magnitude<.1) then
            local future=self:hazardMargin(h,p,h.safeBefore-now+.01)
            if future<.75 and h.safeBefore-now<=(-future+.75)/math.max(1,self.warningSpeed or self.speed)+.4 then m=math.min(m,future)end
        end
    end
    for _,t in ipairs({.1,.2,.35,.5,.7}) do m=math.min(m,self:margin(p,t)) end
    return math.min(m,self:projectileSweep(p,p,.7),self:surfaceSweep(p,p,.7),self:rotatingLaserThreat(p,0))
end 
Adaptive.endpointMargin =                   function(self,p,arrival)
    local m=self:margin(p,arrival)
    local hold=self.continuousMovement and .25 or .7
                                                                         
                                                                 
    for _,t in ipairs({.1,.2,.35,.5,.7}) do if t<=hold then m=math.min(m,self:margin(p,arrival+t))end end
    m=math.min(m,self:margin(p,arrival+hold))
    return math.min(m,self:projectileSweep(p,p,hold,arrival),self:surfaceSweep(p,p,hold,arrival))
end 
Adaptive.spinnerEscapeSafe =                   function(self,from,to,offset)
    offset=offset or 0
    local duration=distance(from,to)/math.max(1,self.speed)
    if duration<.001 then return true end
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
        if not (h.forestLaser or h.spinExclusion or h.kind=="line" and math.abs(h.turnRate or 0)>.01)then continue end
        local initial=self:hazardMargin(h,from,offset)
        local previous=initial;local escaped=initial>=.75
        local steps=math.max(2,math.ceil(duration/.025))
        for i=1,steps do
            local t=duration*i/steps
            local moving=self:hazardMargin(h,from+(to-from)*(i/steps),offset+t)
            if escaped then
                if moving<.75 then return false end
            elseif moving<self:hazardMargin(h,from,offset+t)-.05 then return false end
            if moving>=.75 then escaped=true end
            previous=moving
        end
        if initial<.75 and previous<initial+.1 then return false end
        local imminent=self:hazardMargin(h,from,offset+math.min(.5,duration))
        if imminent<.75 and imminent<initial then
            local t=math.min(.2,duration)
            local moving=self:hazardMargin(h,from+(to-from)*(t/duration),offset+t)
            local staying=self:hazardMargin(h,from,offset+t)
            if moving<staying-.05 then return false end
        end
    end
    return true
end 
Adaptive.travelSeconds =                   function(self,length,offset)
    local speed=math.max(1,self.speed);local base=math.max(1,self.baseSpeed or speed)
    if base>=speed or not self.boostUntil then return length/speed end
    local remaining=math.max(0,self.boostUntil-self.io.now()-(offset or 0))
    local fast=math.min(length,speed*remaining)
    return fast/speed+(length-fast)/base
end 
Adaptive.constantSpeedPathRisk =                   function(self,from,to,timeOffset)
    if not self:spinnerEscapeSafe(from,to,timeOffset)then return false,-math.huge,"incoming spinner" end
    timeOffset=timeOffset or 0
    if self.io.mechanicPathSafe and not self.io.mechanicPathSafe(from,to,self.speed,timeOffset,self.deadline)then return false,-math.huge,"mechanic" end
    local d=distance(from,to);local initial=self:margin(from,timeOffset);local worst=math.huge
    if self.worldWarningReachable and self:worldWarningReachable(from,timeOffset)
        and not self:worldWarningReachable(to,timeOffset+self:travelSeconds(d,timeOffset)) then
        return false,-math.huge,"future escape"
    end
                                                                               
                                                                              
    if initial<.75 then
        local view=table.clone(self)
        setmetatable(view,getmetatable(self))
        local duration=d/math.max(1,self.speed)
        local samples=math.max(4,math.ceil(d/.75))
        for _,h in pairs(self.hazards) do
            local startGap=self:hazardMargin(h,from,timeOffset)
            if startGap>=0 then
                if self.io.now()>=self.deadline then return false,-math.huge,"validation budget" end
                local required=math.min(.75,startGap)-.05
                view.hazards={h}
                local gap=math.min(view:projectileSweep(from,to,duration,timeOffset),view:surfaceSweep(from,to,duration,timeOffset,required))
                if gap<required then return false,gap,"separate hazard" end
                for i=1,samples do
                    local t=i/samples
                    gap=self:hazardMargin(h,from+(to-from)*t,timeOffset+duration*t)
                    if gap<required then return false,gap,"separate hazard" end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    worst=math.min(worst,self:projectileSweep(from,to,d/math.max(1,self.speed),timeOffset))
    worst=math.min(worst,self:surfaceSweep(from,to,d/math.max(1,self.speed),timeOffset,.75))
    if worst<math.min(initial,0)-.15 then return false,worst end
    local samples=math.max(4,math.ceil(d/.75))
    for i=1,samples do
        local t=i/samples;local m=self:margin(from+(to-from)*t,timeOffset+d*t/math.max(1,self.speed))
        worst=math.min(worst,m)
        if m<math.min(initial,0)-.15 then return false,worst end
    end
    return true,worst
end 
Adaptive.pathRisk =                   function(self,from,to,timeOffset)
    timeOffset=timeOffset or 0
    local speed=math.max(1,self.speed);local base=math.max(1,self.baseSpeed or speed)
    local length=distance(from,to)
    local remaining=self.boostUntil and math.max(0,self.boostUntil-self.io.now()-timeOffset) or math.huge
    if base>=speed or length<=speed*remaining then return self:constantSpeedPathRisk(from,to,timeOffset) end
    local fraction=length>.001 and math.min(1,speed*remaining/length) or 0
    local middle=from+(to-from)*fraction
    local safe,worst,reason=true,math.huge,nil
    if fraction>0 then safe,worst,reason=self:constantSpeedPathRisk(from,middle,timeOffset) end
    if not safe then return false,worst,reason end
    self.speed=base
    local ok,nextSafe,nextWorst,why=pcall(self.constantSpeedPathRisk,self,middle,to,timeOffset+remaining)
    self.speed=speed
    if not ok then error(nextSafe) end
    return nextSafe,math.min(worst,nextWorst),why
end 
                                                                               
                                                                         
Adaptive.pocketClearance =                   function(self,point,arrival,horizon)
    horizon=horizon or 1.2
    local worst=math.min(self:projectileSweep(point,point,horizon,arrival),self:surfaceSweep(point,point,horizon,arrival))
    if worst<.75 then return worst end
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards) do
        if self.io.now()>=self.deadline then return nil end
        if h.kind=="projectile" then continue end
        local velocity=h.motionVelocity or h.velocity or Vector3.zero
        local reach=h.span and h.span*.5 or h.size and h.size.Magnitude*.5 or h.radius or 0
        local boundarySpeed=velocity.Magnitude+math.abs(h.turnRate or 0)*reach+(h.growthRate or 0)+(h.motionUncertainty or 0)
        local steps=boundarySpeed>.01 and 10 or 1
        local dt=horizon/steps
        local previous=self:hazardMargin(h,point,arrival)
        worst=math.min(worst,previous)
        for i=1,steps do
            local margin=self:hazardMargin(h,point,arrival+i*dt)
                                                                                
                                                                            
            worst=math.min(worst,math.min(previous,margin)-boundarySpeed*dt*.5)
            if worst<.75 then return worst end
            previous=margin
        end
    end
    for _,actor in ipairs(self.actors or {}) do
        for i=0,6 do
            local t=arrival+horizon*i/6
            local predicted=actor.pos+actor.velocity*math.clamp(t,0,.7)
            if math.abs(point.Y-predicted.Y)<6 then
                local padding=t<.9 and actor.velocity.Magnitude*.1 or 0
                worst=math.min(worst,flat(point-predicted).Magnitude-actor.radius-padding)
            end
        end
        if worst<.75 then return worst end
    end
    return worst
end 
Adaptive.pocketPathClear =                   function(self,from,to)
    if not self:clearMotion(from,to) then return false end
    local duration=distance(from,to)/self.speed
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards) do
        if self.io.now()>=self.deadline then return false end
        if h.kind=="projectile" then continue end
        local reach=h.span and h.span*.5 or h.size and h.size.Magnitude*.5 or h.radius or 0
        local boundarySpeed=(h.motionVelocity or h.velocity or Vector3.zero).Magnitude
            +math.abs(h.turnRate or 0)*reach+(h.growthRate or 0)+(h.motionUncertainty or 0)
        if boundarySpeed<.01 or self:hazardMargin(h,from,0)<.75 then continue end
        local steps=math.max(1,math.ceil(duration/.08));local dt=duration/steps
        local previous=self:hazardMargin(h,from,0)
        for i=1,steps do
            local margin=self:hazardMargin(h,from+(to-from)*(i/steps),duration*i/steps)
            if math.min(previous,margin)-(self.speed+boundarySpeed)*dt*.5<.75 then return false end
            previous=margin
        end
    end
    return true
end 
Adaptive.releasePocket =                   function(self)
    if self.safePocket then
        self.route={};self.routeEscape=false;self.command=nil;self.search=nil
    end
    self.safePocket=nil
end 
Adaptive.pocketMotionRequired =                   function(self,now)
    if self.keepCombatMotion or self:anticipatingAttack(now) then return true end
    for _,e in pairs(self.attackEpisodes) do
        local profile=self.continuityProfiles[e.key]
        if not e.cleared and e.exposed and not e.present and profile and profile.n>=3 and profile.exposed>=2
            and now-e.at<math.min(8,profile.maxDuration+(profile.maxDuration-profile.minDuration)+.1) then return true end
    end
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards) do
        local pattern=h.pattern and self.patterns[h.pattern]
        if pattern and pattern.shape and pattern.shape.anchor=="player" then return true end
    end
    return false
end 
Adaptive.updateSafePocket =                   function(self,sample,now,danger)
    if sample.evadeEnabled==false or not sample.enabled or sample.hp<=0 or not next(self.hazards)
        or self:pocketMotionRequired(now) then
        self:releasePocket();self.pocketScan=nil;return false
    end
    local position=sample.position
    local pocket=self.safePocket
    if pocket and (pocket.revision~=self.revision or pocket.context~=sample.routeContext
        or pocket.target~=sample.targetId or sample.goal and pocket.goal and distance(sample.goal,pocket.goal)>8) then
        self:releasePocket();pocket=nil
    end
    if pocket then
        local length=distance(position,pocket.point)
        local clearance=self:pocketClearance(pocket.point,length/self.speed)
        if clearance and clearance>=.75 then
            if length<=.85 and math.abs(position.Y-pocket.point.Y)<1 then
                local standing=self:pocketClearance(position,0)
                if sample.canAttack and standing and standing>=.75 then
                    self.route={};self.command=nil;self.search=nil;self.progressWatch=nil;self.driveObservation=nil
                    self.io.stop();self.status="holding safe position";return true
                end
            elseif length<=36 and self:pocketPathClear(position,pocket.point) then
                self.route={pocket.point};self.routeEscape=true;self.routeMacro=false;self.routeDirect=false;self.routeStreamed=false
                self.routeSource="safe position";self.search=nil
                if self:drive(position,true) then self.status="moving to safe position";return true end
            end
        end
        self:releasePocket()
        self.nextPocketSearch=0
    end
    if not danger and not sample.canAttack then return false end
    if not sample.canAttack and self.route[1] and self:escapeRouteSafe(position) then return false end
                                                                  
    if sample.canAttack then
        local clearance=self:pocketClearance(position,0)
        if clearance and clearance>=.75 then
            self.safePocket={point=position,goal=sample.goal,revision=self.revision,context=sample.routeContext,target=sample.targetId}
            self.route={};self.command=nil;self.search=nil;self.progressWatch=nil;self.driveObservation=nil
            self.io.stop();self.status="holding safe position";return true
        end
    end
    if now<(self.nextPocketSearch or 0) then return false end
    self.nextPocketSearch=now+.2
    local scan=self.pocketScan
    if not scan or distance(position,scan.origin)>8 or scan.revision~=self.revision then
        scan={origin=position,index=0,revision=self.revision};self.pocketScan=scan
    end
    local candidates={}
    local heading=sample.goal and flat(sample.goal-position) or Vector3.new(1,0,0)
    if heading.Magnitude<.1 then heading=Vector3.new(1,0,0) end
    local base=math.atan2(heading.Z,heading.X)
                                                                              
    local bossPoints=self.io.bossPocketPoints and self.io.bossPocketPoints(position)or {}
    for _=1,16 do
        if self.io.now()>=self.deadline-.0008 then break end
        local index=scan.index;scan.index=(scan.index+1)%48
        local radius=math.min(30,self.speed*(.4+math.floor(index/16)*.4))
        local angle=base+(index%16)*math.pi/8
        local point=scan.origin+Vector3.new(math.cos(angle),0,math.sin(angle))*radius
        if bossPoints[index+1]then point=bossPoints[index+1]end
        local length=distance(position,point);local arrival=self:travelSeconds(length)
        local clearance=self:pocketClearance(point,arrival)
        if clearance and clearance>=.75 then
            local progress=sample.goal and distance(point,sample.goal)-distance(position,sample.goal) or 0
            local score=length*.12+math.max(0,progress)*.12-math.min(8,clearance)*.2
            if self.pursueWhileDodging then score+=progress*.5 end
            local lasting=self:pocketClearance(point,arrival,2.4)
            if lasting and lasting>=.75 then score-=3 end
            local commit=self.directionCommit
            if commit and self.io.now()<commit.untilAt and length>.1 then
                score+=math.max(0,.5-flat(point-position).Unit:Dot(commit.direction))*6
            end
            candidates[#candidates+1]={point=point,score=score}
        end
    end
    table.sort(candidates,                  function(a,b)return a.score<b.score end )
    for i=1,math.min(2,#candidates) do
        if self.io.now()>=self.deadline-.0003 or self.queries>=self.budget-3 then break end
        local point=candidates[i].point
        if not self:pocketPathClear(position,point) then continue end
        local checked,why=self:probe(position,point,false,true)
        if why=="budget" then break end
        if not checked or distance(checked,point)>1.5 then continue end
        local clearance=self:pocketClearance(checked,self:travelSeconds(distance(position,checked)))
        if not clearance or clearance<.75 or not self:pocketPathClear(position,checked) then continue end
        self.safePocket={point=checked,goal=sample.goal,revision=self.revision,context=sample.routeContext,target=sample.targetId}
        self.route={checked};self.routeEscape=true;self.routeMacro=false;self.routeDirect=false;self.routeStreamed=false
        self.search=nil;self.escapeCandidates=nil;self.routeSource="safe position"
        if self:drive(position,true) then self.status="moving to safe position";return true end
        self:releasePocket()
    end
    return false
end 
Adaptive.escapeRouteSafe =                   function(self,position)
    local previous=position;local elapsed=0
    if not self.route[1] then return false end
    if #self.route==1 then return self:clearMotion(position,self.route[1]) end
    for _,point in ipairs(self.route) do
        local safe,worst=self:pathRisk(previous,point,elapsed)
        if not safe or self:margin(previous,elapsed)>=.75 and worst<.75 then return false end
        elapsed+=self:travelSeconds(distance(previous,point),elapsed)
        previous=point
    end
    return self:endpointMargin(previous,elapsed)>=.75
end 
Adaptive.overlapEscapeSafe =                   function(self,from,to)
    if not self:spinnerEscapeSafe(from,to,0)then return false end
                                                                            
                                                                           
                                                                                 
    local duration=distance(from,to)/math.max(1,self.speed)
    if duration>1.25 then return false end
    local covering={};local checked={}
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards) do
        if h.kind=="projectile" then continue end
        local initial=self:hazardMargin(h,from,0)
        checked[#checked+1]={h=h,initial=initial}
        if initial<0 then
            local distinct=true
            for _,other in ipairs(covering) do
                if flat(h.pos-other.pos).Magnitude<.5 then distinct=false;break end
            end
            if distinct then covering[#covering+1]=h end
        end
    end
    if #covering<2 then return false end
    if self:endpointMargin(to,duration)<.75 or self:projectileSweep(from,to,duration)<.75 then return false end
    local samples=math.max(4,math.ceil(distance(from,to)/.75))
    for i=1,samples do
        local fraction=i/samples;local p=from+(to-from)*fraction;local t=duration*fraction
        for _,row in ipairs(checked) do
                                                                                
                                                                                   
            if row.initial>=0 and self:hazardMargin(row.h,p,t)<math.min(.75,row.initial)-.05 then return false end
        end
        for _,actor in ipairs(self.actors or {}) do
            if math.abs(p.Y-actor.pos.Y)<6 then
                local initial=flat(from-actor.pos).Magnitude-actor.radius
                local predicted=actor.pos+actor.velocity*math.clamp(t,0,.7)
                if flat(p-predicted).Magnitude-actor.radius<math.min(.75,initial)-.05 then return false end
            end
        end
    end
    return true
end 
Adaptive.warningDestinationSafe =                   function(self,from,to)
    local now=self.io.now()
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
        if h.kind=="circle" and not h.contain and h.safeBefore and h.safeBefore>now
            and (not h.bossShape or h.bossShape=="circle")then
