            local lead=h.safeBefore-now
            local first=self:hazardMargin(h,from,lead+.01)
            if first<.75 and lead<=(-first+.75)/math.max(1,self.warningSpeed or self.speed)+.4
                and self:hazardMargin(h,to,lead+.01)<.75 then return false end
        end
    end
    return true
end 
Adaptive.clearMotion =                   function(self,from,to)
                                                                               
    if not self:warningDestinationSafe(from,to) then return false,"warning destination" end
    local safe,worst,why=self:pathRisk(from,to)
    if why=="mechanic" or why=="separate hazard" or why=="future escape" or why=="validation budget" then return false,why end
    if not safe then
        if self:travelSeconds(distance(from,to))>distance(from,to)/math.max(1,self.speed)+.001 then return self:completeRecoverySafe(from,to),"boost transition recovery" end
        return self:overlapEscapeSafe(from,to),"overlap trajectory"
    end
                                                                            
                                                                            
    if self:margin(from,0)>=.75 and worst<.75 then return false,"trajectory clearance" end
    return self:endpointMargin(to,self:travelSeconds(distance(from,to)))>=.75,"endpoint settling window"
end 
Adaptive.escapeOutlet =                   function(self,from,point)
                                                                               
    if self:margin(from,0)<.75 then return true end
    local delta=flat(point-from)
    if delta.Magnitude<.1 then return false end
    local heading=delta.Unit;local side=Vector3.new(-heading.Z,0,heading.X)
    local arrival=self:travelSeconds(delta.Magnitude)
    local reach=math.clamp(self.speed*.25,3,6)
    for _,direction in ipairs({heading,side,-side}) do
        if self.io.now()>=self.deadline or self.queries>=self.budget-1 then return nil,"budget" end
        local endpoint=point+direction*reach
        local ok,worst=self:pathRisk(point,endpoint,arrival)
        if ok and worst>=.75 and self:endpointMargin(endpoint,arrival+self:travelSeconds(reach,arrival))>=.75 then
            local p,why=self:probe(point,endpoint,false,true)
            if why=="budget" then return nil,why end
            if p and distance(p,endpoint)<1.5 then return true end
        end
    end
    return false,"no checked outlet"
end 
Adaptive.exposureStepScore =                   function(self,from,to)
    if self.worldWarningReachable and self:worldWarningReachable(from,0)
        and not self:worldWarningReachable(to,self:travelSeconds(distance(from,to)))then return nil end
    if self:travelSeconds(distance(from,to))>distance(from,to)/math.max(1,self.speed)+.001 then return nil end
    if not self:spinnerEscapeSafe(from,to,0)then return nil end
    local length=distance(from,to);local duration=length/math.max(1,self.speed)
    if length<.05 or duration>1.25 or self:margin(from,0)>=.75 and self:margin(from,.35)>=.75 then return nil end
    if self.io.mechanicPathSafe and not self.io.mechanicPathSafe(from,to,self.speed,0,self.deadline)then return nil end
    local moving,staying,initial,finish=0,0,0,0
    local steps=math.max(8,math.ceil(duration/.04))
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
                                                                   
        local start=math.min(self:hazardMargin(h,from,0),self:hazardMargin(h,from,.35))
        initial+=math.max(0,.75-start)
        finish+=math.max(0,.75-math.min(self:hazardMargin(h,to,duration),self:hazardMargin(h,to,math.max(duration,.35))))
        for i=1,steps do
            local t=duration*i/steps
            local movingMargin=self:hazardMargin(h,from+(to-from)*(i/steps),t)
            local stationaryMargin=self:hazardMargin(h,from,t)
            if stationaryMargin>=.75 and movingMargin<.75 then return nil end
            moving+=math.max(0,.75-movingMargin)
            staying+=math.max(0,.75-self:hazardMargin(h,from,t))
        end
    end
                                                                               
                                                                               
    for _,actor in ipairs(self.actors or {})do
        if math.abs(from.Y-actor.pos.Y)<6 then
            local start=flat(from-actor.pos).Magnitude-actor.radius
            initial+=math.max(0,.75-start)
            finish+=math.max(0,.75-(flat(to-(actor.pos+actor.velocity*duration)).Magnitude-actor.radius))
            for i=1,steps do
                local t=duration*i/steps
                local predicted=actor.pos+actor.velocity*t
                moving+=math.max(0,.75-(flat(from+(to-from)*(i/steps)-predicted).Magnitude-actor.radius))
                staying+=math.max(0,.75-(flat(from-predicted).Magnitude-actor.radius))
            end
        end
    end
                                                                           
                                                                            
    if initial-finish<.25 or staying<=0 or moving>=staying*.8 then return nil end
    for _,actor in ipairs(self.actors or {})do
        if math.abs(from.Y-actor.pos.Y)<6 then
            local gap=flat(from-actor.pos).Magnitude-actor.radius
            for i=1,steps do
                local t=duration*i/steps
                if flat(from+(to-from)*(i/steps)-(actor.pos+actor.velocity*t)).Magnitude-actor.radius<math.min(.75,gap)-.05 then return nil end
            end
        end
    end
    return (staying-moving)/steps
end 
Adaptive.treeOverlapExit =                   function(self,position)
    if self:margin(position,0)>=.75 then return false end
    local directions={}
    local function add(d)
        d=flat(d);if d.Magnitude<.01 then return end;d=d.Unit
        for _,v in ipairs(directions)do if v:Dot(d)>.985 then return end end
        directions[#directions+1]=d
    end
    if self.command then add(self.command)end
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
        if h.kind=="line"and h.axis and self:hazardMargin(h,position,0)<.75 then
            local side=Vector3.new(-h.axis.Z,0,h.axis.X);add(side);add(-side)
        end
    end
    for i=0,15 do local angle=i*math.pi/8;add(Vector3.new(math.cos(angle),0,math.sin(angle)))end
    local candidates={}
    local first=self.overlapDirection or 1
    for offset=0,#directions-1 do
        local index=(first+offset-1)%#directions+1
        local d=directions[index]
        self.overlapDirection=index%#directions+1
        for _,seconds in ipairs({1.2,.8,.45})do
            if self.io.now()>=self.deadline then break end
            local point=position+d*self.speed*seconds
            local score=self:exposureStepScore(position,point)
            if score then
                local clear=self:endpointMargin(point,seconds)>=.75
                candidates[#candidates+1]={point=point,score=(clear and 10000 or 0)+score/seconds,clear=clear}
            end
        end
        if self.io.now()>=self.deadline then break end
    end
    table.sort(candidates,function(a,b)return a.score>b.score end)
                                                                                               
    self.deadline=self.io.now()+.003
    for i=1,math.min(4,#candidates)do
        local point,why=self:probe(position,candidates[i].point,false,true)
        if why=="budget"then return false end
        if point and flat(point-candidates[i].point).Magnitude<1 and self:exposureStepScore(position,point)then
            self.route={point};self.routeEscape=true;self.routeDirect=false;self.routeMacro=false;self.routeStreamed=false
            self.routeSource="partial overlap exit";self.search=nil;self.escapeCandidates=nil
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end 
Adaptive.completeRecoverySafe =                   function(self,from,to)
    local length=distance(from,to)
    local duration=self:travelSeconds(length)
    if length<.05 or duration>4 or self:endpointMargin(to,duration)<.75 then return false end
    if self.io.mechanicPathSafe and not self.io.mechanicPathSafe(from,to,self.speed,0,self.deadline)then return false end
    local now=self.io.now();local boosted=self.boostUntil and math.max(0,self.boostUntil-now)or duration
    local speed=math.max(1,self.speed);local base=math.min(speed,self.baseSpeed or speed)
    local count=math.ceil((duration+.35)/.04);local improvement=0
    local checks=0
    local function exhausted()
        checks+=1
        return checks>512 or self.io.now()>=self.deadline
    end
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
        local moving,staying=0,0
        for i=0,count do
            if exhausted()then return false end
            local t=(duration+.35)*i/count
            local travelled=speed*math.min(t,boosted)+base*math.max(0,t-boosted)
            local p=from+(to-from)*math.min(1,travelled/length)
            local still=self:hazardMargin(h,from,t);local gap=self:hazardMargin(h,p,t)
            if still>=.75 and gap<.75 then return false end
            moving+=math.max(0,.75-gap);staying+=math.max(0,.75-still)
        end
        if moving>staying+.05 then return false end
        improvement+=staying-moving
    end
    for _,actor in ipairs(self.actors or {})do
        if math.abs(from.Y-actor.pos.Y)<6 then
            local initial=flat(from-actor.pos).Magnitude-actor.radius
            for i=0,count do
                if exhausted()then return false end
                local t=duration*i/count
                local travelled=speed*math.min(t,boosted)+base*math.max(0,t-boosted)
                local p=from+(to-from)*math.min(1,travelled/length)
                local predicted=actor.pos+(actor.velocity or Vector3.zero)*math.min(t,.7)
                if flat(p-predicted).Magnitude-actor.radius<math.min(.75,initial)-.05 then return false end
            end
        end
    end
    return improvement>.25
end 
Adaptive.completeRecovery =                   function(self,position)
    local candidates={};local preferred=self.command or self.escapePreferred
    local directions={}
    if preferred and flat(preferred).Magnitude>.05 then directions[1]=flat(preferred).Unit end
    for i=0,15 do local angle=i*math.pi/8;directions[#directions+1]=Vector3.new(math.cos(angle),0,math.sin(angle))end
    local lengths={18,26,38,52,64}
    local total=#directions*#lengths
    for _=1,math.min(total,8) do
            if self.io.now()>=self.deadline then return false end
            local index=(self.recoveryCursor or 0)%total
            self.recoveryCursor=(index+1)%total
            local direction=directions[math.floor(index/#lengths)+1]
            local length=lengths[index%#lengths+1]
            local target=position+direction*length
            if self:completeRecoverySafe(position,target)then
                local point,why=self:probe(position,target,false,true)
                if why=="budget"then return false end
                if point and distance(point,target)<1 and self:completeRecoverySafe(position,point)then
                    self.route={point};self.routeEscape=true;self.routeDirect=false;self.routeMacro=false;self.routeStreamed=false
                    self.routeSource="complete recovery exit";self.search=nil;self.escapeCandidates=nil
                    return true
                end
            end
    end
    return false
end 

Adaptive.reduceExposure =                   function(self,position)
    if self:chooseEscape(position,false)then return true end
    self.deadline=self.io.now()+.008;self.budget=math.max(self.budget,self.queries+4)
    return self:completeRecovery(position)
end 
local wallCoordinates; wallCoordinates =                   function(w,p)
    local d=p-w.center
    return d:Dot(w.normal),d:Dot(w.tangent)
end 
local wallCrosses; wallCrosses =                   function(w,from,to)
    if math.min(from.Y,to.Y)>w.top+2 or math.max(from.Y,to.Y)<w.bottom-2 then return false end
    local a,u=wallCoordinates(w,from);local b,v=wallCoordinates(w,to)
    if a*b>=0 or math.abs(a-b)<.001 then return false end
    local t=a/(a-b)
    return math.abs(u+(v-u)*t)<w.halfLength+2
end 
Adaptive.noteWall =                   function(self,w,from)
    if w then
        self.knownWalls=self.knownWalls or {}
        if not self.knownWalls[w] then
            local count=0;for _ in pairs(self.knownWalls) do count+=1 end
            if count<64 then self.knownWalls[w]=true;self.wallGraphDirty=true end
        end
    end
    local position=self.observation and self.observation.p
    if not w or not position or distance(position,from)>8 then return end
    local d,u=wallCoordinates(w,position)
    if math.abs(d)>w.halfThickness+10 or math.abs(u)>w.halfLength+3 then return end
    self.walls=self.walls or {}
    local record=self.walls[w]
    if not record then
        local count=0;for _ in pairs(self.walls) do count+=1 end
        if count>=32 then return end
        record={wall=w,seconds=0};self.walls[w]=record
    end
    record.lastHit=self.io.now()
end 
Adaptive.updateWalls =                   function(self,position,goal,enabled)
    local now=self.io.now();local dt=math.clamp(now-(self.wallTick or now),0,.25);self.wallTick=now
    self.blacklistedWalls=0
    for w,r in pairs(self.walls or {}) do
        if self.io.wallCurrent and not self.io.wallCurrent(w) then
            self.walls[w]=nil
            self.wallGraphDirty=true
            self.probeCache={};self.search=nil;self.failedSearch=nil;self.retryAt=0
            continue
        end
        local d,u=wallCoordinates(w,position)
        if not r.blocked and enabled and goal and now-r.lastHit<5
            and math.abs(d)<=w.halfThickness+10 and math.abs(u)<=w.halfLength+3
            and wallCrosses(w,position,goal) then
            r.seconds+=dt
            if r.seconds>=60 then
                r.blocked=true;r.blockedAt=now
                self.wallBlacklistEpoch=(self.wallBlacklistEpoch or 0)+1
                self.wallGraphDirty=true
                self.lastBlockedWall=w.name
                self.route={};self.command=nil;self.search=nil;self.offeredRoute=nil
                self.failedSearch=nil;self.retryAt=0;self.directFailure=nil;self.rejectedHandoff=nil
                self.probeCache={};self.cacheCount=0
                if self.io.wallBlocked then self.io.wallBlocked(w,r.seconds) end
            end
        end
        if r.blocked then self.blacklistedWalls+=1 end
    end
end 
local wallVisibility; wallVisibility =                   function(walls,from,to)
    for _,w in ipairs(walls) do
        if math.min(from.Y,to.Y)>w.top+2 or math.max(from.Y,to.Y)<w.bottom-2 then continue end
        local a,u=wallCoordinates(w,from);local b,v=wallCoordinates(w,to)
        local lo,hi=0,1
        for _,axis in ipairs({{a,b-a,w.halfThickness+1.25},{u,v-u,w.halfLength+1.25}}) do
            if math.abs(axis[2])<.00001 then
                if math.abs(axis[1])>=axis[3] then lo=2;break end
            else
                local x=(-axis[3]-axis[1])/axis[2];local y=(axis[3]-axis[1])/axis[2]
                lo=math.max(lo,math.min(x,y));hi=math.min(hi,math.max(x,y))
            end
        end
        if lo<hi and hi>0 and lo<1 then return false end
    end
    return true
end 
Adaptive.prepareWallGraph =                   function(self,position,goal)
    if not goal or (self.blacklistedWalls or 0)==0 then self.wallGraph=nil;return end
    for w in pairs(self.knownWalls or {}) do
        if self.io.wallCurrent and not self.io.wallCurrent(w) then self.knownWalls[w]=nil;self.wallGraphDirty=true end
    end
    local current=self.wallGraphWork or self.wallGraph
    if self.wallGraphDirty or not current or distance(current.goal,goal)>2 then
        local choices={};local seen={}
        local include; include =                   function(w)
            if seen[w] or position.Y>w.top+2 or position.Y<w.bottom-2 then return end;seen[w]=true
            local d,u=wallCoordinates(w,position)
            local gap=math.max(0,math.abs(d)-w.halfThickness)+math.max(0,math.abs(u)-w.halfLength)
            if gap<160 then choices[#choices+1]={wall=w,gap=gap} end
        end 
        for w in pairs(self.knownWalls or {}) do include(w) end
        for w in pairs(self.walls or {}) do include(w) end
        table.sort(choices,                  function(a,b)return a.gap<b.gap end )
        local g={walls={},points={goal},edges={},cost={[1]=0},closed={},goal=goal,i=1,j=2}
        for i=1,math.min(6,#choices) do
            local w=choices[i].wall;g.walls[#g.walls+1]=w
            for _,side in ipairs({-1,1}) do for _,ending in ipairs({-1,1}) do
                local p=w.center+w.normal*(side*(w.halfThickness+2.75))+w.tangent*(ending*(w.halfLength+2.75))
                g.points[#g.points+1]=Vector3.new(p.X,position.Y,p.Z)
            end end
        end
        self.wallGraphWork=g;self.wallGraphDirty=false;self.wallGraph=nil;self.wallDistanceCache={}
    end
    local g=self.wallGraphWork;if not g then return end
    local deadline=self.io.now()+.0006
                                                                        
                                                                          
    for _=1,20 do
        if self.io.now()>deadline then return end
        if g.i>=#g.points then break end
        local i,j=g.i,g.j
        if wallVisibility(g.walls,g.points[i],g.points[j]) then
            g.edges[i]=g.edges[i] or {};g.edges[j]=g.edges[j] or {}
            local d=distance(g.points[i],g.points[j]);g.edges[i][j]=d;g.edges[j][i]=d
        end
        g.j+=1;if g.j>#g.points then g.i+=1;g.j=g.i+1 end
    end
    if g.i<#g.points then return end
    for _=1,4 do
        local selected,best=nil,math.huge
        for i,cost in pairs(g.cost) do if not g.closed[i] and cost<best then selected,best=i,cost end end
        if not selected then
            self.wallGraph=g;self.wallGraphWork=nil;self.wallDistanceCache={}
            self.search=nil;self.failedSearch=nil;self.retryAt=0;self.directFailure=nil
            if not self.routeEscape then self.route={};self.command=nil;self.offeredRoute=nil end
            return
        end
        g.closed[selected]=true
        for i,length in pairs(g.edges[selected] or {}) do
            local cost=best+length;if not g.cost[i] or cost<g.cost[i] then g.cost[i]=cost end
        end
    end
end 
Adaptive.wallBlockedPath =                   function(self,from,to)
    if self.manualOverride then return false end
    for w,r in pairs(self.walls or {}) do
        if not r.blocked then continue end
        if wallCrosses(w,from,to) then return true end
        if math.min(from.Y,to.Y)>w.top+2 or math.max(from.Y,to.Y)<w.bottom-2 then continue end
        local a=wallCoordinates(w,from);local b,v=wallCoordinates(w,to)
                                                                            
                                                                              
        if math.abs(v)<w.halfLength+2 and math.abs(b)<w.halfThickness+3
            and math.abs(b)<math.abs(a)-.05 then return true end
    end
    return false
end 
Adaptive.routeDistance =                   function(self,position,goal)
    local graph=self.wallGraph
    if graph and distance(goal,graph.goal)<2 then
        local k=key(position);local cached=self.wallDistanceCache[k]
        if cached then return cached end
        local best=math.huge
        for i,p in ipairs(graph.points) do
            local cost=graph.cost[i]
            if cost and distance(position,p)+cost<best and wallVisibility(graph.walls,position,p) then best=distance(position,p)+cost end
        end
        if best<math.huge then self.wallDistanceCache[k]=best;return best end
    end
    local estimate=distance(position,goal)
    for w,r in pairs(self.walls or {}) do
        if not r.blocked or not wallCrosses(w,position,goal) then continue end
        local d=wallCoordinates(w,position);local side=d>=0 and 1 or -1
        local best=math.huge
        for _,sign in ipairs({-1,1}) do
            local endPoint=w.center+w.tangent*(sign*(w.halfLength+3))
            endPoint=Vector3.new(endPoint.X,position.Y,endPoint.Z)
            local near=endPoint+w.normal*(side*(w.halfThickness+3))
            local far=endPoint-w.normal*(side*(w.halfThickness+3))
            best=math.min(best,distance(position,near)+distance(near,far)+distance(far,goal))
        end
        estimate=math.max(estimate,best)
    end
    return estimate
end 
Adaptive.noteConnectionFailure =                   function(self,from,to,why)
    if type(why)~="string" or self.routeEscape or not self.goal or not self.observation
        or distance(from,self.observation.p)>2 then return end
    local physical=why:sub(1,5)=="wall:" or why=="water is not walking support" or why=="no dry support"
        or why=="unscanned floor" or why=="unsupported edge/height" or why=="insufficient headroom"
    if not physical then return end
    local toward=flat(self.goal-from);local attempted=flat(to-from)
    if toward.Magnitude<8 or attempted.Magnitude<.1 or toward.Unit:Dot(attempted.Unit)<.4 then return end
    self.connectionFailure={position=from,goal=self.goal,reason=why,at=self.io.now(),revision=self.revision}
end 
Adaptive.probe =                   function(self,from,to,cached,urgent)
    if self:wallBlockedPath(from,to) then return nil,"blacklisted wall approach" end
    local delta=flat(to-from)
    for _,failed in ipairs(self.motionFailures or {}) do
        if failed.revision==self.revision and self.io.now()<failed.untilAt and distance(from,failed.position)<2
            and delta.Magnitude>.05 and failed.direction and delta.Unit:Dot(failed.direction)>.85 then
            return nil,"observed movement blocked in this direction"
        end
    end
    local k=string.format("%.2f:%.2f:%.2f>%.2f:%.2f:%.2f",from.X,from.Y,from.Z,to.X,to.Y,to.Z)
    local memo=cached and self.probeCache[k]
    if memo and memo.revision==self.revision and self.io.now()<memo.untilTime then
        if memo.wall then self:noteWall(memo.wall,from) end
        if not memo.point then self:noteConnectionFailure(from,to,memo.reason) end
        return memo.point,memo.reason
    end
    if (self.queries or 0)>=self.budget or not urgent and self.io.now()>=self.deadline then return nil,"budget" end
    self.queries=(self.queries or 0)+1
    local p,why,wall=self.io.probe(from,to)
    if not p then self:noteConnectionFailure(from,to,why) end
    if not p and wall then self:noteWall(wall,from) end
    if cached then
        if not self.probeCache[k] then self.cacheCount=(self.cacheCount or 0)+1 end
        if self.cacheCount>4000 then self.probeCache={};self.cacheCount=1 end
        self.probeCache[k]={point=p,reason=why,wall=wall,revision=self.revision,untilTime=self.io.now()+(p and 30 or 3)}
    end
    return p,why
end 
Adaptive.startSearch =                   function(self,position,goal,escape)
    local start=self:node(position);if not start then return end
    self.epoch+=1;self.stats.searches+=1
    self.search={epoch=self.epoch,start=start.key,goal=goal,escape=escape,
        heap={},cost={[start.key]=0},parents={},closed={},expanded=0,best=start.key,bestH=self:routeDistance(position,goal),cursor=nil}
    push(self.search.heap,{key=start.key,score=0})
end 
Adaptive.rejectedJoin =                   function(self,position,point)
    local rejected=self.rejectedHandoff
    return rejected and rejected.reason~="unsafe trajectory" and rejected.revision==self.revision
        and distance(rejected.position,position)<1.5 and distance(rejected.point,point)<1.5
end 
Adaptive.publish =                   function(self,s,terminal,position)
    local reverse={};local k=terminal
    while k and k~=s.start do
        reverse[#reverse+1]=self.nodes[k].p;k=s.parents[k]
        if #reverse>self.searchLimit then return false end
    end
    local route={};for i=#reverse,1,-1 do route[#route+1]=reverse[i] end
    if #route==0 then return false end
    if not s.escape and self:recoveryBlocked(route[#route],s.goal) then return false end
    if not s.escape and (self.blacklistedWalls or 0)>0 and distance(route[#route],s.goal)>self.arrival
        and self:routeDistance(route[#route],s.goal)>=self:routeDistance(position,s.goal)-.5 then return false end
                                                                             
                                                                              
    if not s.escape and (distance(route[#route],s.goal)>self.arrival or math.abs(route[#route].Y-s.goal.Y)>4) then
        local lowest=position.Y
        for _,p in ipairs(route) do lowest=math.min(lowest,p.Y) end
        if lowest<position.Y-1.25 and s.goal.Y>lowest+4 then return false end
    end
                                                                         
    local nearest,dist=1,math.huge
    for i,p in ipairs(route) do local d=distance(p,position);if d<dist then nearest,dist=i,d end end
    if dist>8 then return false end
    if not s.escape then
        local candidates={}
        for i,p in ipairs(route) do
            local d=distance(p,position)
            if d<=8 then candidates[#candidates+1]={i=i,p=p,d=d} end
        end
        table.sort(candidates,                  function(a,b)return a.d<b.d end )
        nearest=nil
        for _,candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
            if self:rejectedJoin(position,candidate.p) then continue end
            local point,why=self:probe(position,candidate.p,true,true)
            if why=="budget" then return false,"budget" end
            if point and distance(point,candidate.p)<1.5 then nearest=candidate.i;break end
        end
        if not nearest then return false,"handoff blocked" end
    end
    for _=1,nearest-1 do table.remove(route,1) end
    if self:rejectedJoin(position,route[1]) then return false end
    if self.route[1] and s.escape==self.routeEscape then
        if s.escape or self:routeDistance(route[#route],s.goal)>=self:routeDistance(self.route[#self.route],s.goal)-1 then return false end
        local join
        for i,p in ipairs(route) do if distance(p,self.route[1])<1 then join=i;break end end
        if not join then return false end
        for _=1,join-1 do table.remove(route,1) end
    end
    self.route=route;self.routeEscape=s.escape;self.routeDirect=false;self.routeMacro=false;self.routeStreamed=false
    self.routeSource=s.escape and "searched escape" or "local checked route"
    return true
end 
Adaptive.searchSlice =                   function(self,position)
    local s=self.search;if not s then return end
    if s.pendingTerminal then
        local ok,why=self:publish(s,s.pendingTerminal,position)
        if ok then self.search=nil;return end
        if why=="budget" then return end
        s.pendingTerminal=nil
    end
    local dirs={Vector3.new(1,0,0),Vector3.new(-1,0,0),Vector3.new(0,0,1),Vector3.new(0,0,-1),
        Vector3.new(1,0,1),Vector3.new(1,0,-1),Vector3.new(-1,0,1),Vector3.new(-1,0,-1)}
    while self.queries<self.budget-2 and self.io.now()<self.deadline do
        if not s.cursor then
            local item=pop(s.heap)
            if not item or s.expanded>=self.searchLimit then
                self:publish(s,s.best,position);self.search=nil
                self.failedSearch={position=position,goal=s.goal,revision=self.revision,escape=s.escape,hazards=self.hazardEpoch,retryAt=s.retryAt}
                self.retryAt=s.retryAt or self.io.now()+3;self.status="local connection exhausted";return
            end
            if s.closed[item.key] then continue end
            s.closed[item.key]=true;s.expanded+=1;self.stats.expansions+=1
            local n=self.nodes[item.key];local h=self:routeDistance(n.p,s.goal)
            if s.escape and self:margin(n.p,0)>=.75 or not s.escape and h<=self.arrival then
                local ok,why=self:publish(s,n.key,position)
                if ok then self.search=nil;return end
                if why=="budget" then s.pendingTerminal=n.key;return end
            end
            if h<s.bestH-1 then s.best=n.key;s.bestH=h end
            s.cursor={node=n,i=1,neighbors={}}
                                                                         
            for k,e in pairs(n.edges) do
                local point=self.nodes[k] and self.nodes[k].p or self.archive[k] and Vector3.new(table.unpack(self.archive[k].p))
                if point and (not e.blocked or e.blocked<=self.io.now()) then s.cursor.neighbors[#s.cursor.neighbors+1]=point end
                if point and e.blocked and e.blocked>self.io.now() then s.retryAt=math.min(s.retryAt or math.huge,e.blocked) end
            end
                                                                          
                                                                           
                                                                    
            for _,point in ipairs(self:nearbyRecorded(n.p)) do s.cursor.neighbors[#s.cursor.neighbors+1]=point end
                                                                           
                                                                          
                                                                            
            local base=Vector3.new(math.round(n.p.X/self.step)*self.step,n.p.Y,math.round(n.p.Z/self.step)*self.step)
            for _,d in ipairs(dirs) do s.cursor.neighbors[#s.cursor.neighbors+1]=base+d*self.step end
        end
        local c=s.cursor;local p=c.neighbors[c.i]
        if not p then s.cursor=nil;continue end
        c.i+=1
        if self:wallBlockedPath(c.node.p,p) then continue end
        local known=self.nodes[key(p)]
        if known and s.closed[known.key] then continue end
        local previousEdge=c.node.edges[key(p)]
        if previousEdge and previousEdge.blocked and previousEdge.blocked>self.io.now() then
            s.retryAt=math.min(s.retryAt or math.huge,previousEdge.blocked);continue
        end
        local endpoint,why;local checked=false
        if previousEdge and previousEdge.success>0 and not previousEdge.needsValidation
            and previousEdge.validatedRevision==self.revision and previousEdge.validatedAt
            and self.io.now()-previousEdge.validatedAt<30 then endpoint=p
        else checked=true;endpoint,why=self:probe(c.node.p,p,true) end
        if why=="budget" then c.i-=1;break end
        if previousEdge and checked and endpoint and distance(endpoint,p)>1.5 then
            endpoint=nil;why="remembered floor changed"
        end
        if previousEdge and checked and not endpoint then
            previousEdge.needsValidation=true;previousEdge.blocked=self.io.now()+3
            previousEdge.validatedRevision=nil;previousEdge.validatedAt=nil
        end
        if endpoint then
            local n=self:node(endpoint)
            if n and not s.closed[n.key] then
                local e=self:edge(c.node,n,false)
                if e and checked then e.needsValidation=false;e.validatedRevision=self.revision;e.validatedAt=self.io.now() end
                local safe=s.escape and self:pathRisk(c.node.p,n.p) or self:margin(n.p,0)>=.5
                if e and safe then
                    local cost=s.cost[c.node.key]+e.cost*(1+math.min(4,e.failures*.5))+self:positionPreferenceCost(c.node.p)
                        +math.min(8,e.damage/math.max(1,e.success)*.01)
                        +(not s.escape and self.io.clearanceCost and self.io.clearanceCost(n.p) or 0)
                    if not s.cost[n.key] or cost<s.cost[n.key] then
                        s.cost[n.key]=cost;s.parents[n.key]=c.node.key
                        local heuristic=s.escape and math.max(0,.75-self:margin(n.p,0)) or self:routeDistance(n.p,s.goal)
                        push(s.heap,{key=n.key,score=cost+heuristic})
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
                                                                             
    if not s.escape and s.bestH<self:routeDistance(self.nodes[s.start].p,s.goal)-4 then self:publish(s,s.best,position) end
                                                                       
                                                                            
                                                                           
                                                                          
    if not s.escape and not self.route[1] then
        local candidates={}
        if s.cursor then
            local n=s.cursor.node
            candidates[#candidates+1]={key=n.key,score=s.cost[n.key]+self:routeDistance(n.p,s.goal)}
        end
        for i=1,math.min(24,#s.heap) do candidates[#candidates+1]=s.heap[i] end
        table.sort(candidates,                  function(a,b)return a.score<b.score end )
        for _,item in ipairs(candidates) do
            local n=self.nodes[item.key]
            if n and distance(position,n.p)>=6 and self:publish(s,item.key,position) then break end
        end
    end
end 
Adaptive.dodgeProgressDirection =                   function(self,position)
    if self.escapeGoal then
        local preferred=flat(self.escapeGoal-position)
        if preferred.Magnitude>3 then return preferred.Unit end
    end
    if self.pursueWhileDodging==false or not self.goal then return nil end
    local delta=flat(self.goal-position)
    if delta.Magnitude<=(self.arrival or 2) then return nil end
    return delta.Unit
end 
Adaptive.progressEscapePoint =                   function(self,position,target)
    if self.pursueWhileDodging==false then return target end
    local away=flat(target-position)
    local toward=self.goal and flat(self.goal-position)
    if not toward or toward.Magnitude<=(self.arrival or 2) or away.Magnitude<.1 then return target end
    local tangent=toward-away.Unit*toward:Dot(away.Unit)
    if tangent.Magnitude<.1 then return target end
                                                                            
    local length=away.Magnitude
    local total=math.min(length*1.1,length+self.speed*.12)
    local extra=math.min(tangent.Magnitude,math.sqrt(math.max(0,total*total-length*length)))
    if extra<.1 or self.io.now()>=self.deadline then return target end
    local biased=target+tangent.Unit*extra
    if distance(biased,self.goal)>=distance(target,self.goal)-.1 then return target end
    if self:clearMotion(position,biased) then return biased end
    return target
end 
Adaptive.warningStepSafe =                   function(self,from,to)
    local now=self.io.now();local duration=self:travelSeconds(distance(from,to))
    if duration>.65 or duration<.001 then return false end
    local improvement=0
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
        if (h.kind=="circle" or h.kind=="line" or h.kind=="box") and h.safeBefore and h.safeBefore>now and not h.contain and (not h.bossShape or h.bossShape=="circle" or h.bossShape=="box") then
            local lead=h.safeBefore-now
            local first=self:hazardMargin(h,from,lead+.01)
            if first<.75 and lead<=(-first+.75)/math.max(1,self.warningSpeed or self.speed)+.4 then
                local last=self:hazardMargin(h,to,lead+.01)
                if duration>=lead-.05 or last<first-.05 then return false end
                improvement+=last-first
            end
        end
    end
    if improvement<.25 then return false end
    local safe,worst=self:pathRisk(from,to)
    local initial=self:margin(from,0)
                                                                             
    local required=math.min(.75,math.max(0,initial))
    return safe and worst>=required-.01 and self:margin(to,duration)>=required
end 
Adaptive.warningExposure =                   function(self,from,to,horizon)
    if self.worldWarningReachable and self:worldWarningReachable(from,0)
        and not self:worldWarningReachable(to,self:travelSeconds(distance(from,to)))then return false end
    local duration=self:travelSeconds(distance(from,to))
    local moving,staying=0,0
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
        local hazardMoving,hazardStaying=0,0
        for i=1,12 do
            local t=horizon*i/12
            local p=from+(to-from)*math.min(1,t/math.max(.001,duration))
            hazardMoving+=math.max(0,.75-self:hazardMargin(h,p,t))
            hazardStaying+=math.max(0,.75-self:hazardMargin(h,from,t))
        end
                                                                               
        if hazardMoving>hazardStaying+.05 then return false end
        moving+=hazardMoving;staying+=hazardStaying
    end
    return staying>0 and moving<staying-.25
end 
Adaptive.warningReflex =                   function(self,position,warnings)
    return self:chooseEscape(position,false)
end 
Adaptive.urgentAreaExit =                   function(self,position)
                                                                        
                                                                             
    local now=self.io.now()
    local warningExit=false;local urgentWarnings={}
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
        if (h.kind=="circle" or h.kind=="line" or h.kind=="box") and h.safeBefore and h.safeBefore>now and not h.contain and (not h.bossShape or h.bossShape=="circle" or h.bossShape=="box") then
            local lead=h.safeBefore-now
            local margin=self:hazardMargin(h,position,lead+.01)
            if margin<.75 and lead<=(-margin+.75)/math.max(1,self.warningSpeed or self.speed)+.4 then warningExit=true;urgentWarnings[#urgentWarnings+1]=h end
        end
    end
                                                                                      
    if warningExit and self.routeEscape and self.route[1] and self.routeSource=="nearest verified attack exit"
        and flat(self.route[1]-position).Magnitude>.15 and self:clearMotion(position,self.route[1])then return false end
                                                                               
                                                                              
    if warningExit and self.routeEscape and self.route[1]
        and self.routeSource=="warning clearance step"
        and flat(self.route[1]-position).Magnitude>1
        and self:warningStepSafe(position,self.route[1]) then return false end
    if not warningExit and self.routeEscape and self.route[1] and self.routeSource~="partial overlap exit"
        and flat(self.route[#self.route]-position).Magnitude>2 and self:escapeRouteSafe(position) then return false end
    local candidates={};local padding=math.max(4,self.speed*.25)
    local add; add =                   function(direction,length)
        local d=flat(direction)
        if d.Magnitude<.1 or length<0 or length>96 then return end
                                                                           
                                                                                 
        for _,candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
            if candidate.direction:Dot(d.Unit)>.995 then
                candidate.length=math.max(candidate.length,math.max(2,length+padding));return
            end
        end
        candidates[#candidates+1]={direction=d.Unit,length=math.max(2,length+padding)}
    end 
    local covered=0
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards) do
        local future=warningExit and h.safeBefore and math.max(0,h.safeBefore-now+.01) or 0
        if h.kind=="projectile" or self:hazardMargin(h,position,future)>=.75 then continue end
        covered+=1;if covered>12 then break end
        local delta=flat(position-h.pos)
        if h.kind=="line" and h.axis then
            local axis=flat(h.axis).Unit;local side=Vector3.new(-axis.Z,0,axis.X)
            for _,sign in ipairs({-1,1}) do
                add(side*sign,(h.thin or 0)*.5+(h.clearance or 0)-delta:Dot(side)*sign)
                add(axis*sign,(h.span or 0)*.5+3-delta:Dot(axis)*sign)
            end
        elseif h.kind=="ring" and delta.Magnitude>.1 then
            add(delta,(h.radius or 0)+(h.clearance or 0)-delta.Magnitude)
            add(-delta,delta.Magnitude-(h.inner or 0)+(h.clearance or 0))
        elseif h.kind=="circle" then
            local radius=(h.radius or 0)+(h.clearance or 0)
            if delta.Magnitude>.1 then add(delta,radius-delta.Magnitude)end
            local progress=self:dodgeProgressDirection(position) or Vector3.new(1,0,0)
            local base=math.atan2(progress.Z,progress.X)
            for i=0,15 do
                local angle=base+i*math.pi/8
                local direction=Vector3.new(math.cos(angle),0,math.sin(angle))
                local projected=delta:Dot(direction)
                local discriminant=projected*projected+radius*radius-delta:Dot(delta)
                if discriminant>=0 then add(direction,-projected+math.sqrt(discriminant))end
            end
        elseif h.kind=="box" and h.cf and h.size then
            local relative=position-h.pos
            for _,axis in ipairs({{h.cf.RightVector,h.size.X},{h.cf.LookVector,h.size.Z}}) do
                for _,sign in ipairs({-1,1}) do add(axis[1]*sign,axis[2]*.5+(h.clearance or 0)-relative:Dot(axis[1])*sign) end
            end
        end
    end
                                                                              
    for _,candidate in ipairs(candidates)do
        for _,h in ipairs(urgentWarnings)do
            if h.kind~="circle" then continue end
            local delta=flat(position-h.pos);local radius=(h.radius or 0)+(h.clearance or 0)+padding
            local projected=delta:Dot(candidate.direction)
            local disc=projected*projected+radius*radius-delta:Dot(delta)
            if disc>=0 then candidate.length=math.max(candidate.length,-projected+math.sqrt(disc))end
        end
    end
    local function clearsWarnings(point)
        for _,h in ipairs(urgentWarnings)do
            if self:hazardMargin(h,point,h.safeBefore-now+.01)<.75 then return false end
        end
        return true
    end
    local progress=self:dodgeProgressDirection(position)
                                                                               
                                                                   
    local score; score =                   function(candidate)
        return candidate.length+(progress and (1-candidate.direction:Dot(progress))*self.speed*.06 or 0)
    end 
    table.sort(candidates,                  function(a,b)return score(a)<score(b) end )
    local partialCandidates={}
    local first=self.areaExitCursor or 1
                                                                                 
    local fullDeadline=warningExit and self.deadline-.002 or self.deadline
    local fullQueryLimit=warningExit and self.budget-4 or self.budget-2
    for attempt=1,math.min(8,#candidates) do
        if self.io.now()>=fullDeadline or self.queries>=fullQueryLimit then break end
        local i=(first+attempt-2)%#candidates+1
        self.areaExitCursor=i%#candidates+1
        local option=candidates[i];local target=position+option.direction*option.length
        if not self:clearMotion(position,target) then
            if warningExit then partialCandidates[#partialCandidates+1]=option end
            continue
        end
        local existing=self.routeEscape and self.route[1] and flat(self.route[1]-position)
        if not warningExit and existing and existing.Magnitude>.1 then
                                                                             
                                                                             
            local length=math.min(existing.Magnitude,option.length+1.5)
            local keepsProgress=not progress or existing.Unit:Dot(progress)>=option.direction:Dot(progress)-.1
            if keepsProgress and self:clearMotion(position,position+existing.Unit*length) then return false end
        end
                                                                           
                                                                             
                                                                          
        if warningExit then partialCandidates[#partialCandidates+1]=option end
        local directTarget=target
        if not warningExit then target=self:progressEscapePoint(position,target)end
        local point,why=self:probe(position,target,false,true)
        if not point and why~="budget" and target~=directTarget then
            target=directTarget;point,why=self:probe(position,target,false,true)
        end
        if why=="budget" then break end
        if point and flat(point-target).Magnitude<1.5 and clearsWarnings(point) and self:clearMotion(position,point) then
            self.route={point};self.routeEscape=true;self.routeDirect=false;self.routeMacro=false;self.routeStreamed=false
            self.command=nil;self.search=nil;self.escapeCandidates=nil
            self.routeSource="nearest verified attack exit";self.areaExitCursor=nil;return true
        end
    end
                                                                            
                                                                            
    if warningExit then
        self.deadline=self.io.now()+.004
        self.budget=math.max(self.budget,self.queries+4)
        if self:warningReflex(position,urgentWarnings)then return true end
    end
    return false
end 
Adaptive.forwardEscape =                   function(self,position,progressOnly)
    if self.routeSource=="nearest verified attack exit" and self.route[1]
        and self:margin(position,0)<.75 and self:clearMotion(position,self.route[1]) then return false end
    local headings={}
    local progress=self:dodgeProgressDirection(position)
    if progress then
        local side=Vector3.new(-progress.Z,0,progress.X)
        if self.command and side:Dot(self.command)<0 then side=-side end
        headings={progress,(progress+side).Unit,(progress-side).Unit,
            (progress*.4+side).Unit,(progress*.4-side).Unit,side,-side}
        for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
            if h.kind=="circle"and h.pos and h.radius then
                local delta=flat(h.pos-position);local along=delta:Dot(progress)
                local radius=h.radius+(h.clearance or 0)+2
                if along>0 and along<48 and (delta-progress*along).Magnitude<radius then
                    local left=flat(h.pos+side*radius-position)
                    local right=flat(h.pos-side*radius-position)
                    if left.Magnitude>.1 then table.insert(headings,1,left.Unit)end
                    if right.Magnitude>.1 then table.insert(headings,2,right.Unit)end
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local heading=self.command or (self.route[1] and flat(self.route[1]-position))
    if not progressOnly and heading and heading.Magnitude>.05 and (not headings[1] or headings[1]:Dot(heading.Unit)<.99) then headings[#headings+1]=heading.Unit end
                                                                          
                                                                         
    local reach=math.clamp(self.speed*1.2,12,24)
    local options={}
    for _,d in ipairs(headings)do for _,scale in ipairs({1,.75,.5})do options[#options+1]={d,scale}end end
    if #options==0 then return false end
    local cursor=self.forwardEscapeCursor or 1
    for attempt=1,#options do
        local index=(cursor+attempt-2)%#options+1
        local d,scale=options[index][1],options[index][2]
        if self.io.now()>=self.deadline or self.queries>=self.budget-1 then return false end
        self.forwardEscapeCursor=index%#options+1
        local target=position+d*reach*scale
        if not self:clearMotion(position,target) then continue end
        local p,why=self:probe(position,target,false,true)
        if why=="budget" then return false end
        if p and flat(p-target).Magnitude<1.5 and self:clearMotion(position,p) then
            local outlet,reason=self:escapeOutlet(position,p)
            if reason=="budget" then return false end
            if not outlet then continue end
            self.route={p};self.routeEscape=true;self.routeDirect=false;self.routeMacro=false
            self.routeSource="committed safe passage";self.search=nil;self.escapeCandidates=nil;self.forwardEscapeCursor=1
            return true
        end
                                                                       
        if not p then continue end
    end
    return false
end 
Adaptive.positionPreferenceCost =                   function(self,point)
    local cost=0
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
        if h.softCost then cost+=h.softCost(h,point)end
    end
    return cost
end 
Adaptive.chooseEscape =                   function(self,position,reserveRecovery)
    if self.io.aquaticGapPoints then
        for _,target in ipairs(self.io.aquaticGapPoints(position))do
            if self.io.now()>=self.deadline-(reserveRecovery and .0007 or 0)or self.queries>=self.budget-(reserveRecovery and 3 or 1)then break end
            local arrival=self:travelSeconds(distance(position,target))
            if self:endpointMargin(target,arrival)>=.75 and self:clearMotion(position,target)then
                local point,why=self:probe(position,target,false,true)
                if why=="budget"then break end
                if point and self:endpointMargin(point,self:travelSeconds(distance(position,point)))>=.75 and self:clearMotion(position,point)then
                    self.route={point};self.routeEscape=true;self.routeDirect=false;self.routeMacro=false
                    self.search=nil;self.escapeCandidates=nil;self.routeSource="verified slam gap";return true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local pending=self.escapeCandidates
    if pending and distance(position,pending.position)>1 then pending=nil end
    if pending and pending.candidate then
        local target=pending.candidate
        if self:clearMotion(position,target) then
            local point,why=self:probe(position,target,false,true)
            if why=="budget" then return false end
            if point and self:clearMotion(position,point) then
                self.route={point};self.routeEscape=true;self.routeDirect=false;self.routeMacro=false
                self.routeSource=pending.projectile and "projectile clearance"or "immediate verified dodge"
                self.search=nil;self.escapeCandidates=nil;return true
            end
        end
        pending.candidate=nil
    end
    if pending and not pending.directions then pending=nil end
    if not pending then
        local directions={}
        local progress=self:dodgeProgressDirection(position)
        if progress then
            local side=Vector3.new(-progress.Z,0,progress.X)
            if self.command and side:Dot(self.command)<0 then side=-side end
            directions={progress,(progress+side).Unit,(progress-side).Unit,
                (progress*.4+side).Unit,(progress*.4-side).Unit}
        end
        local heading=self.escapePreferred or self.command or (self.goal and flat(self.goal-position))
        local preferred=heading and heading.Magnitude>.05 and heading.Unit or Vector3.new(1,0,0)
                                                                             
        local nearest,nearestTime
        for _,h in pairs(self.hazards) do
            local velocity=h.kind=="projectile" and h.velocity and flat(h.velocity)
            if velocity and velocity.Magnitude>1 then
                local delta=flat(position-h.pos);local t=delta:Dot(velocity)/velocity:Dot(velocity)
                if t>=0 and t<=1.5 and (delta-velocity*t).Magnitude<(h.radius or 0)+1 then
                    if not nearestTime or t<nearestTime then nearest=h;nearestTime=t end
                end
            end
        end
        if nearest then
            local v=flat(nearest.velocity).Unit;local side=Vector3.new(-v.Z,0,v.X)
            if side:Dot(preferred)<0 then side=-side end
            table.insert(directions,1,side);table.insert(directions,2,-side)
        end
                                                                              
                                                                        
        local chainAxis
        for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
            if h.chainForecast and h.chainAxis and (not h.untilTime or h.untilTime>self.io.now())then
                chainAxis=h.chainAxis;break
            end
        end
        if chainAxis then
            local side=Vector3.new(-chainAxis.Z,0,chainAxis.X)
            if side:Dot(preferred)<0 then side=-side end
            table.insert(directions,1,-side);table.insert(directions,1,side)
        end
        local closest,gap
        for _,actor in ipairs(self.actors or {}) do
            local delta=flat(position-actor.pos);local margin=delta.Magnitude-actor.radius
            if math.abs(position.Y-actor.pos.Y)<6 and delta.Magnitude>.05 and (not gap or margin<gap) then closest=delta.Unit;gap=margin end
        end
                                                                                
                                                             
        if closest and gap<self.speed*.7 then
            local side=Vector3.new(-closest.Z,0,closest.X)
            if side:Dot(preferred)<0 then side=-side end
            directions[#directions+1]=side;directions[#directions+1]=-side
        end
        directions[#directions+1]=preferred
        if closest and gap<self.speed*.7 then directions[#directions+1]=closest end
        directions[#directions+1]=Vector3.new(-preferred.Z,0,preferred.X)
        directions[#directions+1]=-directions[#directions]
        for i=0,23 do local angle=i*math.pi/12;directions[#directions+1]=Vector3.new(math.cos(angle),0,math.sin(angle)) end
        if self.io.worldWallCost and (self.keepCombatMotion or self.continuousMovement) then
            local ranked={}
            local toward=self.goal and flat(self.goal-position)
            local pressure=math.clamp(self.io.worldWallCost(position),0,4)/4
            for i,direction in ipairs(directions)do
                local cost=self.io.worldWallCost(position+direction*26)
                if self.positionPreferenceCost then cost+=self:positionPreferenceCost(position+direction*26)end
                if toward and toward.Magnitude>.01 then
                    local alignment=math.max(0,direction:Dot(toward.Unit))
                    local weight=self.continuousMovement and 2 or pressure*2
                    cost-=weight*(math.exp(2*alignment)-1)/(math.exp(2)-1)
                end
                ranked[#ranked+1]={direction=direction,order=i,cost=cost}
            end
            table.sort(ranked,function(x,y)if math.abs(x.cost-y.cost)<.01 then return x.order<y.order end;return x.cost<y.cost end)
            directions={};for _,entry in ipairs(ranked)do directions[#directions+1]=entry.direction end
        end
        pending={directions=directions,index=1,lengthIndex=1,position=position,
            projectile=nearest~=nil,clearance=nearest and math.max(12,2*((nearest.radius or 0)+(nearest.clearance or 0)+2))};self.escapeCandidates=pending
    end
    local lengths={18,26,36,48,64,80}
                                                                                          
    if self.keepCombatMotion then lengths={18,26,36,48,64,80} end
    if pending.projectile then
        local reach=math.clamp(math.max(pending.clearance,self.speed*.8),12,36)
        lengths={reach,math.min(48,reach*1.5),36,48}
    end
    while pending.index<=#pending.directions and self.io.now()<self.deadline-(reserveRecovery and .0007 or 0)
        and self.queries<self.budget-(reserveRecovery and 3 or 1) do
        local d=pending.directions[pending.index];local length=lengths[pending.lengthIndex]
        local target=position+d*length
                                                                           
                                                                           
        local safe=self:endpointMargin(target,self:travelSeconds(length))>=.75 and self:clearMotion(position,target)
        if safe then
            local directTarget=target
            target=self:progressEscapePoint(position,target)
            pending.candidate=target
            local point,why=self:probe(position,target,false,true)
            if not point and why~="budget" and target~=directTarget then
                target=directTarget;pending.candidate=target
                point,why=self:probe(position,target,false,true)
            end
            if why=="budget" then return false end
            if point and self:clearMotion(position,point) then
                self.route={point};self.routeEscape=true;self.routeDirect=false;self.routeMacro=false
                self.search=nil;self.escapeCandidates=nil;self.routeSource=pending.projectile and "projectile clearance"or "immediate verified dodge";return true
            end
            pending.candidate=nil;pending.lengthIndex=#lengths
        end
        pending.lengthIndex+=1
        if pending.lengthIndex>#lengths then pending.index+=1;pending.lengthIndex=1 end
    end
    if pending.index>#pending.directions then self.escapeCandidates=nil end
    return false
end 
Adaptive.joinCoverRoute =                   function(self,position)
    local offered=self.coverOffer
    if not offered then return false end
    if self.io.now()-offered.at>2 or self:threat(position)>=.75 then self.coverOffer=nil;return false end
    local nearest,best=nil,8
    for i,p in ipairs(offered.points) do
        local d=distance(position,p)
        if d<best then nearest,best=i,d end
    end
    if not nearest then self.coverOffer=nil;return false end
    local p,why=self:probe(position,offered.points[nearest],false,true)
    if why=="budget" then return false end
    self.coverOffer=nil
    if not p or distance(p,offered.points[nearest])>1.5 then return false end
    local previous=self.route;local route={}
    for i=nearest,#offered.points do route[#route+1]=offered.points[i] end
    self.route=route
    if not self:escapeRouteSafe(position) then self.route=previous;return false end
    self.routeEscape=true;self.routeDirect=false;self.routeMacro=false
    self.search=nil;self.escapeCandidates=nil;return true
end 
Adaptive.directApproach =                   function(self,position)
    if self.routeMacro and self.route[1] then return false end
    if not self.goal or self.routeEscape then return false end
    if self.route[1] and not self.routeDirect then return false end
    if self.routeDirect and self.route[1] and distance(position,self.route[1])>12 then return false end
    local delta=self.goal-position;local length=flat(delta).Magnitude
    if length<1 then return false end
    local failed=self.directFailure
    if failed and failed.revision==self.revision and distance(failed.position,position)<2
        and distance(failed.goal,self.goal)<2 and self.io.now()<failed.untilTime then return false end
                                                                     
                                                                             
    for _,reach in ipairs({24,12,6,3}) do
        local target=position+flat(delta)*math.min(1,reach/length)
        if self:recoveryBlocked(target,self.goal) then continue end
        local p,why=self:probe(position,target,false,true)
        if why=="budget" then return false end
        if p and p.Y<position.Y-1.25 and self.goal.Y>p.Y+4 then p=nil end
        if p and not self:recoveryBlocked(p,self.goal)
            and (length>reach or math.abs(p.Y-self.goal.Y)<1.5) and self:clearMotion(position,p) then
            self.route={p};self.routeEscape=false;self.routeDirect=true;self.routeMacro=false
            self.routeSource="direct checked approach";return true
        end
    end
    self.directFailure={position=position,goal=self.goal,revision=self.revision,untilTime=self.io.now()+1}
    return false
end 
do
    local direct=Adaptive.directApproach
    Adaptive.directApproach=function(self,position)
        if direct(self,position)then return true end
        if self.route[1] or not self.goal or self.evasionDisabled or self:margin(position,0)<.75 then return false end
        local delta=flat(self.goal-position)
        if delta.Magnitude<3 then return false end
        local forward=delta.Unit;local blocked=false
        for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
            if h.kind=="circle" and h.pos and h.radius and math.abs(h.pos.Y-position.Y)<(h.height or 8)then
                local offset=flat(h.pos-position);local along=offset:Dot(forward)
                if along>0 and along<math.min(48,delta.Magnitude) and (offset-forward*along).Magnitude<h.radius+(h.clearance or 0)+2 then blocked=true;break end
            end
        end
        if not blocked then return false end
        self.deadline=self.io.now()+.003
        self.budget=math.max(self.budget,self.queries+2)
        local moved=self:forwardEscape(position,true)
        if moved then self.routeSource="approaching around attack area" end
        return moved
    end
end

Adaptive.offerRoute =                   function(self,points,goal,source)
    if self.manualOverride or self.backtrack then return false end
    if not points or not points[1] or not goal then return false end
    local from=self.observation and self.observation.p or points[1]
    local lowest=from.Y
    for _,p in ipairs(points) do lowest=math.min(lowest,p.Y) end
    local finish=points[#points]
    local complete=math.abs(finish.Y-goal.Y)<=4 and flat(finish-goal).Magnitude<=8
    if not complete and self.offeredRoute and self.offeredRoute.complete
        and distance(self.offeredRoute.goal,goal)<=8 then return false end
    if not complete and self:recoveryBlocked(finish,goal) then
        self.offeredRoute=nil;self.offerRejection="partial route returns to failed approach";return false
    end
    if not complete and (self.blacklistedWalls or 0)>0
        and self:routeDistance(finish,goal)>=self:routeDistance(from,goal)-.5 then
        self.offeredRoute=nil;self.offerRejection="partial route returns to blacklisted wall"
        return false
    end
    if not complete and lowest<from.Y-1.25 and goal.Y>lowest+4 then
        self.offeredRoute=nil;self.offerRejection="downhill prefix does not reconnect to goal floor"
        return false
    end
    self.offerRejection=nil
    self.offeredRoute={points=points,goal=goal,cursor=1,source=source,complete=complete}
    return true
end 
Adaptive.routeLength =                   function(self,points,position)
    if #points>1024 then return math.huge end
    local length=0
    for _,point in ipairs(points) do length+=distance(position,point);position=point end
    return length
end 
Adaptive.joinOfferedRoute =                   function(self,position,onlyShorter)
    local offered=self.offeredRoute
    if not offered or self.routeEscape then return false end
    if distance(offered.goal,self.goal)>8 then self.offeredRoute=nil;return false end
    if not offered.joins or not offered.joinsPosition or distance(position,offered.joinsPosition)>8 then
        offered.joinsPosition=position;offered.cursor=1
        offered.joins={}
        for i,p in ipairs(offered.points) do
            local d=distance(position,p)
            if d<=32 then offered.joins[#offered.joins+1]={i=i,p=p,d=d} end
        end
                                                                             
                                                                              
                                                                         
        table.sort(offered.joins,                  function(a,b)return a.i>b.i end )
    end
    for _=1,4 do
        local candidate=offered.joins[offered.cursor]
        if not candidate then self.offeredRoute=nil;return false end
        if self:rejectedJoin(position,candidate.p) then offered.cursor+=1;continue end
        local p,why=self:probe(position,candidate.p,false,true)
        if why=="budget" then return false end
        offered.cursor+=1
        if p and distance(p,candidate.p)<1.5 and self:clearMotion(position,p) then
            local route={}
            for i=candidate.i,#offered.points do route[#route+1]=offered.points[i] end
            if onlyShorter and self:routeLength(route,position)>=self:routeLength(self.route,position)-4 then continue end
            self.route=route;self.routeDirect=false;self.routeEscape=false;self.routeMacro=true
            self.routeSource=offered.source
            self.offeredRoute=nil;self.search=nil;return true
        end
    end
    return false
end 
Adaptive.crossedWaypoint =                   function(self,position,point)
    local previous=self.driveObservation
    if not previous or distance(previous.point,point)>.001 then return false end
    local elapsed=self.io.now()-previous.at
    local step=position-previous.position;local horizontal=flat(step)
    if elapsed<=0 or elapsed>.3 or step.Magnitude>math.max(3,self.speed*elapsed*2)
        or horizontal.Magnitude<.05 then return false end
    local t=flat(point-previous.position):Dot(horizontal)/horizontal:Dot(horizontal)
    if t<0 or t>1 then return false end
    local crossed=previous.position+step*t
    return flat(crossed-point).Magnitude<=.25 and math.abs(crossed.Y-point.Y)<=1.5
end 
Adaptive.drive =                   function(self,position,avoiding)
    if self.routeEscape and self.route[1] then
        self.deadline=math.max(self.deadline or 0,self.io.now()+.008)
    end
    self:forwardRouteAnchor(position)
    if self.neutralApproach and self.route and self.route[1]
        and flat(self.route[1]-position):Dot(self.neutralApproach)<-.01 then
        self.route={};self.command=nil;self.io.stop();self.status="finding forward approach";return false
    end
                                                                             
    if self.routeEscape and self.route[1] then
        local endpoint=self.route[#self.route]
        local arrival=self:travelSeconds(distance(position,endpoint))
        if self:endpointMargin(endpoint,arrival)<.75
            or self.worldWarningReachable and not self:worldWarningReachable(endpoint,arrival) then
            self.route={};self.command=nil;self.io.stop()
            self.status="complete escape required";return false
        end
    end
                                                                            
                                                                             
    if self.routeEscape and self.route[1] then
        self.budget=math.max(self.budget or 0,(self.queries or 0)+2)
    end
    local reached=self.routeEscape and .15 or .65
    while self.route[1] and (flat(position-self.route[1]).Magnitude<reached and math.abs(position.Y-self.route[1].Y)<=1.5
        or self:crossedWaypoint(position,self.route[1])) do
        table.remove(self.route,1);self.driveObservation=nil
    end
    local nextPoint=self.route[1];if not nextPoint then return false end
                                                                            
                                                                                  
    local lookahead=self.routeEscape and math.clamp(self.speed*.9,12,24) or math.clamp(self.speed*1.25,16,32)
    local selected=1
    for i=2,math.min(#self.route,12) do
        if distance(position,self.route[i])>lookahead then break end
        selected=i
    end
    local target=self.route[selected]
    local delta=flat(target-position)
    if delta.Magnitude<.05 then self.route={};return false end
    local fraction=math.min(1,lookahead/delta.Magnitude)
    local endpoint=position+(target-position)*fraction
    local continuation=position+delta.Unit*lookahead
    local forwardProgress=self.goal and distance(continuation,self.goal)<distance(target,self.goal)-1
    local extended=not avoiding and not self.routeEscape and not self.routeMacro and (not self.routeStreamed or forwardProgress)
        and #self.route==1 and delta.Magnitude<lookahead*.5
        and self.goal and distance(target,self.goal)>self.arrival+lookahead
    if extended then endpoint=continuation end
    local p,why=self:probe(position,endpoint,false,true)
    if p and extended and p.Y<position.Y-1.25 and self.goal.Y>p.Y+4 then p=nil;why="unchecked downhill continuation" end
    if p and not extended and fraction==1 and math.abs(p.Y-target.Y)>1.5 then p=nil;why="requested floor not reached" end
    local routeSafe
    local safe; safe =                   function(point)
        if avoiding then
                                                                        
                                                                            
                                                                              
            if self.routeEscape then
                if self.routeSource=="warning exposure reduction" then return self:warningExposure(position,point,self.warningReflexHorizon or .5)end
                if self.routeSource=="warning clearance step" then return self:warningStepSafe(position,point) end
                if self.routeSource=="complete recovery exit" then return self:completeRecoverySafe(position,self.route[#self.route]) end
                if self.routeSource=="partial overlap exit" then return self:exposureStepScore(position,point)~=nil end
                if routeSafe==nil then routeSafe=self:escapeRouteSafe(position) end
                if not routeSafe then return false end
                                                                        
                                                                             
                if #self.route==1 then
                    local segment=self.route[1]-position
                    local lengthSquared=segment:Dot(segment)
                    if lengthSquared>.0001 then
                        local t=(point-position):Dot(segment)/lengthSquared
                        if t>=0 and t<=1 and distance(point,position+segment*t)<.1 then return true end
                    end
                end
                if self:pathRisk(position,point) then return true end
                                                                          
                                                                               
                return #self.route==1 and self:overlapEscapeSafe(position,self.route[1])
            end
            return self:clearMotion(position,point)
        end
        local ok,worst=self:pathRisk(position,point)
        return ok and (self:margin(position,0)<.75 or worst>=.75)
    end 
    local safePoint=p and safe(p)
    if (not p and why~="budget" or p and not safePoint) and (selected>1 or extended) then
        extended=false
        selected=1;target=nextPoint;delta=flat(target-position)
        if delta.Magnitude<.05 then return false end
        endpoint=position+(target-position)*math.min(1,lookahead/delta.Magnitude)
        p,why=self:probe(position,endpoint,false,true)
        if p and delta.Magnitude<=lookahead and math.abs(p.Y-target.Y)>1.5 then p=nil;why="requested floor not reached" end
        safePoint=p and safe(p)
    end
    if why=="budget" then return self.command~=nil end
    if not p or not safePoint then
        if not p then
            if self.routeMacro then
                self.macroRejection={goal=self.goal,at=self.io.now(),reason=why,source=self.routeSource,position=position}
            end
            local n=self:node(position);local target=self:node(nextPoint)
            local e=self:edge(n,target,false)
            if e then e.failures+=1;e.blocked=self.io.now()+2;e.needsValidation=true end
            self.probeCache={};self.cacheCount=0
        end
        self.rejectedHandoff={point=nextPoint,position=position,revision=self.revision,reason=why or "unsafe trajectory"}
        self.route={};self.command=nil
        if not self.deferHandoffStop then self.io.stop() end
        self.status=avoiding and "seeking connected shelter" or "route rejected: "..tostring(why or "unsafe trajectory")
        return false
    end
    for _=1,selected-1 do table.remove(self.route,1) end
    if extended then self.route[1]=p;self.routeStreamed=true end
    self.command=delta.Unit
    local commit=self.directionCommit;local now=self.io.now()
    if not commit or now>=commit.untilAt or self.command:Dot(commit.direction)<.5 then
        self.directionCommit={direction=self.command,untilAt=now+.8}
    end
    self.driveObservation={position=position,point=self.route[1],at=self.io.now()}
                                                                         
                                                                              
    self.io.move(self.command,.45,p)
    if avoiding and self.routeEscape and self.lastPhysicalDanger then
        self.escapeLatch={context=self.routeContext,position=position,at=self.io.now()}
    end
    local n=self.nodes[key(position)];self.commandEdge=n and n.edges[key(nextPoint)]
    self.status=self.routeSource=="partial overlap exit" and "reducing exposure; full exit unavailable"
        or self.routeEscape and "committed escape" or self.backtrack and "retracing checked approach" or "following checked route"
    return true
end 
Adaptive.prepareCasterApproach =                   function(self,position,now)
    local intent=self.combatIntent
    if intent and (intent.mode=="finish" or intent.mode=="gather") and not self.treeFight then
        if self.routeEscape and (self.routeSource=="anticipating caster line of fire" or self.routeSource=="kiting between damage windows") then
            self.route={};self.routeEscape=false;self.command=nil
        end
        self.casterApproach=nil;return false
    end
    local selected,best
    for _,actor in ipairs(self.actors or {}) do
        local kite=intent and intent.mode=="kite" and intent.target==actor.id
        if not (actor.ranged or kite) or not actor.clear and not (self.keepCombatMotion and kite and actor.airborneArenaBoss) or not actor.barrage and not actor.airborneArenaBoss and math.abs(actor.pos.Y-position.Y)>6
            or self.deadOwners and self.deadOwners[actor.id] or not actor.barrage and not (self.keepCombatMotion and kite) and self:recoveryWindow(actor.id,now)>.05 then continue end
        local d=flat(actor.pos-position).Magnitude
        local profile=actor.signature and self.engagements[actor.signature]
        local range=kite and math.max(24,intent.range or 24) or actor.barrage and 240 or actor.aggroRange or profile and profile.startHigh or math.max(24,self.speed*2)
        if d<=range+self.speed*.4 and d>actor.radius and (not best or d<best) then selected=actor;best=d end
    end
    if not selected then
        if self.routeEscape and (self.routeSource=="anticipating caster line of fire" or self.routeSource=="kiting between damage windows") then self.route={};self.routeEscape=false;self.command=nil end
        self.casterApproach=nil;return false
    end
                                                                                           
    if self.groupEnemies and intent and intent.mode=="kite" then
        local center=Vector3.zero;local count=0;local radius=selected.radius
        for _,actor in ipairs(self.actors or {})do
            if not actor.ranged and not actor.barrage and (actor.hp or 1)>0
                and math.abs(actor.pos.Y-position.Y)<6 and flat(actor.pos-position).Magnitude<math.max(80,intent.range or 24) then
                center+=actor.pos;count+=1;radius=math.max(radius,actor.radius)
            end
        end
        if count>=3 and flat(center/count-position).Magnitude>.1 then
            selected=table.clone(selected);selected.pos=center/count;selected.radius=radius
                                                                                           
        end
    end
    local state=self.casterApproach
                                                                                 
    if not state then state={owner=selected.id,sign=1};self.casterApproach=state end
    if state.owner~=selected.id then state.owner=selected.id;state.chosen=false end
    local toward=flat(selected.pos-position).Unit;local side=Vector3.new(-toward.Z,0,toward.X)
    if not state.chosen and self.command and self.command:Dot(side)<0 then state.sign=-1 end
    state.chosen=true
    local progress=self:dodgeProgressDirection(position)
    if (self.escapeGoal or not (intent and intent.mode=="kite")) and progress and side:Dot(progress)*state.sign<-.1 then state.sign=-state.sign end
    local existing=self.route[1] and flat(self.route[1]-position)
    local keepsProgress=intent and intent.mode=="kite" or not progress or not existing or existing.Magnitude<.1 or existing.Unit:Dot(progress)>=-.05
    if self.routeEscape and (self.routeSource=="anticipating caster line of fire" or self.routeSource=="kiting between damage windows") and self.route[1]
        and distance(position,self.route[1])>self.speed*.25 and now<(state.untilTime or 0)
        and keepsProgress and self:clearMotion(position,self.route[1]) then return true end
    local advance=self.pursueWhileDodging and best>math.max(self.arrival+2,selected.radius+8) and .65 or 0
    if progress and progress:Dot(toward)<=0 then advance=.65 end
    if intent and intent.mode=="kite" then
        advance=best>math.max(selected.radius+3,intent.range or 14) and .65 or 0
    end
    for _,sign in ipairs({state.sign,-state.sign}) do
        if self.io.now()>=self.deadline or self.queries>=self.budget-2 then break end
        local direction=(side*sign+(progress or toward)*advance).Unit
        if intent and intent.mode=="kite" and best<math.max(selected.radius+12,(intent.range or 24)*.65) then
                                                                               
            direction=(-toward+side*sign*.25).Unit
        end
        local target=position+direction*math.clamp(self.speed*(intent and intent.mode=="kite" and 1 or .5),6,24)
        if not self:clearMotion(position,target) then continue end
        local point,why=self:probe(position,target,false,true)
        if why=="budget" then break end
        if point and distance(point,target)<1.5 and self:clearMotion(position,point) then
            local outlet,reason=self:escapeOutlet(position,point)
            if reason=="budget" then break end
            if not outlet then continue end
            self.route={point};self.routeEscape=true;self.routeDirect=false;self.routeMacro=false
            self.routeStreamed=false;self.search=nil;self.escapeCandidates=nil
            self.routeSource=intent and intent.mode=="kite" and "kiting between damage windows" or "anticipating caster line of fire";state.sign=sign;state.untilTime=now+(intent and intent.mode=="kite" and 1 or .4)
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end 
Adaptive.rememberTravelRoute =                   function(self,now)
    if self.routeMacro and not self.routeEscape and self.route[1] and self.goal and not self.backtrack then
        self.travelPlan={points=self.route,goal=self.goal,context=self.routeContext,revision=self.revision,source=self.routeSource,at=now}
    end
end 
Adaptive.resumeTravelRoute =                   function(self,position,now)
    local plan=self.travelPlan
    if not plan or self.backtrack or self.routeMacro and self.route[1] then return false end
                                                                                    
    self.travelPlan=nil
    self.offeredRoute=nil
    self.search=nil
    self.failedSearch=nil
    self.retryAt=0
    self.progressWatch=nil
    self.backtrack=nil
    return false
end 
Adaptive.approachDuringDodge =                   function(self,sample,now,danger)
    if not danger or not sample.enabled or sample.hp<=0 or sample.evadeEnabled==false
        or sample.approachTarget==false or not self.pursueWhileDodging or self.timedDodge then return false end
