    if self.routeSource=="projectile clearance"and self.routeEscape and self.route[1]
        and self:drive(sample.position,true)then return true end
    local incoming=false
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
        local v=h.kind=="projectile"and h.velocity and flat(h.velocity)
        if v and v.Magnitude>1 then
            local delta=flat(sample.position-h.pos)
            local t=delta:Dot(v)/v:Dot(v)
            if t>=0 and t<=1.5 and (delta-v*t).Magnitude<(h.radius or 0)+(h.clearance or 0)+2 then incoming=true;break end
        end
    end
    if incoming then
        if self:chooseEscape(sample.position,false)and self.routeSource=="projectile clearance"
            and self:drive(sample.position,true)then return true end
        return false
    end
    if self:margin(sample.position,0)<.75 then return false end
    local progress=self:dodgeProgressDirection(sample.position)
    if not progress then return false end
    local nextPoint=self.routeEscape and self.route[1]
    if nextPoint then
        local direction=flat(nextPoint-sample.position)
                                                                         
        if direction.Magnitude>math.max(6,self.speed*.5) and direction.Unit:Dot(progress)>.35
            and self:clearMotion(sample.position,nextPoint) and self:drive(sample.position,true) then
            self.status="approaching while dodging";return true
        end
    end
    if now<(self.nextApproachDodge or 0) then return false end
    self.nextApproachDodge=now+.15
    local deadline,budget=self.deadline,self.budget
    self.deadline=math.min(deadline,self.io.now()+.002)
    self.budget=math.min(budget,(self.queries or 0)+3)
    local found=self:forwardEscape(sample.position,true)
    self.deadline,self.budget=deadline,budget
    if not found then return false end
    self.safePocket=nil;self.pocketScan=nil
    if self:drive(sample.position,true) then
        self.status="approaching while dodging";return true
    end
    return false
end 

Adaptive.bossCombatStep =                   function(self,sample)
    if not self.keepCombatMotion or not sample.enabled or sample.hp<=0 or sample.evadeEnabled==false then return false end
                                                                            
                                                                            
    if self.routeEscape and self.route and self.route[1]
        and self.routeSource~="boss movement between warnings"
        and distance(sample.position,self.route[1])>1
        and self:clearMotion(sample.position,self.route[1]) and self:drive(sample.position,true)then
        self.status="continuing checked boss escape";return true
    end
    local target
    for _,actor in ipairs(self.actors or {})do
        if actor.airborneArenaBoss and self.combatIntent and self.combatIntent.target==actor.id then target=actor;break end
    end
    if not target then return false end
    local toward=flat(target.pos-sample.position)
    if toward.Magnitude<.1 then return false end
    if not sample.spawnBufferOnly and toward.Magnitude>math.max(24,self.combatIntent.range or 76)+6 then return false end
    local targetDistance=toward.Magnitude
    toward=toward.Unit;local side=Vector3.new(-toward.Z,0,toward.X)
    if self.command and self.command:Dot(side)<0 then side=-side end
    local directions={side,-side,(side+toward).Unit,(-side+toward).Unit,(side-toward).Unit,(-side-toward).Unit,toward,-toward}
    local inward=Vector3.zero
                                                                            
                                                                             
    local arenaDelta=sample.escapeGoal and flat(sample.escapeGoal-sample.position)
    if arenaDelta and arenaDelta.Magnitude>55 then
        inward=arenaDelta.Unit*(arenaDelta.Magnitude-55)
    elseif not arenaDelta and targetDistance>55 then inward=toward*(targetDistance-55)end
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
        if h.bossShape=="moving" and h.origin and h.axis and (h.behaviorKey or ""):find("First Boss Criss Cross Projectile",1,true)then
            local along=flat(sample.position-h.origin):Dot(h.axis)
            if along>=-2 and along<35 then inward+=h.axis*(35-along)end
        end
    end
    if inward.Magnitude>.1 then
        local heading=flat(inward).Unit
        table.insert(directions,1,heading)
    elseif sample.spawnBufferOnly then return false end
                                                                       
    for i=0,7 do
        local angle=(i+.5)*math.pi/4
        directions[#directions+1]=toward*math.cos(angle)+side*math.sin(angle)
    end
                                                                           
                                                                             
    local corridors={}
    for _,direction in ipairs(directions)do
        local endpoint=sample.position+direction*math.max(24,self.speed*1.5)
        if self:clearMotion(sample.position,endpoint)then corridors[direction]=endpoint end
    end
    for pass=1,2 do
    for _,length in ipairs({6,3})do
    for _,direction in ipairs(directions)do
        if pass==1 and not corridors[direction] then continue end
        if sample.spawnBufferOnly and direction:Dot(inward.Unit)<.25 then continue end
        local goal=sample.position+direction*length
        if not self:clearMotion(sample.position,goal)then continue end
        if pass==1 then
            local endpoint=corridors[direction]
            local supported,reason=self:probe(sample.position,endpoint,false,true)
            if reason=="budget"then break end
            if not supported or distance(supported,endpoint)>1.5 then continue end
        end
        local point,why=self:probe(sample.position,goal,false,true)
        if why=="budget"then return false end
        if point and distance(point,goal)<1.5 and self:clearMotion(sample.position,point)then
            self:releasePocket();self:releaseTimedDodge()
            self.route={point};self.routeEscape=true;self.routeDirect=false;self.routeMacro=false;self.routeStreamed=false;self.search=nil
            self.routeSource="boss movement between warnings"
            if self:drive(sample.position,true)then self.status="moving between boss warnings";return true end
        end
    end
    end
    end
    return false
end 

Adaptive.directAttackWarningExit =                   function(self,sample)
    if not sample.enabled or sample.hp<=0 or sample.evadeEnabled==false or sample.protected then return false end
    local now=self.io.now()
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
        local name=h.behaviorKey or ""
        if h.bossShape~="moving"or not h.axis or not h.origin or not h.launch or not h.speed or h.speed<=0
            or not (name:find("First Boss Big Spike",1,true)or name:find("First Boss Seeking Spike",1,true)or name:find("First Boss Criss Cross Projectile",1,true)or name:find("Second Boss Moving Beam",1,true))then continue end
        if h.untilTime and now>=h.untilTime then continue end
        local axis=flat(h.axis).Unit;local side=Vector3.new(-axis.Z,0,axis.X)
        local offset=flat(sample.position-h.origin);local along=offset:Dot(axis);local lateral=offset:Dot(side)
        local width=(h.radius or 0)+(h.clearance or 0)+3
        local arrival=h.launch+math.max(0,along-(h.radius or 0))/h.speed-now
        if along<0 or along>(h.length or 0)+width or math.abs(lateral)>=width or arrival<-.2 then continue end
        local escapeTime=(width-math.abs(lateral))/math.max(1,self.warningSpeed or self.speed)+.5
        if arrival>math.max(escapeTime,1.8)then continue end
        local sign=lateral>=0 and 1 or -1
        for _,choice in ipairs({sign,-sign})do
            local goal=sample.position+side*(choice*width-lateral)
            local point,why=self:probe(sample.position,goal,false,true)
            if why=="budget"then return false end
            if point and self:clearMotion(sample.position,point)then
                self:releaseTimedDodge();self:releasePocket()
                self.route={point};self.routeEscape=true;self.routeDirect=false;self.routeMacro=false;self.routeStreamed=false;self.search=nil
                self.routeSource="direct attack warning exit"
                if self:drive(sample.position,true)then self.status="leaving direct attack warning";return true end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end 

Adaptive.advanceOrbCover =                   function(self,sample)
    if not sample.orbCover or not sample.enabled or sample.hp<=0 or not sample.goal then return false end
    local delta=flat(sample.goal-sample.position)
    if delta.Magnitude<=sample.arrival then return false end
    local forward=delta.Unit;local side=Vector3.new(-forward.Z,0,forward.X)
    if self.routeSource=="matching orb cover" and self.route[1]
        and distance(sample.position,self.route[1])>1
        and self:clearMotion(sample.position,self.route[1]) then
        if self:drive(sample.position,true) then self.status="moving behind matching rock";return true end
    end
    local best,bestDistance
    local evidence={checked=0,blocked=0,unsafe=0,distance=delta.Magnitude}
    self.orbRouteEvidence=evidence
    for _,length in ipairs({36,26,18,12})do
        for _,direction in ipairs({forward,(forward+side).Unit,(forward-side).Unit,side,-side,(-forward+side).Unit,(-forward-side).Unit,-forward})do
            local destination=sample.position+direction*math.min(length,delta.Magnitude)
                                                                              
            local safe,reason=self:clearMotion(sample.position,destination)
            if not safe then
                evidence.unsafe+=1;reason=reason or "unspecified hazard"
                evidence[reason]=(evidence[reason]or 0)+1
                continue
            end
            local point,why=self:probe(sample.position,destination,false,true)
            evidence.checked+=1
            if why=="budget"then evidence.budget=true;break end
            if point and self:clearMotion(sample.position,point)then
                local remaining=distance(point,sample.goal)
                if remaining<delta.Magnitude+13 and (not bestDistance or remaining<bestDistance)then
                    best=point;bestDistance=remaining;evidence.step=length
                end
            else
                evidence.blocked+=1;evidence.reason=tostring(why or "unsafe projected trajectory")
            end
        end
        if best and bestDistance<delta.Magnitude-.5 then break end
        if evidence.budget then break end
    end
    if not best then return false end
    self:releaseTimedDodge();self:releasePocket()
    self.route={best};self.routeEscape=true;self.routeDirect=false;self.routeMacro=false;self.search=nil
    self.routeSource="matching orb cover"
    if self:drive(sample.position,true)then self.status="moving behind matching rock";return true end
    return false
end 

Adaptive.forwardRouteAnchor =                   function(self,position)
    if not self.neutralApproach or not self.route or not self.route[1] then return end
    if flat(self.route[1]-position):Dot(self.neutralApproach)>=-.01 then return end
                                                                          
                                                                             
    for i=2,math.min(#self.route,12) do
        local point=self.route[i];local delta=flat(point-position)
        if delta.Magnitude>32 then break end
        if delta:Dot(self.neutralApproach)>.01 then
            local p=self:probe(position,point,false,true)
            if p and (p-point).Magnitude<1.5 and self:clearMotion(position,p) then
                for _=1,i-1 do table.remove(self.route,1)end
                self.command=nil;self.driveObservation=nil
                return
            end
        end
    end
end 
Adaptive.neutralApproachGate =                   function(self,sample,danger)
    self.neutralApproach=nil
    if danger or sample.orbCover or not sample.enabled or sample.hp<=0 or not sample.attackPosition then return false end
                                                                           
                                                                      
    if sample.navigationTraversal or not sample.combatIntent then return false end
                                                                                
                                                                                  
    if sample.goal and math.abs(sample.goal.Y-sample.position.Y)>12 then
        if self.combatIntent then
            self.combatIntent=table.clone(self.combatIntent);self.combatIntent.mode="approach"
        end
        return false
    end
    local toward=flat(sample.attackPosition-sample.position)
    local intent=self.combatIntent
    local attackRange=intent and intent.range or self.arrival or sample.arrival or 0
    if toward.Magnitude<=.001 or toward.Magnitude<=attackRange then return false end
    self.neutralApproach=toward.Unit
    self:forwardRouteAnchor(sample.position)
    if intent then intent=table.clone(intent);self.combatIntent=intent;intent.mode="approach" end
    local backward=self.command and self.command:Dot(self.neutralApproach)<-.01
    local endpoint=self.route and self.route[1]
    backward=backward or endpoint and flat(endpoint-sample.position):Dot(self.neutralApproach)<-.01
    if backward then
        self.route={};self.command=nil;self.search=nil;self.routeEscape=false
        self.directionCommit=nil;self.travelPlan=nil;self.backtrack=nil
        self.worldActive=nil;self.worldPrediction=nil;self.worldNextAt=0
        self.failedSearch=nil;self.retryAt=0
        self:releaseTimedDodge();self:releasePocket();self.io.stop()
    end
    if sample.goal and flat(sample.goal-sample.position):Dot(self.neutralApproach)<-.01 then
        sample.goal=Vector3.new(sample.attackPosition.X,sample.position.Y,sample.attackPosition.Z)
        sample.escapeGoal=nil;self.escapeGoal=nil
    end
    return false
end 

Adaptive.canFinishBeforeHit =                   function(self,sample,now,continuity)
    local finish=sample.finishBeforeHit
    if not finish or not sample.canAttack or continuity or not sample.enabled or sample.hp<=0 then return false end
    local delay=finish.killAt-now
    if delay<=0 or delay>2 then return false end
    local matched=false
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
        local owned=h.owner==finish.owner
        local horizon=owned and delay or math.max(.7,delay)
        local steps=math.max(1,math.ceil(horizon/.025))
        local boundary=(h.motionBoundarySpeed or 0)+(h.velocity and h.velocity.Magnitude or 0)
        local previous=self:hazardMargin(h,sample.position,0)
        if previous<.75 then return false end
        for i=1,steps do
            local margin=self:hazardMargin(h,sample.position,horizon*i/steps)
            if math.min(previous,margin)-boundary*horizon/steps*.5<.75 then return false end
            previous=margin
        end
        if owned then matched=true end
    end
    return matched
end 
Adaptive.continueEscape =                   function(self,sample,danger)
    local latch=self.escapeLatch
    if not latch then return false end
    local position=sample.position
    if not sample.enabled or sample.hp<=0 or sample.evadeEnabled==false or sample.protected
        or latch.context~=sample.routeContext then self.escapeLatch=nil;return false end
                                                                         
                                                                 
    self.deadline=self.io.now()+.003;self.budget=math.max(self.budget,self.queries+4)
    if self:followWorldPlan(sample)then return end
    if self:directAttackWarningExit(sample)then return end
    if sample.orbCover then self.escapeLatch=nil;return false end
    if self:threat(position)>=2 then
        self.escapeLatch=nil
        self.route={};self.routeEscape=false;self.command=nil
        return false
    end
                                                                            
    self.deadline=self.io.now()+.008
    self.budget=math.max(self.budget or 0,(self.queries or 0)+8)
    self.deferHandoffStop=true
    local moved=self.routeEscape and self.route[1] and self:drive(position,true)
    if not moved then
        self.route={};self.routeEscape=false;self.command=nil
        self.escapeCandidates=nil;self.search=nil
                                                                              
                                                                             
        local goal=sample.goal
        if goal and (goal-position).Magnitude>.75 then
            local delta=goal-position
            local target=position+delta.Unit*math.min(32,delta.Magnitude)
            local point=self:probe(position,target,false,true)
            if point and self:clearMotion(position,point)then
                self.route={point};self.routeEscape=true;self.routeSource="forward combat escape"
                moved=self:drive(position,true)
            end
        end
    end
    if not moved then
        self:urgentAreaExit(position)
        if not self.route[1] then self:chooseEscape(position,false)end
        if self.route[1]then
            self.deadline=math.max(self.deadline,self.io.now()+.003)
            moved=self:drive(position,true)
        end
        if not moved then
            self.route={};self.routeEscape=false;self.command=nil
            self.deadline=self.io.now()+.008
            self.budget=math.max(self.budget,(self.queries or 0)+4)
            if self:completeRecovery(position)then
                self.deadline=self.io.now()+.004
                moved=self:drive(position,true)
            end
        end
    end
    self.deferHandoffStop=nil
    latch.position=position;latch.at=self.io.now()
    if moved then
        self.safePocket=nil;self.pocketScan=nil
        self.status="committed escape"
    else
                                                                       
        self.command=nil;self.io.stop();self.status="escape blocked; recalculating from current position"
    end
    return true
end 

Adaptive.World=(function()
                                                                          
                                                                              
local World={}
World.__index=World
local function flat(v)return Vector3.new(v.X,0,v.Z)end
local function copy(t)return table.clone(t or {})end
function World.new()
    return setmetatable({actors={},actorHistory={},landmarks={},revision=0,observations=0},World)
end
function World:observe(frame)
    if self.mapId~=frame.mapId then
        self.actors={};self.actorHistory={};self.landmarks={};self.mapId=frame.mapId;self.revision+=1
    end
    self.observations+=1
    for id,landmark in pairs(frame.landmarks or {})do
        self.landmarks[id]=copy(landmark)
    end
    local seen={}
    for _,actor in ipairs(frame.actors or {})do
        local id=actor.id or actor.model
        if id then
            local record=copy(actor);record.seenAt=frame.at;record.observed=true
            self.actors[id]=record;self.actorHistory[id]=copy(record);seen[id]=true
        end
    end
    for id,actor in pairs(self.actors)do
        if not seen[id]then
            actor.observed=false
            if frame.at-actor.seenAt>5 or actor.hp and actor.hp<=0 then self.actors[id]=nil end
        end
    end
    self.frame=frame
end
function World:snapshot()
    local f=assert(self.frame);local actors,hazards,skills,history,landmarks,rooms,orbs={},{},{},{},{},{},{}
    for i,o in ipairs(f.homingOrbs or {})do orbs[i]=copy(o)end
    for id,a in pairs(self.actors)do actors[id]=copy(a)end
    for id,h in pairs(f.hazards or {})do hazards[id]=copy(h)end
    for id,s in pairs(f.skills or {})do skills[id]=copy(s)end
    for id,a in pairs(self.actorHistory)do history[id]=copy(a)end
    for id,a in pairs(self.landmarks)do landmarks[id]=copy(a)end
    for i,a in ipairs(f.mission and f.mission.rooms or {})do rooms[i]=copy(a)end
    return {at=f.at,mapId=f.mapId,revision=f.revision,terrain=f.terrain,
        actors=actors,hazards=hazards,skills=skills,player=copy(f.player),homingOrbs=orbs,
        objective=copy(f.objective),mechanic=copy(f.mechanic),patterns=f.patterns,
        observations=self.observations,actorHistory=history,landmarks=landmarks,
        mission={rooms=rooms,progressRank=f.mission and f.mission.progressRank}}
end
local Search={};Search.__index=Search
local function key(p)return math.round(p.X/2)..":"..math.round(p.Z/2)end
function World.search(snapshot,io,options)
    options=options or {}
    local ready={};for id,s in pairs(snapshot.skills)do ready[id]=s.readyAt or math.huge end
    return setmetatable({snapshot=snapshot,io=io,dt=options.dt or .35,
        depth=options.depth or 10,width=options.width or 12,layer=0,cursor=1,
        frontier={{pos=snapshot.player.pos,t=0,cost=0,ready=ready,actions={},path={},actors=snapshot.actors,orbs=snapshot.homingOrbs,heading=snapshot.player.heading}},
        next={},dedup={},expanded=0,rejected={},unknown={},status="searching"},Search)
end
function Search:speedAt(t)
    local p=self.snapshot.player
    if p.boostUntil and self.snapshot.at+t>=p.boostUntil then return math.max(1,p.baseSpeed or p.speed)end
    return math.max(1,p.speed)
end
function Search:distanceDuring(t,dt)
    local p=self.snapshot.player
    local remaining=p.boostUntil and math.clamp(p.boostUntil-self.snapshot.at-t,0,dt) or dt
    return self:speedAt(t)*remaining+self:speedAt(t+dt)*(dt-remaining)
end
function Search:reject(reason,p)
    reason=reason or "unsafe";self.rejected[reason]=(self.rejected[reason]or 0)+1
    if reason=="unknown terrain"then self.unknown[key(p)]=p end
end
function Search:advanceActors(node,point)
    local nextActors={}
    for id,actor in pairs(node.actors or {})do
        local a=copy(actor);nextActors[id]=a
        if not actor.pos or not actor.observed then continue end
        local velocity=actor.velocity or Vector3.zero
        local toward=flat(node.pos-actor.pos)
        local pursuing=actor.pursuing
        if pursuing==nil then pursuing=toward.Magnitude>.1 and velocity.Magnitude>1
            and flat(velocity).Unit:Dot(toward.Unit)>.3 end
        if pursuing and toward.Magnitude>.1 then velocity=toward.Unit*flat(velocity).Magnitude end
        a.pursuing=pursuing;a.velocity=velocity;a.pos=actor.pos+velocity*self.dt
        if actor.radius and math.abs(point.Y-actor.pos.Y)<6 then
            local relative=flat(node.pos-actor.pos)
            local movement=flat(point-node.pos-(a.pos-actor.pos))
            local t=movement.Magnitude>.001 and math.clamp(-relative:Dot(movement)/movement:Dot(movement),0,1)or 0
            if (relative+movement*t).Magnitude<actor.radius+.75 then return nil end
        end
    end
    return nextActors
end
function Search:advanceOrbs(node,point)
    local result={};local steps=math.max(1,math.ceil(self.dt/.05));local dt=self.dt/steps
    for id,orb in pairs(node.orbs or {})do
        local o=copy(orb);result[id]=o
        if o.absorbed then continue end
        for i=1,steps do
            local previous=node.pos+(point-node.pos)*((i-1)/steps)
            local target=node.pos+(point-node.pos)*(i/steps)
            local toward=flat(previous-o.pos)
            local nextPos=o.pos+(toward.Magnitude>.01 and toward.Unit*math.min(toward.Magnitude,o.speed*dt)or Vector3.zero)
            local motion=flat(nextPos-o.pos)
            if o.shield then
                local u=math.clamp(flat(o.shield-o.pos):Dot(motion)/math.max(.0001,motion:Dot(motion)),0,1)
                if flat(o.pos+motion*u-o.shield).Magnitude<(o.shieldRadius or 5)then o.absorbed=true;break end
            end
            local relative=flat(previous-o.pos);local shift=flat(target-nextPos)-relative
            local u=math.clamp(-relative:Dot(shift)/math.max(.0001,shift:Dot(shift)),0,1)
            if (relative+shift*u).Magnitude<(o.clearance or 12)then return nil end
            o.pos=nextPos
        end
    end
    return result
end
function Search:canEnterEncounter(node,point)
    local ready=math.huge;local hasDamage=false
    for id,skill in pairs(self.snapshot.skills)do
        if skill.role=="damage"then hasDamage=true;ready=math.min(ready,node.ready[id] or math.huge)end
    end
    if not hasDamage or ready<=self.snapshot.at+node.t+self.dt then return true end
    for _,actor in pairs(node.actors or {})do
        local radius=actor.aggroRange
        if actor.observed and radius and actor.pos and math.abs(point.Y-actor.pos.Y)<6
            and flat(node.pos-actor.pos).Magnitude>radius and flat(point-actor.pos).Magnitude<=radius then return false end
    end
    return true
end
function Search:expand(node,index)
    local objective=self.snapshot.objective;local goal=objective.goal
    local dirs={Vector3.zero}
    local toward=goal and flat(goal-node.pos)
    if toward and toward.Magnitude>.01 then dirs[#dirs+1]=toward.Unit end
    local arcTurns={}
    local nearest,nearestGap
    for _,orb in pairs(node.orbs or {})do
        if not orb.absorbed and orb.pos then
            local radial=flat(node.pos-orb.pos)
            if radial.Magnitude>.01 and (not nearestGap or radial.Magnitude<nearestGap)then
                nearest=radial;nearestGap=radial.Magnitude
            end
        end
    end
    if nearest then
        local outward=nearest.Unit;local tangent=Vector3.new(-outward.Z,0,outward.X)
                                                                            
                                                                           
        for _,sign in ipairs({1,-1})do
            dirs[#dirs+1]=(tangent*sign+outward*.35).Unit;arcTurns[#dirs]=sign
            if toward and toward.Magnitude>.01 then
                dirs[#dirs+1]=(tangent*sign+outward*.35+toward.Unit*.4).Unit;arcTurns[#dirs]=sign
            end
        end
    end
    for i=0,15 do local angle=i*math.pi/8;dirs[#dirs+1]=Vector3.new(math.cos(angle),0,math.sin(angle))end
    local reach=self:distanceDuring(node.t,self.dt)
    for choice=index,index do
        local direction=dirs[choice]
        if not direction then return false end
        local waiting=direction.Magnitude<.01
        if objective.orb and waiting and toward and toward.Magnitude>(objective.arrival or 2) then
            self:reject("orb delivery incomplete",node.pos);continue
        end
        if objective.keepMoving and waiting and (self.dt>.25 or node.waiting or (node.waitTime or 0)+self.dt>.5) then
            self:reject("boss wait budget exhausted",node.pos);continue
        end
        local endpoint=node.pos+direction*reach
        if toward and toward.Magnitude<reach and direction.Magnitude>0 and direction:Dot(toward.Unit)>.999 then endpoint=goal end
        if objective.keepMoving and not waiting and flat(endpoint-node.pos).Magnitude<reach*.5 then
            self:reject("insufficient movement reserve",endpoint);continue
        end
        local point,reason=self.io.terrain(node.pos,endpoint,self.snapshot)
        if not point then self:reject(reason,endpoint);continue end
        if not self:canEnterEncounter(node,point)then self:reject("damage cooldown before engagement",point);continue end
        local actors=self:advanceActors(node,point)
        if not actors then self:reject("predicted enemy interception",point);continue end
        local orbs=self:advanceOrbs(node,point)
        if not orbs then self:reject("predicted homing interception",point);continue end
        local safe,clearance,why=self.io.trajectory(node.pos,point,node.t,self.dt,self.snapshot)
        if not safe then self:reject(why,point);continue end
        local nextTime=node.t+self.dt
        local ready=copy(node.ready);local actions=table.clone(node.actions)
        local future=copy(self.snapshot);future.actors=actors;future.simulated=true
                                                                             
                                                                                
        local opportunity=0
        for id,skill in pairs(self.snapshot.skills)do
            if skill.role=="damage" and ready[id]<=self.snapshot.at+nextTime and skill.cooldown and skill.cooldown>0 then
                local count=self.io.targets and self.io.targets(point,nextTime,skill,future)or 0
                if count>0 then
                    opportunity+=math.min(count,8)
                    ready[id]=self.snapshot.at+nextTime+skill.cooldown
                    actions[#actions+1]={kind="cast opportunity",slot=id,at=nextTime,targets=count}
                end
            end
        end
        local remaining=self.io.remaining
        local progress=remaining and (remaining(node.pos)-remaining(point))
            or goal and (flat(node.pos-goal).Magnitude-flat(point-goal).Magnitude)or 0
        if progress<-.05 and not arcTurns[choice] and self.io.retreatRequired and not self.io.retreatRequired(node,goal,self.snapshot) then
            self:reject("unnecessary retreat",point);continue
        end
        if objective.reserveCenter and not objective.orb then
            local radius=objective.reserveRadius or 65
            local before=math.abs(flat(node.pos-objective.reserveCenter).Magnitude-radius)
            local after=math.abs(flat(point-objective.reserveCenter).Magnitude-radius)
            progress=(before-after)*4
        end
        local risk=1/math.max(.5,math.min(20,clearance or 20))
        local cost=node.cost+risk*self.dt-progress*(objective.orb and 1 or .15)-opportunity*.8
        if self.io.positionCost then cost+=self.io.positionCost(point)*self.dt end
                                                                             
                                                                             
        if self.io.wallCost and toward and toward.Magnitude>.01 and not waiting
            and progress>0 and not objective.reserveCenter then
            local pressure=math.clamp(self.io.wallCost(node.pos),0,4)/4
            local alignment=math.max(0,direction:Dot(toward.Unit))
            cost-=pressure*(math.exp(2*alignment)-1)/(math.exp(2)-1)*self.dt*2
        end
        if objective.keepMoving and node.heading and direction.Magnitude>.01 then
            cost+=(1-math.clamp(node.heading:Dot(direction),-1,1))*.35
        end
        if waiting then cost+=objective.keepMoving and .4 or .03 end
        local arcTurn=arcTurns[choice]
        if arcTurn then
            cost+=.02*self.dt
            if node.arcTurn and node.arcTurn~=arcTurn then cost+=1 end
        end
        local path=table.clone(node.path);path[#path+1]={pos=point,t=nextTime,arcTurn=arcTurn}
        local child={pos=point,t=nextTime,cost=cost,ready=ready,actions=actions,path=path,actors=actors,orbs=orbs,heading=direction.Magnitude>.01 and direction or node.heading}
        child.waiting=waiting;child.waitTime=(node.waitTime or 0)+(waiting and self.dt or 0)
        child.arcTurn=arcTurn
        local signature=key(point)
        if arcTurn then signature..="|arc:"..arcTurn end
        if objective.keepMoving then signature..="|wait:"..tostring(child.waiting)..":"..tostring(child.waitTime)end
        for id,o in pairs(orbs)do signature..="|orb:"..tostring(id)..":"..(o.absorbed and "gone" or key(o.pos))end
        for id,at in pairs(ready)do signature..="|"..tostring(id)..":"..math.round(at*5)end
        local old=self.dedup[signature]
        if not old or cost<old.cost then self.dedup[signature]=child end
    end
    return index<#dirs
end
function Search:step(seconds,maxExpansions)
    if self.status~="searching"then return self.result,self.status end
    local deadline=self.io.clock()+(seconds or .004);local count=0
    while self.io.clock()<deadline and count<(maxExpansions or 32)do
        local node=self.frontier[self.cursor]
        if node then
            self.expanded+=1;count+=1
            local more=self:expand(node,self.directionCursor or 1)
            if more then self.directionCursor=(self.directionCursor or 1)+1
            else self.directionCursor=1;self.cursor+=1 end
        else
            local nextLayer={}
            for _,candidate in pairs(self.dedup)do
                if self.layer+1>=self.depth and self.io.terminal and not self.io.terminal(candidate)then
                    self:reject("terminal remains exposed",candidate.pos)
                else nextLayer[#nextLayer+1]=candidate end
            end
            table.sort(nextLayer,function(a,b)return a.cost<b.cost end)
                                                                          
                                                                         
                                                                         
            local diverse,used,chosen={},{},{}
            for _,candidate in ipairs(nextLayer)do
                local first=flat(candidate.path[1].pos-self.snapshot.player.pos)
                local sector=first.Magnitude<.01 and -1
                    or math.floor((math.atan2(first.Z,first.X)+math.pi)/(2*math.pi)*math.max(1,self.width-1))
                if not used[sector]then
                    used[sector]=true;diverse[#diverse+1]=candidate;chosen[candidate]=true
                    if #diverse>=self.width then break end
                end
            end
            for _,candidate in ipairs(nextLayer)do
                if #diverse>=self.width then break end
                if not chosen[candidate]then diverse[#diverse+1]=candidate end
            end
            nextLayer=diverse
            self.layer+=1
            if #nextLayer==0 then self.status="no verified sequence";return nil,self.status end
            if self.layer>=self.depth then
                self.finalists=nextLayer
                self.result={path=nextLayer[1].path,actions=nextLayer[1].actions,cost=nextLayer[1].cost,
                    origin=self.snapshot.player.pos,objective=self.snapshot.objective,
                    horizon=nextLayer[1].t,at=self.snapshot.at,revision=self.snapshot.revision,
                    expanded=self.expanded,rejected=self.rejected,unknown=self.unknown}
                self.status="complete";return self.result,self.status
            end
            self.frontier=nextLayer;self.cursor=1;self.dedup={}
        end
    end
    return nil,self.status
end
World.Search=Search
return World

end)()
                                                                     
                                                                       
Adaptive.forecastPassiveBeams =                   function(self,sample)
    for id,h in pairs(self.hazards or {})do if h.passiveForecast then self.hazards[id]=nil end end
    if not sample.targetId or sample.targetId.Name~="Midgardian Champion" then self.passiveEmitter=nil;return end
    local now=self.io.now();local rows={}
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards or {})do
        local part=h.part or h.id
        if typeof(part)=="Instance" and part.Name=="precast" and part.Parent and part.Parent.Name=="firstBossPassiveBeam"
            and h.axis and h.safeBefore and h.safeBefore>now-2 then rows[#rows+1]=h end
    end
    table.sort(rows,function(x,y)return x.safeBefore<y.safeBefore end)
    local state=self.passiveEmitter or {count=0};self.passiveEmitter=state
    for _,h in ipairs(rows)do
        if state.last and h.safeBefore<=state.last.safeBefore+.1 then continue end
        local angle=math.atan2(h.axis.Z,h.axis.X)
        if state.last then
            local dt=h.safeBefore-state.last.safeBefore
            local turn=(angle-state.angle+math.pi*.5)%math.pi-math.pi*.5
            if dt>.35 and dt<.7 and math.abs(turn)>.2 and math.abs(turn)<.5 then
                if state.turn and math.abs(turn-state.turn)<.06 then state.count+=1 else state.count=1 end
                state.turn=turn;state.interval=dt
            else state.count=0;state.turn=nil end
        end
        state.last=h;state.angle=angle
    end
    if state.count<2 or not state.last or now-state.last.safeBefore>.7 then return end
    for i=1,2 do
        local h=table.clone(state.last);local angle=state.angle+state.turn*i
        h.id="passive forecast:"..i;h.part=nil;h.passiveForecast=true
        h.axis=Vector3.new(math.cos(angle),0,math.sin(angle));h.turnRate=nil
        h.safeBefore=state.last.safeBefore+state.interval*i-.08
        h.untilTime=h.safeBefore+1.16;h.clearance=(h.clearance or 0)+2
        self.hazards[h.id]=h
    end
end 
Adaptive.worldReserveSafe =                   function(self,from,to)
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
        if not h.strategic then continue end
        local before=self:hazardMargin(h,from,0)
        if h.kind=="circle" and h.pos and h.radius then
            local delta=flat(to-from);local radial=flat(from-h.pos)
            if before<.75 then
                if delta:Dot(radial)<=0 then return false end
            else
                local u=math.clamp(-radial:Dot(delta)/math.max(.00001,delta:Dot(delta)),0,1)
                if self:hazardMargin(h,from+(to-from)*u,0)<.75 then return false end
            end
        end
        if before<.75 then
                                                                            
            local previous=before
            for i=1,8 do
                local margin=self:hazardMargin(h,from+(to-from)*(i/8),0)
                if margin<=previous+.00001 then return false end
                previous=margin
            end
        else
            for i=1,16 do
                if self:hazardMargin(h,from+(to-from)*(i/16),0)<.75 then return false end
            end
        end
    end
    return true
end 
Adaptive.worldHomingView =                   function(self,orbs)
    orbs=orbs or {}
    local ids={}
    for _,orb in ipairs(orbs)do
                                                                                       
        if not orb.id then return self end
        ids[orb.id]=true
    end
    local view=table.clone(self);setmetatable(view,getmetatable(self))
    view.io=table.clone(self.io);view.io.mechanicPathSafe=nil;view.hazards={}
    for id,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
        if not h.strategic and not ids[h.id] and not ids[h.part] and not ids[id] then view.hazards[id]=h end
    end
    return view
end 

Adaptive.worldWarningReachable =                   function(self,point,offset)
    local now=self.io.now()
    for _,h in pairs(self.hazards)do
        if h.bossShape=="moving" and not h.halfLength and h.origin and h.axis
            and h.speed and h.speed>0 and h.launch then
                                                                          
                                                                             
            local along=math.clamp(flat(point-h.origin):Dot(h.axis),0,h.length or math.huge)
            local closest=h.launch+along/h.speed
            local delay=closest-now-offset
            if delay>0 and delay<=2 then
                local gap=self:hazardMargin(h,point,offset+delay)
                if gap<.75 then
                    local speed=math.max(1,self.speed)
                    local base=math.max(1,self.baseSpeed or speed)
                    local boosted=self.boostUntil and math.clamp(self.boostUntil-now-offset,0,delay) or delay
                    local reach=speed*boosted+math.min(base,speed)*(delay-boosted)
                    if gap+reach<.75 then
                        self.worldWarningRejection={kind="projectile",at=now,offset=offset,point=point,
                            gap=gap,delay=delay,reach=reach,radius=h.radius,origin=h.origin,axis=h.axis,
                            speed=h.speed,launch=h.launch,untilTime=h.untilTime}
                        return false,self.worldWarningRejection
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if h.kind=="circle" and not h.contain and h.safeBefore and h.safeBefore>now+offset
            and (not h.bossShape or h.bossShape=="circle")then
            local lead=h.safeBefore-now
            local margin=self:hazardMargin(h,point,lead+.001)
            if margin<.75 and self:travelSeconds(.75-margin,offset)>lead-offset+.02 then
                self.worldWarningRejection={kind="circle",at=now,offset=offset,point=point,
                    gap=margin,delay=lead-offset,travel=self:travelSeconds(.75-margin,offset),
                    radius=h.radius,origin=h.pos,safeBefore=h.safeBefore,untilTime=h.untilTime}
                return false,self.worldWarningRejection
            end
        end
    end
    return true
end 

Adaptive.worldSegmentSafe =                   function(self,from,to,offset)
    offset=offset or 0
    local safe,worst,reason=self:pathRisk(from,to,offset)
    if not safe then return false,worst,reason end
    if worst>=.75 then return true,worst end
                                                                          
                                                                         
                                                                           
    local initial=self:margin(from,offset)
    local duration=self:travelSeconds(distance(from,to),offset)
    local finish=self:margin(to,offset+duration)
    if initial>=.75 or distance(from,to)<.05 or finish<=initial+.05 then
        return false,worst,"escape makes no clearance progress"
    end
    return true,worst
end 

Adaptive.observeWorld =                   function(self,sample)
    if not self.io.worldState then return end
    self:forecastPassiveBeams(sample)
    local orbObjective=sample.orbCover==true
    if self.worldOrbObjective~=orbObjective then
        self.worldOrbObjective=orbObjective
        self.worldObjectiveGeneration=(self.worldObjectiveGeneration or 0)+1
        self.worldActive=nil;self.worldPrediction=nil;self.worldGuide=nil;self.worldNextAt=0
    end
    local generation=self.worldObjectiveGeneration
    local bossPlanning=sample.keepCombatMotion or sample.orbCover
    if sample.keepCombatMotion and sample.targetId and not sample.orbCover then
        local root=sample.targetId:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or sample.targetId.PrimaryPart
        local engagement=sample.targetId.Name=="Bob The Frost Giant" and 260 or 160
        if root and distance(sample.position,root.Position)<=engagement then self.worldEncounterTarget=sample.targetId end
        if root and distance(sample.position,root.Position)>engagement and self.worldEncounterTarget~=sample.targetId then bossPlanning=false end
    end
    if not sample.keepCombatMotion and not sample.orbCover then self.worldEncounterTarget=nil end
    self.worldBossEngaged=bossPlanning==true
    if self.worldBossOnly~=false and not bossPlanning then
        self.worldActive=nil;self.worldPrediction=nil
        return
    end
    self.worldModel=self.worldModel or Adaptive.World.new()
    local state=self.io.worldState()
    local actors={};local known={}
    for _,actor in ipairs(sample.actors or {})do actors[#actors+1]=actor;known[actor.id]=true end
    for _,actor in ipairs(state.actors or {})do if not known[actor.id]then actors[#actors+1]=actor end end
    local destination=sample.orbCover and sample.goal or sample.escapeGoal or sample.goal
    if self.io.worldRoute and destination and not self.worldRouteBusy
        and (not self.worldRouteAt or self.io.now()>self.worldRouteAt)
        and (not self.worldRouteGoal or distance(destination,self.worldRouteGoal)>8 or not self.worldGuide
            or self.worldGuideRevision~=state.revision)then
        self.worldRouteBusy=true;self.worldRouteAt=self.io.now()+1
        local start=sample.position;local revision=state.revision
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok,route=pcall(self.io.worldRoute,start,destination)
            if generation==self.worldObjectiveGeneration and ok and route and #route>1 then
                self.worldGuide=route;self.worldRouteGoal=destination;self.worldGuideRevision=revision
            end
            self.worldRouteBusy=false
        end)
    end
    self.worldModel:observe({at=self.io.now(),mapId=state.mapId,revision=state.revision,
        terrain=state.terrain,actors=actors,hazards=self.hazards,skills=state.skills,landmarks=state.landmarks,mission=state.mission,homingOrbs=state.homingOrbs,
        player={pos=sample.position,hp=sample.hp,speed=self.speed,baseSpeed=self.baseSpeed,boostUntil=self.boostUntil,heading=self.command},
        objective={goal=destination,orb=sample.orbCover,arrival=sample.arrival,
            keepMoving=sample.keepCombatMotion and not sample.orbCover,
            target=sample.targetId,range=sample.arrival},mechanic=state.mechanic,patterns=self.patterns})
    if self.worldBusy or self.io.now()<(self.worldNextAt or 0) or not sample.goal or sample.hp<=0 then return end
    self.worldNextAt=self.io.now()+.2
    local snapshot=self.worldModel:snapshot()
    local root=sample.targetId and (sample.targetId:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or sample.targetId.PrimaryPart)
    local center=root and {pos=root.Position}
    if sample.keepCombatMotion and sample.targetId and sample.targetId.Name=="Midgardian Champion" and center then
                                                                                 
        snapshot.objective.reserveCenter=center.pos
                                                                        
                                                                         
        snapshot.objective.reserveRadius=40
    end
    local guide=self.worldGuide
    local remaining
    if guide and self.worldGuideRevision==state.revision and self.worldRouteGoal
        and distance(self.worldRouteGoal,destination)<8 then
        local suffix={};suffix[#guide]=distance(guide[#guide],destination)
        for i=#guide-1,1,-1 do suffix[i]=suffix[i+1]+distance(guide[i],guide[i+1])end
        remaining=function(point)
            local nearest,score=math.huge,math.huge
            for i=1,#guide-1 do
                local delta=flat(guide[i+1]-guide[i]);local length=delta.Magnitude
                if length>.01 then
                    local t=math.clamp(flat(point-guide[i]):Dot(delta)/(length*length),0,1)
                    local lateral=distance(point,guide[i]+delta*t)
                    if lateral<nearest then nearest=lateral;score=lateral*2+suffix[i+1]+length*(1-t)end
                end
            end
            return score<math.huge and score or distance(point,destination)
        end
    end
                                                                           
    local view=table.clone(self);view.hazards=snapshot.hazards;view.io=table.clone(self.io)
    view.worldWarningRejection=nil
    local reserveView=view
    view=view:worldHomingView(snapshot.homingOrbs)
    view.io.now=function()return snapshot.at end
    view.deadline=math.huge
    local originalMargin=self.io.margin
    view.io.margin=function(h,p,t)
        if h.launchTime then return originalMargin(h,p,t+snapshot.at-os.clock())end
        return originalMargin(h,p,t)
    end
                                                                            
                                                                                
    local terrainCache={};local terrainHits,terrainCalls=0,0
    local function terrain(from,to,world)
        local key=string.format("%.17g,%.17g,%.17g:%.17g,%.17g,%.17g",from.X,from.Y,from.Z,to.X,to.Y,to.Z)
        local cached=terrainCache[key]
        if cached then terrainHits+=1;return cached.point,cached.reason end
        terrainCalls+=1
        local point,reason=self.io.worldTerrain(from,to,world)
        terrainCache[key]={point=point,reason=reason}
        return point,reason
    end
    local function trajectory(from,to,start,duration)
        if not reserveView:worldReserveSafe(from,to) then return false,-math.huge,"spawner exclusion"end
        if not view:worldWarningReachable(to,start+duration)then return false,-math.huge,"warning exit deadline"end
        local travel=view:travelSeconds((to-from).Magnitude,start)
        if travel>duration+.02 then return false,-math.huge,"speed timeline"end
        local ok,worst,reason=view:worldSegmentSafe(from,to,start)
        if not ok then return false,worst,reason or "predicted collision"end
        local hold=math.max(0,duration-travel)
        if hold>0 then
            worst=math.min(worst,view:projectileSweep(to,to,hold,start+travel),view:surfaceSweep(to,to,hold,start+travel))
            for i=0,math.ceil(hold/.05)do worst=math.min(worst,view:margin(to,start+travel+math.min(hold,i*.05)))end
        end
        return hold<=.001 or worst>=.75,worst,"predicted collision"
    end
    local search=Adaptive.World.search(snapshot,{clock=os.clock,
        terrain=terrain,trajectory=trajectory,remaining=remaining,
        terminal=function(node)return view:endpointMargin(node.pos,node.t)>=.75 end,
        wallCost=self.io.worldWallCost,
        positionCost=function(point)return view:positionPreferenceCost(point)+(view.io.worldWallCost and view.io.worldWallCost(point) or 0)end,
        retreatRequired=function(node,goal)
            if not goal then return false end
            local delta=flat(goal-node.pos)
            if delta.Magnitude<1 then return false end
            if not self:worldReserveSafe(node.pos,node.pos) then return true end
            local duration=1
            local point=node.pos+delta.Unit*math.min(delta.Magnitude,view.speed*duration)
            local safe=trajectory(node.pos,point,node.t,duration)
            if not safe then return true end
            if not Adaptive.World.Search.advanceOrbs({dt=duration},node,point) then return true end
            return false
        end,
        targets=function(point,t,skill,world)
            local n=0
            for _,actor in pairs(world.actors)do
                if actor.observed and actor.pos and actor.clear~=false then
                    local p=actor.pos
                    if not world.simulated then p+=(actor.velocity or Vector3.zero)*math.min(t,.5)end
                    if math.abs(p.Y-point.Y)<=(skill.vertical or 6) and flat(p-point).Magnitude<=(skill.range or 0) then n+=1 end
                end
            end
            return n
        end},{dt=.25,depth=16,width=6})
    self.worldBusy=true
    self.worldEvidence={status="simulating",at=snapshot.at,mode=self.worldControl and "control"or"shadow",
        observations=snapshot.observations,mapId=snapshot.mapId}
    task.spawn(function()
        local started=os.clock()
        local publishedPrefix=false
        local ok,err=pcall(function()
            while search.status=="searching" do
                if generation~=self.worldObjectiveGeneration then search.status="objective changed";break end
                search:step(.004,96)
                                                                         
                                                                            
                                                                           
                if not publishedPrefix and search.layer>=4 and search.status=="searching" then
                    for i=1,math.min(4,#search.frontier)do
                        local candidate=search.frontier[i]
                        if view:endpointMargin(candidate.pos,candidate.t)<.75 then continue end
                        local from=snapshot.player.pos;local valid=true
                        for _,step in ipairs(candidate.path)do
                            if (step.pos-from).Magnitude>.05 then
                                local success,point=pcall(self.io.probe,from,step.pos)
                                if not success or not point or (point-step.pos).Magnitude>1.5 then valid=false;break end
                            end
                            from=step.pos
                        end
                        if generation==self.worldObjectiveGeneration and valid and os.clock()-snapshot.at<=1 then
                            publishedPrefix=true
                            self.worldPrediction={path=candidate.path,actions=candidate.actions,cost=candidate.cost,
                                origin=snapshot.player.pos,objective=snapshot.objective,revision=snapshot.revision,
                                at=snapshot.at,horizon=candidate.t}
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
                if search.status~="searching"then break end
                if os.clock()-snapshot.at>1 then search.status="snapshot exceeded planning age";break end
                task.wait()
            end
        end)
        local result=ok and search.result
        if result then
                                                                             
                                                                           
            local selected
            for i=1,math.min(4,#search.finalists)do
                local candidate=search.finalists[i];local from=snapshot.player.pos;local valid=true
                for _,step in ipairs(candidate.path)do
                    if (step.pos-from).Magnitude>.05 then
                        local success,point=pcall(self.io.probe,from,step.pos)
                        if not success or not point or (point-step.pos).Magnitude>1.5 then valid=false;break end
                    end
                    from=step.pos
                end
                if valid then selected=candidate;break end
                task.wait()
            end
            if selected then result.path=selected.path;result.actions=selected.actions;result.cost=selected.cost
            else result=nil;search.status="no connected sequence"end
        end
        if result and os.clock()-snapshot.at>1 then
            result=nil;search.status="snapshot exceeded planning age"
        end
        self.worldEvidence={status=ok and search.status or tostring(err),at=snapshot.at,
            planningSeconds=os.clock()-started,expanded=search.expanded,rejected=search.rejected,
            horizon=result and result.horizon,mode=self.worldControl and "control"or"shadow",
            observations=snapshot.observations,mapId=snapshot.mapId,
            first=result and result.path[1].pos,terminal=result and result.path[#result.path].pos,
            warning=view.worldWarningRejection,terrainCalls=terrainCalls,terrainCacheHits=terrainHits}
        self.worldLastCompleted=table.clone(self.worldEvidence)
        if result and generation==self.worldObjectiveGeneration then self.worldPrediction=result end
        self.worldBusy=false
    end)
end 

Adaptive.followWorldPlan =                   function(self,sample)
    if not self.worldControl or not sample.enabled or sample.hp<=0 or sample.protected then return false end
    if self.worldBossEngaged==false then self.worldActive=nil;return false end
    if self.worldBossOnly~=false and not (sample.keepCombatMotion or sample.orbCover) then
        self.worldActive=nil;self.worldPrediction=nil
        return false
    end
    local now=self.io.now();local prediction=self.worldPrediction
    if self.worldActive and self.worldActive.context~=sample.routeContext then self.worldActive=nil end
    if self.worldActive then
        local active=self.worldActive;local objective=active.objective or {}
        if active.revision~=self.revision or now-active.at>4
            or (objective.orb==true)~=(sample.orbCover==true)
            or sample.orbCover and (not objective.orb or not objective.goal or distance(objective.goal,sample.goal)>=3) then
            self.worldActive=nil
        end
    end
                                                                            
                                                                             
                                          
    if not self.worldActive and prediction and prediction~=self.worldConsumed then
        self.worldConsumed=prediction
        local objective=prediction.objective or {}
                                                                            
                                                                                 
        if now-prediction.at>1 then
            self.worldHandoff="snapshot exceeded planning age"
        elseif prediction.revision==self.revision and (objective.orb==true)==(sample.orbCover==true) and (not sample.orbCover or objective.orb
            and objective.goal and distance(objective.goal,sample.goal)<3)then
            self.worldActive={path=prediction.path,index=1,at=now,revision=prediction.revision,
                origin=prediction.origin,context=sample.routeContext,objective=objective}
        else
            self.worldHandoff="simulation objective or geometry changed"
        end
    end
    local plan=self.worldActive
    if not plan or plan.revision~=self.revision or now-plan.at>4 then self.worldActive=nil;return false end
    local step=plan.path[plan.index]
    local function reached(point,index)
        if flat(point.pos-sample.position).Magnitude<.5 then return true end
        local previous=plan.path[index-1] or {pos=plan.origin}
        if not previous.pos then return false end
        local segment=flat(point.pos-previous.pos)
        if segment.Magnitude<.05 then return false end
        local delta=flat(sample.position-point.pos)
        local along=delta:Dot(segment.Unit)
                                                                        
                                                                          
        return along>=0 and (delta-segment.Unit*along).Magnitude<=1.5
    end
    while step and reached(step,plan.index) do
        local previous=plan.path[plan.index-1] or {pos=plan.origin,t=0}
        local isWait=previous and flat(step.pos-previous.pos).Magnitude<.05
        if isWait then
            if sample.orbCover and sample.goal and flat(sample.goal-sample.position).Magnitude>(sample.arrival or 2)then
                self.worldActive=nil;self.worldHandoff="orb delivery cannot wait before cover";return false
            end
            plan.waitUntil=plan.waitUntil or now+(step.t-previous.t)
            if now<plan.waitUntil then break end
        end
        plan.waitUntil=nil;plan.index+=1;step=plan.path[plan.index]
    end
    if not step then self.worldActive=nil;return false end
                                                                              
                                                                              
    local from=sample.position;local offset=0;local verifiedEnd
    local orbs=self.io.worldState and self.io.worldState().homingOrbs
    local view=self:worldHomingView(orbs)
    local orbNode=orbs and #orbs>0 and view~=self and {pos=from,orbs=orbs}or nil
    local function advanceOrbs(point,duration)
        if not orbNode then return true end
        local nextOrbs=Adaptive.World.Search.advanceOrbs({dt=duration},orbNode,point)
        if not nextOrbs then return false end
        orbNode={pos=point,orbs=nextOrbs};return true
    end
    for i=plan.index,#plan.path do
        local point=plan.path[i].pos
        local duration=self:travelSeconds(distance(from,point),offset)
        local previous=plan.path[i-1] or {pos=plan.origin,t=0}
        if previous and distance(point,previous.pos)<.05 then
            duration=i==plan.index and math.max(0,(plan.waitUntil or now)-now) or plan.path[i].t-previous.t
        end
        local priorOrbNode=orbNode
        if not self:worldReserveSafe(from,point)then
            self.worldActive=nil;self.worldHandoff="spawner exclusion changed";return false
        end
        local safe,worst,reason=view:worldSegmentSafe(from,point,offset)
        if not advanceOrbs(point,duration)then
            self.worldActive=nil;self.worldHandoff="homing interception in simulated sequence";return false
        end
        local reachable,warning=self:worldWarningReachable(point,offset+duration)
        if not reachable then safe=false;worst=-math.huge;reason="warning exit deadline" end
        if not safe then
            self.worldSegmentRejection={at=now,index=i,reason=reason,margin=worst,from=from,to=point,offset=offset,warning=warning}
                                                                          
                                                                       
            if verifiedEnd and offset>=.5 then
                    local reserve=math.min(view:projectileSweep(from,from,.5,offset),view:surfaceSweep(from,from,.5,offset))
                if reserve>=.75 then
                    local prefix={}
                    for j=1,verifiedEnd do prefix[j]=plan.path[j]end
                    plan.path=prefix;self.worldNextAt=0;orbNode=priorOrbNode
                    break
                end
            end
            self.worldActive=nil;self.worldHandoff="new collision in simulated sequence";return false
        end
        if duration>0 and distance(from,point)<.05 then
            worst=math.min(view:projectileSweep(point,point,duration,offset),view:surfaceSweep(point,point,duration,offset))
            if worst<.75 then self.worldActive=nil;self.worldHandoff="wait became unsafe";return false end
        end
        offset+=duration;from=point;verifiedEnd=i
    end
    local hold=math.min(view:projectileSweep(from,from,.35,offset),view:surfaceSweep(from,from,.35,offset))
    if not advanceOrbs(from,.35)then self.worldActive=nil;self.worldHandoff="terminal homing interception";return false end
    if hold<.75 or view:endpointMargin(from,offset)<.75 then self.worldActive=nil;self.worldHandoff="terminal lost clearance";return false end
    if plan.waitUntil and now<plan.waitUntil then
        self.io.stop();self.command=nil;self.status="waiting in simulated safe interval";return true
    end
    self.budget=math.max(self.budget or 0,(self.queries or 0)+1)
    local point,why=self:probe(sample.position,step.pos,true,true)
    if not point or distance(point,step.pos)>1.5 then
        self.worldActive=nil;self.worldHandoff=why or "simulation connection changed";return false
    end
    local delta=flat(point-sample.position)
    if delta.Magnitude<.05 then return false end
    if self.neutralApproach and delta:Dot(self.neutralApproach)<-.01 then
        self.worldActive=nil;self.worldHandoff="neutral retreat rejected";return false
    end
    self:releasePocket();self:releaseTimedDodge();self.search=nil
    self.route={point};self.routeEscape=false;self.routeMacro=false;self.routeSource="world forward simulation"
    self.command=delta.Unit
    self.io.move(delta.Unit,.12,point)
    self.worldHandoff="following verified sequence";self.status=self.worldHandoff
    return true
end 

Adaptive.tick =                   function(self,sample)
    local now=self.io.now();self.queries=0
                                           
    self.lastTickAt=now;self.tickStage="begin"
    self.treeFight=false
    for _,actor in ipairs(sample.actors or {})do if actor.barrage then self.treeFight=true;break end end
    self.tickDeadline=now+(self.treeFight and .012 or .006)
    self.deadline=now+(self.treeFight and .008 or .003)
    local revision=sample.revision or 0
    if self.revision~=revision then
        self.probeCache={};self.search=nil;self.failedSearch=nil;self.retryAt=0
        if self.backtrack then self.route={};self.command=nil end
        self.backtrack=nil;self.breadcrumbs={};self.progressWatch=nil;self.recoveryAvoid=nil
    end
    self.revision=revision
    self.speed=math.max(1,sample.speed or 16);self.arrival=sample.arrival or 2
    self.combatIntent=sample.combatIntent
                                                                            
    self.keepCombatMotion=sample.keepCombatMotion==true
    self.groupEnemies=sample.groupEnemies==true
    local coverChanged=sample.orbCover and (not self.orbCoverGoal or distance(self.orbCoverGoal,sample.goal)>16)
    local coverEnded=self.orbCoverGoal~=nil and not sample.orbCover
    self.orbCoverGoal=sample.orbCover and sample.goal or nil
    if coverChanged or coverEnded then
                                                                             
        self.route={};self.command=nil;self.search=nil;self.directionCommit=nil
        self.routeEscape=false;self.travelPlan=nil;self.offeredRoute=nil
        self.failedSearch=nil;self.retryAt=0;self.escapeCandidates=nil
        self.worldActive=nil;self.worldPrediction=nil;self.worldGuide=nil
        self.worldRouteGoal=nil;self.worldRouteAt=0;self.worldNextAt=0
        self.coverOffer=nil;self.pocketScan=nil;self.orbRouteEvidence=nil
        self:releaseTimedDodge();self:releasePocket()
    end
    self.continuousMovement=sample.orbCover==true
    self.primaryTask=sample.orbCover and "DELIVER_ORB" or nil
    self.escapeGoal=sample.escapeGoal
    self.warningSpeed=math.max(1,math.min(self.speed,sample.baseSpeed or self.speed))
    self.baseSpeed=sample.baseSpeed;self.boostUntil=sample.boostUntil
    if self.keepCombatMotion and sample.approachTarget~=false then
        self.combatIntent=self.combatIntent and table.clone(self.combatIntent) or {target=sample.targetId,range=sample.arrival}
        self.combatIntent.mode="kite"
    end
    local protected=sample.protected==true
    if protected~=self.protected then
        self.route={};self.command=nil;self.search=nil;self.routeEscape=false
        self.failedSearch=nil;self.retryAt=0;self.probeCache={}
        self:releaseTimedDodge();self:releasePocket()
        self.io.stop()
    end
    self.protected=protected
    self.evasionDisabled=sample.evadeEnabled==false
    if self.evasionDisabled then
        self:releaseTimedDodge()
        self:releasePocket();self.pocketScan=nil;self.coverOffer=nil;self.escapeCandidates=nil
        if self.routeEscape then self.route={};self.command=nil;self.routeEscape=false;self.search=nil end
        if self.search and self.search.escape then self.search=nil end
    end
    self:learnEngagement(sample,now)
    if sample.canAttack then self.arrival=self:engagementDistance(sample.targetSignature,self.arrival) end
    self:observe(sample.position,sample.hp,now,sample.grounded)
    self.protected=sample.protected==true
    self:effects(sample.effects or {},now)
    self.actors=sample.actors or {}
    self:observeWorld(sample)
    if sample.enabled and sample.hp>0 then
        for _,zone in ipairs(sample.requiredShelter or {})do
            local future=math.max(0,(zone.safeBefore or now)-now+.001)
            if zone.kind=="requiredZone" and zone.scriptedMargin and
                (not zone.untilTime or now<zone.untilTime) and
                zone.scriptedMargin(zone,sample.position,future,now)>=2 then
                self:releaseTimedDodge();self:releasePocket()
                self.route={};self.command=nil;self.search=nil;self.routeEscape=false
                self.io.stop();self.status="holding inside shelter";return
            end
        end
    end
    local continuity=self:attackContinuity(sample.effects or {},sample.position,now,sample.enabled and sample.hp>0 and sample.evadeEnabled~=false)
    self.continuityActive=continuity
    self.tickStage="threat"
    local physicalDanger=self:threat(sample.position)<.75
    self.lastPhysicalDanger=physicalDanger;self.tickStage="planning"
    local danger=physicalDanger or continuity
    if self:neutralApproachGate(sample,danger)then return end
    if self:continueEscape(sample,danger)then return end
    self.tickStage="finish-check"
    if physicalDanger and self:canFinishBeforeHit(sample,now,continuity)then
        self.route={};self.routeEscape=false;self.command=nil;self.search=nil;self.escapeCandidates=nil
        self.io.stop();self.status="finishing before attack impact";return
    end
                                                                              
                                                                            
    if not danger and not self.safePocket and self.routeEscape and sample.combatIntent and sample.combatIntent.mode=="finish" then
        self.route={};self.routeEscape=false;self.command=nil;self.search=nil;self.escapeCandidates=nil
    end
    self.tickStage="walls"
    self:updateWalls(sample.position,sample.goal,sample.enabled and not danger)
    if not danger then self:prepareWallGraph(sample.position,sample.goal) end
    if self.ownerRetired then
        if not danger and not self.safePocket and self.routeEscape then self.route={};self.routeEscape=false;self.command=nil end
        self.ownerRetired=nil
    end
    if danger and not sample.orbCover and self.search and not self.search.escape then self.search=nil end
    if not sample.enabled or not sample.goal and not danger then
        self:releaseTimedDodge()
        self:releasePocket();self.pocketScan=nil
        self.backtrack=nil;self.progressWatch=nil;self.breadcrumbs={};self.recoveryAvoid=nil
        self.command=nil;self.route={};self.search=nil;self.io.stop();self.status="idle";return
    end
    local goal=sample.goal or sample.position
    self.pursueWhileDodging=not sample.canAttack or distance(sample.position,sample.attackPosition or goal)>self.arrival
    local objectiveChanged=sample.routeContext~=nil and self.routeContext~=nil and sample.routeContext~=self.routeContext
    if objectiveChanged or sample.targetRetired then
        self.directionCommit=nil;self.travelPlan=nil;self.offeredRoute=nil
                                                                             
                                                                               
        self.backtrack=nil;self.progressWatch=nil;self.breadcrumbs={sample.position};self.recoveryAvoid=nil
        self.offeredRoute=nil;self.failedSearch=nil;self.retryAt=0;self.driveObservation=nil
        if not self.routeEscape or not danger then
            if not danger then self:releasePocket()end
            self.route={};self.command=nil;self.search=nil;self.escapeCandidates=nil
            self.routeEscape=false;self.routeMacro=false;self.routeDirect=false;self.routeStreamed=false
        end
    end
    self.routeContext=sample.routeContext
    local changed=not self.goal or distance(self.goal,goal)>8
    if changed then
        local relocated=self.goal and (distance(self.goal,goal)>24 or math.abs(self.goal.Y-goal.Y)>4)
        self.goal=goal;self.search=nil;self.failedSearch=nil;self.retryAt=0
        if relocated and not self.routeEscape then
            self.route={};self.command=nil;self.routeMacro=false;self.routeDirect=false;self.routeStreamed=false
            self.driveObservation=nil
        end
        if self.offeredRoute and distance(self.offeredRoute.goal,goal)>8 then self.offeredRoute=nil end
    end
    self.tickStage="travel-memory"
    self:rememberTravelRoute(now)
    if sample.orbCover then
        self.deadline=self.io.now()+.005;self.budget=math.max(self.budget,self.queries+8)
        if self:advanceOrbCover(sample)then return end
    end
    if not sample.orbCover and not danger and self.keepCombatMotion then
        self.deadline=self.io.now()+.005;self.budget=math.max(self.budget,self.queries+8)
        sample.spawnBufferOnly=true
        local buffered=self:bossCombatStep(sample)
        sample.spawnBufferOnly=nil
        if buffered then return end
        if self:prepareCasterApproach(sample.position,now) and self:drive(sample.position,true)then return end
        self.deadline=self.io.now()+.004;self.budget=math.max(self.budget,self.queries+8)
        if self:bossCombatStep(sample)then return end
    end
    if physicalDanger and sample.enabled and sample.hp>0 and sample.evadeEnabled~=false then
                                                                                         
        self.deadline=self.io.now()+.008
        local savedBudget=self.budget
        self.budget=math.max(self.budget,self.queries+8)
        local moved=false
        self.tickStage="urgent-exit"
        self:urgentAreaExit(sample.position)
        if self.routeEscape and self.route[1]then
            moved=self:drive(sample.position,true)
        end
        if not moved then
            self:urgentAreaExit(sample.position)
            if not self.route[1]then self:chooseEscape(sample.position,false)end
            if self.route[1]then
                self.deadline=math.max(self.deadline,self.io.now()+.002)
                moved=self:drive(sample.position,true)
            end
        end
        self.budget=savedBudget
        if moved then self.safePocket=nil;self.pocketScan=nil;return end
        self.deadline=self.io.now()+.003;self.tickDeadline=self.deadline
    end
    if not sample.orbCover and self:approachDuringDodge(sample,now,danger) then return end
    local plannerDeadline=self.deadline
    self.deadline=math.min(self.deadline,self.io.now()+.0015)
    local timedHandled=not sample.orbCover and self:updateTimedDodge(sample,now)
    self.deadline=plannerDeadline
    if timedHandled then return end
    self.deadline=math.min(self.deadline,self.io.now()+.0015)
    local pocketHandled=not sample.orbCover and not self.treeFight and self:updateSafePocket(sample,now,danger)
    self.deadline=plannerDeadline
    if pocketHandled then return end
    if not danger then self:resumeTravelRoute(sample.position,now) end
    local recovering=self:recoverProgress(sample,now,danger)
    if recovering then
                                                                          
                                                                         
        self.deadline=math.min(self.tickDeadline,self.io.now()+.003)
        self:drive(sample.position,false)
        return
    end
                                                                               
                                                                         
                                                                         
    self.deadline=math.min(self.tickDeadline,self.io.now()+.003)
    if not physicalDanger and sample.enabled and sample.evadeEnabled~=false then self:prepareCasterApproach(sample.position,now) end
                                                                             
                                                                              
    if not danger and not (self.routeEscape and self.route[1]) and sample.canAttack and distance(sample.position,sample.attackPosition or goal)<=self.arrival then
        self.command=nil;self.io.stop();self.status="attacking from verified range";return
    end
    self.escapePreferred=self.command or (self.route[1] and flat(self.route[1]-sample.position))
    if not danger and self.routeEscape and not self.route[1] then self.routeEscape=false;self.search=nil end
                                                                               
    self.deadline=math.min(self.tickDeadline,self.io.now()+.003)
    if not danger and not self.route[1] then self:joinOfferedRoute(sample.position) end
    if not danger and not self.routeEscape and self.offeredRoute and self.offeredRoute.complete then
        local finish=self.route[#self.route]
        if not finish or math.abs(finish.Y-self.goal.Y)>4 or flat(finish-self.goal).Magnitude>8 then
            self:joinOfferedRoute(sample.position)
        else
            self:joinOfferedRoute(sample.position,true)
        end
    end
    if not danger and (not sample.canAttack or distance(sample.position,self.goal)>self.arrival) then self:directApproach(sample.position) end
    if danger and (self.lastAreaExitEpoch~=self.hazardEpoch or now>=(self.nextAreaExit or 0)) then
        self.lastAreaExitEpoch=self.hazardEpoch;self.nextAreaExit=now+.15
        self:urgentAreaExit(sample.position)
    end
    if danger and (not self.route[1] or not self.routeEscape and not self:clearMotion(sample.position,self.route[1])
        or self.routeEscape and distance(sample.position,self.route[#self.route])<self.speed*.35) then
        self:forwardEscape(sample.position)
    end
                                                                          
                                                                             
                                                                             
    local progress=self:dodgeProgressDirection(sample.position)
    local retreat=self.routeEscape and self.route[1] and flat(self.route[1]-sample.position)
    if progress and retreat and retreat.Magnitude>.1 and retreat.Unit:Dot(progress)<.15
        and self:margin(sample.position,0)>=.75 and now>=(self.nextProgressEscape or 0) then
        self.nextProgressEscape=now+.3
        self:forwardEscape(sample.position,true)
    end
                                                                        
                                                                          
    self.deferHandoffStop=danger
    local driven=self.route[1] and self:drive(sample.position,danger)
    self.deferHandoffStop=nil
    if danger and not driven and not self.routeEscape then self:joinCoverRoute(sample.position) end
    if not self.route[1] and danger then
                                                                          
                                                                           
        self.deadline=math.min(self.tickDeadline,math.max(self.deadline,self.io.now()+.0015))
        if not self:joinCoverRoute(sample.position) then self:chooseEscape(sample.position,true) end
        if not self.route[1] then
                                                                           
                                                                           
                                                                 
            local savedBudget=self.budget
            self.budget=math.max(self.budget,self.queries+2)
            self.deadline=self.io.now()+.004
            local found=self:reduceExposure(sample.position)
            if found then
                self.deadline=self.io.now()+.003
                self.budget=math.max(self.budget,self.queries+2)
                driven=self:drive(sample.position,true)
            end
            self.budget=savedBudget
            if driven then return end
        end
    end
    if not danger and not self.route[1] and self.routeEscape then
        self.routeEscape=false;self.search=nil
        if sample.canAttack and distance(sample.position,sample.attackPosition or goal)<=self.arrival then
            self.command=nil;self.io.stop();self.status="attacking from verified range";return
        end
        self:joinOfferedRoute(sample.position)
        if not self.route[1] then self:directApproach(sample.position) end
    end
    local escapeSearch=danger and not sample.orbCover
    local failed=self.failedSearch
    local unchanged=failed and distance(failed.position,sample.position)<1 and distance(failed.goal,self.goal)<2
        and failed.revision==self.revision and failed.escape==escapeSearch and failed.hazards==self.hazardEpoch
        and (not failed.retryAt or now<failed.retryAt)
    if self.search and not self.route[1] and not escapeSearch then
        local start=self.nodes[self.search.start]
        if start and distance(start.p,sample.position)>8 then self:startSearch(sample.position,self.goal,false) end
    end
    if not self.search and not ((danger or self.routeEscape) and self.route[1]) and not (self.routeMacro and self.route[1]) and not unchanged and (now>=(self.retryAt or 0) or danger) then
        self:startSearch(sample.position,self.goal,escapeSearch)
    end
    self:searchSlice(sample.position)
    if self.route[1] then
        if not driven then
            if not self:drive(sample.position,danger) and self.route[1] then
                self.status="validating route handoff"
            end
        end
    else
        self.command=nil
        self.io.stop();self.status=danger and "seeking connected shelter" or (self.blacklistedWalls or 0)>0 and "wall blacklisted; finding detour" or "seeking local connection"
    end
end
