function Adaptive:snapshot(compact)
    local nodes={}
    for k,n in pairs(self.archive) do nodes[k]=n end
    for k,n in pairs(self.nodes) do
        nodes[k]=packNode(n)
    end
    local format
    if compact then
                                                                          
                                                            
        local needed={}
        for k,n in pairs(nodes) do
            for to,e in pairs(n.edges) do if e.success>0 then needed[k]=true;if nodes[to] then needed[to]=true end end end
        end
        local ids,packed={},{}
        for k in pairs(needed) do
            local n=nodes[k];ids[k]=#packed+1;packed[#packed+1]={n.p[1],n.p[2],n.p[3],{}}
        end
        for k,id in pairs(ids) do
            for to,e in pairs(nodes[k].edges) do
                if e.success>0 then
                    table.insert(packed[id][4],{ids[to] or to,e.success,e.cost,e.failures or 0,e.time or 0,e.damage or 0})
                end
            end
        end
        nodes=packed;format="indexed-v1"
    end
    return {version=2,nodeFormat=format,nodes=nodes,patterns=self.patterns,stats=self.stats,engagements=self.engagements,traversed=self.traversed,continuityProfiles=self.continuityProfiles,attackTransitions=self.attackTransitions,attackCadence=self.attackCadence,behaviorProfiles=self.behaviorProfiles}
end
function Adaptive:restore(saved)
    if type(saved)~="table" or saved.version~=2 then return end
    if saved.nodeFormat=="indexed-v1" then
        if type(saved.nodes)~="table" or #saved.nodes>120000 then return end
        local keys,expanded={},{}
        for i,n in ipairs(saved.nodes)do
            if type(n)~="table" or not finite(n[1]) or not finite(n[2]) or not finite(n[3]) or type(n[4])~="table" or #n[4]>128 then return end
            local k=key(Vector3.new(n[1],n[2],n[3]));keys[i]=k;expanded[k]={p={n[1],n[2],n[3]},edges={}}
        end
        for i,n in ipairs(saved.nodes)do
            for _,e in ipairs(n[4])do
                if type(e)~="table" then return end
                local to=type(e[1])=="number" and keys[e[1]] or e[1]
                if type(to)~="string" then return end
                expanded[keys[i]].edges[to]={success=e[2],cost=e[3],failures=e[4],time=e[5],damage=e[6],needsValidation=true}
            end
        end
        saved=table.clone(saved);saved.nodes=expanded
    elseif saved.nodeFormat~=nil then return end
    local behaviorCount=0
    for k,p in pairs(type(saved.behaviorProfiles)=="table" and saved.behaviorProfiles or {}) do
        if behaviorCount>=256 then break end
        if type(k)~="string" or #k>300 or type(p)~="table" then continue end
        local clean={};local valid=true
        for _,field in ipairs({"episodes","turning","growing","following","maxSpeed","maxObservedLife"}) do
            local v=p[field]
            if not finite(v) or v<0 or v>10000 then valid=false;break end
            clean[field]=v
        end
        if valid and clean.episodes>=1 and clean.turning<=clean.episodes and clean.growing<=clean.episodes
            and clean.following<=clean.episodes and clean.maxSpeed<=240 and clean.maxObservedLife<=120 then
            self.behaviorProfiles[k]=clean;behaviorCount+=1
        end
    end
    local transitionCount=0
    for k,p in pairs(type(saved.attackTransitions)=="table" and saved.attackTransitions or {}) do
        if transitionCount>=256 then break end
        if type(k)~="string" or #k>1300 or type(p)~="table" or type(p.next)~="string" or #p.next>240 then continue end
        local clean={next=p.next};local valid=true
        for _,f in ipairs({"n","streak","hits","minGap","maxGap"}) do
            if not finite(p[f]) or p[f]<0 or p[f]>10000 then valid=false;break end
            clean[f]=p[f]
        end
        if valid and clean.n>=1 and clean.hits<=clean.n and clean.streak<=clean.hits
            and clean.minGap>=.08 and clean.minGap<=clean.maxGap and clean.maxGap<=12 then
            self.attackTransitions[k]=clean;transitionCount+=1
        end
    end
    local cadenceCount=0
    for k,p in pairs(type(saved.attackCadence)=="table" and saved.attackCadence or {}) do
        if cadenceCount>=128 then break end
        if type(k)=="string" and #k<=240 and type(p)=="table" and finite(p.n) and p.n>=1 and p.n<=10000
            and finite(p.minGap) and finite(p.maxGap) and p.minGap>=.15 and p.maxGap<=12 and p.minGap<=p.maxGap then
            self.attackCadence[k]={n=p.n,minGap=p.minGap,maxGap=p.maxGap};cadenceCount+=1
        end
    end
    local profileCount=0
    for k,p in pairs(type(saved.continuityProfiles)=="table" and saved.continuityProfiles or {}) do
        if profileCount>=256 then break end
        if type(k)~="string" or #k>240 or type(p)~="table" then continue end
        local valid=true;local clean={}
        for _,f in ipairs({"n","exposed","minDuration","maxDuration","pauses","moving","outages"}) do
            if not finite(p[f]) or p[f]<0 or p[f]>1e6 then valid=false;break end
            clean[f]=p[f]
        end
        if valid and clean.minDuration<=clean.maxDuration and clean.maxDuration<=8 and clean.exposed<=clean.n then
            self.continuityProfiles[k]=clean;profileCount+=1
        end
    end
    for i,p in ipairs(type(saved.traversed)=="table" and saved.traversed or {}) do
        if i>12000 then break end
        if type(p)=="table" and finite(p[1]) and finite(p[2]) and finite(p[3]) then
            self:recordTraversal(Vector3.new(p[1],p[2],p[3]))
        end
    end
    for signature,data in pairs(type(saved.engagements)=="table" and saved.engagements or {}) do
        if type(data)~="table" then continue end
        local p=self:engagementProfile(signature)
        if not p then continue end
        for _,field in ipairs({"starts","provokedStarts","stops","hitCount","missCount","startLow","startHigh","hitDelayMax"}) do
            if finite(data[field]) and data[field]>=0 then p[field]=math.min(data[field],1e6) end
        end
        for k,b in pairs(type(data.bins)=="table" and data.bins or {}) do
            local idx=tonumber(k)
            if type(k)=="string" and idx and idx>=0 and idx<=100 and idx%1==0 and type(b)=="table" then
                local clean={}
                for _,f in ipairs({"idle","chase","hits","misses"}) do clean[f]=finite(b[f]) and math.clamp(b[f],0,1e6) or 0 end
                p.bins[k]=clean
            end
        end
    end
    local canonical={}
    for k,n in pairs(type(saved.nodes)=="table" and saved.nodes or {}) do
        if type(n)=="table" and type(n.p)=="table" and finite(n.p[1]) and finite(n.p[2]) and finite(n.p[3]) then
            canonical[k]=key(Vector3.new(n.p[1],n.p[2],n.p[3]))
        end
    end
    for k,n in pairs(type(saved.nodes)=="table" and saved.nodes or {}) do
        if type(k)=="string" and #k<80 and type(n)=="table" and type(n.p)=="table"
            and finite(n.p[1]) and finite(n.p[2]) and finite(n.p[3]) then
            local p=Vector3.new(n.p[1],n.p[2],n.p[3]);local node
            if self.count<1000 then node=self:node(p)
            else node={p=n.p,edges={}};self.archive[key(p)]=node end
            for to,e in pairs(type(n.edges)=="table" and n.edges or {}) do
                if type(to)=="string" and #to<80 and type(e)=="table" and finite(e.success) and e.success>0
                    and finite(e.cost) and e.cost>0 and e.cost<20 then
                    node.edges[canonical[to] or to]={success=math.min(e.success,1e6),cost=e.cost,failures=math.clamp(tonumber(e.failures) or 0,0,100),
                        time=math.clamp(tonumber(e.time) or 0,0,1e6),damage=math.clamp(tonumber(e.damage) or 0,0,1e8),
                        needsValidation=true}
                    self:indexRecorded(p)
                end
            end
        end
    end
                                                                                  
    local count=0
    for k,p in pairs(type(saved.patterns)=="table" and saved.patterns or {}) do
        if count>=256 then break end
        if type(k)=="string" and #k<500 and type(p)=="table" and finite(p.n) and finite(p.delay)
            and finite(p.duration) and p.n>=0 and p.delay>=0 and p.delay<=4 and p.duration>0 and p.duration<=30 then
            self.patterns[k]=p;count+=1
        end
    end
end
return Adaptive


end)()
function R.ai.shortestEncounterOrder(cost,count)
    if count<2 or count>4 then return end
    local full=2^count-1;local memo={}
    local function solve(last,mask)
        if mask==full then return cost[last] and cost[last][count+1] or math.huge,{} end
        local key=last..":"..mask
        if memo[key] then return memo[key].cost,memo[key].order end
        local best,order=math.huge,nil
        for i=1,count do
            if bit32.band(mask,2^(i-1))==0 then
                local edge=cost[last] and cost[last][i]
                if edge and edge<math.huge then
                    local tail,rest=solve(i,bit32.bor(mask,2^(i-1)))
                    if edge+tail<best then
                        best=edge+tail;order={i}
                        for _,v in ipairs(rest) do order[#order+1]=v end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        memo[key]={cost=best,order=order};return best,order
    end
    local total,order=solve(0,0)
    return order,total
end

do
    local a=R.ai
    local state={nextAt=0,cache={},busy=false}
    local alive; alive =                   function(e)
        return e.root and e.root.Parent and enemyAlive(e.model)
    end 
    local encounterSelection; encounterSelection =                   function()
        local plan=state.plan
        if not plan or plan.revision~=a.geometryRevision or plan.generation~=a.generation or plan.course~=a.course
            or not plan.room.Parent then state.plan=nil;return end
        for _,v in ipairs(R.enemies) do
            if a.enemyInRoom(v,plan.room) and alive(v) and not plan.members[v.model] then state.plan=nil;return end
        end
        for _,index in ipairs(plan.order) do
            local group=plan.groups[index]
            for _,e in ipairs(group.members) do
                if alive(e) then
                    if (e.root.Position-group.point).Magnitude>24 then state.plan=nil;return end
                    return e,plan
                end
            end
        end
        state.plan=nil
    end 
    a.encounterRoomPending =                   function(room)
        local e,plan=encounterSelection()
        return e~=nil and plan.room==room or state.busy and state.room==room
    end 
    a.encounterObjective =                   function(position)
        local e,plan=encounterSelection()
        if e then return e,e.root.Position,plan.room end
    end 
    a.planEncounter =                   function(position,blockedRoom)
        local course=a.course
        if not course or state.busy or os.clock()<state.nextAt or not R.farming then return end
        if encounterSelection() then return end
        state.nextAt=os.clock()+3
        local entry,exit
        for i,v in ipairs(course.order) do
            if v.room.Parent and (blockedRoom and v.room==blockedRoom or not blockedRoom and v.rank==course.progressRank) then
                entry=v;exit=course.order[i+1] and course.order[i+1].anchor;break
            end
        end
        if not entry or not exit then return end
        local enemies={}
        for _,v in ipairs(R.enemies) do
            if a.enemyInRoom(v,entry.room) and alive(v) then enemies[#enemies+1]=v end
        end
        if #enemies<2 or #enemies>64 then return end
        local generation,revision=a.generation,a.geometryRevision
        local scopeRank=course.progressRank
        local start=position
        state.busy=true;state.room=entry.room;a.encounterPlanStatus="Comparing branch routes"
        task.defer(function()
            local ok,why=pcall(function()
                local deadline=os.clock()+8
                local current; current = function()
                    return R.booted and R.farming and a.generation==generation and a.geometryRevision==revision
                        and a.course==course and course.progressRank==scopeRank
                        and not (a.adaptive and a.adaptive.routeEscape)
                        and os.clock()<deadline
                end
                local checkpoint; checkpoint = function()
                    if a.backgroundCheckpoint then a.backgroundCheckpoint("route") end
                    return current()
                end
                local groups={}
                for _,v in ipairs(enemies) do
                    if not checkpoint() or not alive(v) then return end
                    local point=v.root.Position;local group
                    for _,g in ipairs(groups) do
                        if (point-g.point).Magnitude<=18 and math.abs(point.Y-g.point.Y)<4
                            and a.spellLineClear(point,g.point) then group=g;break end
                    end
                    if not group then
                        if #groups==4 then a.encounterPlanStatus="Using normal route: more than four groups";return end
                        group={point=point,members={}};groups[#groups+1]=group
                    end
                    group.members[#group.members+1]=v
                end
                if #groups<2 then return end
                local routeCost; routeCost = function(from,to)
                    if not checkpoint() then return nil end
                    for _,c in ipairs(state.cache) do
                        if c.revision==revision and c.generation==generation and os.clock()-c.at<15
                            and (c.from-from).Magnitude<1 and (c.to-to).Magnitude<1 then return c.cost end
                    end
                    local route=a.mapCorridorRoute(from,to)
                    if not current() then return nil end
                    if not route or not route[1] then return math.huge end
                    local finish=route[#route]
                    if (finish-to).Magnitude>8 then return math.huge end
                                                                            
                                                                             
                    route[#route+1]=to
                    local previous=from;local length=0
                    for _,point in ipairs(route) do
                        local delta=point-previous
                        if delta.Magnitude<.05 then continue end
                        local count=math.max(1,math.ceil(delta.Magnitude/8))
                        local origin=previous
                        for i=1,count do
                            if not checkpoint() then return nil end
                            local step=origin+delta*(i/count)
                            local clear,_,_,arrival=a.segmentUncached(previous,step,nil,true)
                            if not clear or arrival and (arrival-step).Magnitude>1.5 then return math.huge end
                            length+=(step-previous).Magnitude;previous=step
                        end
                    end
                    state.cache[#state.cache+1]={from=from,to=to,cost=length,at=os.clock(),revision=revision,generation=generation}
                    if #state.cache>40 then table.remove(state.cache,1) end
                    return length
                end
                local points={[0]=start};for i,g in ipairs(groups) do points[i]=g.point end
                points[#groups+1]=exit
                local cost={}
                for i=0,#groups do
                    cost[i]={}
                    for j=1,#groups+1 do
                        if i~=j and not (i==0 and j==#groups+1) then
                            local value=routeCost(points[i],points[j]);if value==nil then return end
                            cost[i][j]=value
                        end
                    end
                end
                local order,total=a.shortestEncounterOrder(cost,#groups)
                local rp=root()
                if not current() or not rp or (rp.Position-start).Magnitude>16 then return end
                if not order then a.encounterPlanStatus="No complete verified branch route yet";return end
                                                                                    
                local members={};for _,v in ipairs(enemies) do members[v.model]=true end
                for _,v in ipairs(R.enemies) do
                    if a.enemyInRoom(v,entry.room) and alive(v) and not members[v.model] then return end
                end
                state.plan={groups=groups,order=order,room=entry.room,course=course,members=members,revision=revision,generation=generation}
                a.encounterPlanStatus="Following branch order";a.encounterPlanDistance=total
            end)
            state.busy=false;state.nextAt=os.clock()+5
            if not ok then a.encounterPlanStatus="Branch planning unavailable: "..tostring(why) end
        end)
    end 
end

R.ai.blockingRoomCandidate =                   function(part,from,position)
    local course=R.ai.course
    if not course or not part or not part.Parent or not part:IsA("BasePart") or not part.CanCollide then return end
                                                                             
    if from and (not position or (from-position).Magnitude>1.5) then return end
    local barrier=false;local ancestor=part
    while ancestor do
        if ancestor.Name:lower()=="barrier" then barrier=true end
        local entry=course.rooms[ancestor]
        if entry then
            if barrier and entry.rank<(course.progressRank or entry.rank) then return ancestor end
            return
        end
        ancestor=ancestor.Parent
    end
end 

do
    local state={name=nil,requirement=nil,nextRead=0,stopped=false}
    local difficulties={"Easy","Medium","Hard","Insane","Nightmare"}
    function R.ai.easyDungeonRequirement(data,difficulty)
        if type(data)~="table" then return nil end
        local highest
        for _,name in ipairs(difficulties) do
            local entry=data[name]
            local level=type(entry)=="table" and tonumber(entry.levelReq)
            if level and level>=0 and level<10000 and level%1==0 then
                if name==difficulty then return level end
                highest=math.max(highest or 0,level)
            end
        end
        return highest
    end
    R.ai.easyDungeon =                   function()
        if not inDungeon() or state.name~=wsVal("dungeonName") or state.difficulty~=wsVal("difficulty") then return false end
        local stats=LP:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
        local level=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Level")
        level=level and tonumber(level.Value)
        return level~=nil and state.requirement~=nil and level>=math.max(state.requirement+30,state.requirement*2)
    end 
    Lib:OnUnload(function()state.stopped=true end)
    task.spawn(function()
        while not state.stopped and not Lib.Unloaded do
            local name=wsVal("dungeonName");local difficulty=wsVal("difficulty")
            if name~=state.name or difficulty~=state.difficulty then
                state.name=name;state.difficulty=difficulty;state.requirement=nil;state.nextRead=0
            end
            if inDungeon() and type(name)=="string" and name~="" and os.clock()>=state.nextRead then
                state.nextRead=os.clock()+60
                local remotes=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("remotes")
                local remote=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("getDungeonStats")
                if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                    local ok,data=pcall(function()return remote:InvokeServer(name)end)
                    if not state.stopped and name==wsVal("dungeonName") and difficulty==wsVal("difficulty") then
                        state.requirement=ok and R.ai.easyDungeonRequirement(data,difficulty) or nil
                    end
                end
            end
            task.wait(3)
        end
    end)
end

R.ai.golemPolicy=(function()
local Golem={}
Golem.__index=Golem
Golem.slamAnimation="138539837002465"
function Golem.new()
    return setmetatable({slamKey={},dropKey={}},Golem)
end
function Golem:reset(owner)
    if owner~=self.owner then self.slamKey={};self.dropKey={}end
    self.owner=owner;self.slam=nil;self.drop=nil;self.choice=nil;self.carrying=nil
end
function Golem:animation(id,now,length,position,speed)
    if tostring(id):match("%d+$")~=self.slamAnimation or not self.owner then return end
    length=length and length>0 and length or 2                                 
    speed=speed and speed>0 and speed or 1
    self.slam=now+math.max(0,length-(position or 0))/speed
end
function Golem:impact(owner)
    if owner==self.owner then self.slam=nil;self.choice=nil end
end
function Golem:crystals(now,finish)
    if type(finish)=="number" and finish>now and finish-now<=15 then self.drop=finish end
end
local zoneMargin; zoneMargin =                   function(h,p,dt,now)
    if h.safeBefore and now+dt<h.safeBefore then return math.huge end
    local best=-math.huge
    for _,z in ipairs(h.regions)do
        local margin
        if z.cf then
            local q=z.cf:PointToObjectSpace(p);local s=z.size*.5
            margin=math.min(s.X-math.abs(q.X),s.Y-math.abs(q.Y),s.Z-math.abs(q.Z))-h.body
        else margin=z.radius-(p-z.pos).Magnitude-h.body end
        best=math.max(best,margin)
    end
    return best
end 
local function hazard(key,owner,regions,activation,finish,body)
    return {id=key,owner=owner,kind="requiredZone",scripted=true,pos=regions[1]and(regions[1].pos or regions[1].cf.Position)or Vector3.zero,
        regions=regions,safeBefore=activation,untilTime=finish,body=body or 2,scriptedMargin=zoneMargin}
end
function Golem.bubbleEntry(zone,position,body)
    local radius=zone.radius-(body or 2)-2
    local dy=position.Y-zone.pos.Y
    if radius<=0 or math.abs(dy)>=radius then return nil end
    local horizontal=Vector3.new(position.X-zone.pos.X,0,position.Z-zone.pos.Z)
    local reach=math.sqrt(radius*radius-dy*dy)*.5
    if horizontal.Magnitude<=reach then return position end
    return Vector3.new(zone.pos.X,position.Y,zone.pos.Z)+horizontal.Unit*reach
end
function Golem:step(s)
    if not s.alive or not s.owner then self:reset(nil);return end
    if self.owner~=s.owner then self:reset(s.owner)end
    if self.drop and s.now>self.drop+.2 then self.drop=nil end
    if self.slam and s.now>self.slam+.5 then self.slam=nil;self.choice=nil end
    local function result(goal,phase,region,activation,finish,key)
        return {goal=goal,phase=phase,arrival=.65,hold=region~=nil,
            hazards=region and {hazard(key,self.owner,region,activation,finish,s.body)}or {}}
    end
    if self.drop then
        local best,d
        for _,z in ipairs(s.bubbles)do
            local entry=Golem.bubbleEntry(z,s.position,s.body)
            local n=entry and (entry-s.position).Magnitude
            if n and (not d or n<d)then best=entry;d=n end
        end
        if best then return result(best,"entering crystal shelter",s.bubbles,
            self.drop and self.drop-.2,self.drop and self.drop+.2,self.dropKey)end
                                                                                  
        return {phase="waiting for crystal shelter",hazards={},arrival=.65}
    end
    local built={};local chosen,best
    for _,b in ipairs(s.barriers)do
        if b.built then
            built[#built+1]={cf=b.cf,size=b.size}
            local d=(b.goal-s.position).Magnitude
            if b.id==self.choice then d-=8 end
            if not best or d<best then chosen=b;best=d end
        end
    end
    if chosen and not self.slam then self.choice=nil;return end
    if chosen then
        self.choice=chosen.id
        return result(chosen.goal,"holding behind barrier",built,nil,self.slam and self.slam+.5,self.slamKey)
    end
    local goal,phase
    best=nil;chosen=nil
    for _,b in ipairs(s.barriers)do
        if not b.built and b.delivery then
            if s.carrying then
                local score=(b.delivery-s.position).Magnitude-(b.id==self.choice and 8 or 0)
                if not best or score<best then best=score;chosen=b;goal=b.delivery end
            else
                for _,supply in ipairs(s.supplies)do
                    local score=(supply-s.position).Magnitude+(b.delivery-supply).Magnitude-(b.id==self.choice and 8 or 0)
                    if not best or score<best then best=score;chosen=b;goal=supply end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if chosen then self.choice=chosen.id;phase=s.carrying and "building barrier"or "collecting barrier rock" end
    if not goal then return end
    local out=result(goal,phase)
                                                                           
                                                                       
    return out
end
return Golem

end)()
do (function()
    local a=R.ai
    local policy=a.golemPolicy.new()
    local owner,animator,remote,character
    local bossConnections={};local remoteConnection
    local nextScan=0;local stopped=false
    local barriers,supplies,bubbles={},{},{}
    local function disconnect()
        for _,c in ipairs(bossConnections)do c:Disconnect()end
        table.clear(bossConnections);animator=nil
    end
    local function scope()
        local name=wsVal("dungeonName","")
        return type(name)=="string"and name:lower():gsub("[^a-z]","")=="enchantedforest"
    end
    local function animation(track)
        if not owner or not enemyAlive(owner)then return end
        local id=track.Animation and track.Animation.AnimationId
        policy:animation(id,os.clock(),track.Length,track.TimePosition,track.Speed)
    end
    local function refresh(now)
        if now<nextScan then return end;nextScan=now+.5
        local candidate
        if scope()then
            local d=dungeonFolder();local room=d and d:FindFirstChild("room2")
            local folder=room and room:FindFirstChild("enemyFolder")
            candidate=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Crystal Golem")
            if candidate and not enemyAlive(candidate)then candidate=nil end
        end
        if owner~=candidate then
            disconnect();owner=candidate;policy:reset(owner)
            if owner then
                local h=owner:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if h then bossConnections[#bossConnections+1]=h.Died:Connect(function()policy:reset(nil)end)end
            end
        end
        local h=owner and owner:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local found=h and h:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        if found and found~=animator then
            animator=found
            bossConnections[#bossConnections+1]=found.AnimationPlayed:Connect(animation)
            for _,track in ipairs(found:GetPlayingAnimationTracks())do animation(track)end
        end
        barriers={};supplies={};bubbles={}
        if owner then
            local builds=workspace:FindFirstChild("firstBossBuildZones")
            if builds then
                for _,b in ipairs(builds:GetChildren())do
                    local box=b:FindFirstChild("safeBox");local flag=b:FindFirstChild("built")
                    if box and box:IsA("BasePart")and flag and flag:IsA("BoolValue")then
                        barriers[#barriers+1]={id=b,box=box,flag=flag,delivery=b:FindFirstChild("beamPart")}
                    end
                end
            end
            local supply=workspace:FindFirstChild("firstBossSupplyModels")
            if supply then for _,m in ipairs(supply:GetChildren())do
                local p=m:FindFirstChild("mainPart")
                if p and p:IsA("BasePart")then supplies[#supplies+1]=p end
            end end
            local safe=workspace:FindFirstChild("firstBossSafeZones")
            if safe then for _,p in ipairs(safe:GetChildren())do
                if p:IsA("BasePart")then bubbles[#bubbles+1]=p end
            end end
        end
        local remotes=RS:FindFirstChild("remotes")
        local event=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("enchantedBossSpecficEvents")
        if event~=remote then
            if remoteConnection then remoteConnection:Disconnect()end
            remote=event;remoteConnection=nil
            if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent")then
                remoteConnection=remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(name,args)
                    if stopped or not owner or not enemyAlive(owner)then return end
                    if name=="First Boss Remove All Player Supplies"then policy:impact(args);policy.carrying=false
                    elseif name=="First Boss Player Pick Up Supplies"and args==LP.Character then policy.carrying=true
                    elseif name=="First Boss Remove Player Supplies"and args==LP.Character then policy.carrying=false
                    elseif name=="First Boss Crystal Drop Explosion"and args==LP.Character then policy.drop=nil
                    elseif name=="First Boss Crystal Drop"and type(args)=="table"then
                        local mine=false
                        if type(args[1])=="table"then for _,c in pairs(args[1])do if c==LP.Character then mine=true;break end end end
                        if mine and type(args[3])=="number"then
                            local clockModule=RS:FindFirstChild("timeSync")
                            local ok,serverNow=pcall(function()return require(clockModule):GetTime()end)
                            if ok then policy:crystals(os.clock(),os.clock()+args[3]-serverNow)end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end
    a.golemObjective=                  function(rp)
        if stopped then return end
        if character~=LP.Character then character=LP.Character;policy:reset(owner)end
        local now=os.clock();refresh(now)
        if not owner or not owner.Parent or not enemyAlive(owner)then policy:reset(nil);return end
        local bossRoot=owner.PrimaryPart or owner:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not bossRoot or (bossRoot.Position-rp.Position).Magnitude>150 and not policy.choice then return end
        local bs,ss,zs={},{},{}
        for _,b in ipairs(barriers)do if b.box.Parent and b.flag.Parent then
            bs[#bs+1]={id=b.id,built=b.flag.Value,cf=b.box.CFrame,size=b.box.Size,
                goal=b.box.Position,delivery=b.delivery and b.delivery:IsA("BasePart") and b.delivery.Position or nil}
        end end
        for _,p in ipairs(supplies)do if p.Parent then ss[#ss+1]=p.Position+Vector3.new(0,3,0)end end
        for _,p in ipairs(bubbles)do if p.Parent and p.Transparency<.95 then
            zs[#zs+1]={pos=p.Position,radius=math.min(p.Size.X,p.Size.Y,p.Size.Z)*.5}
        end end
        local h=hum()
        local out=policy:step({owner=owner,alive=h and h.Health>0,now=now,position=rp.Position,body=math.max(rp.Size.X,rp.Size.Z)*.5+1,
            barriers=bs,supplies=ss,bubbles=zs,carrying=policy.carrying==true or policy.carrying==nil and character and character:FindFirstChild("firstBossSupplyOverhead")~=nil})
        a.golemPhase=out and out.phase or nil
        return out
    end 
    a.golemArenaPart=                  function(part)
        local p=part
        for _=1,5 do
            if not p or p==workspace then break end
            if p.Name=="firstBossSafeZones"or p.Name=="firstBossBuildZones"or p.Name=="firstBossSupplyModels"then return true end
            p=p.Parent
        end
        return false
    end 
    Lib:OnUnload(function()
        stopped=true;disconnect();if remoteConnection then remoteConnection:Disconnect()end
        policy:reset(nil);a.golemObjective=nil;a.golemPhase=nil;a.golemArenaPart=nil
    end)
end)()end

                                                                       
R.ai.encounterPolicy=(function()
local Policy={}
Policy.ringMargin =                   function(center,axis,outer,inner,point,padding)
    local delta=Vector3.new(point.X-center.X,0,point.Z-center.Z)
    local radius=delta.Magnitude
    return math.max(inner-radius-padding,radius-outer-padding,-delta:Dot(axis)-padding)
end 
Policy.coverPoint =                   function(orb,rock,radius,body)
    local away=Vector3.new(rock.X-orb.X,0,rock.Z-orb.Z)
    if away.Magnitude<.1 then return end
    return rock+away.Unit*(radius+body+2)
end 
function Policy.coverImpact(position,velocity,rock,radius)
    local p=Vector3.new(position.X-rock.X,0,position.Z-rock.Z)
    local v=Vector3.new(velocity.X,0,velocity.Z)
    local aa=v:Dot(v);if aa<1 then return end
    local bb=p:Dot(v);local cc=p:Dot(p)-radius*radius
    if cc<=0 then return 0 end
    if bb>=0 then return end
    local disc=bb*bb-aa*cc;if disc<0 then return end
    local time=(-bb-math.sqrt(disc))/aa
    if time>=0 and time<=1.2 then return time end
end
Policy.turnCost =                   function(direction,commit,now)
    if not commit or now>=commit.untilAt or direction.Magnitude<.1 then return 0 end
    return math.max(0,.5-direction.Unit:Dot(commit.direction))*6
end 
function Policy.drawInterval(ms)
    return ms>6 and .2 or ms>3 and .1 or .05
end
Policy.routes={
    ['Volcanic Chambers']={
        {-1626,-20,690},{-1620,-20,668},{-1610,-20,657},{-1604,-20,650},
        {-1605,-19,642},{-1610,-17,636},{-1619,-15,631},{-1634,-11,629},
        {-1671,-9,615},{-1711,-7,610},{-1748,3,630},{-1750,9,668},
        {-1756,13,697},{-1880,13,697}
    }
}
return Policy

end)()
do (function()
    local a=R.ai
    local policy=a.encounterPolicy
    local rings=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    local crystals={};local nextScan=0;local nextCrystals=0;local crystalFolder
    local bossAlive; bossAlive =                   function(word)
        for _,e in ipairs(R.enemies)do
            if e.model and enemyAlive(e.model) and e.model.Name:lower():find(word,1,true)then return e.model end
        end
    end 
    local scan; scan =                   function()
        if os.clock()<nextScan then return end
        nextScan=os.clock()+.25
        for _,model in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren())do
            if model.Name:lower()=='thirdbossmultirings' and not rings[model]then
                rings[model]={owner=bossAlive('odin')}
            end
        end
        if os.clock()<nextCrystals then return end
        nextCrystals=os.clock()+1
        if not crystalFolder or not crystalFolder.Parent then
            crystalFolder=workspace:FindFirstChild('secondBossCrystals',true)
        end
        local folder=crystalFolder
        crystals={}
        if folder then
            for _,part in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants())do
                if part:IsA('BasePart')then
                    local n=part.Name:lower()
                    for _,color in ipairs({'red','green','yellow'})do
                        if not crystals[color] and n:find(color,1,true)then crystals[color]=part end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end 
    a.specialBossHazards=                  function(body)
        local list={};local owner=bossAlive('odin')
        if not owner then return list end
        scan()
        for model,state in pairs(rings)do
            if not model.Parent then rings[model]=nil;continue end
            if state.owner~=owner then continue end
            local centerPart=model:FindFirstChild('center')or model:FindFirstChild('Center')
            for _,part in ipairs(model:GetChildren())do
                if not part:IsA('BasePart')or part.Transparency>=.98 then continue end
                local name=part.Name:lower()
                if name~='ring' and name~='center' then continue end
                local outer=math.max(part.Size.X,part.Size.Z)*.5
                local axis=flat(part.CFrame.LookVector)
                if axis.Magnitude<.01 then continue end
                axis=axis.Unit
                local center=part.Position-axis*outer*.5
                if centerPart and centerPart:IsA('BasePart')then
                    center=centerPart.Position
                    local offset=flat(part.Position-center)
                    if offset.Magnitude>1 then axis=offset.Unit end
                end
                local h={id=part,owner=owner,pos=center,height=10,
                    behaviorKey='Odin:'..name,attackId=model,attackKey='Odin:ring',attackSource=owner,
                    attackSourceKey='Odin',specialBoss=true,clearance=body+.5}
                if name=='ring' and outer>=10 then
                    h.kind='ring';h.radius=outer;h.inner=math.max(0,outer-(outer>=100 and 17.5 or 12.5));h.axis=axis
                elseif name=='center'then
                    h.kind='circle';h.pos=part.Position;h.radius=outer
                else continue end
                list[#list+1]=h
            end
        end
        return list
    end 
    a.orbCoverExpiry=function(part,h)
        local color=part.Name:lower():match('^secondboss(%a+)orb$')
        local rock=color and crystals[color]
        if not rock or not rock.Parent or not h.velocity then return end
        if math.abs(part.Position.Y-rock.Position.Y)>rock.Size.Y*.5 then return end
        local impact=policy.coverImpact(part.Position,h.velocity,rock.Position,math.min(rock.Size.X,rock.Size.Z)*.3)
        if impact then return os.clock()+impact end
    end
    local orbCommit
    a.bobCoverObjective=                  function(rp)
        local owner=bossAlive('bob') or bossAlive('frost giant')
        if not owner then return end
        scan()
        local candidates={};local orbWatch={}
        for part,info in pairs(R.watch)do orbWatch[part]=info end
                                                                            
        for _,part in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren())do
            if part:IsA("BasePart")and part.Name:lower():match('^secondboss%a+orb$')then orbWatch[part]=orbWatch[part]or {}end
        end
        if orbCommit and not orbCommit.Parent then orbCommit=nil end
        for part,info in pairs(orbWatch)do
            if R.ai.characterEffectPart(part) or R.ai.spentBossIceVisual(part)then R.watch[part]=nil;continue end
            if not part.Parent then continue end
            local color=part.Name:lower():match('^secondboss(%a+)orb$')
            local rock=color and crystals[color]
            if rock and rock.Parent then
                local delta=rp.Position-part.Position
                local velocity=info.lastVel
                                                                
                local mine=info.lineOwn=='me' or info.stick=='me' or #Players:GetPlayers()==1
                if mine or part==orbCommit then
                    local radius=math.max(rock.Size.X,rock.Size.Z)*.5
                    local goal=policy.coverPoint(part.Position,rock.Position,radius,math.max(rp.Size.X,rp.Size.Z)*.5)
                    if goal then
                        goal=Vector3.new(goal.X,rp.Position.Y,goal.Z)
                        candidates[#candidates+1]={goal=goal,distance=(goal-rp.Position).Magnitude,orb=part,color=color}
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        table.sort(candidates,                  function(x,y)if x.orb==orbCommit then return true end;if y.orb==orbCommit then return false end;return x.distance<y.distance end )
        local best=candidates[1]
        a.orbCoverEvidence=best and {color=best.color,orb=best.orb.Name,goal=best.goal}or nil
        if best then orbCommit=best.orb;return {goal=best.goal,arrival=1,hold=true,canHold=(best.goal-rp.Position).Magnitude<=1,hazards={},phase='matching orb cover'}end
    end 
    a.knownEncounterRoute=function(from,goal)
        local points=policy.routes[wsVal('dungeonName',nil)]
        if not points then return end
        local start,finish,sd,fd
        for i,row in ipairs(points)do
            local point=Vector3.new(row[1],row[2]+3,row[3])
            local d=(point-from).Magnitude;local g=(point-goal).Magnitude
            if not sd or d<sd then start=i;sd=d end
            if not fd or g<fd then finish=i;fd=g end
        end
        if sd>30 or fd>35 or finish<=start then return end
        local route={};local previous=from
        for i=start,finish do
            local row=points[i];local point=Vector3.new(row[1],row[2]+3,row[3])
            if not a.connectedSegment(previous,point)then return end
            route[#route+1]=point;previous=point
        end
        if not a.connectedSegment(previous,goal)then return end
        route[#route+1]=goal
        return route
    end
    local paint=a.updateDangerDisplay
    local nextDraw=0
    a.updateDangerDisplay=                  function(...)
        local now=os.clock()
        if now<nextDraw then return end
        nextDraw=now+policy.drawInterval(a.navigationTickMs or 0)
        if paint then return paint(...) end
    end 
end)()
end

                                                                       
R.ai.bossMechanicsPolicy=(function()
local P={}
local flat; flat =                   function(v)return Vector3.new(v.X,0,v.Z)end 
local distance; distance =                   function(a,b)return flat(a-b).Magnitude end 
P.finite =                   function(n)return type(n)=="number" and n==n and math.abs(n)<1e12 end 
function P.profile(name)
    name=tostring(name):lower()
    if name:find("reincarnation",1,true)then return "reincarnation" end
    if name=="odin" then return "odin" end
    if name:find("midgardian champion",1,true)then return "champion" end
    if name:find("frost giant",1,true)then return "bob" end
    if name:find("pumpkin king",1,true)then return "pumpkin" end
end
P.splitTimes={6.12,7.61,9.22,10.76}
P.events={
    ["First Boss Jump Up"]="champion",["First Boss Jump Down"]="champion",
    ["First Boss Criss Cross Projectile"]="champion",["First Boss Seeking Spike"]="champion",["First Boss Big Spike"]="champion",
    ["Second Boss Big Hitting Ground Spikes"]="bob",["Second Boss Moving Beam"]="bob",
    ["Third Boss Bouncing Orb Beam"]="odin",["Third Boss Sideways Missile"]="odin",["Third Boss Orb Explosion"]="odin",
    ["Bonus Boss Sideways Missile"]="reincarnation",["Bonus Boss Orb Explosion"]="reincarnation",
    ["Bonus Boss Bad Orb Explosion"]="reincarnation",["Bonus Boss Missile Explosion"]="reincarnation",
    ["Bonus Boss Freezing Orb Beam"]="reincarnation",["Bonus Boss Safe Color Zone Activated"]="reincarnation",
    ["Bonus Boss Safe Color Zone Deactivated"]="reincarnation",["Bonus Boss Tall Swirly"]="reincarnation",
    ["Bonus Boss Tall Swirly Recolor"]="reincarnation",
}
P.pumpkinEvents={"PassiveCircle","LineStrike","Trail","JackOLanternBreath","HeadThrow","PumpkinRain",
    "ThornVines","Snapvines","SnapvineStrike","CandyScatter","CandyTaken","ArenaShrink"}
function P.timestamp(stamp,serverNow,now)
    if not P.finite(stamp)or not P.finite(serverNow)then return nil end
    local t=now+stamp-serverNow
    if t<now-30 or t>now+120 then return nil end
    return t
end
P.boxMargin =                   function(cf,size,p,pad)
    local q=cf:PointToObjectSpace(p)
    local x=math.abs(q.X)-size.X*.5-pad
    local z=math.abs(q.Z)-size.Z*.5-pad
    return math.max(x,z)
end 
P.bouncePoint =                   function(origin,velocity,centre,radius,dt)
    local pos=flat(origin-centre);local v=flat(velocity)
    if dt<=0 or v.Magnitude<.01 then return origin end
    for _=1,8 do
        local vv=v:Dot(v);local b=pos:Dot(v)
        local disc=b*b-vv*(pos:Dot(pos)-radius*radius)
        if disc<0 then return centre+pos+v*dt+Vector3.new(0,origin.Y-centre.Y,0)end
        local hit=math.max(0,(-b+math.sqrt(disc))/vv)
        if hit>=dt then return centre+pos+v*dt+Vector3.new(0,origin.Y-centre.Y,0)end
        pos+=v*hit;dt-=hit
        if pos.Magnitude<.01 then break end
        local normal=pos.Unit
        v-=normal*(2*v:Dot(normal));pos=normal*(radius-.001)
    end
    return centre+pos+Vector3.new(0,origin.Y-centre.Y,0)
end 
P.homingPath =                   function(orbs,from,to,speed,offset,deadline)
    local duration=distance(from,to)/math.max(1,speed);offset=offset or 0
    local horizon=math.min(3,offset+duration+.4)
    local steps=math.max(1,math.ceil(horizon/.05));local dt=horizon/steps
    for _,orb in ipairs(orbs)do
        local pos=orb.pos;local previous=from
        local clearance=math.max(0,math.min(orb.clearance or 12,distance(from,pos)-2))
        for i=1,steps do
            if deadline and i%8==0 and os.clock()>=deadline then return false end
            local t=i*dt;local target=from+(to-from)*math.clamp((t-offset)/math.max(.001,duration),0,1)
            local toward=flat(previous-pos)
            local nextPos=toward.Magnitude>.01 and pos+toward.Unit*math.min(toward.Magnitude,orb.speed*dt)or pos
            if orb.shield then
                local delta=flat(nextPos-pos)
                local u=math.clamp(flat(orb.shield-pos):Dot(delta)/math.max(.0001,delta:Dot(delta)),0,1)
                if distance(pos+delta*u,orb.shield)<(orb.shieldRadius or 5)then break end
            end
            local relative=flat(previous-pos);local shift=flat(target-nextPos)-relative
            local u=math.clamp(-relative:Dot(shift)/math.max(.0001,shift:Dot(shift)),0,1)
            if (relative+shift*u).Magnitude<clearance then return false end
            pos=nextPos;previous=target
        end
    end
    return true
end 
P.margin =                   function(h,p,time,now)
    local at=now+(time or 0)
    if h.safeBefore and at<h.safeBefore or h.untilTime and at>=h.untilTime then return math.huge end
    local pad=h.clearance or 0
    if math.abs(p.Y-h.pos.Y)>(h.height or 16)then
        return h.contain and -math.huge or math.huge
    end
    if h.bossShape=="circle"then return distance(p,h.pos)-(h.radius or 0)-pad end
    if h.bossShape=="ring"then
        local d=distance(p,h.pos)
        return math.max((h.inner or 0)-d-pad,d-h.radius-pad)
    end
    if h.bossShape=="box"then return P.boxMargin(h.cf,h.size,p,pad)end
    if h.bossShape=="bounce"then
        return distance(p,P.bouncePoint(h.pos,h.velocity,h.arenaCentre,h.arenaRadius,time or 0))-h.radius-pad
    end
    if h.bossShape=="moving"then
        local dt=math.max(0,at-h.launch)
        local along=math.min(h.length,h.speed*dt)
        local centre=h.origin+h.axis*along
        if h.halfLength then
            local delta=flat(p-centre);local side=Vector3.new(-h.axis.Z,0,h.axis.X)
            return math.max(math.abs(delta:Dot(h.axis))-h.halfLength-pad,math.abs(delta:Dot(side))-h.radius-pad)
        end
        return distance(p,centre)-h.radius-pad
    end
    if h.bossShape=="arena"then
        local inset=h.inset or 0
        if h.shrink then
            local s=h.shrink;local t=at-s.at
            local x=math.clamp(t/s.move,0,1);local y=math.clamp((t-s.move-s.hold)/s.move,0,1)
            inset+=s.inset*(x*x*(3-2*x)-y*y*(3-2*y))
        end
        return math.min(p.X-h.x0,h.x1-p.X,p.Z-h.z0,h.z1-p.Z)-inset-pad
    end
    if h.bossShape=="spoke"then
        local theta=h.angle+h.angularSpeed*math.clamp(at-h.spinStart,0,h.spinEnd-h.spinStart)
        local axis=Vector3.new(math.cos(theta),0,math.sin(theta))
        local delta=flat(p-h.pos)
        local along=math.clamp(delta:Dot(axis),0,h.length)
        return (delta-axis*along).Magnitude-h.width-pad
    end
    if h.bossShape=="safe"then
        local best=-math.huge
        for _,z in ipairs(h.regions)do
            local m
            if z.cf then m=-P.boxMargin(z.cf,z.size,p,-pad)
            else m=z.radius-distance(p,z.pos)-pad end
            best=math.max(best,m)
        end
        return best
    end
    return math.huge
end 
function P.new()
    return {zones={},serial=0,phase="open",phaseAt=0,sequence={},timings={},candy={},snap={}}
end
function P.add(s,shape,now)
    if not shape or typeof(shape.pos)~="Vector3" or not P.finite(shape.untilTime)then return end
    if shape.untilTime<=now or shape.untilTime>now+120 then return end
    s.serial+=1;shape.id={serial=s.serial};shape.scripted=true;shape.regions=shape.regions or {}
    shape.motionBoundarySpeed=math.max(shape.speed or 0,math.abs(shape.angularSpeed or 0)*(shape.length or 0))
    shape.kind="circle";shape.scriptedMargin=P.margin;shape.clearance=shape.clearance or 2
    s.zones[#s.zones+1]=shape
    return shape
end
function P.phase(s,name,now)
    if s.phase==name then return end
    local previous=s.phase
    if s.phaseAt>0 then
        local key=previous..">"..name
        local sample=now-s.phaseAt
        if sample>.05 and sample<120 then
            local timing=s.timings[key]or {n=0,mean=0}
            timing.n+=1;timing.mean+=(sample-timing.mean)/math.min(timing.n,30)
            s.timings[key]=timing
        end
    end
    s.phase=name;s.phaseAt=now
    s.sequence[#s.sequence+1]={name=name,at=now}
    if #s.sequence>64 then table.remove(s.sequence,1)end
end
function P.cycle(s,name,now,gap)
    s.cycles=s.cycles or {}
    local previous=s.cycles[name]
    if previous and now-previous<gap then return false end
    if previous then
        local sample=now-previous
        local key="cycle:"..name;local t=s.timings[key]or {n=0,mean=0}
        if sample<120 then t.n+=1;t.mean+=(sample-t.mean)/math.min(t.n,8);s.timings[key]=t end
    end
    s.cycles[name]=now;return true
end
function P.nextCycle(s,name)
    local t=s.timings["cycle:"..name];local last=s.cycles and s.cycles[name]
    if last and t and t.n>=2 then return last+t.mean end
end
function P.chain(s,pos,size,now,bossPosition)
    local previous=s.chain;local delta=previous and flat(pos-previous.pos)
    local same=previous and now-previous.at<2
    local axis=delta and delta.Magnitude>=8 and delta.Magnitude<=45 and delta.Unit
    if not axis and bossPosition then
        local away=flat(pos-bossPosition);if away.Magnitude>=5 then axis=away.Unit end
    end
    if not axis then return end
    local measured=same and now-previous.at>.03 and now-previous.at<.6 and delta.Magnitude>=8 and delta.Magnitude<=45 and math.abs(size-previous.size)<=12
    local c={pos=pos,size=size,at=now,axis=axis,index=same and previous.index+1 or 1,
        step=measured and delta.Magnitude or 22,growth=measured and size-previous.size or 6,
        interval=measured and math.max(.15,now-previous.at)or .26}
    s.chain=c
    for _,h in ipairs(s.zones)do if h.chainForecast then h.untilTime=now end end
    for i=1,math.max(0,10-c.index)do
        local at=now+c.interval*i+.1
        P.add(s,{bossShape="circle",pos=pos+axis*c.step*i,radius=math.max(8,(size+c.growth*i)*.5),
            safeBefore=at,untilTime=at+1,owner=s.owner,chainForecast=true,chainAxis=c.axis},now)
    end
    return c
end
function P.colour(s,name,now,deadline)
    name=tostring(name):lower()
    if name=="grey"or name=="gray"then s.colour=s.firstColour
    elseif name=="red"or name=="green"or name=="yellow"then s.colour=name;s.firstColour=s.firstColour or name
    else return false end
    s.colourActive=true;s.colourAt=s.colourAt or now
    if deadline then s.colourDeadline=deadline end
    return true
end
function P.splitFlash(s,side,good,elapsed)
    if side~="left" and side~="right"then return end
    if elapsed>1.5 and elapsed<5.2 then
        local index=elapsed<2.46 and 1 or elapsed<3.2 and 2 or elapsed<3.97 and 3 or 4
        s.green=s.green or {}
        local safe=good and side or (side=="left" and "right" or "left")
        if good or not s.green[index]then s.green[index]=safe end
    elseif not good then
        local best,delta
        for i,t in ipairs(P.splitTimes)do
            local d=elapsed-t-(s.shift or 0)
            if math.abs(d)<.6 and(not delta or math.abs(d)<math.abs(delta))then best=i;delta=d end
        end
        if best then s.shift=(s.shift or 0)+delta*.5 end
    end
end
function P.splitStep(s,now)
    for i,t in ipairs(P.splitTimes)do
        if now<s.at+t+(s.shift or 0)+.15 then return i,s.green and s.green[i],s.at+t+(s.shift or 0)end
    end
end
function P.prune(s,now,alive)
    for i=#s.zones,1,-1 do
        local h=s.zones[i]
        if now>=h.untilTime or h.owner and not alive(h.owner)or h.model and not h.model.Parent then table.remove(s.zones,i)end
    end
end
P.pick =                   function(candidates,position,speed,now,zones,probe,hold,deadline)
    local best,score
    speed=math.max(1,speed)
    for _,goal in ipairs(candidates)do
        if deadline and os.clock()>deadline then break end
        local length=distance(position,goal);local arrival=length/speed
        local steps=math.max(1,math.ceil(length/2),math.ceil(arrival/.06))
        local safe=true;local initial=math.huge
        for _,h in ipairs(zones)do initial=math.min(initial,P.margin(h,position,0,now))end
        local last=initial
        for i=1,steps do
            if deadline and os.clock()>deadline then return best end
            local point=position+(goal-position)*(i/steps);local t=arrival*i/steps
            local margin=math.huge
            for _,h in ipairs(zones)do margin=math.min(margin,P.margin(h,point,t,now))end
            if margin<.5 and not(initial<.5 and margin>=last-.1 and margin>initial)then safe=false;break end
            last=margin
        end
        if safe then
            for i=0,math.ceil((hold or .8)/.1)do
                for _,h in ipairs(zones)do
                    if P.margin(h,goal,arrival+i*.1,now)<.5 then safe=false;break end
                end
                if not safe then break end
            end
        end
        if safe and (length<.2 or probe(position,goal))then
            local cost=length
            if not score or cost<score then best=goal;score=cost end
        end
    end
    return best
end 
return P

end)()
R.ai.bossMechanicsEvents=(function()
local E={}
E.apply =                   function(P,s,name,d,ctx)
    local now,owner=ctx.now,ctx.owner
    local at; at =                   function(t)return P.timestamp(t,ctx.serverNow,now)end 
    local add; add =                   function(h)
        h.owner=owner;h.attackSource=owner;h.behaviorKey="boss-event:"..ctx.profile..":"..name
        h.height=h.height or 18
        return P.add(s,h,now)
    end 
    local circle; circle =                   function(pos,r,start,finish,inner)
        if typeof(pos)~="Vector3"or not P.finite(r)or r<=0 or r>600 then return end
        return add({bossShape=inner and "ring"or"circle",pos=pos,radius=r,inner=inner,safeBefore=start,untilTime=finish})
    end 
    local box; box =                   function(cf,size,start,finish)
        if typeof(cf)~="CFrame"or typeof(size)~="Vector3"then return end
        return add({bossShape="box",pos=cf.Position,cf=cf,size=size,safeBefore=start,untilTime=finish})
    end 
    local line; line =                   function(origin,axis,length,width,start,finish)
        if typeof(origin)~="Vector3"or typeof(axis)~="Vector3"or not P.finite(length)or not P.finite(width)then return end
        axis=Vector3.new(axis.X,0,axis.Z)
        if axis.Magnitude<.01 then return end
        axis=axis.Unit;local pos=origin+axis*length*.5
        return box(CFrame.lookAt(pos,pos+axis),Vector3.new(width,18,length),start,finish)
    end 
    local moving; moving =                   function(radius,halfLength)
        if type(d)~="table"or typeof(d[5])~="CFrame"or not P.finite(d[1])or not P.finite(d[2])or d[2]<=0 then return end
        local launch,finish=at(d[3]),at(d[4])
        if not launch or not finish then return end
        local axis=Vector3.new(d[5].LookVector.X,0,d[5].LookVector.Z)
        if axis.Magnitude<.01 then return end
        add({bossShape="moving",pos=d[5].Position,origin=d[5].Position,axis=axis.Unit,length=d[1],
            speed=d[1]/d[2],launch=launch,safeBefore=launch,untilTime=finish,radius=radius,halfLength=halfLength,height=20})
    end 
    if name=="First Boss Jump Up"then
        P.phase(s,"jump",now);s.jumpAt=now
                                                                           
    elseif name=="First Boss Jump Down"then
        P.phase(s,"slam",now);s.slamAt=now
        if typeof(d)=="Vector3"then circle(d,38,now,now+.4)end
    elseif name=="First Boss Criss Cross Projectile"then P.phase(s,"crossfire",now);moving(math.max(ctx.radius or 0,9.5))
    elseif name=="First Boss Seeking Spike"then P.phase(s,"seeking spikes",now);moving(ctx.radius or 10)
    elseif name=="First Boss Big Spike"then P.phase(s,"big spike",now);moving(ctx.radius or 20)
    elseif name=="Second Boss Moving Beam"then
                                                                               
                                                                            
                                                                                   
        P.phase(s,"moving beams",now);moving(29,3)
    elseif name=="Second Boss Big Hitting Ground Spikes"then
        if type(d)~="table"or typeof(d[2])~="CFrame"then return end
        local t=at(d[3]);if not t then return end
        P.phase(s,"growing spikes",now)
        circle(d[2].Position,({small=21,medium=31,large=46})[d[1]]or 31,t,t+1.2)
                                                                           
                                                                             
    elseif name=="Third Boss Sideways Missile"or name=="Bonus Boss Sideways Missile"then
        P.phase(s,"missiles",now);moving(ctx.radius or 5,16)
    elseif name=="Third Boss Bouncing Orb Beam"or name=="Bonus Boss Freezing Orb Beam"then
        P.phase(s,"orb beam",now)
        if typeof(d)=="CFrame"then circle(d.Position,12,now,now+6)end
        s.orbBlastAt=now+14.1
    elseif name=="Third Boss Orb Explosion"or name=="Bonus Boss Orb Explosion"or name=="Bonus Boss Bad Orb Explosion"or name=="Bonus Boss Missile Explosion"then
        if typeof(d)=="CFrame"then circle(d.Position,45,now,now+2.6)end
        s.orbBlastAt=nil
    elseif name=="Bonus Boss Safe Color Zone Activated"then
        s.colourActive=true;s.firstColour=nil;s.colour=nil;s.colourDeadline=nil;s.colourAt=now
    elseif name=="Bonus Boss Safe Color Zone Deactivated"then
        s.colourActive=false;s.colour=nil;s.firstColour=nil;s.colourDeadline=nil
    elseif name=="Bonus Boss Tall Swirly"or name=="Bonus Boss Tall Swirly Recolor"then
        P.colour(s,type(d)=="table"and d[1]or d,now,type(d)=="table"and at(d[2]))
    elseif ctx.profile=="pumpkin"and type(d)=="table"then
        if name=="PassiveCircle"then local t=at(d.hitTime);if t then circle(d.point,ctx.radius or 12.5,t,t+.3)end
        elseif name=="LineStrike"then
            P.phase(s,"fan",now);if P.cycle(s,"fan",now,5)then s.fanAt=now end
            local t=at(d.hitTime);if not t then return end
            for _,dir in ipairs(type(d.dirs)=="table"and d.dirs or {})do
                if typeof(dir)=="Vector3"then line(d.origin,dir,d.radius,d.width,t,t+.15);line(d.origin,-dir,d.radius,d.width,t,t+.15)end
            end
        elseif name=="Trail"then
            local t=at(d.hitTime);if not t then return end
            for _,row in ipairs(type(d.segments)=="table"and d.segments or {})do
                if type(row)=="table"and P.finite(row[2])and P.finite(d.width)then box(row[1],Vector3.new(d.width,18,row[2]),t,t+.35)end
            end
        elseif name=="JackOLanternBreath"then
            local start,finish=at(d.shootStart),at(d.fireEnd)
            if start and finish and P.finite(d.aim)then line(d.origin,Vector3.new(math.cos(d.aim),0,math.sin(d.aim)),d.length,d.width,start,finish+.3)end
        elseif name=="HeadThrow"then s.throwAt=now;local t=at(d.impactTime);if t then circle(d.impact,d.radius or 30,t,t+.3)end
        elseif name=="PumpkinRain"then
            local land=at(d.landTime);if not land then return end
            for _,pos in ipairs(type(d.impacts)=="table"and d.impacts or {})do
                for i,r in ipairs(ctx.rings or {{inner=0,outer=11.75},{inner=26,outer=29.5},{inner=44,outer=47.5}})do
                    local t=land+(i-1)*(tonumber(d.ringInterval)or 0)+(tonumber(d.ringDelay)or 0)
                    circle(pos,r.outer,t,t+.3,r.inner>0 and r.inner or nil)
                end
            end
        elseif name=="ThornVines"then
            local start,finish,grow=at(d.spinStart),at(d.spinEnd),at(d.growStart)
            if start and finish and grow and typeof(d.centre)=="Vector3"then
                for _,angle in ipairs(type(d.angles)=="table"and d.angles or {})do
                    if P.finite(angle)then add({bossShape="spoke",pos=d.centre,angle=angle,angularSpeed=tonumber(d.speed)or 0,
                        spinStart=start,spinEnd=finish,safeBefore=grow+.45,untilTime=finish+.5,width=2.5,length=ctx.thornLength or 57.5})end
                end
            end
        elseif name=="Snapvines"then
            if d.id~=nil then s.snap[d.id]=tonumber(d.precastRadius)or 8 end
            local finish=at(d.expire);if not finish then return end
            for _,v in pairs(type(d.vines)=="table"and d.vines or {})do if type(v)=="table"then circle(v.base,6,now,finish)end end
        elseif name=="SnapvineStrike"then local t=at(d.landed);if t then circle(d.target,s.snap[d.id]or 8,t,t+.3)end
        elseif name=="CandyScatter"then
            local land,finish=at(d.landTime),at(d.endTime)
            if not land or not finish or d.id==nil then return end
            local group={land=land,finish=finish,pieces={}};s.candy[d.id]=group
            for i,p in ipairs(type(d.candies)=="table"and d.candies or {})do
                if type(p)=="table"and typeof(p.point)=="Vector3"then
                    local c={point=p.point,good=p.good==true};group.pieces[i]=c
                    if not c.good then c.zone=circle(c.point,6,now,finish)end
                end
            end
        elseif name=="CandyTaken"then
            local group=s.candy[d.id];local c=group and group.pieces[d.index]
            if c then c.taken=true;if c.zone then c.zone.untilTime=now end end
        elseif name=="ArenaShrink"then
            local start=at(d.start)
            if start then s.shrink={at=start,move=math.max(.01,tonumber(d.moveTime)or 1),hold=tonumber(d.holdTime)or 0,inset=tonumber(d.inset)or 0}end
        end
    end
end 
return E

end)()

do (function()
    local a=R.ai
    local P,E=a.bossMechanicsPolicy,a.bossMechanicsEvents
    local state=P.new();a.bossMechanicsState=state
    local owner,profile,character
    local models=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
    local remoteConnections={};local hooks={}
    local stopped=false;local scanAt=0;local hookAt=0;local bridge;local bridgeAt=0;local bridgePending=false
    local output={};local safeGoal;local generation=0
    local objectiveAt=0;local objectiveCache
    local pocketCache,pocketAt,pocketFrom={},0,nil
    local modelConnections={}
    local homingOrbs={};local crystals={};local crystalAt=0
    local flat; flat =                   function(v)return Vector3.new(v.X,0,v.Z)end 
    local alive; alive =                   function(m)return m and m.Parent and enemyAlive(m)end 
    local function current()
        local best,dist
        local rp=root();if not rp then return end
        for _,e in ipairs(R.enemies)do
            local p=e.model and P.profile(e.model.Name)
            if p and e.root and alive(e.model)then
                local d=(e.root.Position-rp.Position).Magnitude
                if d<350 and(not dist or d<dist)then best=e;dist=d end
            end
        end
        return best
    end
    local function reset(e)
        for _,c in pairs(modelConnections)do c:Disconnect()end
        modelConnections={}
        generation+=1
        state=P.new();a.bossMechanicsState=state
        owner=e and e.model;profile=owner and P.profile(owner.Name)
        state.owner=owner;state.profile=profile
        a.bossMechanicMemory=a.bossMechanicMemory or {}
        if profile then
            local key=tostring(wsVal("dungeonName","unknown"))..":"..profile
            local saved=a.bossMechanicMemory[key]
            if type(saved)=="table"then
                for k,v in pairs(saved)do
                    if type(k)=="string"and #k<100 and type(v)=="table"and P.finite(v.n)and P.finite(v.mean)and v.n>0 and v.mean>0 and v.mean<120 then
                        state.timings[k]={n=math.min(10000,v.n),mean=v.mean}
                    end
                end
            end
            a.bossMechanicMemory[key]=state.timings
        end
        models=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"});output={};safeGoal=nil;objectiveAt=0;objectiveCache=nil
        pocketCache={};pocketAt=0;pocketFrom=nil
        homingOrbs={};crystals={};crystalAt=0
    end
    local function serverClock()
                                                                             
        if profile=="champion" or profile=="bob" or profile=="odin" or profile=="reincarnation" then
            return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
        end
        local module=RS:FindFirstChild("timeSync")
        if module and module:IsA("ModuleScript")then
            local ok,result=pcall(function()return require(module):GetTime()end)
            if ok and P.finite(result)then return result end
        end
        return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
    end
    local receive; receive =                   function(name,data,pumpkin)
        if stopped or not alive(owner)then return end
        local expected=P.events[name]
        if pumpkin then if profile~="pumpkin"then return end
        elseif expected~=profile and not(expected=="odin"and profile=="reincarnation")then return end
        local rp=root()
        local ctx={now=os.clock(),serverNow=pumpkin and workspace:GetServerTimeNow()or serverClock(),
            owner=owner,profile=profile,position=rp and rp.Position}
        if pumpkin and name=="PumpkinRain"then
            local assets=RS:FindFirstChild("enemyAssets")
            assets=assets and assets:FindFirstChild("Pumpkin King")
            local wave=assets and assets:FindFirstChild("PumpkinShockwave")
            local rings={}
            for _,p in ipairs(wave and wave:GetChildren()or {})do
                local radius=p:GetAttribute("Radius")
                if p:IsA("BasePart")and P.finite(radius)then
                    rings[#rings+1]={inner=radius,outer=math.max(p.Size.Y,p.Size.Z)*.5}
                end
            end
            if #rings>0 then table.sort(rings,                  function(x,y)return x.inner<y.inner end );ctx.rings=rings end
        end
        local ok,err=pcall(E.apply,P,state,name,data,ctx)
        if not ok then a.bossMechanicsError=tostring(err)end
    end 
    a.observeBossMechanic=receive
    local function disconnectAll()
        for _,c in pairs(remoteConnections)do pcall(function()c:Disconnect()end)end
        remoteConnections={}
        if bridge then pcall(function()bridge:Disconnect()end);bridge=nil end
        for _,h in ipairs(hooks)do if rawget(h.table,h.key)==h.wrapper then pcall(rawset,h.table,h.key,h.original)end end
        hooks={}
        for _,c in pairs(modelConnections)do c:Disconnect()end
        modelConnections={}
    end
    local function bind()
        if stopped then return end
        local remotes=RS:FindFirstChild("remotes")
        if remotes then
            for _,r in ipairs(remotes:GetChildren())do
                if r:IsA("RemoteEvent")and (r.Name:find("BossSpecficEvents",1,true)or r.Name:find("BossSpecificEvents",1,true))and not remoteConnections[r]then
                    remoteConnections[r]=r.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(name,data)receive(name,data,false)end)
                end
            end
        end
        for r,c in pairs(remoteConnections)do if not r.Parent then c:Disconnect();remoteConnections[r]=nil end end
    end
    local function bindBridge()
        if stopped or bridge then return end
        local utility=RS:FindFirstChild("Utility");local module=utility and utility:FindFirstChild("BridgeNet2")
        if not module or not module:IsA("ModuleScript")then return end
        local ok,err=pcall(function()
            local api=require(module);if stopped then return end;local action=api.ReferenceIdentifier("action")
            bridge=api.ReferenceBridge("precastHitbox"):Connect(function(d)
                if stopped or type(d)~="table"then return end
                local now=os.clock();local stamp=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
                local start=P.timestamp(d.startTime,stamp,now)
                if not start or not P.finite(d.delayUntilAttack)then return end
                start+=d.delayUntilAttack
                local h={safeBefore=start,untilTime=start+.45,owner=nil,height=18}
                if d[action]=="Circle"and typeof(d.position)=="Vector3"and P.finite(d.radius)then
                    h.bossShape="circle";h.pos=d.position;h.radius=d.radius
                elseif typeof(d.cframe)=="CFrame"and typeof(d.size)=="Vector3"then
                    h.bossShape="box";h.pos=d.cframe.Position;h.cf=d.cframe;h.size=d.size
                else return end
                local source=d.source or d.enemy or d.caster
                if typeof(source)=="Instance"and source:IsA("Model")and alive(source)then h.owner=source end
                P.add(state,h,now)
            end)
        end)
        if not ok then a.bossBridgeStatus=tostring(err)end
    end
    local function hookPumpkin()
        if stopped or profile~="pumpkin"or #hooks>0 or type(filtergc)~="function"then return end
        local ok,tables=pcall(filtergc,"table",{Keys={"CandyScatter","CandyTaken","LineStrike","ArenaShrink"}},false)
        if not ok or type(tables)~="table"then return end
        for _,t in ipairs(tables)do
            if type(t)~="table"then continue end
            local valid=true
            for _,key in ipairs(P.pumpkinEvents)do if type(rawget(t,key))~="function"then valid=false;break end end
            if not valid then continue end
            for _,key in ipairs(P.pumpkinEvents)do
                local original=rawget(t,key)
                local wrapper=function(...)
                    local args=table.pack(...)
                    if not stopped and type(args[3])=="table"then receive(key,args[3],true)end
                    return original(table.unpack(args,1,args.n))
                end
                local installed=pcall(rawset,t,key,wrapper)
                if installed then hooks[#hooks+1]={table=t,key=key,original=original,wrapper=wrapper}end
            end
            a.bossPumpkinStatus=#hooks>0 and "Attack observer connected"or "Using visual attack tracking"
            return
        end
    end
    local families={
        firstbosscrisscross=true,firstbossjumpslam=true,firstbossbigspike=true,firstbossseekingspikes=true,
        firstbosspassivebeam=true,secondbosscriclehitbox=true,secondbosslonglingeringline=true,
        thirdbossbouncingorb=true,thirdbossmissile=true,thirdbossmultirings=true,thirdbosslineshot=true,
        bonusbossmemorymodel=true,bonusbosstallswirly=true,bonusbosscolorsafespots=true,
        bonusbosssweepingflames=true,bonusbosslongline=true,bonusbosssmallspiralflame=true,
        bonusbossbouncingorb=true,bonusbossbouncingorbbad=true,bonusbossbouncingorbgood=true,
        bonusbossfreezingorbbeam=true,bonusbossgroundflame=true,bonusbossflameprecast=true,
        passivecircle=true,staffslamline=true,staffbeamstrail=true,breathbeam=true,pumpkinshockwave=true,
        rainpumpkin=true,headexplosion=true,thrownpumpkinhead=true,snapvines=true,thornwall=true,
        branchhub=true,treebranch=true,vinepoison=true,
    }
    local ignored={bonusbosscolorsafespots=true,bonusbosstallswirly=true,bonusbossbouncingorbgood=true,
        bonusbossmemorymodel=true,bonusbossspawnpart=true,bonusbossstandpart=true,bonusbossplayerspawnpart=true}
    a.bossManagedPart=                  function(part)
        local parent=part
        for _=1,6 do
            if not parent or parent==workspace then break end
            local name=parent.Name:lower()
            if ignored[name]or name=="bonusbosssweepingflames"and profile=="reincarnation"then return true end
            if name=="thirdbosslineshot"and profile=="odin"then
                local st=models[parent]
                if st and(st.secondary or st.firedAt)then return true end
            end
            parent=parent.Parent
        end
        return false
    end 
    local originalClassify=a.classifyEffect
    a.classifyEffect=                  function(part)
        local parent=part
        for _=1,5 do
            if not parent or parent==workspace then break end
            if ignored[parent.Name:lower()]then return nil end
            parent=parent.Parent
        end
        local kind,entry,source=originalClassify(part)
        if kind then return kind,entry,source end
        parent=part
        for _=1,5 do
            if not parent or parent==workspace then break end
            local family=parent.Name:lower()
            local n=part.Name:lower()
            if (families[family] or a.bossAttackPriors[family]) and (n:find("hitbox",1,true)or n:find("precast",1,true)or parent==part)then
                return "enemy",{hitbox=n:find("hitbox",1,true)~=nil,family=family}
            end
            parent=parent.Parent
        end
    end 
    local collect; collect =                   function(model,now)
        if models[model]then return models[model]end
        local name=model.Name:lower()
        if not families[name]and not a.bossAttackPriors[name]then return end
        local st={name=name,at=now,parts={},lit={},owner=owner,green={},shift=0}
        if model:IsA("BasePart")then st.parts[1]=model else
            for _,part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do if part:IsA("BasePart")then st.parts[#st.parts+1]=part end end
            modelConnections[model]=model.DescendantAdded:Connect(                  function(part)
                if part:IsA("BasePart")then st.parts[#st.parts+1]=part end
            end )
        end
        models[model]=st
        if name=="thirdbosslineshot"and profile=="odin"then
            if now-(state.lastLineAt or -math.huge)>2 then state.centralLine=st else st.secondary=true end
            state.lastLineAt=now
        end
        if name=="firstbosspassivebeam"and profile=="champion"then
            state.beams=state.beams or {}
            state.beams[#state.beams+1]=now
            while #state.beams>0 and now-state.beams[1]>.5 do table.remove(state.beams,1)end
            if #state.beams>=4 then P.phase(state,"fan",now);state.fanUntil=now+4 end
        elseif name=="thirdbossmultirings"then P.phase(state,"rings",now)
        elseif name=="bonusbosssweepingflames"then P.phase(state,"sweep",now)
        elseif name=="bonusbossmemorymodel"then P.phase(state,"memory split",now)
        elseif name=="secondbosscriclehitbox"then P.phase(state,"circle chain",now)
        end
        return st
    end 
    local function sphere(pos,r,finish,model)
        return {id=model,kind="circle",bossShape="circle",pos=pos,radius=r,clearance=2,untilTime=finish,
            scripted=true,scriptedMargin=P.margin,regions={},owner=owner,model=model,height=18}
    end
    local function safeRegion(part)
        return {cf=part.CFrame,size=Vector3.new(part.Size.X,math.max(part.Size.Y,20),part.Size.Z),pos=part.Position}
    end
    local function safeZone(part,id,start,finish)
        return {id=id,kind="circle",bossShape="safe",contain=true,pos=part.Position,clearance=2,regions={{pos=part.Position,radius=7}},
            scripted=true,scriptedMargin=P.margin,safeBefore=start,untilTime=finish,owner=owner,height=100}
    end
    local tickModels; tickModels =                   function(now,rp)
        local colourParts={}
        for model,st in pairs(models)do
            if not model.Parent or st.owner~=owner then
                if st.name=="bonusbosstallswirly"then state.colourActive=false;state.colourAt=nil end
                if modelConnections[model]then modelConnections[model]:Disconnect();modelConnections[model]=nil end
                models[model]=nil;continue
            end
            if st.name=="bonusbosscolorsafespots"then
                for _,p in ipairs(st.parts)do if p.Parent then colourParts[p.Name:lower()]=p end end
            elseif st.name=="thirdbosslineshot"and profile=="odin"then
                for _,p in ipairs(st.parts)do
                    if p.Parent and p.Name:lower():find("hitbox",1,true)then st.box=p end
                    if p.Parent and p.Name:lower()=="precast"then
                        st.box=st.box or p
                        local sig=math.floor(p.Transparency*100+.5)
                        if st.sig~=nil and sig~=st.sig and now-st.at>=.3 and not st.firedAt then
                            st.firedAt=now
                            local timing=state.timings["line detonation"]or {n=0,mean=0}
                            timing.n+=1;timing.mean+=(now-st.at-timing.mean)/math.min(timing.n,30)
                            state.timings["line detonation"]=timing
                        end
                        st.sig=sig
                    end
                end
            elseif st.name=="bonusbossmemorymodel"then
                local left,right
                for _,p in ipairs(st.parts)do
                    local n=p.Name:lower()
                    local side=n:find("left",1,true)and"left"or n:find("right",1,true)and"right"
                    if side and n:find("hitbox",1,true)then if side=="left"then left=p else right=p end end
                    if side and n:find("precast",1,true)then
                        local lit=p.Transparency<.9
                        if lit and not st.lit[p]then P.splitFlash(st,side,n:find("precastgood",1,true)~=nil,now-st.at)end
                        st.lit[p]=lit
                    end
                end
                local index,side,hit=P.splitStep(st,now)
                if index and side and left and right then
                    local safe=side=="left"and left or right
                    local danger=side=="left"and right or left
                    local h=sphere(danger.Position,1,hit+.15,model)
                    h.bossShape="box";h.cf=danger.CFrame;h.size=Vector3.new(danger.Size.X,20,danger.Size.Z)
                    h.safeBefore= index==1 and st.at or st.at+P.splitTimes[index-1]+st.shift+.15
                    output[#output+1]=h
                    local q=safe.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(rp.Position)
                    local x=math.clamp(q.X,-math.max(0,safe.Size.X*.5-5),math.max(0,safe.Size.X*.5-5))
                    local z=math.clamp(q.Z,-math.max(0,safe.Size.Z*.5-5),math.max(0,safe.Size.Z*.5-5))
                    local goal=safe.Position+safe.CFrame.RightVector*x-safe.CFrame.LookVector*z
                    safeGoal={goal=Vector3.new(goal.X,rp.Position.Y,goal.Z),phase="memory split",arrival=2,hazards={},hold=true}
                end
            elseif st.name=="bonusbosstallswirly"then
                state.colourActive=true;state.colourAt=state.colourAt or st.at
                for _,p in ipairs(st.parts)do
                    if p.Parent and p.Size.X>100 and p.Transparency<.98 then
                        local c=p.Color;local colour
                        if math.abs(c.R-c.G)<.13 and math.abs(c.G-c.B)<.13 and c.R<.83 then colour="grey"
                        elseif c.R>.74 and c.G>.74 then colour="yellow"
                        elseif c.R>.74 and c.G<.63 then colour="red"
                        elseif c.G>.74 and c.R<.63 then colour="green"end
                        if colour then P.colour(state,colour,now)end
                    end
                end
            elseif st.name=="bonusbosssweepingflames"then
                st.segments=st.segments or {}
                for _,p in ipairs(st.parts)do
                    if not p.Parent then continue end
                    local parent=p.Parent;local seg=st.segments[parent]or {id={}}
                    st.segments[parent]=seg
