                    local n=p.Name:lower()
                    if n:find("precast",1,true)then
                        if p.Transparency<.9 then seg.seen=seg.seen or now end
                        if p.Transparency<.45 then seg.fire=seg.fire or now end
                    elseif n:find("hitbox",1,true)then seg.box=p end
                end
                for parent,seg in pairs(st.segments)do
                    if not parent.Parent then st.segments[parent]=nil;continue end
                    if seg.seen and seg.box and seg.box.Parent then
                        local start=seg.fire or seg.seen+2.15
                        if now<start+5.7 then
                            local h=sphere(seg.box.Position,1,start+5.7,model)
                            h.id=seg.id;h.bossShape="box";h.cf=seg.box.CFrame;h.size=Vector3.new(seg.box.Size.X,18,seg.box.Size.Z);h.safeBefore=start-.35
                            output[#output+1]=h
                        end
                    end
                end
            elseif st.name=="secondbosscriclehitbox"and not st.chainMade then
                local box=model:IsA("BasePart")and model or nil
                for _,part in ipairs(st.parts)do
                    if part.Parent and (part.Name:lower():find("precast",1,true)or part.Name:lower():find("hitbox",1,true))
                        and (not box or math.max(part.Size.Y,part.Size.Z)>math.max(box.Size.Y,box.Size.Z))then box=part end
                end
                if box then
                    st.chainMade=true;local e=current()
                    P.cycle(state,"circle chain",now,2)
                    P.chain(state,box.Position,math.max(box.Size.Y,box.Size.Z),st.at,e and e.root and e.root.Position)
                end
            elseif st.name=="bonusbosslongline"and not st.fanMade then
                local box
                for _,p in ipairs(st.parts)do if p.Name:lower():find("hitbox",1,true)then box=p;break end end
                if box then
                    st.fanMade=true
                    if now-(state.fanForecastAt or -math.huge)>3 then
                        state.fanForecastAt=now
                        local axis=box.CFrame.LookVector;local yaw=math.atan2(axis.Z,axis.X)
                        for i=1,9 do
                            local angle=yaw+math.rad(-20)*i;local dir=Vector3.new(math.cos(angle),0,math.sin(angle))
                            local h={bossShape="box",pos=box.Position,cf=CFrame.lookAt(box.Position,box.Position+dir),
                                size=Vector3.new(box.Size.X,18,box.Size.Z),safeBefore=st.at+.105*i+.5,
                                untilTime=st.at+.105*i+1.4,owner=owner,height=18,model=model}
                            P.add(state,h,now)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if state.colourActive then
            local gui=LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
            local health=gui and gui:FindFirstChild("bonusBossHealth")
            local frame=health and health:FindFirstChild("healthFrame")
            local arrow=frame and frame:FindFirstChild("safeColorArrow")
            arrow=arrow and arrow:FindFirstChild("arrow")
            if arrow and arrow:IsA("GuiObject")then
                local angle=arrow.Rotation%360
                local colour=not arrow.Visible and "grey"or(angle<45 or angle>=315)and"yellow"or angle<135 and"red"or angle<225 and"green"
                if colour then P.colour(state,colour,now)end
            end
            local part=colourParts[state.colour]
            if part then
                local deadline=state.colourDeadline or (state.colourAt or now)+12.2
                state.colourZoneId=state.colourZoneId or {}
                local h=safeZone(part,state.colourZoneId,deadline,deadline+1)
                output[#output+1]=h
                safeGoal={goal=Vector3.new(part.Position.X,rp.Position.Y,part.Position.Z),phase="colour refuge",arrival=1,hazards={},hold=true}
            end
        end
    end 
    local tick; tick =                   function(rp)
        if stopped then return end
        local e=current()
        if owner~=(e and e.model)or character~=LP.Character then character=LP.Character;reset(e)end
        local now=os.clock()
        if now>=scanAt then
            scanAt=now+.25;bind()
            if owner then for _,m in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren())do collect(m,now)end end
        end
        if now>=hookAt then hookAt=now+10;task.defer(hookPumpkin)end
        if not bridge and not bridgePending and now>=bridgeAt then
            bridgeAt=now+10;bridgePending=true
            task.defer(                  function()bindBridge();bridgePending=false end )
        end
        P.prune(state,now,alive);output={};safeGoal=nil
        if owner then tickModels(now,rp)end
        for _,h in ipairs(state.zones)do if h.untilTime>now then output[#output+1]=h end end
        if not owner then return end
        homingOrbs={}
        if profile=="bob"then
            if now>=crystalAt then
                crystalAt=now+.5;crystals={}
                local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("secondBossCrystals",true)
                for _,p in ipairs(folder and folder:GetDescendants()or {})do
                    if p:IsA("BasePart")then
                        for _,colour in ipairs({"red","green","yellow"})do
                            if p.Name:lower():find(colour,1,true)then crystals[colour]=p end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            for part,info in pairs(R.watch)do
            if R.ai.characterEffectPart(part) or R.ai.spentBossIceVisual(part)then R.watch[part]=nil;continue end
                local colour=part.Name:lower():match("^secondboss(%a+)orb$")
                local velocity=info.lastVel
                if colour and part.Parent and velocity and velocity.Magnitude>1 then
                    local delta=flat(rp.Position-part.Position)
                    if (info.lineOwn=="me"or info.stick=="me")and delta.Magnitude>1 and flat(velocity).Unit:Dot(delta.Unit)>.65 then
                        local rock=crystals[colour]
                        homingOrbs[#homingOrbs+1]={id=part,pos=part.Position,speed=velocity.Magnitude,clearance=12,
                            shield=rock and rock.Position,shieldRadius=rock and math.min(rock.Size.X,rock.Size.Z)*.3}
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if state.orbBlastAt and now>=state.orbBlastAt-2 and now<state.orbBlastAt+.7 then
            local nearest,distance
            for part,info in pairs(R.watch)do
            if R.ai.characterEffectPart(part) or R.ai.spentBossIceVisual(part)then R.watch[part]=nil;continue end
                local name=part.Name:lower()
                if part.Parent and name:find("bouncingorb",1,true)and not name:find("good",1,true)then
                    local d=(part.Position-rp.Position).Magnitude
                    if not distance or d<distance then nearest={part=part,info=info};distance=d end
                end
            end
            if nearest then
                state.orbBlastId=state.orbBlastId or {}
                local h=sphere(nearest.part.Position,45,state.orbBlastAt+.7,nearest.part)
                h.id=state.orbBlastId;h.safeBefore=state.orbBlastAt
                local centre=workspace:FindFirstChild("thirdBossMiddlePart")
                local velocity=nearest.info.lastVel
                if centre and centre:IsA("BasePart")and velocity then
                    h.bossShape="bounce";h.arenaCentre=centre.Position;h.arenaRadius=100;h.velocity=velocity;h.motionBoundarySpeed=velocity.Magnitude
                end
                output[#output+1]=h
            end
        end
        if profile=="pumpkin"then
            local barriers=workspace:FindFirstChild("BossBarriers")
            local west=barriers and barriers:FindFirstChild("BarrierWest")
            local east=barriers and barriers:FindFirstChild("BarrierEast")
            local north=barriers and barriers:FindFirstChild("BarrierNorth")
            local south=barriers and barriers:FindFirstChild("BarrierSouth")
            if west and east and north and south and west:IsA("BasePart")and east:IsA("BasePart")and north:IsA("BasePart")and south:IsA("BasePart")then
                local x0,x1=west.Position.X+west.Size.X*.5,east.Position.X-east.Size.X*.5
                local z0,z1=north.Position.Z+north.Size.Z*.5,south.Position.Z-south.Size.Z*.5
                if x0>x1 then x0,x1=x1,x0 end;if z0>z1 then z0,z1=z1,z0 end
                state.arenaId=state.arenaId or {}
                local slam=owner:GetAttribute("BorderSlamTime")
                local border=P.finite(slam)and workspace:GetServerTimeNow()>=slam and 6 or 0
                output[#output+1]={id=state.arenaId,kind="circle",bossShape="arena",contain=true,pos=Vector3.new((x0+x1)*.5,rp.Position.Y,(z0+z1)*.5),
                    x0=x0,x1=x1,z0=z0,z1=z1,inset=border,shrink=state.shrink,height=100,owner=owner,
                    scripted=true,scriptedMargin=P.margin,regions={{pos=Vector3.new(x0,0,z0),size=Vector3.new(x1-x0,0,z1-z0),radius=border+(state.shrink and state.shrink.at or 0)}},clearance=2,
                    motionBoundarySpeed=state.shrink and 1.5*state.shrink.inset/state.shrink.move or 0}
            end
        end
        a.bossMechanicsStatus=profile..": "..state.phase
    end 
    a.bossMechanicsTick=tick
    a.bossHomingSnapshot=function()local out={}for i,o in ipairs(homingOrbs)do out[i]=table.clone(o)end return out end
    a.bossMechanicsHazards=function()return output end
    a.bossMechanicsPathSafe=                  function(from,to,speed,offset,deadline)
        return #homingOrbs==0 or P.homingPath(homingOrbs,from,to,speed,offset,deadline)
    end 
    a.bossPocketPoints=                  function(position)
        if pocketFrom and os.clock()<pocketAt and (position-pocketFrom).Magnitude<6 then return pocketCache end
        pocketAt=os.clock()+.25;pocketFrom=position
        local e=current();if not e or not e.root then return {}end
        local centre=e.root.Position
        local radii={math.max(8,math.min(a.range()-4,60))}
        if profile=="bob"then
            local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("secondBossCrystals",true)
            if folder then
                local sum,count=Vector3.zero,0
                for _,p in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants())do
                    if p:IsA("BasePart")and (p.Name:lower()=="red"or p.Name:lower()=="green"or p.Name:lower()=="yellow")then sum+=p.Position;count+=1 end
                end
                if count>0 then
                    local home=sum/count;local axis=flat(home-centre)
                    if axis.Magnitude>1 then centre+=axis.Unit*math.min(axis.Magnitude,40)end
                end
            end
            radii={30,55}
        elseif profile=="odin"or profile=="reincarnation"then
            for _,h in ipairs(a.specialBossHazards and a.specialBossHazards(2)or {})do
                if h.kind=="ring"then centre=h.pos;radii[#radii+1]=math.max(5,h.inner-4)end
            end
        end
        local points={}
        local central=state.centralLine
        if profile=="odin"and central and central.box and central.box.Parent and os.clock()-central.at<6 then
            local box=central.box;local q=box.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
            local along=math.clamp(q.Z,-box.Size.Z*.45,box.Size.Z*.45)
            local centre=box.Position-box.CFrame.LookVector*along
            if central.firedAt then points[#points+1]=centre
            else
                points[#points+1]=centre+box.CFrame.RightVector*(box.Size.X*.5+4)
                points[#points+1]=centre-box.CFrame.RightVector*(box.Size.X*.5+4)
            end
        end
        if profile=="bob"and state.chain and os.clock()-state.chain.at<1.6 then
            local c=state.chain;local side=Vector3.new(-c.axis.Z,0,c.axis.X)
            local along=flat(position-c.pos):Dot(c.axis)
            local width=0
            for i=0,math.max(0,10-c.index)do
                local radius=math.max(8,(c.size+c.growth*i)*.5)+5
                local dx=along-c.step*i
                if math.abs(dx)<radius then width=math.max(width,math.sqrt(radius*radius-dx*dx))end
            end
            if width>0 then
                points[#points+1]=c.pos+c.axis*along+side*(width+2)
                points[#points+1]=c.pos+c.axis*along-side*(width+2)
            end
        end
        for _,h in ipairs(output)do
            if h.bossShape=="moving"and h.axis then
                local side=Vector3.new(-h.axis.Z,0,h.axis.X)
                local along=flat(position-h.origin):Dot(h.axis)
                local centre=h.origin+h.axis*along
                points[#points+1]=centre+side*(h.radius+5)
                points[#points+1]=centre-side*(h.radius+5)
            end
        end
        for _,radius in ipairs(radii)do
            for i=0,15 do
                local angle=i*math.pi/8
                points[#points+1]=Vector3.new(centre.X+math.cos(angle)*radius,position.Y,centre.Z+math.sin(angle)*radius)
            end
        end
        table.sort(points,                  function(x,y)return (x-position).Magnitude<(y-position).Magnitude end )
        while #points>16 do table.remove(points)end
        pocketCache=points
        return points
    end 
    a.bossAttackOverride=                  function(part,info,h,body)
        if h and (profile=="odin"or profile=="reincarnation")then
            local name=part.Name:lower()
            local parent=part.Parent
            if parent and parent~=workspace then name=name..parent.Name:lower()end
            local centre=workspace:FindFirstChild("thirdBossMiddlePart")
            local velocity=info.lastVel or h.velocity
            if name:find("bouncingorb",1,true)and not name:find("good",1,true)and centre and centre:IsA("BasePart")and velocity and velocity.Magnitude>1 then
                h.kind="circle";h.bossShape="bounce";h.scripted=true;h.scriptedMargin=P.margin;h.regions={}
                h.arenaCentre=centre.Position;h.arenaRadius=100;h.velocity=velocity;h.motionBoundarySpeed=velocity.Magnitude
                h.radius=h.radius or math.max(part.Size.X,part.Size.Z)*.5;h.clearance=body
                h.owner=owner
                return h
            end
        end
        local model=part
        local prior
        for _=1,5 do
            if not model or model==workspace then return h end
            prior=a.bossAttackPriors[model.Name:lower()]
            if prior then break end
            model=model.Parent
        end
        if not prior then return h end
        local st=collect(model,os.clock());if not st then return h end
        local n=part.Name:lower()
        if not h and not(n:find("hitbox",1,true)or n:find("precast",1,true)or part==model)then return end
        local now=os.clock();local finish=st.at+(prior.last or 2)
        local live=h~=nil and part.Transparency<.98
                                                                                   
        if now>=finish and model.Name:lower()=="firstbosspassivebeam" then return nil end
        if now>=finish and not(live and prior.holdLive)then return h end
        if not h then
            h={kind="box",pos=part.Position,cf=part.CFrame,size=part.Size,height=math.max(part.Size.Y,12),clearance=body}
        end
                                                                                       
        if model.Name:lower()=="secondbosscriclehitbox" and part:IsA("Part") and part.Shape==Enum.PartType.Cylinder then
            h.kind="circle";h.radius=math.max(part.Size.Y,part.Size.Z)*.5
            h.height=math.max(12,part.Size.X);h.pos=part.Position
        end
        h.safeBefore=h.safeBefore or st.at+(prior.first or 0)
        if not prior.holdLive or not live then h.untilTime=finish end
                                                                             
        if model.Name:lower()=="firstbossjumpslam" and h.kind=="circle" then h.radius=math.max(h.radius or 0,38) end
        h.clearance=math.max(h.clearance or 0,body+(prior.pad or 0))
        if model.Name:lower()=="firstbosspassivebeam" then h.clearance=math.max(h.clearance,body+3)end
        return h
    end 
    a.bossMechanicsObjective=                  function(rp)
        if not alive(owner)then return end
                                                                                                        
        if safeGoal then safeGoal.canHold=(flat(safeGoal.goal-rp.Position).Magnitude<=safeGoal.arrival);return safeGoal end
        if profile=="pumpkin"then
            local nextFan=P.nextCycle(state,"fan")or state.throwAt and state.throwAt+4.5 or state.fanAt and state.fanAt+45.1
            if state.fanAt and os.clock()<state.fanAt+3.2 or nextFan and os.clock()>=nextFan-3.5 and os.clock()<nextFan+3.2 then return end
            local goals={}
            for id,group in pairs(state.candy)do
                if group.finish<=os.clock()then state.candy[id]=nil else
                    for _,p in pairs(group.pieces)do if p.good and not p.taken and os.clock()>=group.land then goals[#goals+1]=Vector3.new(p.point.X,rp.Position.Y,p.point.Z)end end
                end
            end
            if os.clock()<objectiveAt then return objectiveCache end
            objectiveAt=os.clock()+.2;objectiveCache=nil
            local h=hum();local goal=P.pick(goals,rp.Position,h and h.WalkSpeed or 16,os.clock(),output,a.connectedSegment,.35,os.clock()+.003)
            if goal then objectiveCache={goal=goal,arrival=1,canHold=false,hazards={},phase="green candy"}end
            return objectiveCache
        end
        if profile=="reincarnation"then
            if os.clock()<objectiveAt then return objectiveCache end
            objectiveAt=os.clock()+.2;objectiveCache=nil
            local goals={}
            for model,st in pairs(models)do
                if st.name=="bonusbosssweepingflames"or st.name=="bonusbossmemorymodel"then return end
                if st.name=="bonusbossbouncingorbgood"and model.Parent then
                    local part=model:IsA("BasePart")and model or st.parts[1]
                    if part and part.Parent then goals[#goals+1]=Vector3.new(part.Position.X,rp.Position.Y,part.Position.Z)end
                end
            end
            local h=hum();local goal=P.pick(goals,rp.Position,h and h.WalkSpeed or 16,os.clock(),output,a.connectedSegment,.35,os.clock()+.003)
            if goal then objectiveCache={goal=goal,arrival=1,canHold=false,hazards={},phase="green orb"}end
            return objectiveCache
        end
    end 
    Lib:OnUnload(function()stopped=true;disconnectAll();output={};models={};state.zones={}end)
    task.defer(function()if not stopped then bind();bindBridge()end end)
end)()end

do (function()
    local a=R.ai;local P=a.bossMechanicsPolicy
    local shots={};local connections={};local bound={};local stopped=false
    local endpoints=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
    local function serverNow()
        local module=RS:FindFirstChild("timeSync")
        if not module then return end
        local ok,value=pcall(function()return require(module):GetTime()end)
        if ok and P.finite(value)then return value end
    end
    local function sourceOwner(source)
        for _,e in ipairs(R.enemies)do
            if e.model==source or source:IsDescendantOf(e.model)then return e.model end
        end
        return source
    end
    local function receive(name,data)
        if stopped or name~="first boss laser shot" or type(data)~="table"then return end
        if not P.finite(data[1])or not P.finite(data[2])or typeof(data[3])~="CFrame"
            or not P.finite(data[4])or data[4]<=0 or data[4]>2000
            or typeof(data[5])~="Instance"then return end
        local clock=serverNow();if not clock then return end
        local now=os.clock();local start=P.timestamp(data[1],clock,now);local finish=P.timestamp(data[2],clock,now)
        if not start or not finish or finish<=now or finish<=start then return end
        local index=tostring(data[6]);if #index>12 then return end
        local top=data[5]:FindFirstChild("top"..index)
        local main=top and top:FindFirstChild("top"..index.."Main")
        local beam=main and main:FindFirstChild("Beam")
        if not beam or not beam:IsA("Beam")or not beam.Attachment0 then return end
        local owner=sourceOwner(data[5])
        shots[#shots+1]={id={},owner=owner,beam=beam,origin=data[3],length=data[4],start=start,finish=finish,
            expire=now+math.max(10.5,finish-now+.5),radius=math.max(8,beam.Width0*.5,beam.Width1*.5)}
        while #shots>64 do table.remove(shots,1)end
    end
    local function bind(remote)
        if stopped or bound[remote]or remote.Name~="aquaticBossSpecficEvents"or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent")then return end
        bound[remote]=true
        connections[#connections+1]=remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(receive)
    end
    local remotes=RS:FindFirstChild("remotes")
    if remotes then
        local remote=remotes:FindFirstChild("aquaticBossSpecficEvents");if remote then bind(remote)end
        connections[#connections+1]=remotes.ChildAdded:Connect(bind)
    end
    local margin; margin =                   function(h,p,time,now)
        local at=now+(time or 0)
        if at<h.safeBefore or at>=h.untilTime then return math.huge end
        local endpoint=h.origin+h.axis*(h.length*math.clamp((at-h.safeBefore)/h.duration,0,1))
        local delta=endpoint-h.anchor
        local horizontal=Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z)
        local relative=Vector3.new(p.X-h.anchor.X,0,p.Z-h.anchor.Z)
        local t=math.clamp(relative:Dot(horizontal)/math.max(.001,horizontal:Dot(horizontal)),0,1)
        local closest=h.anchor+delta*t
        if math.abs(closest.Y-p.Y)>h.height then return math.huge end
        local width=math.max(8,(h.width0+(h.width1-h.width0)*t)*.5)
        return (relative-horizontal*t).Magnitude-width-h.clearance
    end 
    a.aquaticManagedPart=                  function(part)
        if endpoints[part]then return true end
        for _,shot in ipairs(shots)do
            if os.clock()>shot.expire then continue end
            local endpoint=shot.beam.Parent and shot.beam.Attachment1
            if endpoint and endpoint.Parent==part then endpoints[part]=true;return true end
            if part.Name=="precast" and part.Parent and part.Parent:IsA("Model") and part.Parent.Name=="Model"
                and math.abs(part.Size.X-16)<.1 and math.abs(part.Size.Z-150)<.1 then
                local primary=part.Parent.PrimaryPart
                if primary and (primary.Position-shot.origin.Position).Magnitude<.2
                    and primary.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(shot.origin.LookVector)>.999 then return true end
            end
        end
        return false
    end 
    a.aquaticHazards=                  function()
        local out={};local now=os.clock()
        for i=#shots,1,-1 do
            local shot=shots[i];local beam=shot.beam
            if now>shot.expire then table.remove(shots,i);continue end
            if now>=shot.finish or not shot.owner.Parent or not enemyAlive(shot.owner)
                or not beam.Parent or not beam.Attachment0 then continue end
            if beam.Enabled then shot.seenActive=true
            elseif shot.seenActive then shot.finish=now;continue end
            local anchor=beam.Attachment0.WorldPosition
            local endpoint=shot.origin.Position+shot.origin.LookVector*shot.length*math.clamp((now-shot.start)/(shot.finish-shot.start),0,1)
            out[#out+1]={id=shot.id,owner=shot.owner,kind="line",pos=(anchor+endpoint)*.5,
                axis=shot.origin.LookVector,span=(endpoint-anchor).Magnitude,thin=shot.radius*2,
                radius=shot.radius,width0=beam.Width0,width1=beam.Width1,clearance=2,height=8,anchor=anchor,origin=shot.origin.Position,length=shot.length,
                safeBefore=shot.start,untilTime=shot.finish,duration=shot.finish-shot.start,
                scripted=true,scriptedMargin=margin,motionBoundarySpeed=shot.length/(shot.finish-shot.start)}
        end
        return out
    end 
    Lib:OnUnload(function()
        stopped=true;shots={}
        for _,c in ipairs(connections)do c:Disconnect()end
        connections={};bound={}
    end)
end)()
end

R.ai.aquaticTemplePolicy=(function()
local Q={}
function Q.packet(name,d,serverNow,now)
    if type(serverNow)~='number'or type(now)~='number'or serverNow~=serverNow or now~=now or math.abs(serverNow)==math.huge or math.abs(now)==math.huge then return end
    if name~='first boss moving orb'and name~='last boss moving orb'then return end
    if type(d)~='table'or type(d[2])~='number'or type(d[3])~='number'or type(d[4])~='number'or type(d[5])~='number'then return end
    for i=2,5 do if d[i]~=d[i]or math.abs(d[i])==math.huge then return end end
    if d[5]<=0 or d[4]<=0 or d[4]>2000 or d[3]<=d[2]then return end
    local start=now+d[2]-serverNow;local finish=now+d[3]-serverNow
    if finish<=now or start-now>30 then return end
    return {start=start,finish=finish,length=d[4],duration=d[5],speed=d[4]/d[5]}
end
function Q.gap(distance,depthA,depthB,body)
    local lower=depthA*.5+body+.75
    local upper=distance-depthB*.5-body-.75
    if upper<=lower then return end
    return (lower+upper)*.5
end
function Q.compatible(b,dt,step,widthStep)
    if dt<=0 or dt>1.5 or step<=.1 or widthStep==0 then return false end
    if not b.interval then return true end
    return math.abs(dt-b.interval)<=math.max(.06,b.interval*.4)
        and math.abs(step-b.step)<=math.max(.5,b.step*.15)
        and math.abs(widthStep-b.widthStep)<=math.max(.5,math.abs(b.widthStep)*.15)
end
function Q.nextSection(previous,current)
    local dt=current.t-previous.t
    if dt<=0 or dt>1.5 then return end
    local width=current.width-previous.width
    local distance=current.distance-previous.distance
    if width==0 or current.width<=0 or distance<=0 then return end
    return {interval=dt,widthStep=width,step=distance}
end
return Q

end)()
do (function()
    local a=R.ai;local P=a.bossMechanicsPolicy;local Q=a.aquaticTemplePolicy
    local casts={};local branches={};local seen=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'});local stopped=false
    local names={['Temple Core Generator']=true,['Ancient Temple Protector']=true,['Sea King']=true}
    local boss; boss =                   function()
        local found
        for _,e in ipairs(R.enemies)do
            if e.model and names[e.model.Name]and e.model.Parent and enemyAlive(e.model)then
                if found then return end
                found=e.model
            end
        end
        return found
    end 
    local function clock()
        local m=RS:FindFirstChild('timeSync');if not m then return end
        local ok,t=pcall(function()return require(m):GetTime()end)
        if ok and P.finite(t)then return t end
    end
    local connections={};local bound={}
    local function receive(name,d)
        if stopped or type(d)~='table'or typeof(d[1])~='CFrame'then return end
        local owner=boss();if not owner then return end
        if name=='first boss moving orb'and owner.Name~='Temple Core Generator'then return end
        if name=='last boss moving orb'and owner.Name~='Sea King'then return end
        local server=clock();if not server then return end
        local timing=Q.packet(name,d,server,os.clock());if not timing then return end
        local assets=RS:FindFirstChild('enemyProjectiles')
        local template=assets and assets:FindFirstChild(name=='first boss moving orb'and 'firstBossMoveOrb'or 'finalBossOrbShot')
        if not template or not template:IsA('BasePart')then return end
        casts[#casts+1]={id={},owner=owner,origin=d[1],timing=timing,radius=math.max(template.Size.X,template.Size.Y,template.Size.Z)*.5}
    end
    local function bind(r)
        if bound[r]or r.Name~='aquaticBossSpecficEvents'or not r:IsA('RemoteEvent')then return end
        bound[r]=true;connections[#connections+1]=r.OnClientEvent:Connect(receive)
    end
    local remotes=RS:FindFirstChild('remotes')
    if remotes then for _,r in ipairs(remotes:GetChildren())do bind(r)end;connections[#connections+1]=remotes.ChildAdded:Connect(bind)end
    local section; section =                   function(part,owner,now)
        if seen[part]or not part:IsA('BasePart')or part.Name:lower()~='hitbox'then return end
        local model=part.Parent;local name=model and model.Name
        if not model or not model:FindFirstChild('precast')then return end
        local size=part.Size
        if name~='secondBossSlamHitbox'and not(name=='Model'and math.abs(size.Y-150)<1 and math.abs(size.Z-12)<.2)then return end
        if owner.Name=='Temple Core Generator'then return end
        seen[part]=true
        local cf=part.CFrame;local chosen
        for _,b in ipairs(branches)do
            if b.owner~=owner or now-b.t>1.5 or b.name~=name then continue end
            local delta=part.Position-b.pos
            local distance=delta:Dot(b.forward)
            if b.n==1 then distance=math.abs(distance)end
            if cf.RightVector:Dot(b.right)>.999 and math.abs(delta:Dot(b.right))<1 and math.abs(delta.Y)<1
                and Q.compatible(b,now-b.t,distance,size.X-b.width)then
                if not chosen or b.t>chosen.t then chosen=b end
            end
        end
        if not chosen then
            branches[#branches+1]={owner=owner,name=name,pos=part.Position,right=cf.RightVector,forward=-cf.LookVector,width=size.X,
                size=size,cf=cf,t=now,n=1,part=part,ids={{},{}},rows={{part=part,cf=cf,size=size,t=now}}}
            return
        end
        if chosen.n==1 and (part.Position-chosen.pos):Dot(chosen.forward)<0 then chosen.forward=-chosen.forward end
        local distance=(part.Position-chosen.pos):Dot(chosen.forward)
        local timing=Q.nextSection({t=chosen.t,width=chosen.width,distance=0},{t=now,width=size.X,distance=distance})
        if timing then
            chosen.n+=1;chosen.interval=timing.interval;chosen.step=timing.step;chosen.widthStep=timing.widthStep
            chosen.pos=part.Position;chosen.width=size.X;chosen.cf=cf;chosen.size=size;chosen.t=now;chosen.part=part
            chosen.rows[#chosen.rows+1]={part=part,cf=cf,size=size,t=now}
        end
    end 
    local originalClassify=a.classifyEffect
    a.classifyEffect=function(part)
        local owner=boss()
        if owner and part:IsA('BasePart')and part.Parent then
            local model=part.Parent;local size=part.Size;local n=part.Name:lower()
            if (n=='hitbox'or n=='precast')and (model.Name=='secondBossSlamHitbox'or model.Name=='secondBossGridShot'
                or model.Name=='firstBossRightHandShot'or model.Name=='lastBossPylonShot'
                or model.Name=='Model'and model:FindFirstChild('precast')and math.abs(size.Y-150)<1 and math.abs(size.Z-12)<.2)then
                return 'enemy',{hitbox=n=='hitbox',family=model.Name:lower()}
            end
        end
        return originalClassify(part)
    end
    a.aquaticTempleHazards=                  function()
        local now=os.clock();local out={};local owner=boss()
        for i=#casts,1,-1 do
            local c=casts[i];local t=c.timing
            if now>=t.finish or not c.owner.Parent or not enemyAlive(c.owner)then table.remove(casts,i)
            else
                out[#out+1]={id=c.id,owner=c.owner,kind='projectile',bossShape='moving',pos=c.origin.Position,
                    origin=c.origin.Position,axis=c.origin.LookVector,length=t.length,speed=t.speed,launch=t.start,
                    safeBefore=t.start,untilTime=t.finish,radius=c.radius,clearance=2,height=20,
                    scripted=true,scriptedMargin=P.margin,motionBoundarySpeed=t.speed}
            end
        end
        if not owner then branches={};return out end
        local fresh={}
        for part,info in pairs(R.watch)do
            if R.ai.characterEffectPart(part) or R.ai.spentBossIceVisual(part)then R.watch[part]=nil;continue end
            if part.Parent and not seen[part]and part.Name:lower()=='hitbox'then fresh[#fresh+1]={part=part,t=info.t or now}end
        end
        table.sort(fresh,                  function(x,y)return x.t<y.t end )
        for _,v in ipairs(fresh)do section(v.part,owner,v.t)end
        for i=#branches,1,-1 do
            local b=branches[i]
            if b.owner~=owner or not b.part.Parent or now-b.t>math.max(.5,(b.interval or .5)*2.5)then table.remove(branches,i)
            elseif b.n>=3 and b.interval then
                for step=1,2 do
                    local at=b.t+b.interval*step
                    if at+b.interval<now then continue end
                    if b.width+b.widthStep*step<=0 then continue end
                    local cf=b.cf+b.forward*b.step*step
                    local size=Vector3.new(b.width+b.widthStep*step,b.size.Y,b.size.Z)
                    out[#out+1]={id=b.ids[step],owner=owner,kind='box',bossShape='box',pos=cf.Position,cf=cf,size=size,
                        clearance=2,height=size.Y*.5+4,safeBefore=at,untilTime=at+b.interval,
                        scripted=true,scriptedMargin=P.margin,aquaticForecast=true,motionBoundarySpeed=b.step/b.interval}
                end
            end
        end
        return out
    end 
    a.aquaticTempleGapPoints=                  function(position)
        local out={};local rp=root();if not rp or not boss()then return out end
        local body=math.max(2,math.max(rp.Size.X,rp.Size.Z)*.5)
        for _,b in ipairs(branches)do
            for i=2,#b.rows do
                local left,right=b.rows[i-1],b.rows[i]
                if not left.part.Parent or not right.part.Parent then continue end
                local delta=right.cf.Position-left.cf.Position
                local d=delta:Dot(b.forward)
                local offset=Q.gap(d,left.size.Z,right.size.Z,body)
                local half=math.min(left.size.X,right.size.X)*.5-body-.75
                if offset and half>0 then
                    local across=math.clamp((position-left.cf.Position):Dot(b.right),-half,half)
                    local p=left.cf.Position+b.forward*offset+b.right*across
                    p=Vector3.new(p.X,position.Y,p.Z)
                    if (p-position).Magnitude<80 then out[#out+1]=p end
                end
            end
        end
        table.sort(out,                  function(x,y)return (x-position).Magnitude<(y-position).Magnitude end )
        return out
    end 
    a.aquaticTempleWindow=                  function(h,part)
        local owner=boss()
        if h and owner and part.Parent and part.Parent.Name=='secondBossSlamHitbox'and part.Name:lower()=='hitbox'then
            h.safeBefore=nil;h.owner=owner
        end
    end 
    Lib:OnUnload(function()stopped=true;casts={};branches={};for _,c in ipairs(connections)do c:Disconnect()end end)
end)()
end

R.ai.volcanicPolicy=(function()
local P={}
function P.new()return {holding=false}end
function P.event(s,name,target,character,now)
    if name=='Second Boss Destroy All Overhead Rocks'then s.holding=false;return end
    if not character or target~=character then return end
    if name=='Second Boss Player Hold Rock'then s.holding=true
    elseif name=='Second Boss Player Drop Rock'then s.holding=false
    elseif name=='Third Boss Curse Char'then
        if not s.curse then s.curse={start=now,deadline=now+6,id={}}end
    elseif name=='Third Boss Curse Sizzle'or name=='Third Boss Curse Explosion'then s.curse=nil end
end
function P.gap(width,spacing,body)return spacing-width>2*(body+.75)end
return P

end)()
do (function()
    local a=R.ai;local P=a.volcanicPolicy;local M=a.bossMechanicsPolicy
    local state=P.new();local owner,character;local connections={};local bound={}
    local tracked=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'});local stopped=false
    local families={secondBossCheckeredLine=true,thirdBossSpreadLine=true,thirdBossLavaLine=true,
        thirdBossDualSwingLine=true,secondBossGeyserShot=true,secondBossRockFall=true,
        volcanicFirstBossFlameShot=true,volcanicSecondBossRandomLine=true,firstBossSkyShot=true,firstBossTurretShot=true}
    local current; current =                   function()
        for _,e in ipairs(R.enemies)do
            local m=e.model
            if m and m.Parent and enemyAlive(m)and (m.Name=='Ancient Lava Mage'or m.Name=='Deity of the Volcano'or m.Name=='Lava King')then return m end
        end
    end 
    local function sync()
        local m=current();local c=char()
        if m~=owner or c~=character then state=P.new();owner=m;character=c end
        return owner
    end
    local function receive(name,target)
        if stopped or not sync()then return end
        P.event(state,name,target,character,os.clock())
    end
    local function bind(remote)
        if bound[remote]or remote.Name~='volcanicBossSpecficEvents'or not remote:IsA('RemoteEvent')then return end
        bound[remote]=true;connections[#connections+1]=remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(receive)
    end
    local remotes=RS:FindFirstChild('remotes')
    if remotes then for _,r in ipairs(remotes:GetChildren())do bind(r)end;connections[#connections+1]=remotes.ChildAdded:Connect(bind)end
    local function family(part)
        local p=part.Parent
        return p and families[p.Name]and p.Name
    end
    local managed; managed =                   function(part)
        local parent=part.Parent
        if parent and families[parent.Name]and part.Name:lower()=='precast'and parent:FindFirstChild('hitBox')then return true end
        local p=part
        for _=1,3 do
            if not p or p==workspace then break end
            if p.Name=='thirdBossSafeSpot'or p.Name=='thirdBossSafeSpotSpawns'or p.Name=='thirdBossCurseRing'then return true end
            p=p.Parent
        end
        return false
    end 
    a.volcanicManagedPart=managed
    a.volcanicAttackOverride=function(part,h,body)
        local boss=current()
        if h and boss and family(part)then
            h.owner=boss
            h.clearance=math.max(1,body or 1)+.25

        end
        return h
    end
    local classify=a.classifyEffect
    a.classifyEffect=function(part)
        if managed(part)then return 'friendly'end
        local name=family(part)
        if name and current()then
            local n=part.Name:lower()
            if n:find('hitbox',1,true)then tracked[part]=true;return 'enemy',{hitbox=true,family=name:lower()}end
            if n:find('precast',1,true)then return 'enemy',{family=name:lower()}end
        end
        return classify(part)
    end
    local function partOf(model)
        if not model then return end
        if model:IsA('BasePart')then return model end
        return model:FindFirstChild('base')or model:FindFirstChild('Union')or model.PrimaryPart
    end
    local function objective(part,rp,phase,arrival,hold,hazards)
        local goal=Vector3.new(part.Position.X,rp.Position.Y,part.Position.Z)
        return {goal=goal,phase=phase,arrival=arrival,canHold=hold and (goal-rp.Position).Magnitude<=arrival or false,
            hold=hold,hazards=hazards or {}}
    end
    a.volcanicObjective=                  function(rp)
        if not sync()then return end
        if owner.Name=='Lava King'and state.curse then
            local curse=state.curse;local now=os.clock()
            local model=workspace:FindFirstChild('thirdBossSafeSpot')
            local pad=model and model:FindFirstChild('precast')
            if pad and pad:IsA('BasePart')then
                curse.pad=pad
                local radius=math.max(pad.Size.X,pad.Size.Y,pad.Size.Z)*.5
                local zone={id=curse.id,owner=owner,kind='circle',bossShape='safe',pos=pad.Position,height=200,
                    contain=true,regions={{pos=pad.Position,radius=radius}},clearance=2,
                    safeBefore=curse.deadline-.2,untilTime=math.max(now+.25,curse.deadline+.5),scripted=true,scriptedMargin=M.margin}
                return objective(pad,rp,'reach curse green pad',math.max(1,radius-3),true,{zone})
            end
            if now>curse.deadline+.5 then state.curse=nil end
            return
        end
        if owner.Name~='Deity of the Volcano'then return end
        local spawns=workspace:FindFirstChild('secondBossGeyserSpawns');if not spawns then return end
        local hole,distance
        for _,spawn in ipairs(spawns:GetChildren())do
            local occupied=spawn:FindFirstChild('occupied');local link=spawn:FindFirstChild('correspondingGeyser')
            local geyser=occupied and occupied.Value==true and link and link.Value
            local base=geyser and geyser.Parent and partOf(geyser)
            if base then local d=(base.Position-rp.Position).Magnitude;if not distance or d<distance then hole=base;distance=d end end
        end
        if not hole then return end
        if state.holding then return objective(hole,rp,'plug active geyser',.6,false)end
        local pile,pileDistance
        for _,name in ipairs({'secondBossRockPile1','secondBossRockPile2'})do
            local model=workspace:FindFirstChild(name);local active=model and model:FindFirstChild('active')
            local part=active and active.Value==true and partOf(model)
            if part then
                local d=(part.Position-rp.Position).Magnitude+(part.Position-hole.Position).Magnitude
                if not pileDistance or d<pileDistance then pile=part;pileDistance=d end
            end
        end
        if pile then return objective(pile,rp,'collect geyser rock',.6,false)end
    end 
    local priorGaps=a.aquaticTempleGapPoints
    a.aquaticTempleGapPoints=                  function(position)
        local out=priorGaps and priorGaps(position)or {}
        if not sync()then return out end
        local rp=root();local body=rp and math.max(2,math.max(rp.Size.X,rp.Size.Z)*.5)or 2
        for part in pairs(tracked)do
            if not part.Parent then tracked[part]=nil;continue end
            local name=family(part)
            if name~='secondBossCheckeredLine'and name~='thirdBossSpreadLine'and name~='thirdBossLavaLine'and name~='thirdBossDualSwingLine'then continue end
            local cf,size=part.CFrame,part.Size
            local narrow,along,width,length=cf.RightVector,cf.LookVector,size.X,size.Z
            if size.Z<size.X then narrow,along,width,length=cf.LookVector,cf.RightVector,size.Z,size.X end
            local offset=math.clamp((position-part.Position):Dot(along),-length*.5,length*.5)
            for _,sign in ipairs({-1,1})do
                local point=part.Position+along*offset+narrow*(width*.5+body+1)*sign
                point=Vector3.new(point.X,position.Y,point.Z)
                if (point-position).Magnitude<80 then out[#out+1]=point end
            end
        end
        table.sort(out,                  function(x,y)return (x-position).Magnitude<(y-position).Magnitude end )
        return out
    end 
    Lib:OnUnload(function()stopped=true;state=P.new();tracked={};for _,c in ipairs(connections)do c:Disconnect()end end)
end)()
end

R.ai.forestPolicy=(function()
local F={}
local finite; finite =                   function(v)return type(v)=='number'and v==v and math.abs(v)<math.huge end 
function F.time(value,server,now)
    if not finite(value)or not finite(server)or not finite(now)then return end
    local t=now+value-server
    if t<now-60 or t>now+60 then return end
    return t
end
function F.laser(d,server,now)
    if type(d)~='table'or not finite(d[4])or not finite(d[8])then return end
    local arrival=F.time(d[5],server,now);local spin=F.time(d[6],server,now);local finish=F.time(d[7],server,now)
    if not arrival or not spin or not finish or spin<=arrival or finish<=spin or finish<=now then return end
    return {arrival=arrival,spin=spin,finish=finish,angle=math.rad(d[4]),baseAngle=math.rad(d[8])}
end
function F.angle(s,t)return s.angle*math.clamp((t-s.spin)/(s.finish-s.spin),0,1)end
return F

end)()
do (function()
    local a=R.ai;local F=a.forestPolicy;local P=a.bossMechanicsPolicy
    local lasers,blasts={},{};local links=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    local connections,bound={},{};local stopped=false
    local known={firstBossCrystal=true,firstBossSpinningRockHitbox=true,secondBossDirectShot=true,
        secondBossAncientSpiritShot=true,secondBossCircleShot=true,secondBossSpinningLaserHitbox=true,
        thirdBossCrossShot=true,thirdBossXShot=true,thirdBossOneShot=true}
    local function scope()return tostring(wsVal('dungeonName','')):lower():gsub('[^a-z]','')=='enchantedforest'end
    local function clock()
        local ok,t=pcall(function()return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()end)
        if ok and P.finite(t)then return t end
    end
    local function receive(name,d)
        if stopped or not scope()or type(d)~='table'then return end
        local now=os.clock();local server=clock();if not server then return end
        if name=='Second Boss Spinning Laser'and typeof(d[1])=='Instance'and typeof(d[2])=='CFrame'then
            local s=F.laser(d,server,now)
            if s then s.owner=d[1];s.pos=d[2].Position;s.received=now;lasers[#lasers+1]=s end
        elseif name=='Third Boss One Shot Beam'and typeof(d[1])=='CFrame'then
            local at=F.time(d[2],server,now)
            if at then blasts[#blasts+1]={pos=d[1].Position,at=at,received=now}end
        end
        for i=#lasers,1,-1 do if now>lasers[i].finish then table.remove(lasers,i)end end
        for i=#blasts,1,-1 do if now-blasts[i].received>30 then table.remove(blasts,i)end end
    end
    local function bind(r)
        if bound[r]or r.Name~='enchantedBossSpecficEvents'or not r:IsA('RemoteEvent')then return end
        bound[r]=true;connections[#connections+1]=r.OnClientEvent:Connect(receive)
    end
    local folder=RS:FindFirstChild('remotes')
    if folder then for _,r in ipairs(folder:GetChildren())do bind(r)end;connections[#connections+1]=folder.ChildAdded:Connect(bind)end
    local previous=a.classifyEffect
    a.classifyEffect=function(part)
        local model=part.Parent;local family=model and model.Name
        if scope()and family and known[family]then
            local n=part.Name:lower()
            if n:find('hitbox',1,true)then return 'enemy',{hitbox=true,family=family:lower()}end
            if n:find('precast',1,true)then return 'enemy',{family=family:lower()}end
        end
        return previous(part)
    end
    a.forestManagedPart=                  function(part)
        local model=part.Parent
        if model and (known[model.Name] or model.Name=='secondBossSpinningLaser') and part.Name=='PrimaryPart' then return true end
        return false
    end 
    local function link(part,items,now)
        local cached=links[part];if cached then return cached end
        local best,count
        count=0
        local model=part.Parent
        local pivot=model and model:IsA('Model')and model.PrimaryPart
        local position=pivot and pivot.Position or part.Position
        for _,s in ipairs(items)do
            local inWindow=s.finish and now>=s.received-.25 and now<=s.finish or not s.finish and math.abs(now-s.received)<2
            if not s.part and inWindow and (position-s.pos).Magnitude<3 then best=s;count+=1 end
        end
        if count>1 and best and best.finish then
            local equivalent=true
            for _,candidate in ipairs(items)do
                if not candidate.part and candidate~=best and now>=candidate.received-.25 and now<=candidate.finish
                    and (position-candidate.pos).Magnitude<3 then
                    if math.abs(candidate.spin-best.spin)>.05 or math.abs(candidate.finish-best.finish)>.05
                        or math.abs(candidate.angle-best.angle)>.001 then equivalent=false;break end
                end
            end
                                                                                         
                                                                                               
            if equivalent then count=1 end
        end
        if count==1 then best.part=part;links[part]=best;return best end
    end
    local laserMargin; laserMargin =                   function(h,point,dt,now)
        local s=h.forestLaser;local at=now+(dt or 0)
        if at>=s.finish or not h.part.Parent or not s.owner.Parent or not enemyAlive(s.owner)then return math.huge end
        if h.sampleAt<s.spin and at>=s.spin and h.arrivalLocalPose then
            local margin=math.huge
            for _,candidate in ipairs(lasers)do
                if candidate.baseAngle and candidate.pos and (candidate.pos-s.pos).Magnitude<3
                    and math.abs(candidate.arrival-s.arrival)<.05 and math.abs(candidate.spin-s.spin)<.05
                    and math.abs(candidate.finish-s.finish)<.05 then
                    local cf=CFrame.new(candidate.pos)*CFrame.Angles(0,candidate.baseAngle+F.angle(candidate,at),0)*h.arrivalLocalPose
                    margin=math.min(margin,P.boxMargin(cf,h.size,point,h.clearance))
                end
            end
            if margin<math.huge then return margin end
        end
        local turn=F.angle(s,at)-F.angle(s,h.sampleAt)
        local cf=CFrame.new(s.pos)*CFrame.Angles(0,turn,0)*CFrame.new(-s.pos)*h.cf
        return P.boxMargin(cf,h.size,point,h.clearance)
    end 
    a.golemSpinnerMargin=                  function(h,point,dt,now)
        if not h.part.Parent or h.owner and (not h.owner.Parent or not enemyAlive(h.owner)) then return math.huge end
        local elapsed=math.max(0,now-h.sampleAt)+(dt or 0)
        local delta=point-h.pos-(h.spinVelocity or Vector3.zero)*elapsed
        if math.abs(delta.Y)>h.height then return math.huge end
        if h.spinExclusion or not h.spinRate or now-h.sampleAt>.3 then
            return flat(delta).Magnitude-h.spinRadius-h.clearance
        end
        local angle=h.spinRate*elapsed
        local c,s=math.cos(angle),math.sin(angle)
        local localPoint=h.pos+Vector3.new(delta.X*c+delta.Z*s,delta.Y,-delta.X*s+delta.Z*c)
        return a.attackMargin(h,localPoint)
    end 
    a.observeGolemSpinner=                  function(part,info,h,now)
        local prior=info.golemSpin
        local axis=flat(part.CFrame.RightVector)
        local sample={at=now,pos=part.Position,axis=axis}
        local dt=prior and now-prior.at or 0
        if prior and dt>=.005 and dt<=.3 and axis.Magnitude>.1 and prior.axis.Magnitude>.1 then
            local turn=math.atan2(prior.axis.X*axis.Z-prior.axis.Z*axis.X,prior.axis:Dot(axis))
                                                                              
            if turn>math.pi*.5 then turn-=math.pi elseif turn< -math.pi*.5 then turn+=math.pi end
            sample.rate=turn/dt
            sample.velocity=(sample.pos-prior.pos)/dt
        elseif prior and dt<.005 then return h end
        info.golemSpin=sample
        h.part=part;h.sampleAt=now;h.spinRate=sample.rate;h.spinVelocity=sample.velocity
        h.spinRadius=math.sqrt(h.size.X*h.size.X+h.size.Z*h.size.Z)*.5
                                                                     
                                                                          
        h.spinExclusion=true;h.kind="circle";h.radius=h.spinRadius
        h.scripted=true;h.scriptedMargin=a.golemSpinnerMargin
        h.motionBoundarySpeed=math.abs(sample.rate or 0)*h.spinRadius+(sample.velocity or Vector3.zero).Magnitude
        return h
    end 
    a.forestAttackOverride=                  function(part,info,h,body)
        if not h or not scope()or not part.Parent then return h end
        local family=part.Parent.Name
        if not known[family]then return h end
        h.clearance=math.max(1,body or 1)+.25
        if family:sub(1,10)=="secondBoss" then
                                                                                        
            h.clearance=math.max(1,body or 1)+3
            if h.kind=="projectile"then h.radius=(h.radius or 0)+2.75 end
        end
        local now=os.clock()
        if family=='firstBossSpinningRockHitbox'then
            h=a.observeGolemSpinner(part,info,h,now)
            for _,e in ipairs(R.enemies)do
                if e.model and e.model.Name=='Crystal Golem'and enemyAlive(e.model)then h.owner=e.model;break end
            end
        elseif family=='secondBossSpinningLaserHitbox'then
            local s=link(part,lasers,info.t or now)
            if s then
                if now>=s.finish or not s.owner.Parent or not enemyAlive(s.owner)then return nil end
                h.forestLaser=s;h.sampleAt=now;h.part=part;h.owner=s.owner
                local pivot=part.Parent:IsA("Model")and part.Parent.PrimaryPart
                if pivot then h.arrivalLocalPose=pivot.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)end
                h.untilTime=s.finish;h.scripted=true;h.scriptedMargin=laserMargin
                h.motionBoundarySpeed=math.abs(s.angle)/(s.finish-s.spin)*math.max(h.size.X,h.size.Z)*.5
            end
        elseif family=='thirdBossOneShot'then
            local s=link(part,blasts,info.t or now)
            if s then h.safeBefore=s.at-.2 end
        elseif family=='secondBossAncientSpiritShot'then
            local candidate,count=nil,0
            local cf,size=part.CFrame,part.Size
            local axis=size.X>size.Z and cf.RightVector or cf.LookVector
            local reach=math.max(size.X,size.Z)*.5
            for _,e in ipairs(R.enemies)do
                if e.model and e.root and e.model.Name=='Ancient Spirit'and enemyAlive(e.model)then
                    local p=e.root.Position
                    local pivot=part.Parent.PrimaryPart
                    local matches=pivot and (p-pivot.Position).Magnitude<3
                    if not pivot then
                        matches=math.abs(p.Y-part.Position.Y)<16 and math.min(flat(p-(part.Position+axis*reach)).Magnitude,flat(p-(part.Position-axis*reach)).Magnitude)<8
                    end
                    if matches then candidate=e.model;count+=1 end
                end
            end
            if count==1 then h.owner=candidate;info.adaptiveOwner=candidate end
        end
        return h
    end 
    Lib:OnUnload(function()stopped=true;lasers={};blasts={};for _,c in ipairs(connections)do c:Disconnect()end end)
end)()
end

do
    local previous=R.ai.encounterObjective
    R.ai.encounterObjective=function(position)
        for _,enemy in ipairs(R.enemies)do
            if enemy.model.Name=="Ancient Enchanted Tree"and enemy.root and enemyAlive(enemy.model)then
                return enemy,R.ai.combatPoint(enemy,position),enemy.roomInstance
            end
        end
        if previous then return previous(position)end
    end
end

local function installAdaptive(Adaptive)
    local a=R.ai
    local array; array =                   function(v)return {v.X,v.Y,v.Z} end 
    local vector; vector =                   function(v)
        if type(v)~="table" or #v~=3 then return end
        for _,n in ipairs(v) do if type(n)~="number" or n~=n or math.abs(n)>1e6 then return end end
        return Vector3.new(v[1],v[2],v[3])
    end 
    local attackScope; attackScope =                   function()
                                                                                
        local name=wsVal("dungeonName",nil)
        if type(name)~="string" or name=="" then return nil end
        return tostring(game.PlaceId)..":"..name
    end 
    local attackContext; attackContext =                   function() return a.routeMapKey().."|"..tostring(attackScope() or "unidentified") end 
    local function memoryFile()
        local hash=5381
        for i=1,#a.routeMapKey() do hash=(hash*33+a.routeMapKey():byte(i))%2147483647 end
        return "DQR/data/UIBot-adaptive-v2-"..tostring(game.PlaceId).."-"..tostring(hash)..".json"
    end
    local context=attackContext()
    local file=memoryFile()
    local saved
    if type(readfile)=="function" then
        local ok,result=pcall(function()return HTTP:JSONDecode(readfile(file))end)
        if ok then saved=result end
    end
    if type(saved)=="table"and type(saved.bossMechanics)=="table"then a.bossMechanicMemory=saved.bossMechanics end
    local relative; relative =                   function(h,cf)
        local p={inner=h.inner,kind=h.kind,radius=h.radius,thin=h.thin,span=h.span,clearance=h.clearance,height=h.height}
        local rp=root()
        if rp and h.kind=="circle" and flat(h.pos-rp.Position).Magnitude<3 then
            p.anchor="player";cf=CFrame.new(rp.Position)
        end
        p.pos=array(cf:PointToObjectSpace(h.pos))
        if h.axis then p.axis=array(cf:VectorToObjectSpace(h.axis)) end
        if h.size then p.size=array(h.size) end
        if h.velocity then p.velocity=array(cf:VectorToObjectSpace(h.velocity)) end
        if h.cf then p.cf={cf:ToObjectSpace(h.cf):GetComponents()} end
        return p
    end 
    local predict; predict =                   function(p,cf)
        if type(p)~="table" or not cf then return end
        if p.anchor=="player" then local rp=root();if not rp then return end;cf=CFrame.new(rp.Position) end
        local pos=vector(p.pos);if not pos then return end
        local h={kind=p.kind,pos=cf:PointToWorldSpace(pos)}
        for _,k in ipairs({"radius","inner","thin","span","clearance","height"}) do
            local n=p[k];if n~=nil and (type(n)~="number" or n~=n or math.abs(n)>500) then return end;h[k]=n
        end
        if p.axis then local v=vector(p.axis);if not v then return end;h.axis=cf:VectorToWorldSpace(v) end
        if p.velocity then local v=vector(p.velocity);if not v then return end;h.velocity=cf:VectorToWorldSpace(v) end
        if p.size then h.size=vector(p.size);if not h.size then return end end
        if p.cf then
            if type(p.cf)~="table" or #p.cf~=12 then return end
            for _,n in ipairs(p.cf) do if type(n)~="number" or n~=n or math.abs(n)>1e6 then return end end
            h.cf=cf*CFrame.new(table.unpack(p.cf))
        end
        if h.kind=="line" and not (h.axis and h.thin and h.span) then return end
        if h.kind=="circle" and not h.radius then return end
        if h.kind=="box" and not (h.size and h.cf) then return end
        if h.kind=="ring" and not (h.radius and h.inner and h.axis and h.inner>=0 and h.inner<h.radius) then return end
        if h.kind~="ring" and h.kind~="line" and h.kind~="circle" and h.kind~="box" and h.kind~="projectile" then return end
        return h
    end 
    local commandUntil=0
    local commandEndpoint
    local blockingRoom; blockingRoom =                   function()
        local gate=a.blockingGate
        if not gate then return end
        if a.blockingRoomCandidate(gate.part)~=gate.room then a.blockingGate=nil;return end
        for _,e in ipairs(R.enemies) do
            if a.enemyInRoom(e,gate.room) and enemyAlive(e.model) then return gate.room end
        end
        a.blockingGate=nil
    end 
    a.clearanceCost=                  function(position)
        local g=a.grid;if not g or not g.cells then return 0 end
        local x,z=math.round(position.X/g.size),math.round(position.Z/g.size)
        local penalty=0
        for _,off in ipairs({{1,0},{-1,0},{0,1},{0,-1}}) do
            local c=g.cells[(x+off[1])..":"..(z+off[2])]
            if not a.physicalCell(c) or c.pos.Y<position.Y-4 then penalty+=1 end
        end
        return penalty*.8
    end 
    local wallDescriptors=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
    local wallCurrent; wallCurrent =                   function(w)
        local p=w.part
        return p.Parent~=nil and p.CanCollide and p.Shape==Enum.PartType.Block
            and p.CFrame==w.cf and p.Size==w.size and p.CollisionGroup==w.collisionGroup
    end 
    local describeWall; describeWall =                   function(part)
                                                                         
                                                                               
        if not part or not part:IsA("Part") or part.Shape~=Enum.PartType.Block or not part.CanCollide then return end
        local old=wallDescriptors[part]
        if old and wallCurrent(old) then return old end
        local cf,size=part.CFrame,part.Size
        if math.abs(cf.UpVector.Y)<.98 or size.Y<5 then return end
        local alongX=size.X>=size.Z
        local w={part=part,cf=cf,size=size,collisionGroup=part.CollisionGroup,name=part:GetFullName(),center=part.Position,
            tangent=flat(alongX and cf.RightVector or cf.LookVector).Unit,
            normal=flat(alongX and cf.LookVector or cf.RightVector).Unit,
            halfLength=(alongX and size.X or size.Z)*.5,
            halfThickness=(alongX and size.Z or size.X)*.5,
            bottom=part.Position.Y-size.Y*.5,top=part.Position.Y+size.Y*.5}
        wallDescriptors[part]=w;return w
    end 
    local worldFloorCache={}
    local function worldFloorCell(g,p,revision)
        local k=math.round(p.X/g.size)..":"..math.round(p.Z/g.size)
        local c=g.cells[k]
        if not c or not c.pos or math.abs(c.pos.Y-p.Y)<=2 then return c end
                                                                             
                                                                         
        local key=k..":"..math.round(p.Y/4)..":"..tostring(revision)
        local cached=worldFloorCache[key]
        if cached and os.clock()-cached.at<1 then return cached.cell end
        local x,z=math.round(p.X/g.size)*g.size,math.round(p.Z/g.size)*g.size
        local hit=workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x,p.Y+3,z),Vector3.new(0,-10,0),a.rayParams())
        local cell
        if hit and hit.Normal.Y>=.85 and hit.Material~=Enum.Material.Water
            and math.abs(hit.Position.Y+3-p.Y)<=2 then
            cell={key=k,x=math.round(p.X/g.size),z=math.round(p.Z/g.size),
                pos=hit.Position+Vector3.new(0,3,0),walk=true,baseWalk=true,localLayer=true}
        end
        worldFloorCache[key]={cell=cell,at=os.clock()}
        return cell
    end
    local function worldTerrain(from,to,world)
        local g=world.terrain
        if not g or not g.cells then return nil,"unknown terrain"end
        if g~=a.grid or world.revision~=(a.geometryRevision or 0)then return nil,"terrain changed"end
        local steps=math.max(1,math.ceil((to-from).Magnitude/math.max(.5,g.size*.4)))
        local previous,last
        for i=0,steps do
            local p=from+(to-from)*(i/steps)
            local k=math.round(p.X/g.size)..":"..math.round(p.Z/g.size)
            local c=worldFloorCell(g,p,world.revision)
            if not c or c.reason=="unscanned"then return nil,"unknown terrain"end
            if not a.physicalCell(c)then return nil,"blocked terrain"end
            if math.abs(c.pos.Y-p.Y)>2 then return nil,"different floor"end
            if previous and previous~=c then
                local edge=not previous.localLayer and not c.localLayer and g.edges and g.edges[previous.key..">"..c.key]
                if edge and edge.walk==false then return nil,"blocked connection"end
                if previous.x~=c.x and previous.z~=c.z then
                    if not a.physicalCell(worldFloorCell(g,Vector3.new(previous.x*g.size,p.Y,c.z*g.size),world.revision))
                        or not a.physicalCell(worldFloorCell(g,Vector3.new(c.x*g.size,p.Y,previous.z*g.size),world.revision))then return nil,"blocked corner"end
                end
            end
            previous=c;last=c
        end
        return Vector3.new(to.X,last.pos.Y,to.Z)
    end
    local wallReserveCache={}
    local function worldWallCost(point)
        local revision=a.geometryRevision or 0
        local key=math.round(point.X/4)..":"..math.round(point.Y/4)..":"..math.round(point.Z/4)..":"..revision
        local cached=wallReserveCache[key];local now=os.clock()
        if cached and now-cached.at<.75 then return cached.cost end
        local open,maxArc,arc=0,0,0;local blocked={};local nearest=24
        for i=1,8 do
            local angle=(i-1)*math.pi/4
            local hit=workspace:Raycast(point,Vector3.new(math.cos(angle),0,math.sin(angle))*24,a.rayParams())
            local clearance=hit and hit.Distance or 24
            nearest=math.min(nearest,clearance);blocked[i]=clearance<16
            if not blocked[i]then open+=1 end
        end
        for i=1,16 do
            if not blocked[(i-1)%8+1]then arc=math.min(8,arc+1);maxArc=math.max(maxArc,arc)else arc=0 end
        end
        local cost=math.exp(math.max(0,12-nearest)/4)-1
        cost+=25*math.max(0,3-nearest)^2
        if maxArc<4 then cost+=math.exp(4-maxArc)-1 end
        wallReserveCache[key]={at=now,cost=cost,open=open,arc=maxArc}
        return cost
    end
    local worldLandmarks,worldLandmarkNext={},0
    local function worldState()
        local skills={};local now=os.clock()
        if now>=worldLandmarkNext then
            worldLandmarkNext=now+1
            local center=workspace:FindFirstChild("firstBossMiddlePart")
            if center and center:IsA("BasePart")then worldLandmarks.championCenter={pos=center.Position,seenAt=now,kind="arena center"}end
            local crystals=workspace:FindFirstChild("secondBossCrystals",true)
            if crystals then
                for _,part in ipairs(crystals:QueryDescendants("BasePart"))do
                    for _,color in ipairs({"red","yellow","green"})do
                        if part.Name:lower():find(color,1,true)then
                            worldLandmarks["stone:"..color]={pos=part.Position,size=part.Size,color=color,seenAt=now,kind="orb cover"}
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for key,p in pairs(a.slots or {})do
            if S["Use"..key]then
                skills[key]={role=p.role,range=p.engageRange or p.range,vertical=p.vertical,cooldown=p.cooldown,
                    readyAt=math.max(a.slotCooldownDeadline(key),p.next or 0,p.inputUntil or 0,p.retryAt or 0),
                    speedBoost=p.speedBoost}
            end
        end
        local actors={}
        for _,e in ipairs(R.enemies or {})do
            if e.root and e.root.Parent and enemyAlive(e.model)then
                actors[#actors+1]={id=e.model,pos=e.root.Position,velocity=e.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity,
                    radius=math.max(e.root.Size.X,e.root.Size.Z)*.5+3,
                    hp=e.hum and e.hum.Health,kind=e.kind,room=e.room,rank=e.rank}
            end
        end
        local rooms={}
        for _,entry in ipairs(a.course and a.course.order or {})do
            rooms[#rooms+1]={id=entry.room,rank=entry.rank,anchor=entry.anchor}
        end
        return {mapId=tostring(game.PlaceId)..":"..game.JobId,revision=a.geometryRevision or 0,terrain=a.grid,
            skills=skills,actors=actors,landmarks=worldLandmarks,mechanic=a.bossMechanicsState,homingOrbs=a.bossHomingSnapshot and a.bossHomingSnapshot(),
            mission={rooms=rooms,progressRank=a.course and a.course.progressRank}}
    end
    local core=Adaptive.new({worldWallCost=worldWallCost,worldRoute=function(from,to)return a.mapCorridorRoute(from,to,"world")end,worldTerrain=worldTerrain,worldState=worldState,now=os.clock,relative=relative,predict=predict,aquaticGapPoints=a.aquaticTempleGapPoints,bossPocketPoints=a.bossPocketPoints,mechanicPathSafe=a.bossMechanicsPathSafe,
        hazardActive=                  function(h)
            local part=h.id
            if typeof(part)~="Instance" then return nil end
            if not part.Parent or not part:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return false end
            if a.spentBossIceVisual(part) then return false end
            if h.specialBoss then return part.Transparency<.98 and (not h.owner or enemyAlive(h.owner)) end
            local info=R.watch[part]
            if not info then return nil end
            if not info.projectile and not a.attackGeometry(part,info) then return false end
            return true
        end ,
        wallCurrent=wallCurrent,
        wallBlocked=function(w,seconds)
            a.wallBlacklistStatus={wall=w.name,seconds=seconds,at=os.clock()}
            a.telemetryAdd("wall-blacklisted",{wall=w.name,seconds=seconds,position=array(w.center)})
        end,
        clearanceCost=a.clearanceCost,
        probe=                  function(from,to)
            local floor=supportFloor(to+Vector3.new(0,4,0),a.rayParams())
            local taught=a.adaptiveDrawing and a.adaptiveDrawing(to)
            if waterSupport(floor) or not floor and not taught then return nil,"no dry support" end
            local point=floor and floor.Position+Vector3.new(0,3,0) or to
            local actual=root()
            local mode=actual and (actual.Position-from).Magnitude<1 and waterAtFootprint(from,a.rayParams()) and "shore" or nil
            local ok,why,collider=a.connectedSegment(from,point,mode)
            if not ok then
                local room=a.blockingRoomCandidate(collider,from,actual and actual.Position)
                if room then a.blockingGate={part=collider,room=room} end
            end
            return ok and point or nil,why,not ok and describeWall(collider) or nil
        end ,
        margin=                  function(h,p,t)
            if h.kind=="ring" then
                if math.abs(h.pos.Y-p.Y)>(h.height or 10) then return math.huge end
                return a.encounterPolicy.ringMargin(h.pos,h.axis,h.radius,h.inner,p,h.clearance or 0)
            end
            if h.kind=="projectile" then
                if h.launchTime then t=math.max(0,os.clock()+t-h.launchTime) end
                local v=h.velocity or Vector3.zero
                local projected=v:Dot(v)>.01 and (p-h.pos):Dot(v)/v:Dot(v) or t
                local position=h.pos+v*math.clamp(projected,math.max(0,t-.08),t+.08)
                if math.abs(position.Y-p.Y)>(h.height or 5) then return math.huge end
                return flat(p-position).Magnitude-h.radius
            end
            return a.attackMargin(h,p)
        end ,
        move=                  function(direction,duration,endpoint)
            releaseAll();a.moving=true;a.commandDirection=direction;a.emergencyDirection=direction
            commandUntil=os.clock()+duration;commandEndpoint=endpoint
            a.commandEndpoint=endpoint;a.commandUntil=commandUntil
            local h=hum();if h then h:Move(direction,false) end
        end ,
        stop=                  function()
            commandUntil=0;commandEndpoint=nil;stopMoving()
            a.commandEndpoint=nil;a.commandUntil=0
            local h=hum();if h then h:Move(Vector3.zero,false) end
        end ,
    },saved)
                                                                          
                                                                             
local function installBridgeDrop(core,a)
    local original=core.tick
    core.tick=function(self,sample)
        local p=sample.position
        local active=self.bridgeDrop
        if not sample.enabled or sample.hp<=0 or sample.protected then self.bridgeDrop=nil;return original(self,sample)end
        if active and (p.Y<active.goal.Y+5 or os.clock()>active.untilAt) then self.bridgeDrop=nil;active=nil end
        if not active and game.PlaceId==85776757589518 and p.X>345 and p.X<405
            and p.Z>145 and p.Z<205 and p.Y>10 and p.Y<30
            and sample.goal and sample.goal.Y<p.Y-30 and os.clock()>(self.bridgeProbeAt or 0) then
            self.bridgeProbeAt=os.clock()+.5
            local params=a.rayParams()
            local best,bestScore
            for radius=12,28,4 do
                for i=0,15 do
                    local d=Vector3.new(math.cos(i*math.pi/8),0,math.sin(i*math.pi/8))*radius
                    if workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(p+Vector3.new(0,2,0)),Vector3.new(2,3,2),d,params) then continue end
                    local hit=workspace:Raycast(p+d+Vector3.new(0,4,0),Vector3.new(0,-110,0),params)
                    if not hit or hit.Normal.Y<.85 or hit.Material==Enum.Material.Water then continue end
                    local goal=hit.Position+Vector3.new(0,3,0)
                    if goal.Y>p.Y-30 or math.abs(goal.Y-sample.goal.Y)>8 then continue end
                    local above=Vector3.new(goal.X,p.Y+2,goal.Z)
                    if workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(above),Vector3.new(2,3,2),goal-above,params) then continue end
                    local score=(goal-sample.goal).Magnitude+radius*.5
                    if not bestScore or score<bestScore then best=goal;bestScore=score end
                end
                if best then break end
            end
            if best then active={goal=best,untilAt=os.clock()+4};self.bridgeDrop=active end
        end
        if active then
            local character=game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
            local h=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if h then
                local delta=Vector3.new(active.goal.X-p.X,0,active.goal.Z-p.Z)
                self.status="jumping down through verified bridge exit"
                if delta.Magnitude>1 then
                    self.command=delta.Unit;self.route={active.goal}
                    self.io.move(delta.Unit,.2,active.goal)
                else self.io.stop()end
                if h.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Air then h.Jump=true end
                return
            end
        end
        return original(self,sample)
    end
end

        end
        return false
    end

    local function importMemory()
        if not importing then importing=(a.corridors.maps or {})[context] or {} end
                                                                                   
        for _=1,48 do
            local record=importing[importRecord];if not record then break end
            local points=record.points or {};local p=vector(points[importPoint]);local q=vector(points[importPoint+1])
            if p and q and (p-q).Magnitude<20 then core:remember(p,q) end
            importPoint+=1
            if importPoint>=#points then importRecord+=1;importPoint=1 end
        end
        if drawStamp~=a.drawnRevision then
            if drawStamp~=false then core.route={};core.command=nil;stopMoving() end
            drawStamp=a.drawnRevision;drawSegments={}
            for _,record in ipairs(a.drawRouteRecords()) do
                local previous
                for _,v in ipairs(record.points or {}) do
                    local p=vector({v.x,v.y,v.z})
                    if p and previous and #drawSegments<2048 then
                        drawSegments[#drawSegments+1]={previous,p}
                        local steps=math.ceil((p-previous).Magnitude/2)
                        if steps<=200 then
                            local n=core:node(previous)
                            for i=1,steps do
                                local nextNode=core:node(previous+(p-previous)*(i/steps))
                                core:edge(n,nextNode,false);core:edge(nextNode,n,false);n=nextNode
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    previous=p
                end
            end
            core.search=nil;core.failedSearch=nil;core.retryAt=0
        end
    end

    local movingGeometry; movingGeometry =                   function(part,info,body)
        local cf,size=part.CFrame,part.Size
        local axes={cf.RightVector,cf.UpVector,-cf.LookVector}
        local lengths={size.X,size.Y,size.Z}
        local height=0
        for i,axis in ipairs(axes) do height+=math.abs(axis.Y)*lengths[i]*.5 end
        for i,axis in ipairs(axes) do
            if math.abs(axis.Y)>.25 or lengths[i]<5 then continue end
            local direction=flat(axis).Unit;local side=Vector3.new(-direction.Z,0,direction.X)
            local width=0
            for j,other in ipairs(axes) do width+=math.abs(other:Dot(side))*lengths[j] end
            if lengths[i]>width*3 then
                return {kind="line",pos=part.Position,cf=cf,size=size,axis=direction,span=lengths[i],thin=width,
                    clearance=body+.5,height=height+4,motionVelocity=info.lastVel}
            end
        end
        return {kind="projectile",pos=part.Position,velocity=info.lastVel,
            radius=math.max(size.X,size.Z)*.5+body+.5,height=height+4}
    end 
    local reconcileBossProjectile; reconcileBossProjectile =                   function(h,name,zones,now)
        local names={firstbosscrisscross="First Boss Criss Cross Projectile",firstbossseekingspikes="First Boss Seeking Spike",firstbossbigspike="First Boss Big Spike"}
        local event=names[name:lower()]
        if not event or h.kind~="projectile" then return end
        local selected,best
        for _,zone in ipairs(zones)do
            if zone.bossShape~="moving" or not zone.behaviorKey or not zone.behaviorKey:find(event,1,true)
                or now<zone.launch or now>=zone.untilTime then continue end
            local centre=zone.origin+zone.axis*math.clamp((now-zone.launch)*zone.speed,0,zone.length)
            local offset=h.pos-centre
            local along=offset:Dot(zone.axis)
            local lateral=(offset-zone.axis*along).Magnitude
            local gap=offset.Magnitude
                                                                              
                                                                              
            if lateral<=3 and along<=math.max(3,zone.speed*.05)
                and along>=-math.max(3,zone.speed*.25) and (not best or gap<best)
                and (not h.velocity or h.velocity.Magnitude<2 or h.velocity.Unit:Dot(zone.axis)>.98)then
                selected=zone;best=gap
            end
        end
        if selected then
                                                                                                           
            h.velocity=selected.axis*selected.speed
            h.untilTime=math.min(h.untilTime or math.huge,selected.untilTime)
            h.eventMotionMatched=true
        end
    end

                or (part.Position-rp.Position).Magnitude-part.Size.Magnitude*.5>240 then continue end
            local h

                h=movingGeometry(part,info,body)

                h=a.attackGeometry(part,info)

            if a.forestAttackOverride then h=a.forestAttackOverride(part,info,h,body)end
            if h then
                if a.applyAttackWindow then a.applyAttackWindow(h,info)end
                if a.aquaticTempleWindow then a.aquaticTempleWindow(h,part)end
                if h.kind=="projectile" and a.orbCoverExpiry then

                local parent=part.Parent

                for _,e in ipairs(R.enemies) do
                    if part:IsDescendantOf(e.model) then h.owner=e.model;directOwner=e.model;break end
                end
                                                                              
                h.owner=h.owner or directOwner or info.lineCast and info.lineCast.owner or sole
                info.adaptiveOwner=h.owner
                if contextKey then h.behaviorKey=(contextKey..":"..parent.Name..":"..part.Name..":"..h.kind):sub(1,300) end
                                                                                 
                                                                                  
                if contextKey and (info.enemyEffect or info.lineCast or info.projectile) then
                    h.attackId=parent
                    h.attackKey=contextKey..":"..parent.Name

                    end
                end

            end
        end
        return list
    end

    end
