    local prepareMapRoute; prepareMapRoute =                   function(position,goal)
        if core.backtrack then return end
        if handledWallEpoch~=(core.wallBlacklistEpoch or 0) then
            handledWallEpoch=core.wallBlacklistEpoch or 0
            macroRetry=0;guideRetry=0
        end
                                                                         
        prepareMapGuide(position,goal)
        if a.longRouteDeferred and a.longRouteDeferred(position,goal) then return end
        if not goal or not a.grid or not a.grid.cells or macroBusy then return end
        local revision=a.geometryRevision or 0
        local rejection=core.macroRejection
        if rejection and rejection~=handledRejection then
            handledRejection=rejection;macroRetry=0
        end
        local preferMap=a.mapReady==true
        local unchanged=macroGoal and (goal-macroGoal).Magnitude<8 and macroRevision==revision
        local floorSearch=a.needsFloorRoute and a.needsFloorRoute(position,goal)
        local connectionSearch=a.needsPhysicalConnection and a.needsPhysicalConnection(position,goal)
        local ahead=a.routeLookaheadNeeded and a.routeLookaheadNeeded(position,goal)
        if unchanged and ((core.routeMacro and core.route[1] and not floorSearch and not connectionSearch and not ahead) or os.clock()<(macroRetry or 0)) then return end
        macroGoal=goal;macroRevision=revision;macroRetry=os.clock()+3;macroBusy=true
        local generation=a.generation;local requested=goal
        task.defer(                  function()
                                                                           
                                                                                   
            local ok,route;local source
            if a.knownEncounterRoute then ok,route=pcall(a.knownEncounterRoute,position,requested);source="verified encounter route" end
            if (not ok or not route) and (core.blacklistedWalls or 0)>0 then
                ok,route=pcall(a.recallCorridor,position,requested,generation,true)
                source="verified recorded detour"
            end
            if not ok or not route then
                ok,route=pcall(a.nativeRoute,position,requested)
                source="verified 3D terrain route"
            end
            if a.longRouteDeferred and a.longRouteDeferred(position,requested) then macroBusy=false;return end
            local supportFailure=a.connectionRejection and a.connectionRejection(a.nativeRouteFailure)
            if (not ok or not route) and (floorSearch or connectionSearch or supportFailure) then
                a.adaptiveMapRouteStatus=floorSearch and "searching connected floors" or "searching physical crossing"
                ok,route=pcall(a.surfaceGraphRoute,{Position=position},requested,6000,true)
                source=floorSearch and "verified stair and floor route" or "verified physical crossing"
            end
            if a.longRouteDeferred and a.longRouteDeferred(position,requested) then macroBusy=false;return end
            if not ok or not route then
                ok,route=pcall(a.mapGraphRoute,{Position=position},requested,true)
                source="connected map route ready"
            end
            if ok and route and a.shortenRoute then ok,route=pcall(a.shortenRoute,position,route) end
            macroBusy=false
            if not R.booted or generation~=a.generation or revision~=(a.geometryRevision or 0)
                or core.goal and (core.goal-requested).Magnitude>8 then return end
            if ok and route and #route>0 then
                local accepted=core:offerRoute(route,requested,source);a.adaptiveMapRouteStatus=accepted and source or core.offerRejection
            else a.adaptiveMapRouteStatus=ok and "no mapped connection yet" or tostring(route) end
        end )
    end 
    local chooseTarget; chooseTarget =                   function(rp)
        local choices,byId={},{}
        local prerequisite=blockingRoom() or a.progressionRoom
        for _,e in ipairs(R.enemies) do
            if prerequisite and not a.enemyInRoom(e,prerequisite) then continue end
            if e.room=="bossRoom" and a.stallBossActive and a.stallBossActive() then continue end
            if enemyAlive(e.model) and e.root and e.root.Parent then
                choices[#choices+1]={id=e.model,pos=a.combatPoint(e,rp.Position),clear=false};byId[e.model]=e
            end
        end
        table.sort(choices,                  function(x,y)return (x.pos-rp.Position).Magnitude<(y.pos-rp.Position).Magnitude end )
        local range=a.range()
        for i=1,#choices do
            local x=choices[i]
            if (x.pos-rp.Position).Magnitude>range then break end
            if (x.pos-rp.Position).Magnitude<=range then
                x.clear=a.spellLineClear(rp.Position,x.pos) or a.canAttackThroughWall(byId[x.id],rp)
                if x.clear then break end
            end
        end
        local selected=(a.sessionTarget and a.sessionTarget(choices)) or core:selectCombatTarget(rp.Position,locked and locked.model,choices,range)
        local ordered=a.encounterObjective and a.encounterObjective(rp.Position)
        if ordered and byId[ordered.model] then selected=ordered.model end
        locked=selected and byId[selected]
        R.target=locked;return locked
    end 
    a.canCastAt=                  function(target,rp)

            (point-rp.Position).Magnitude,a.range(),point.Y-rp.Position.Y,
            (extended and clear or a.spellLineClear(rp.Position,point)) or a.canAttackThroughWall(target,rp),not extended and a.needsAttackElevation(target,rp))
        a.attackStatus=reason;return ok
    end 
    a.canMeleeAt=                  function(target,rp)

    end

    walkStep=                  function()

            core.knownWalls={};core.wallGraph=nil;core.wallGraphWork=nil;core.wallGraphDirty=true
            core.traversed={};core.traversedKeys={}
            core.breadcrumbs={};core.backtrack=nil;core.progressWatch=nil;core.recoveryAvoid=nil

                local ok,data=pcall(                  function()return HTTP:JSONDecode(readfile(file))end )

        if teamObjective then goal=teamObjective.goal;arrival=teamObjective.arrival;canAttack=teamObjective.canAttack;attackPoint=goal end
        local protected=char() and char():FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField")~=nil

        if not mechanic then mechanic=enabled and a.golemObjective and a.golemObjective(rp)end
        if not mechanic and enabled and not recovering and a.bossMechanicsObjective then mechanic=a.bossMechanicsObjective(rp)end
        if not mechanic and enabled and not recovering and a.bobCoverObjective then mechanic=a.bobCoverObjective(rp) end
        local packGoal,packSpacing,packGathering

            packGoal,packSpacing=a.packGatherGoal(target,rp)

        end
        local rockStagingGoal
        if enabled and not mechanic and target and target.model.Name=="Bob The Frost Giant" then
            local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("secondBossCrystals")
            local sum,count=Vector3.zero,0
            if folder then
                for _,color in ipairs({"red","green","yellow"})do
                    local rock=folder:FindFirstChild(color)
                    if rock and rock:IsA("BasePart")then sum+=rock.Position;count+=1 end
                end
            end

                local direction=flat(sum/count-target.root.Position)
                if direction.Magnitude>1 then
                    goal=target.root.Position+direction.Unit*math.min(76,direction.Magnitude)
                    goal=Vector3.new(goal.X,rp.Position.Y,goal.Z)
                    rockStagingGoal=goal
                    a.navigationObjective="reserving access to all orb stones"
                end
            end
        end
        local detectedMechanic=mechanic
        if mechanic and mechanic.goal then
            goal=mechanic.goal;arrival=mechanic.arrival;attackPoint=goal;canAttack=mechanic.canHold==true

do (function()
    local a=R.ai
    local sessionTeam; sessionTeam =                   function()
        local shared=a.sessionTeam
        if not a.sessionLinked or not shared then return nil,{} end
        local peers={}
        if os.clock()-shared.at<5 then
            for _,peer in ipairs(shared.peers)do
                if peer.job==game.JobId and peer.place==tostring(game.PlaceId) and (peer.age or 99)<4 then
                    local player=Players:GetPlayerByUserId(tonumber(peer.user))
                    local character=player and player.Character
                    local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    local rp=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 and rp then
                        peers[#peers+1]={user=peer.user,role=peer.role~="Auto" and peer.role or peer.effectiveRole or "Auto",master=peer.master,root=rp,
                            hp=humanoid.Health/math.max(1,humanoid.MaxHealth),healing=peer.healing,healReady=peer.healReady,
                            healRange=peer.healRange or 0,target=peer.target,targetName=peer.targetName}
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local assignment=shared.assignment or {}
        if a.sessionCarryActive then
            assignment=table.clone(assignment)
            local carrier=a.sessionCarryPlan and a.sessionCarryPlan.leader or a.sessionCarryLeader
            assignment.mode=(carrier==tostring(LP.UserId) or assignment.accountType~="Alt") and "Normal" or (assignment.mode or "Wait at spawn")
        end
        return assignment,peers
    end 
    local sessionRole; sessionRole =                   function(assignment)
        a.scanSpells()
        local selected=assignment and assignment.role or "Auto"
        if selected~="Auto" then return selected end
        for _,p in pairs(a.slots)do if p.role=="heal" then return "Healer" end end
        for _,p in pairs(a.slots)do if p.role=="damage" then return p.school=="magic" and "Mage" or "Melee" end end
        return "Auto"
    end 
    a.sessionCapability=function()
        local assignment=sessionTeam()
        local selected=sessionRole(assignment)
        local range=0
        if R.farming and S.AttackEnabled and selected=="Healer" then
            for key,p in pairs(a.slots)do
                if S["Use"..key] and p.role=="heal" and a.spellSlotReady(p,os.clock()) then range=math.max(range,p.range or 0)end
            end
        end
        return selected,range
    end
    local sessionInjured; sessionInjured =                   function(peers)
        local candidates={}
        for _,p in ipairs(peers)do if p.hp<.85 then candidates[#candidates+1]=p end end
        table.sort(candidates,function(x,y)if math.abs(x.hp-y.hp)>.01 then return x.hp<y.hp end;return x.user<y.user end)
        return candidates
    end 
    a.sessionNeedsHeal=                  function()
        local assignment,peers=sessionTeam()
        if not assignment or assignment.mode=="Wait at spawn" then return false end
        local selected=assignment.role
        if selected~="Healer" and selected~="Auto" and selected~=nil then return false end
        return #sessionInjured(peers)>0
    end 
    local spawn,spawnCharacter,spawnDungeon,kiteGoal,kiteTarget
    a.sessionObserveSpawn=                  function(rp)
        local dungeon=dungeonFolder()
        if spawnCharacter~=char() or spawnDungeon~=dungeon then spawn=rp.Position;spawnCharacter=char();spawnDungeon=dungeon end
    end 
    a.sessionObjective=                  function(rp,target,goal,canAttack,arrival)
        local assignment,peers=sessionTeam();if not assignment then return end
        a.sessionObserveSpawn(rp)
        local mode=assignment.mode or "Normal";local selected=sessionRole(assignment)
        a.sessionRoleStatus=selected.." · "..mode
        if mode=="Wait at spawn" then return {goal=spawn,arrival=3,canAttack=(rp.Position-spawn).Magnitude<=3} end
        if mode=="Follow carrier" then
            local carrier=Players:GetPlayerByUserId(tonumber(assignment.carrier) or 0)
            local body=carrier and carrier.Character and carrier.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not body then return {goal=rp.Position,arrival=3,canAttack=true} end
            local d=flat(rp.Position-body.Position);local point=body.Position+(d.Magnitude>.1 and d.Unit or Vector3.new(1,0,0))*9
            return {goal=point,arrival=3,canAttack=(rp.Position-point).Magnitude<=3}
        end
        if a.proximityObjective or a.blockingGate then return end
        if selected=="Healer" then
            local allies=sessionInjured(peers);local ally=allies[1]
            if ally and ally.user~=tostring(LP.UserId) then
                local range=12
                for _,p in pairs(a.slots)do if p.role=="heal" then range=math.max(range,math.min(p.range*.65,25)) end end
                return {goal=ally.root.Position,arrival=range,canAttack=(rp.Position-ally.root.Position).Magnitude<=range}
            end
        end
        if target and target.root then
            local delta=flat(rp.Position-target.root.Position)
            if selected=="Kiter" and delta.Magnitude>.1 then
                local keep=math.max(12,math.min(a.range()-5,30))
                if kiteTarget~=target.model or delta.Magnitude>=keep or kiteGoal and (kiteGoal-rp.Position).Magnitude<2 then kiteGoal=nil end
                if not kiteGoal and delta.Magnitude<keep*.7 then kiteGoal=target.root.Position+delta.Unit*keep;kiteTarget=target.model end
                if kiteGoal then return {goal=kiteGoal,arrival=2,canAttack=false} end
            elseif selected=="Tank" then
                return {goal=target.root.Position,arrival=14,canAttack=(rp.Position-target.root.Position).Magnitude<=14}
            end
        end
        if selected=="Mage" or selected=="Healer" then
            for _,p in ipairs(peers)do
                if p.role=="Tank" and p.user~=tostring(LP.UserId) and not canAttack and (rp.Position-p.root.Position).Magnitude>24 then
                    local back=flat(rp.Position-p.root.Position)
                    return {goal=p.root.Position+back.Unit*12,arrival=4,canAttack=false}
                end
            end
        end
    end 
    a.sessionTarget=                  function(choices)
        local assignment,peers=sessionTeam();if not assignment or assignment.mode=="Wait at spawn" then return end
        local chosen
        for _,peer in ipairs(peers)do
            if peer.user~=tostring(LP.UserId) and peer.target and (peer.master or peer.role=="Tank") then
                if not chosen or peer.master then chosen=peer end
            end
        end
        if chosen and type(chosen.target)=="table" and #chosen.target==3 then
            local point=Vector3.new(table.unpack(chosen.target));local best,dist=nil,10
            for _,candidate in ipairs(choices)do
                local d=(candidate.pos-point).Magnitude
                if d<dist then best=candidate.id;dist=d end
            end
            return best
        end
    end 
    local original=combatStep
    combatStep=                  function()
        local assignment,peers=sessionTeam()
        if not assignment then a.sessionHealing=nil;return original() end
        if assignment.mode=="Wait at spawn" then a.sessionHealing=nil;return end
        if not R.farming or not S.AttackEnabled or not alive() or not inDungeon() then
        R.ai.attackStatus=not R.farming and "controller stopped" or not S.AttackEnabled and "attacks disabled" or not alive() and "character not alive" or "waiting for dungeon" a.sessionHealing=nil;return original() end
        local selected=sessionRole(assignment);local rp=root();local now=os.clock()
        if now>=(a.sessionHealingUntil or 0) then a.sessionHealing=nil end
        local busy=char() and char():FindFirstChild("busyCasting")
        if rp and not (busy and busy.Value) and now>=R.nextSpell then
            if selected=="Healer" then
                local candidates=sessionInjured(peers)
                for _,ally in ipairs(candidates)do
                    local claimed=false
                    for _,peer in ipairs(peers)do
                        if peer.user~=tostring(LP.UserId) and peer.healing==ally.user and ally.hp>.35 then claimed=true;break end
                    end
                    if claimed then continue end
                    for key,p in pairs(a.slots)do
                        if S["Use"..key] and p.role=="heal" and a.spellSlotReady(p,now)
                            and (ally.root.Position-rp.Position).Magnitude<=p.range and a.spellLineClear(rp.Position,ally.root.Position) then
                            local distance=(ally.root.Position-rp.Position).Magnitude
                            local elected=true
                            if ally.hp>.35 then
                                for _,peer in ipairs(peers)do
                                    local d=(ally.root.Position-peer.root.Position).Magnitude
                                    if peer.user~=tostring(LP.UserId) and peer.role=="Healer" and peer.healReady and d<=peer.healRange
                                        and (d<distance-.5 or math.abs(d-distance)<=.5 and peer.user<tostring(LP.UserId)) then elected=false;break end
                                end
                            end
                            if not elected then continue end
                            a.sessionHealing=ally.user;a.sessionHealingUntil=now+1
                            if p.name:lower():find("spray",1,true) then
                                steerCamera(ally.root.Position);R.faceWant=ally.root.Position
                                if not aimedAt(ally.root.Position) then return end
                            end
                            a.sendSkill(p,nil,rp,now);a.sessionRoleStatus="Healing "..ally.user;return
                        end
                    end
                end
            elseif selected=="Tank" and R.target and (R.target.root.Position-rp.Position).Magnitude<20 then
                for key,p in pairs(a.slots)do
                    local n=p.name:lower()
                    if S["Use"..key] and p.role=="support" and (n:find("taunt",1,true) or n=="guardian roar" or n=="guardian call") and a.spellSlotReady(p,now) then
                        a.sendSkill(p,R.target,rp,now);return
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return original()
    end 
end)()
end

R.ai.skillSetPolicy=(function()
local M={}
function M.compatible(skill,school)
    if not skill or skill.role=="unknown" then return false end
    if skill.role=="damage" or skill.role=="booster" then return school~=nil and skill.school==school end
    return skill.role=="heal" or skill.role=="shield" or skill.taunt==true
end
function M.active(sets,names,hint)
    local matches={}
    for id=1,2 do
        local set=sets[id];local match=set~=nil;local count=0
        for _,key in ipairs({"Q","E"})do
            local name=set and set[key] and set[key].name
            if name~=names[key] then match=false end
            if name then count+=1 end
        end
        if match and count>0 then matches[#matches+1]=id end
    end
    if #matches==1 then return matches[1] end
    if hint and table.find(matches,hint)then return hint end
end
function M.score(set,context)
    local score=0;local damage={}
    for key,p in pairs(set or {})do
        if context.enabled[key] and M.compatible(p,context.school) and p.ready~=false
            and (p.readyAt or 0)<=context.now then
            if p.role=="damage" and context.target then damage[p.school]=true;score+=10
            elseif p.role=="heal" and context.injured then score+=context.healer and 40 or 25
            elseif p.role=="shield" and context.injured then score+=15
            elseif p.taunt and context.tank and context.target then score+=8 end
        end
    end
    for key,p in pairs(set or {})do
        if context.enabled[key] and p.role=="booster" and M.compatible(p,context.school) and damage[p.school]
            and p.ready~=false and (p.readyAt or 0)<=context.now then score+=4 end
    end
    return score
end
function M.reserveDamageSlot(alternate,context)
    if not context.enabled or not context.target or context.busy or not alternate
        or alternate.role~="damage" or not M.compatible(alternate,context.school)
        or alternate.ready==false or (alternate.readyAt or 0)>context.now then return false end
    if not context.travel then return true end
    return context.arrival<(context.buffCooldown or 0)+.25
end
function M.choose(sets,active,context)
    if not active or context.busy or context.pending or context.waiting then return end
    if context.escape then
        local function usable(set)
            for key,p in pairs(set or {})do
                if context.enabled[key] and p.speedBoost and M.compatible(p,context.school)
                    and p.ready~=false and (p.readyAt or 0)<=context.now then return true end
            end
            return false
        end
        if usable(sets[active]) then return end
        if usable(sets[3-active]) then return 3-active end
        return
    end
    if context.holdEffect then return end
    local other=3-active;local current=M.score(sets[active],context);local alternate=M.score(sets[other],context)
    local gain=false
    for key,p in pairs(sets[other] or {})do
        local old=sets[active] and sets[active][key]
        if context.enabled[key] and M.compatible(p,context.school) and p.ready~=false and (p.readyAt or 0)<=context.now then
            if old and p.name==old.name then continue end
            if context.injured and (p.role=="heal" or p.role=="shield") then gain=true
            elseif p.role=="damage" and context.target then
                if not old or old.role~="damage" or not M.compatible(old,context.school) then gain=true
                elseif p.strength and old.strength and p.strength>old.strength then gain=true end
            end
        end
    end
                                                                              
                                                                             
    if not gain then return end
    if not context.injured then
        for key,p in pairs(sets[other] or {})do
            local old=sets[active] and sets[active][key]
            if old and p.role==old.role and p.school==old.school and p.strength and old.strength
                and p.strength<old.strength then return end
        end
    end
                                                                                
    if alternate>0 and (current==0 or context.injured and alternate>=25 and alternate>current)then return other end
end
return M

end)()
do (function()
    local a=R.ai;local policy=a.skillSetPolicy
    local remotes=RS:FindFirstChild("remotes")
    local state={sets={},strengths={},at=0,nextSwap=0,nextRead=0,stopped=false,character=nil}
    local function readInventory(raw)
        assert(type(raw)=="table" and type(raw.abilities)=="table","Ability inventory unavailable")
        if a.observeDamageGear then a.observeDamageGear(raw)end
        local sets={{},{}};local count=0;local seen={}
        for id,row in pairs(raw.abilities)do
            count+=1;assert(count<=500,"Ability inventory too large")
            if type(row)=="table" and type(row.equipped)=="table" then
                for _,slot in ipairs({"q","e","q2","e2"})do
                    if row.equipped[slot]==true then
                        assert(not seen[slot],"Duplicate ability slot");seen[slot]=true
                        local reference=a.skillCatalog[tostring(row.name):lower()] or {}
                        local description=tostring(row.description or ""):lower()
                        local school=reference.school
                        if description:find("scales with spell",1,true)then school="magic"
                        elseif description:find("scales with physical",1,true)then school="physical" end
                        local name=tostring(row.name);local n=name:lower()
                        sets[#slot==2 and 2 or 1][slot:sub(1,1):upper()]={id=tostring(id),name=name,
                            role=reference.role or "unknown",school=school,taunt=n:find("taunt",1,true)~=nil or n=="guardian call" or n=="guardian roar"}
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local physical,magic=0,0;local weapons=0
        for _,row in pairs(raw.weapons or {})do
            if row.equipped==true then physical=tonumber(row.physicalDamage) or 0;magic=tonumber(row.spellPower) or 0;weapons+=1 end
        end
        state.school=weapons==1 and (magic>physical*1.15 and "magic" or physical>magic*1.15 and "physical") or nil
        local signature={}
        for id=1,2 do for _,key in ipairs({"Q","E"})do local p=sets[id][key];signature[#signature+1]=p and p.id..":"..p.name or "-" end end
        signature=table.concat(signature,"|")
        if state.signature~=signature then state.failed=false;state.signature=signature end
        state.sets=sets;state.at=os.clock()
    end
    local activeSet; activeSet =                   function()
        local names={}
        for key,p in pairs(a.slots)do if a.skillStillEquipped(p)then names[key]=p.name end end
        local gui=LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui");local abilities=gui and gui:FindFirstChild("abilities")
        local frame=abilities and abilities:FindFirstChild("Frame");local label=frame and frame:FindFirstChild("Set#")
        local hint=state.hint or label and tonumber(label.Text:match("^Set ([12])$"))
        return policy.active(state.sets,names,hint)
    end 
    local permittedSchool; permittedSchool =                   function()
        if S.SwapBuild=="Magic" then return "magic" end
        if S.SwapBuild=="Physical" then return "physical" end
        return state.school
    end 
    a.reserveDamageSlot=                  function(key,target,rp,now,travel)
        if not S.AutoSwapSets or state.failed or now-state.at>45 or not target or not rp then return false end
        local active=activeSet();if not active then return false end
        local other=state.sets[3-active] and state.sets[3-active][key]
        local live=a.slots[key]
        if not other or not live then return false end
        local partner=a.slots[key=="Q" and "E" or "Q"]
        if not travel and live.role=="booster" and partner and partner.role=="damage"
            and partner.school==live.school and S["Use"..partner.key]
            and a.spellSlotReady(partner,now) and a.skillCanCast(partner,target,rp) then return false end
        local data=table.clone(other)
        data.readyAt=math.max(a.slotCooldownDeadline(key),live.inputUntil or 0,live.retryAt or 0)
        local point=a.combatPoint(target,rp.Position)
        local h=hum();local speed=h and h.WalkSpeed or 16
        local arrival=math.max(0,(point-rp.Position).Magnitude-a.range())/math.max(1,speed)
        return policy.reserveDamageSlot(data,{now=now,enabled=S["Use"..key],target=enemyAlive(target.model),
            school=permittedSchool(),travel=travel,arrival=arrival,buffCooldown=live.cooldown or 0})
    end 
    a.skillSwapReset=function()state.failed=false;state.nextRead=0;state.nextSwap=os.clock()+1 end
    a.skillSwapStep=                  function()
        local now=os.clock()
        if state.character~=char() then state.character=char();state.pending=nil;state.hint=nil;state.nextRead=0;state.failed=false end
        if not S.AutoSwapSets or not R.farming or not S.AttackEnabled or not alive() or not inDungeon() then return false end
        a.scanSpells()
        local active=activeSet()
        if state.pending then
            if active==state.pending.want and state.hint==active then
                state.pending=nil;a.scanAt=0;a.boosterPending=nil;R.nextSpell=math.max(R.nextSpell,now+.15)
                a.skillSwapStatus="Using set "..active;return true
            end
            if now-state.pending.at>2 then state.pending=nil;state.failed=true;a.skillSwapStatus="Swap unconfirmed — toggle auto swap to retry";return false end
            return true
        end
        if not active then a.skillSwapStatus="Waiting for matching spell-set data";return false end
        local sets={{},{}};local hold=false
        for id=1,2 do
            for key,p in pairs(state.sets[id])do
                local data=table.clone(p)
                local reference=a.skillCatalog[p.name:lower()] or {}
                data.speedBoost=reference.speedBoost==true or p.name=="Enhanced Inner Rage" or p.name=="Enhanced Inner Focus"
                if p.role=="booster" then data.strength=state.strengths[p.name] end
                if p.role=="damage" and R.target then
                    local estimate=a.expectedSpellDamage({name=p.name,school=p.school,origin=(a.skillCatalog[p.name:lower()] or {}).origin},R.target,now)
                    if estimate>0 then data.strength=estimate end
                end
                if id==active then
                    local live=a.slots[key]
                    if live and live.role=="booster" and tonumber(live.buffPower) then
                        state.strengths[live.name]=tonumber(live.buffPower);data.strength=tonumber(live.buffPower)
                    end
                    local cd=live and a.skillCooldown(live)
                    data.ready=live and a.spellSlotReady(live,now) or false
                    data.readyAt=live and math.max(now+math.max(0,cd or 0),live.next or 0,live.inputUntil or 0) or now+2
                                                                                                       
                    if data.ready then data.readyAt=now end
                    if live and (live.effectPending or live.activeEffect and now<live.activeEffect.untilAt)then hold=true end
                end
                sets[id][key]=data
            end
        end
        for _,key in ipairs({"Q","E"})do
            local live=a.slots[key]
            local deadline=math.max(a.slotCooldownDeadline(key),live and live.inputUntil or 0,live and live.retryAt or 0)
            for id=1,2 do
                local data=sets[id][key]
                if data then data.readyAt=math.max(data.readyAt or 0,deadline) end
            end
        end
        local team=a.sessionTeam and a.sessionTeam.assignment or {};local role=team.role
        local carrier=a.sessionCarryPlan and a.sessionCarryPlan.leader or a.sessionCarryLeader
        local carryWaiting=a.sessionCarryActive and carrier~=tostring(LP.UserId)
        local injured=hpPct()<=(tonumber(S.SkillHealHP) or 65)
        if a.sessionNeedsHeal and a.sessionNeedsHeal()then injured=true end
        local ch=char();local busy=ch and ch:FindFirstChild("busyCasting")
        local actor=root();local human=hum();local core=a.adaptive
        local escape=S.TravelSpeedSkills~=false and actor and human and a.dodgeMotionReady(actor,human,core)
            and now>=(a.travelBoostUntil or 0) and not (a.travelBaseSpeed and human.WalkSpeed>a.travelBaseSpeed+2)
        local want=policy.choose(sets,active,{now=now,escape=escape,school=permittedSchool(),enabled={Q=S.UseQ,E=S.UseE},
            target=R.target and enemyAlive(R.target.model),injured=injured,healer=role=="Healer",tank=role=="Tank",
            waiting=carryWaiting or team.mode=="Wait at spawn",pending=a.boosterPending~=nil,busy=busy and busy.Value==true,holdEffect=hold})
        if state.failed or now<state.nextSwap or now<R.nextSpell or now-state.at>45 or not want then return false end
        local gui=LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui");local inv=gui and gui:FindFirstChild("inventory")
        local panel=inv and inv:FindFirstChild("mainBackground")
        if panel and panel.Visible then return false end
        local remote=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("swapAbilitySet")
        if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then a.skillSwapStatus="Swap unavailable";return false end
        state.pending={want=want,at=now};state.nextSwap=now+2;a.skillSwapStatus="Switching to set "..want
        local ok=pcall(                  function()remote:FireServer()end )
        if not ok then state.pending=nil;state.failed=true;a.skillSwapStatus="Swap request failed";return false end
        return true
    end 
    local event=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("abilitySetSwapped")
    local connection
    if event and event:IsA("RemoteEvent")then connection=event.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(id)
        if id==1 or id==2 then state.hint=id;a.scanAt=0;state.nextSwap=math.max(state.nextSwap,os.clock()+1)end
    end)end
    local original=combatStep
    combatStep=                  function()if a.skillSwapStep()then return end;return original()end 
    Lib:OnUnload(function()state.stopped=true;if connection then connection:Disconnect()end end)
    task.spawn(function()
        while not state.stopped and not Lib.Unloaded do
            if S.AutoSwapSets and R.farming and os.clock()>=state.nextRead then
                state.nextRead=os.clock()+15
                local ok,why=pcall(function()
                    local remote=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("reloadInvy")
                    assert(remote and remote:IsA("RemoteFunction"),"Inventory reader unavailable")
                    local inventory=remote:InvokeServer()
                    if not state.stopped then readInventory(inventory)end
                end)
                if not ok then a.skillSwapStatus=tostring(why)end
            end
            task.wait(1)
        end
    end)
end)() end

                                                                             
                                                                                    
do (function()
    local a=R.ai
    local stopped=false;local remote,remoteConnection
    local watched={}
    local function disconnect(list)
        for _,connection in ipairs(list)do pcall(function()connection:Disconnect()end)end
    end
    local function bind(list,signal,callback)
        if not signal then return end
        local ok,connection=pcall(function()return signal:Connect(callback)end)
        if ok then list[#list+1]=connection end
    end
    local function property(list,object,key,callback)
        if not object then return end
        local ok,signal=pcall(function()return object:GetPropertyChangedSignal(key)end)
        if ok then bind(list,signal,callback)end
    end
    local function refresh()
        if stopped or Lib.Unloaded then return end
        local container=RS:FindFirstChild("remotes")
        local candidate=container and container:FindFirstChild("abilityCast")
        if candidate and not candidate:IsA("RemoteEvent")then candidate=nil end
        if remote~=candidate then
            if remoteConnection then remoteConnection:Disconnect();remoteConnection=nil end
            remote=candidate
            if remote then
                remoteConnection=remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(actor,name)
                    if stopped or Lib.Unloaded then return end
                    local ok,result=pcall(a.observeAbilityCast,actor,name)
                    a.castObserverError=not ok and tostring(result)or nil
                end)
            end
        end
        local wanted={}
        for _,p in pairs(a.slots)do
            if not a.skillStillEquipped(p)then continue end
            wanted[p]=true
            local value=p.tool:FindFirstChild("cooldown")
            local label=p.panel and p.panel:FindFirstChild("cooldownNumber",true)
            local row=watched[p]
            if row and (row.value~=value or row.label~=label)then disconnect(row);watched[p]=nil;row=nil end
            if row then continue end
            row={value=value,label=label};watched[p]=row
            local function changed()
                if stopped or Lib.Unloaded or not a.skillStillEquipped(p)then return end
                                                                                       
                local ok,why=pcall(a.observeSlotCooldown,p,os.clock(),false)
                if not ok then a.castObserverError=tostring(why)end
            end
            if value and value:IsA("ValueBase")then property(row,value,"Value",changed)end
            property(row,label,"Text",changed);property(row,label,"Visible",changed)
            local function invalidate()if not stopped then a.scanAt=0 end end
            property(row,p.tool,"Name",invalidate)
            bind(row,p.tool.ChildAdded,invalidate);bind(row,p.tool.ChildRemoved,invalidate)
            local slot=p.tool:FindFirstChild("abilitySlot")
            if slot and slot:IsA("ValueBase")then property(row,slot,"Value",invalidate)end
            changed()
        end
        for p,row in pairs(watched)do if not wanted[p]then disconnect(row);watched[p]=nil end end
        a.castObserverStatus=remoteConnection and "Cast events connected" or "Using cooldown values"
    end
    a.refreshCastObserver=refresh
    Lib:OnUnload(function()
        stopped=true
        if remoteConnection then remoteConnection:Disconnect()end
        for _,row in pairs(watched)do disconnect(row)end
        table.clear(watched);a.castEvidence=nil;a.refreshCastObserver=nil
    end)
    task.spawn(function()
        while not stopped and not Lib.Unloaded do
            local ok,why=pcall(refresh)
            if not ok then a.castObserverError=tostring(why)end
            task.wait(1)
        end
    end)
end)() end

do (function()
    local a=R.ai
    local state={saved=nil,stopped=false,teleportAt=0,signature=nil}
    local path="DQR/settings/Armstrong-carry-original-"..tostring(LP.UserId)..".json"
    local restored,saved=pcall(function()if isfile(path)then return HTTP:JSONDecode(readfile(path))end end)
    if restored and type(saved)=="table" then state.saved=saved end
    local controlled={"Master","MoveEnabled","AttackEnabled","AutoReplay","ReturnLobby","AutoStart","AutoReady",
        "AutoLevelLobby","AutoLaunchLobby","LevelLobbyHardcore","Private","WaitForParty","PartyNames",
        "AutoRequestHost","AutoJoinLobby","JoinHost","JoinMaps","JoinDifficulties","JoinHardcoreOnly","LeaveWithoutHost"}
    local function setting(key,value)
        local object=a.sessionControls.settings[key]
        if object and object.Value~=value then
            local ok,why=a.applySessionCommand({command="setting",key=key,value=value});assert(ok,why)
        end
    end
    local function persist()
        if state.saved then return end
        local ok,data=pcall(function()if isfile(path)then return HTTP:JSONDecode(readfile(path))end end)
        if ok and type(data)=="table" then state.saved=data;return end
        local saved={}
        for _,key in ipairs(controlled)do
            local object=a.sessionControls.settings[key]
            if object then saved[key]=a.configValues.copy(object.Value)end
        end
        writefile(path,HTTP:JSONEncode(saved));state.saved=saved
    end
    local function restore()
        if not state.saved then return end
        setting("Master",false)
        setting("AutoLevelLobby",false);setting("AutoLaunchLobby",false);setting("AutoRequestHost",false)
        for _,key in ipairs(controlled)do
            if key~="Master" and state.saved[key]~=nil then setting(key,state.saved[key])end
        end
        if isfile(path)then delfile(path)end
        state.saved=nil;state.signature=nil
    end
    a.sessionCarryFresh=function()
        return a.sessionCarryActive and a.sessionLinked and a.sessionCarryPlan and os.clock()-(a.sessionCarryAt or 0)<8
    end
    a.sessionCarryCanHost=function()
        local plan=a.sessionCarryPlan
        return a.sessionCarryFresh() and plan.ready and plan.leader==tostring(LP.UserId)
    end
    a.sessionCarryCanStart=function()
        local plan=a.sessionCarryPlan
        if not a.sessionCarryFresh() or a.sessionCarryLeader~=tostring(LP.UserId)
            or plan.maintaining or a.inventoryTripBusy then return false end
        local roster=plan.users or a.sessionCarryRoster
        if not roster or #roster==0 then return false end
        local players=game:GetService("Players")
        for _,id in ipairs(roster)do
            local player=players:GetPlayerByUserId(tonumber(id))
            local loaded=player and player:FindFirstChild("dataLoaded")
            local c=player and player.Character;local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not loaded or loaded.Value~=true or not h or h.Health<=0 or not c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")then return false end
        end
        return inDungeon()
    end
    a.sessionCarryUpdate=function(plan)
        a.sessionCarryPlan=plan;a.sessionCarryAt=os.clock();a.sessionCarryActive=plan.enabled==true
        if plan.users then a.sessionCarryRoster=plan.users end
        if not plan.enabled then a.sessionCarryLeader=nil;restore();return end
        if not plan.leader then setting("AutoReplay",false);setting("ReturnLobby",false);return end
        a.sessionCarryLeader=plan.leader
        persist()
        local carrier=plan.leader==tostring(LP.UserId)
                                                                                     
        setting("Master",true)
        setting("MoveEnabled",true);setting("AttackEnabled",true)
        setting("AutoReplay",carrier and plan.afterRun=="replay");setting("ReturnLobby",plan.afterRun=="return");setting("AutoStart",true);setting("AutoReady",true)
        setting("LeaveWithoutHost",false);setting("AutoJoinLobby",false)
        setting("JoinMaps","");setting("JoinDifficulties","");setting("JoinHardcoreOnly",false)
        if carrier then
            setting("AutoRequestHost",false)
            setting("Private",true);setting("LevelLobbyHardcore",true)
            setting("PartyNames",table.concat(plan.names,", "));setting("WaitForParty",true)
            setting("AutoLevelLobby",true);setting("AutoLaunchLobby",true)
        else
            setting("AutoLevelLobby",false);setting("AutoLaunchLobby",false);setting("WaitForParty",false)
            setting("JoinHost",plan.name);setting("AutoRequestHost",true)
        end
        local signature=plan.leader..":"..plan.minLevel
        if state.signature~=signature then
            state.signature=signature
            if a.resumeCarryLobby then a.resumeCarryLobby()end
        end
    end
    local original=a.partyReady
    a.partyReady=function()
        if a.sessionCarryActive then
            if inDungeon() then return a.sessionCarryCanStart()end
            if not a.sessionCarryCanHost()then return false end
            if a.sessionCarryPlan.crossJoin then return true end
        end
        return original()
    end
    local originalReplay=replayRun
    replayRun=function(...)
        if a.sessionCarryActive and (not a.sessionCarryFresh() or a.sessionCarryPlan.leader~=tostring(LP.UserId) or a.sessionCarryPlan.afterRun~="replay")then return false end
        return originalReplay(...)
    end
    local originalLobby=toLobby
    toLobby=function(...)
        if a.sessionCarryActive and not a.inventoryTripBusy and (not a.sessionCarryFresh() or
            a.sessionCarryPlan.afterRun~="return" and not table.find(a.sessionCarryPlan.rejoinUsers or {},tostring(LP.UserId)))then return false end
        return originalLobby(...)
    end
    Lib:OnUnload(function()state.stopped=true end)
    task.spawn(function()
        while not state.stopped and not Lib.Unloaded do
            local plan=a.sessionCarryPlan
            if inDungeon() and wsVal("dungeonStarted",true)==false and S.AutoStart and a.sessionCarryCanStart()
                and os.clock()-(R.lastStart or -10)>=4 then
                R.lastStart=os.clock();startRun()
            end
            if a.sessionCarryFresh() and plan.leader and plan.leader~=tostring(LP.UserId) and inDungeon()
                and os.clock()>=state.teleportAt and (plan.runComplete and plan.afterRun=="return" or
                    table.find(plan.rejoinUsers or {},tostring(LP.UserId)) and (plan.place=="77649408247578" or a.lifecycleOutcome and a.lifecycleOutcome() or wsVal("dungeonStarted",true)==false)) then
                state.teleportAt=os.clock()+30;toLobby()
            end
                                                                         
            task.wait(2)
        end
    end)
end)() end

do (function()
    local a=R.ai
    local pending,answered={},{}
    local stopped=false
    local remotes=RS:FindFirstChild("remotes")
    local incoming=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("showJoinRequest")
    local respond=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("respondJoinRequest")
    local function idKey(id)
        if type(id)=="string" and #id>0 and #id<=128 then return id end
        if type(id)=="number" and id==id and math.abs(id)<1e16 then return tostring(id) end
    end
    local function allowed(name)
        if stopped or Lib.Unloaded or not inDungeon() or wsVal("dungeonStarted",true)~=false or not S.Master or not a.sessionCarryFresh or not a.sessionCarryFresh() then return false end
        local plan=a.sessionCarryPlan
        if not plan or plan.leader~=tostring(LP.UserId) then return false end
        for _,member in ipairs(plan.names or {})do if member:lower()==name:lower() then return true end end
        return false
    end
    local function accept()
        if not respond or not respond:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return end
        local now=os.clock()
        for key,row in pairs(answered)do
            if row.sent and Players:FindFirstChild(row.name) then
                local gui=LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
                local prompt=gui and gui:FindFirstChild("joinRequestConfirm_"..key)
                if prompt and prompt:IsA("ScreenGui") then prompt:Destroy() end
                if not row.confirmed then a.carryRequestStatus="Joined "..row.name;row.confirmed=true end
            end
            if now-row.at>120 then answered[key]=nil end
        end
        for key,row in pairs(pending)do
            if now-row.at>60 then pending[key]=nil
            elseif allowed(row.name) and not answered[key] then
                                                                                   
                local answer={at=now,name=row.name};answered[key]=answer;pending[key]=nil
                local ok=pcall(function()respond:FireServer(row.id,true)end)
                answer.sent=ok
                a.carryRequestStatus=ok and "Accept sent: "..row.name or "Could not accept "..row.name
            end
        end
    end
    local connection
    if incoming and incoming:IsA("RemoteEvent")then
        connection=incoming.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(id,name,action)
            local key=idKey(id)
            if action=="close" then
                if key then pending[key]=nil else pending={} end
                return
            end
            if not key or type(name)~="string" or not name:match("^[%w_]+$") or #name>20 or answered[key] then return end
            local count=0;for _ in pairs(pending)do count+=1 end
            if count>=30 and not pending[key] then return end
            pending[key]={id=id,name=name,at=os.clock()};accept()
        end)
    end
                                                                          
    local function existing()
        local gui=LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        if not gui then return end
        local count=0
        for _,prompt in ipairs(gui:GetChildren())do
            local id=prompt.Name:match("^joinRequestConfirm_(.+)$")
            if id and prompt:IsA("ScreenGui") and prompt.Enabled then
                count+=1;if count>30 then break end
                local outer=prompt:FindFirstChild("Frame");local inner=outer and outer:FindFirstChild("Frame")
                local label=inner and inner:FindFirstChild("status")
                local text=label and label:IsA("TextLabel") and label.Text
                local name=text and (text:match("^([%w_]+) %(LVL %d+%) wants to join your raid%.$") or text:match("^([%w_]+) wants to join your raid%.$"))
                if name and not answered[id] and not pending[id] then pending[id]={id=tonumber(id) or id,name=name,at=os.clock()}end
            end
        end
    end
    Lib:OnUnload(function()stopped=true;if connection then connection:Disconnect()end end)
    task.spawn(function()
        while not stopped and not Lib.Unloaded do existing();accept();task.wait(1) end
    end)
end)() end

R.ai.inventoryTripPolicy=(function()
local P={capacity=300,storageCapacity=125}
function P.valuable(row)return row.rarity=="legendary" or row.rarity=="ultimate" end
P.signature =                   function(row)
    local r=row.raw or row
    local parts={}
    for _,key in ipairs({"name","rarity","levelReq","currentUpgrade","maxUpgrades","physicalDamage","physicalPower","spellPower","health"}) do
        parts[#parts+1]=tostring(r[key])
    end
    return table.concat(parts,"|")
end 
function P.storage(raw)
    assert(type(raw)=="table","Storage unavailable")
    local count,signatures=0,{}
    for _,name in ipairs({"weapons","helmets","chests","abilities"}) do
        local bucket=raw[name] or {};assert(type(bucket)=="table","Storage format changed")
        for _,row in pairs(bucket) do
            assert(type(row)=="table","Storage item unreadable")
            count+=1;assert(count<=500,"Storage size unexpected")
            local key=P.signature(row);signatures[key]=(signatures[key] or 0)+1
        end
    end
    return count,signatures
end
function P.plan(rows,options,model,mathModel)
    local sales,store={},{}
    for _,row in ipairs(rows) do
        if P.valuable(row) and not row.equipped and not model.held(row,options.hold) then store[#store+1]=row end
    end
    for _,row in ipairs(model.sales(rows,options,mathModel)) do
        if not P.valuable(row) then sales[#sales+1]=row end
    end
    return sales,store
end
function P.confirm(pending,byKey,signatures)
    for key in pairs(pending.keys) do if byKey[key] then return false end end
    return pending.kind=="sell" or (signatures[pending.signature] or 0)>pending.before
end
return P

end)()
do (function()
    local a=R.ai;local policy=a.inventoryTripPolicy
    local player=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local remotes=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("remotes")
    local path="DQR/settings/Armstrong-inventory-trip-"..tostring(player.UserId)..".json"
    local state={stopped=false,record=nil,checked=false,lastRead=-100,busy=false,restored=false}
    local group=a.itemsTab:AddRightGroupbox("Inventory trips")
    local label=group:AddLabel("Automatic inventory checks · Inventory: 300 · Storage: 125",true)
    S.AutoLobbySell=S.AutoLobbySell==true;S.LobbySellAt=tonumber(S.LobbySellAt) or 270
    local function say(text)state.status=text;label:SetText(text)end
    local function lobby()return game.PlaceId==77649408247578 end
    local function flag(name)local v=player:FindFirstChild(name);return v and v.Value end
    local function loaded()return flag("dataLoaded")==true and flag("teleporting")==false end
    local function idle()return lobby() and loaded() and flag("inGame")==false and flag("busyTrading")==false
        and flag("inEnchant")~=true and flag("inBlacksmith")~=true end
    local function remote(name,class)
        local r=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild(name);assert(r and r:IsA(class),"Missing remote: "..name);return r
    end
    local function save()writefile(path,HTTP:JSONEncode(state.record))end
    local function gate()
        if state.record then return state.record.phase~="joining" or state.record.error~=nil or not state.record.enabled end
        return false
    end
    a.inventoryTripBlocks=function()return gate()~=nil and gate()~=false end
    a.inventoryTripNeedsLobby=function()return state.record~=nil and state.record.phase~="joining" end
    local function publish()a.inventoryTripBusy=a.inventoryTripBlocks()end
    local function clear()
        if isfile(path) then delfile(path) end
        state.record=nil;state.restored=false;state.checked=true;publish()
    end
    local function setting(key,value)
        if value==nil then return end
        local ok,why=a.applySessionCommand({command="setting",key=key,value=value});assert(ok,why)
    end
    local keys={"Master","AutoStart","AutoReady","AutoReplay","ReturnLobby","AutoLevelLobby","AutoLaunchLobby",
        "AutoJoinLobby","AutoRequestHost","JoinHost","JoinMaps","JoinDifficulties","JoinHardcoreOnly",
        "WaitForParty","PartyNames","Private","Hardcore","WaveDefence","LevelReq","DungeonPick","DifficultyPick"}
    local function begin()
        local resume={}
        for _,key in ipairs(keys) do local object=a.sessionControls.settings[key];if object then resume[key]=a.configValues.copy(object.Value)end end
        if inDungeon() then
            resume.DungeonPick=tostring(wsVal("dungeonName",S.Dungeon));resume.DifficultyPick=tostring(wsVal("difficulty",S.Difficulty))
        end
        state.record={format=1,phase=lobby() and "cleaning" or "returning",resume=resume,enabled=true}
        state.startedMaster=S.Master==true
        save();publish();say(lobby() and "Cleaning inventory" or "Inventory nearly full; returning after this run")
    end
    local function inventory()
        return a.itemModel.normalize(remote("reloadInvy","RemoteFunction"):InvokeServer())
    end
    local function paused(message)
        if state.record then state.record.error=tostring(message);pcall(save)end
        say("Paused: "..tostring(message));publish()
    end
    group:AddToggle("AutoLobbySell",{Text="Auto lobby to sell",Default=S.AutoLobbySell,Callback=function(v)
        S.AutoLobbySell=v;state.checked=false
        if not v and state.record then state.record.enabled=false;save();say("Trip paused. Resume or cancel below.")
        elseif v and state.record then state.record.enabled=true;save()end
        publish()
    end})
    group:AddSlider("LobbySellAt",{Text="Return at inventory count",Default=S.LobbySellAt,Min=50,Max=295,Rounding=0,
        Callback=function(v)S.LobbySellAt=v end})
    group:AddLabel("Finishes the run, sells matching items, stores unequipped legendaries and ultimates, then rejoins. Held and locked items stay with you.",true)
    group:AddButton({Text="Resume inventory trip",Func=function()
        if state.record then state.record.error=nil;state.record.enabled=true;state.record.departed=nil;state.record.launch=nil;save()end
        state.checked=false;state.startedMaster=false;publish()
    end})
    group:AddButton({Text="Cancel inventory trip",Func=function()
                                                                                 
        if state.record and state.record.pending then say("Resolve the pending item action before cancelling.");return end
        clear();setting("AutoLobbySell",false);say("Trip cancelled")
    end})
    local ok,record=pcall(function()if isfile(path)then return HTTP:JSONDecode(readfile(path))end end)
    if ok and type(record)=="table" and record.format==1 and type(record.resume)=="table" then state.record=record
    elseif not ok then say("Cannot read saved inventory trip");state.record={format=1,phase="cleaning",resume={},enabled=false,error="Saved trip unreadable"}end
    publish()
    local originalReplay=replayRun;local originalLobby=toLobby
    local function freshCheck()
        if not S.AutoLobbySell or state.record then return true end
        if not loaded() or state.reading then return false end
        state.reading=true
        local ok,rows=pcall(inventory);state.reading=false;assert(ok,rows)
        if state.record or not S.AutoLobbySell then return true end
        state.checked=true;state.lastRead=os.clock()
        if #rows>=math.clamp(tonumber(S.LobbySellAt) or 270,50,295) then begin()end
        publish();return true
    end
    replayRun=function()
        if a.inventoryTripBlocks()then return false end
        return originalReplay()
    end
    toLobby=function()
        if state.record then return false end
        return originalLobby()
    end
    for _,name in ipairs({"start","ready","make"}) do
        if name=="start" then local old=startRun;startRun=function(...)if a.inventoryTripBlocks()then return false end;return old(...)end
        elseif name=="ready" then local old=readyUp;readyUp=function(...)if a.inventoryTripBlocks()then return false end;return old(...)end
        else local old=makeLobby;makeLobby=function(...)if a.inventoryTripBlocks()then return false end;return old(...)end end
    end
    local function cleanup()
        local r=state.record
        local rows,byKey=inventory()
        local raw=remote("getPlayerStorage","RemoteFunction"):InvokeServer()
        local storageCount,signatures=policy.storage(raw)
        if r.pending then
            if policy.confirm(r.pending,byKey,signatures) then r.pending=nil;save()
            elseif os.time()>=r.pending.deadline then error("Item action unconfirmed; no repeat sent")
            else say("Waiting for item action confirmation")end
            return
        end
        local _,options=a.itemRuleOptions()
        local sales,store=policy.plan(rows,options,a.itemModel,a.upgradeMath)
        assert(idle(),"Lobby changed during inventory read")
        if #sales>0 then
            local payload={weapon={},helmet={},chest={},ability={}};local selected={}
            for i=1,math.min(50,#sales)do local row=sales[i];table.insert(payload[row.kind],row.id);selected[row.key]=true end
            r.pending={kind="sell",keys=selected,deadline=os.time()+25};save()
            remote("sellItemEvent","RemoteEvent"):FireServer(payload);say("Selling "..math.min(50,#sales).." items");return
        end
        if #store>0 then
            assert(storageCount<policy.storageCapacity,"Storage is full; free space, then resume")
            local row=store[1];local signature=policy.signature(row)
            r.pending={kind="store",keys={[row.key]=true},signature=signature,before=signatures[signature] or 0,deadline=os.time()+25};save()
            local accepted=remote("moveItemToStorage","RemoteFunction"):InvokeServer(row.kind,tostring(row.id))
            if accepted==false then r.pending=nil;save()end
            assert(accepted==true,"Storage transfer rejected; check inventory before resuming")
            say("Storing "..row.name);return
        end
        assert(#rows<math.clamp(tonumber(S.LobbySellAt) or 270,50,295),"Inventory still near full; adjust sell filters or free space")
        r.phase="joining";save();publish();say("Inventory ready; resuming dungeon")
    end
    local function rejoin()
        local r=state.record
        if not state.restored then
            setting("Master",r.resume.Master)
            for _,key in ipairs(keys) do if key~="Master" then setting(key,r.resume[key])end end
            state.restored=true
        end
        if inDungeon() and not lobby() then clear();say("Dungeon resumed");return end
        if r.resume.Master~=true then clear();say("Inventory ready");return end
        if not S.Master then paused("Bot stopped; resume the trip when ready");return end
        if a.sessionCarryActive or S.AutoLevelLobby or S.AutoRequestHost or S.AutoJoinLobby then return end
        if not loaded() then return end
        local games=workspace:FindFirstChild("games");local folder=games and games:FindFirstChild("inLobby")
        local own=folder and folder:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
        if r.launch then
            if os.time()>r.launch.deadline then error("Dungeon join unconfirmed; check lobby, then resume")end
            if r.launch.kind=="create" and own then r.launch=nil;save()else return end
        end
        if own then
            if a.partyReady and not a.partyReady() then return end
            r.launch={kind="start",deadline=os.time()+30};save()
            remote("startDungeon","RemoteEvent"):FireServer();return
        end
        if not idle() then return end
        r.launch={kind="create",deadline=os.time()+20};save()
        local accepted=remote("createLobby","RemoteFunction"):InvokeServer(S.Dungeon,S.Difficulty,tonumber(S.LevelReq) or 1,S.Hardcore==true,S.Private==true,S.WaveDefence==true)
        assert(accepted==true,"Dungeon lobby rejected; check selection, then resume")
    end
    local function step()
        if not loaded() then return end
        if not state.record then
            if S.AutoLobbySell and os.clock()-state.lastRead>=5 then freshCheck()end
            return
        end
        local r=state.record;publish()
        if not r.enabled or r.error then say("Paused: "..tostring(r.error or "trip disabled"));return end
        if state.startedMaster and not S.Master then paused("Bot stopped; resume the trip when ready");return end
        if r.phase=="joining" then rejoin();return end
        if not lobby() then
            local carryFinished=a.sessionCarryFresh and a.sessionCarryFresh() and (a.sessionCarryPlan.runComplete or
                a.sessionCarryPlan.place=="77649408247578" and table.find(a.sessionCarryPlan.rejoinUsers or {},tostring(player.UserId)))
            if not a.lifecycleOutcome() and not carryFinished and wsVal("dungeonStarted",true)~=false then return end
            if r.departed then
                if os.time()-r.departed>30 then error("Return to lobby unconfirmed; resume to try again")end
                return
            end
            r.departed=os.time();save();originalLobby();say("Returning to lobby to sell");return
        end
        if not idle() then say("Waiting for an idle lobby");return end
        r.phase="cleaning"
        if a.itemActionBusy or a.itemsPending or a.upgradePending then return end
        local token={};a.itemActionBusy=token
        local cleaned,why=pcall(cleanup)
        if a.itemActionBusy==token then a.itemActionBusy=nil end
        if not cleaned then error(why)end
    end
    Lib:OnUnload(function()state.stopped=true end)
    task.spawn(function()
        while not state.stopped and not Lib.Unloaded do
            task.wait(2)
            if state.stopped or Lib.Unloaded then break end
            local worked,why=pcall(step);if not worked then paused(why)end
        end
    end)
end)() end

do (function()
local player=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local path="DQR/settings/last-session-"..tostring(player.UserId)..".json"
    R.ai.settingsPath=path
    local state={muted=true,stopped=false,revision=0,scheduled=false,held={}}
    local function snapshot()
        local data={}
        for key,value in pairs(S)do
            if not CFG_SKIP[key] then data[key]=R.ai.configValues.copy(value)end
        end
        uiEach(function(_,key,obj)
            if not CFG_SKIP[key] then data[key]=R.ai.configValues.copy(obj.Value)end
        end)
        for key,value in pairs(state.held)do data[key]=value end
        return data
    end
    local function flush()
        if state.stopped or state.muted then return end
        local ok,why=pcall(function()
            assert(fileApi(),"File API unavailable")
            cfgFolders()
            local data=snapshot()
            local function equal(a,b)
                if type(a)~=type(b) then return false end
                if type(a)~="table" then return a==b end
                for k,v in pairs(a)do if not equal(v,b[k])then return false end end
                for k in pairs(b)do if a[k]==nil then return false end end
                return true
            end
            if equal(data,state.last) then return end
            writefile(path,HTTP:JSONEncode(data));state.last=data
        end)
        R.ai.settingsSaveError=not ok and tostring(why) or nil
        if not ok and not state.warned then
            state.warned=true;notify("Settings","Could not autosave settings. Check executor file support.",5)
        end
    end
    local function schedule()
        if state.scheduled or state.muted or state.stopped then return end
        state.scheduled=true
        local revision=state.revision
        task.delay(.4,function()
            state.scheduled=false
            if state.stopped then return end
            if revision~=state.revision then schedule();return end
            flush()
        end)
    end
    local ok,raw=pcall(readfile,path)
    if not ok then ok,raw=pcall(readfile,"DQR/settings/last-session.json")end
    if ok and type(raw)=="string" then
        local decoded,data=pcall(function()return HTTP:JSONDecode(raw)end)
        if decoded and type(data)=="table" then
            cfgApply(raw,true,true)
            for key in pairs(R.ai.configPaused)do
                if type(data[key])=="boolean" then state.held[key]=data[key]end
            end
        else notify("Settings","Last settings could not be read. Using defaults or your preset.",5)end
    end
    if R.ai.startupPreset then
        local preset=R.ai.startupPreset;R.ai.startupPreset=nil
        cfgApply(HTTP:JSONEncode(preset),true,true)
        for key,value in pairs(preset)do
            if R.ai.configPaused[key] and type(value)=="boolean" then state.held[key]=value end
        end
    end
    R.ai.settingsChanged=function()
        state.revision+=1;schedule()
    end
    R.ai.onPresetLoaded=function(values)
        for key in pairs(values)do state.held[key]=nil end
        R.ai.settingsChanged()
    end
                                                                      
    R.ai.resumeSavedSettings=function()
        local held=state.held;state.held={};state.muted=true
        for key,value in pairs(held)do S[key]=value end
        pushToUI()
        state.muted=false
        state.revision=state.revision+1;schedule()
    end
    uiEach(function(_,key,obj)
        local callback=obj.Callback
        obj.Callback=function(...)
            if state.stopped or state.muted then
                if type(callback)=="function" then return callback(...)end
                return
            end
            state.held[key]=nil
            if type(callback)=="function" then callback(...)end
            state.revision=state.revision+1
            if type(obj.Value)=="boolean" or type(obj.Value)=="table" then flush()else schedule()end
        end
    end)
    state.muted=false
    flush()
    local teleport=player.OnTeleport and player.OnTeleport:Connect(flush)
    R.ai.stopSettingsAutosave=function()
        if state.stopped then return end
        flush();state.stopped=true
        if teleport then teleport:Disconnect()end
    end
    Lib:OnUnload(function()R.ai.stopSettingsAutosave()end)
end)() end

pcall(function()
    Lib:OnUnload(function()
        if R.ai.stopAutoUpgrade then R.ai.stopAutoUpgrade() end; if R.ai.stopPotentialPredictor then R.ai.stopPotentialPredictor() end; if R.ai.stopItems then R.ai.stopItems() end; if R.ai.stopParty then R.ai.stopParty() end; if R.ai.stopUtilities then R.ai.stopUtilities() end
        if R.ai.stopAutoLevelLobby then R.ai.stopAutoLevelLobby() end

        R.ai.finishRunLearning("script unloaded")
        if R.privacy then R.privacy.unload() end
        R.ai.finishCorridor();R.ai.saveCorridors()
        R.ai.releaseRise()
        R.booted = false
    R.ai.generation += 1
    if R.ai.preview then R.ai.preview:Destroy() end
    R.ai.clearDangerCircle(true)
        R.farming = false
        stopMoving()
        releaseCamera()
        releaseBodyLock()
    end)
end)

pcall(function() Window:SelectTab(1) end)

notify("Armstrong Armory", "loaded. press " .. tostring(S.Hotkey) .. " or use the Main tab", 5)

                                                                       
getgenv().__UIBotResume=nil
                                                                       
do
    local replay=R.ai.replayRunButton
    R.ai.replayRunButton=function()
        pcall(R.ai.telemetrySave)
        pcall(R.ai.saveLearning)
        pcall(R.ai.saveCorridors)
        return replay()
    end
end
end
DQR.run()
